# How Do I Add a Quiz to My Course?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-add-a-quiz-to-my-course



<iframe />

On the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and above, you’ll see the option to **Create Quiz** inside the Course feature.

Creating and viewing a Quiz as a Host is available on **web** and **mobile web** only.Once you publish a Quiz, your members can view and complete it on **web**, **iOS**, and **Android**.

## Creating a Quiz

To create a Quiz, go to the "Create" button in a Course.

A Quiz always starts with an **introduction page**.

You can add a header image, native video, and text to introduce the Quiz and provide instructions. If Course Preview is turned on, this introduction will also appear there.

## Adding Questions

From the introduction page, you can start adding your questions.

When creating a question, you can attach:

* Images
* Native video (up to 2GB per file)
* GIFs
* Emoji

**Embedded video (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.) is not supported in Quiz questions.**

After adding your question text and any media, add up to **five responses** and select the one correct answer.

## Building and organizing your Quiz

* Use the **“+” icon** to add a question above or below the current one.
* Or click **Add a Question** in the upper right corner.
* Delete individual responses using the **“x”** next to each answer.
* Delete full questions using the **trash icon**.
* Reorder questions using the **three-line drag handle**.
* You can add up to **100 questions** per Quiz.

## Managing Your Quiz

Under **Manage Quiz Settings**, you’ll find visibility, unlock, and completion settings—similar to the Course feature.

## Visibility

Toggle the Quiz **on** or **off** to control when members can see it.

## Unlock Settings

Choose how the Quiz becomes available:

* **None** (unlocked)
* **Sequential**
* **Timed**
* **Scheduled**

## Showing Correct Answers

You can choose whether members see the correct responses on their results page.

* **Show correct answers ON**: Members can view which answers were correct after they submit.
* **Show correct answers OFF**: Useful if members need to pass before moving on—this prevents them from seeing correct answers before a retake.

## Completion Options

* **None**: Completion isn’t tracked.
  * Space Hosts and moderators can see all member responses.
  * Members see only their own responses.
* **Completed**: Members must complete the Quiz to continue.
* **Completed and Pass**: Members must complete and **pass** the Quiz to continue.
  * You can set a **Pass Score** as a percentage.

## Additional Settings

* You can change the **Quiz owner**, who must be a Space Host or Space moderator.
* You can edit questions or content anytime without affecting previous scores.
  * Edits only apply to **new attempts**.
* The **three-dot menu** lets you:
  * Adjust visibility
  * Download a **CSV** of Quiz results
  * Delete the Quiz

**Note:** Quiz results currently appear only in the CSV export. They do not appear in Mighty Insights™ or other completion dashboards—this is planned for the future.

## Member Experience

Members can take Quizzes on **web**, **iOS**, and **Android**.

To preview your Quiz as a member on mobile, use **mobile web** or temporarily demote your role to Space member.

Members will see a **“Ready to take the Quiz?”** prompt and a **Start** button.

**During the Quiz:**

* Members can see their progress.
* They can go back and change answers before submitting.
* They cannot skip questions.
* They must answer questions in order.
* Responses are **automatically saved**, so they can leave and return anytime.

**After submitting:**

* Members see their results, including any completion requirements.
* Members can retake the Quiz immediately or anytime after—there is no limit on attempts.

If you edit a Quiz while a member is taking it, they’ll receive a pop-up letting them know they need to restart.

Once added to a Course, members can **bookmark** the Quiz for quick access.

## Additional Notes

* Only **one Instructor** can be assigned per Quiz at a time.
* Commenting is not supported on Quizzes.
* You can edit or add questions even after members have started taking the Quiz.
* If you make edits while someone is taking it, they’ll be prompted to **restart**.
  * You’ll see how many members will be affected before confirming changes.
* Quizzes cannot be duplicated yet.
* If you duplicate a Space, the Quizzes inside it will **not** be duplicated (coming soon).


# How Do I Build a Course in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-build-a-course-in-my-mighty-network



<iframe />

## 3 Quick Steps to Get Started

On the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and up, you can create a Course inside a Space using one of our Course templates.

## 1. Create a Space Using a Course Template

When you [create a new Space](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces), select either a **Cohort Course Template** or **Content Course Template**.

**Cohort Course Template** includes:

* Course Community (**Feed**)
* Course Materials (**Course**)
* Discovery
* Members

**Content Course Template** includes:

* Course Materials (**Course**)
* Members

By default, a new Space is set to ["Only Logged in Members" can see the Space.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space) This lets you create your Course privately and share it when you're ready.

When creating your Space, you’ll choose:

* Space Name
* Tagline
* [Collection](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections)
* [Privacy Level](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space)

After you select **Create Space**, you’ll see three options:

* Charge for Access
* Invite People to Join
* View the Course

Select **View this Space** to start adding Course Materials and adjusting Course Settings.

## 2. Add Your Course Materials

A Course includes four content types:

* [**Overview**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons)
* [**Lessons**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons)
* [**Sections**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons)
* [**Quizzes**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-add-a-quiz-to-my-course)

### Instant Course Outline(AI Feature)

Use the Instant Course Outline to generate a first draft of your Course structure. This gives you Sections and Lessons you can refine as you go.

You can add several types of content to your Course, including images, videos, media, and file attachments.

To learn more, [**check out this article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/what-kind-of-media-can-i-upload-into-a-course).

## 3. Adjust Your Course Settings

You can update Course Settings at any time by going to the gear icon in the **Space > Space Features > Course.**

### Section Naming

Customize the name of the Course, Sections, Lessons and Quizzes.

### Display Style

On web and mobile, choose how your Course appears: **Thumbnail View**, **Simple View**, or **Grid View**.

Uses each Lesson’s default image. You can upload a custom thumbnail in each Lesson’s settings.

Displays Lessons and Sections in a simplified list. Videos show a play icon; Quizzes show a quiz icon.

Shows a more visual, dynamic layout. This view works best when you have multiple Lessons organized into Sections.

### Section Preferences

Choose where you would like all Sections expanded when a member first opens the Course or just a single Section.

**Expand All Sections:**

With this option, all Sections are expanded when a member opens the Course. As the member progresses through the Course, completed Sections will collapse.

**Expand Single Section:**

This option is helpful if your Course has many Sections and you don’t want to overwhelm members by showing all Lessons and Quizzes at once. Here’s how this option works:

* When a member first opens the Course, if the first Lesson or Quiz is in a Section, only that Section will be expanded. If the first Lesson or Quiz is not within a Section, all Sections will be collapsed.
* Sections will expand based on a member’s progress through the Course, with only one Section expanded at a time, unless the member chooses to expand other Sections as well.
* If the member is in-progress on a Quiz or Lesson that is not inside of a Section, then all Sections are collapsed, unless the member chooses to expand other Sections as well.

## Preview the Course

You can allow people outside the Course to preview Lessons or Sections, regardless of your Space’s privacy.

To enable this, go to each **Lesson Settings** or **Section Settings** page.

## Privacy

When your Course is ready, you can update [privacy](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space) or add a [paid plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan).Your Mighty Network’s overall privacy also affects who can see a Space.

## Invite and Manage Course Members

You can decide whether only Hosts and moderators can invite people to the Course, or whether all members can invite. By default, all members can invite.

To manage Course members, go to **Members**. You can:

* View all members
* Welcome and message members
* Download your Course member list

See our [inviting article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members) for more details.

## Making Your Course Visible

By default, a new Course and its contents (Overview, Lessons, and Sections) are set to **Hidden**.

This allows you to create content privately before making it visible to members.

## Make Your Entire Course Visible

1. Go to your Course.
2. Click the small **Select All** box in the upper-left corner.
3. Choose to make all—or any—Lessons or Sections **Visible** or **Hidden**.

## Make Individual Lessons or Sections Visible

You can also make specific items visible anytime:

* Go to **Manage Overview Settings**, **Manage Lesson Settings**, or **Manage Section Settings.**

When you make a Lesson, Section, or Overview visible, the following will appear to students:

* The **title**
* The **first few lines** of the body text
* The **thumbnail image**

Students will always be able to open and view the **Overview**.The [**Space privacy level**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space) also determines who can see any visible content.

## If You’re Starting From Scratch: Use a Live Course

If you don’t yet have Course content, you can run your first Course live.

Turn on the Feed feature as your main Course page, invite a small group of students, and follow a simple weekly rhythm:

1. **Topic:** Share it live (Zoom or Crowdcast).
2. **Case Study:** Show the Topic in action.
3. **Challenge:** Give members an action for the week.
4. **Result:** Help members achieve one win each week.

You can run a Live Course with as few as 5–10 people.

At the end of each week, add a Lesson or Section using video replays from your sessions.


# How Do I Generate Completion Certificates?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates



Sending members **Course completion certificates** gives them tangible proof of their progress. It builds confidence, motivates them to keep going, and deepens engagement in your community.

This article walks you through how to use **[Zapier](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-use-zapier-with-mighty-networks)** to automatically send certificates (or congratulatory messages) to members when they complete a Course.

If you’re not familiar with Zapier, it’s an automation tool that connects different apps so you can create simple workflows between them—no coding required.

**Note:** You’ll need a **paid Zapier account** to automate Course completion certificates. This workflow isn’t available on the free Zapier plan.

## Using Mighty Automations

You can also use our native **[Automations](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network)** feature to show a pop-up when a member completes a Course. This message can include a link where they can download their completion certificate.

## Using Zapier

## Building the Zap

To automate sending a certificate or completion message after a member finishes a Course, you’ll create a **Trigger** and an **Action** in Zapier.

## Step 1: Set Up Your Trigger

1. In Zapier, create a new Zap.

2. Select **Mighty Networks** as the **Trigger** app.

3. Choose **Course Progress Update** as the **Event**.

From here, you’ll configure which Course completion should trigger the Zap, then connect it to whatever tool you’re using to send certificates (for example, email or a certificate app).

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750388842381)

Click **Continue** and connect your Mighty Network in the **Account** section if you haven’t already.

Then select **Close** at the bottom of the Trigger box.

Next, select the **+** icon below the Trigger to add your **Action**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750418812301)

## Add an Action

For the next step in your Zap, add an **Action** and select **Filter**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750382604557)

Set the filter to:​**Progress Percentage → Exactly matches → 100**

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750404937741)

Setting this filter ensures that the member receives a completion certificate only after they’ve completed **100%** of the Course.

Click **Continue**, then add a new Action by selecting the **+** icon below the Action box.

Next, choose the app you want to use to generate your Certificate of Completion.

Popular options include **Canva**, **Google Slides**, **SimpleCert**, and **Certifier**.

## Creating a Certificate of Completion Using Google Slides

Start by **[creating your certificate](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1LdzFssNUfc1yg88ZA9KU9XWAPP5Ws1AY6egA9_DzSlI/template/preview)** in **Google Slides**. Google Slides includes a variety of ready-to-use templates, or you can design your own from scratch.

Once your certificate is ready, return to Zapier and select **Google Slides** as your Action app.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750418814349)

Choose **Create Presentation From Template** as the **Event**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750392889101)

If your Google account isn’t connected yet, Zapier will prompt you to connect it after you click **Continue**.

Under the **Action** settings:

* Give your certificate a unique name in the **Title of New Presentation** field. This title will appear for your members.

* If you want members to be able to **download** their certificate, set **Is Shared?** to **True**.

* In the **Template Presentation** dropdown, select the Google Slides file you created for your Certificate of Completion.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750405066637)

Once you’ve completed the setup, click **Continue**.

Zapier will then create a **test certificate** in your Google Slides account. This test pulls in sample data from your Trigger App based on how you mapped your fields in Google Slides.

To review it, go to your Google Slides account and open **All Slides** to find the test certificate.

## Modify the Zap to Send the Certificate to Your Members

In the same Zap, add another **Action** and choose **Email by Zapier** as the Action app.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750373187085)

Choose **Send Outbound Email** as the **Action Event**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750382610061)

Click **Continue**, then set up your email template.In the **To** field, select the email value from your **Trigger** using the dropdown menu.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750388853133)

Choose **User Email**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750418819341)

Fill in the **Subject** line with the text you want members to see when they receive their certificate. Then complete the **Body** of your email.

**Tip:** Use variables from your Trigger to personalize your message.

In the **Attachment** field, select your **Google Slides** Action, then choose the generated certificate file from the dropdown menu.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750382613517)

Complete any additional optional fields, then click **Continue** to test your Zap.

* If you used **your own email address** in the **To** field, you’ll receive a test email from your Mighty Network through Zapier Mail.

* If you mapped a **customer’s email address**, Zapier will send the test to that customer’s inbox.

After a successful test, make sure to switch your Zap **from Off to On** so it runs automatically.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-generate-completion-certificates/18750388861197)

Remember, you can always return to your Zap to update the certificate template or adjust your email message at any time.

**Note:** If you add or remove Lessons or Sections in your Course, be sure to **test your Zap again** to confirm it still fires correctly when members reach 100% completion.

## What Will My Member Experience?

When your Zap is turned on, Zapier will automatically create and send a certificate to members as soon as they complete your Course.

When a member selects **Mark as Complete** on the final Lesson, the Zap will fire and they’ll receive their Certificate of Completion right away.


# How Do I Organize My Course With Overviews, Sections, and Lessons?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons



On the [**Launch plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan)**,** and up you can create Courses with four content types:

* Overview
* Sections
* Lessons
* [Quizzes](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-add-a-quiz-to-my-course)

You can use these in many ways—whether you’re building a Course, organizing a resource library, or designing a step-by-step learning path. All Course content is created and edited on web.

With each of the content types, you can format, add images, videos, pdfs, embeds and more. [**Check out this article to learn more.**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/what-kind-of-media-can-i-upload-into-a-course)

You can create **up to 500 total Sections and Lessons** in each Course feature you add to your Mighty Network.

## Overview

Your Overview is the introduction to your Course. It’s where you add the description, expectations, and guidelines members will need before getting started.

## Add an Overview

When you enable the Course feature for the first time, you'll see an example Overview.

You can edit this example provided to add your own image and text.

## Overview Settings

At the bottom of your Overview, select **Manage Overview Settings** to:

* Make the Overview [**Visible**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-build-a-course-in-my-mighty-network) [or Hidden](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-build-a-course-in-my-mighty-network)
* Use the default thumbnail or upload a custom thumbnail
* Enable **Previewing** for visitors

When you’re done, continue building out your Sections and Lessons.

## Sections

Sections help you organize related material. Think of each Section as a mini-overview for a specific topic or module. Each Section contains Lessons.

## Add a Section

To add a Section:

1. Go to **Course > Create > Add Section**.
2. Add your title and content.
3. Save your Section.

After saving, open **Manage Section Settings** to:

* Add or reorder Lessons
* Make the Section [**Hidden**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-build-a-course-in-my-mighty-network) [or Visible](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-build-a-course-in-my-mighty-network)
* Add an [Unlock Rule](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-track-member-completion-and-progress) (for example, completing the Overview or another Lesson)
* Add a Completion button
* Edit the thumbnail
* Enable **Previewing** for visitors

Section instructors update automatically based on the Lessons inside that Section.

## Add Sections to an Existing Course

Scroll to the bottom of your Course and select **Create** to add a new Section.

## Lessons

Lessons can stand alone or be placed inside Sections.

## Add a Lesson

To add a Lesson:

1. Go to **Course > Create > Add Lesson**.
2. Add your content.
3. Save your Lesson.

Then use **Manage Lesson Settings** to:

* Make the Lesson **Hidden** or **Visible**
* Add an Unlock Rule
* Add a Completion button
* Change the Instructor
* Edit the thumbnail
* Enable **Previewing**

## Managing Course Content

## Course Settings

For overall Course settings like naming, section behavior and display style, [check out this article.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-build-a-course-in-my-mighty-network)

## Previewing Sections and Lessons

You can preview specific Sections or Lessons to people who haven’t joined the Space.

Inside a Lesson or Section, open **Settings** and enable **Preview**.

Visitors will see a **Preview** icon next to any content you’ve made available. Content with a lock icon remains hidden.

## Bookmarking Sections and Lessons

Members can bookmark Sections and Lessons on web:

1. Hover over the Section or Lesson.
2. Open the **three-dot menu**.
3. Select **Bookmark**.

Bookmarked content appears in **Bookmarks** on both web and mobile.

## Featuring or Pinning Sections and Lessons

You can feature Sections and Lessons in the Space’s **Featured** or **Welcome** Section.

* Hidden coursework won’t appear in Featured.
* Once visible, it will reappear.
* What’s shown depends on the Space’s visibility settings.
* Pinning and unpinning must be done on web.

## Bulk Actions

You have some bulk action options with your content.

At the top of, you will see the option to "Bulk Select" You can select all content or just some.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 04 14 At 10 02 50 AM 1" title="Screenshot 2026 04 14 At 10 02 50 AM 1" />
</Frame>

Once you select the content, go to the three dot menu in the right corner.

You will see options depending on the content that you selected.

#### Overview and Sections:

* Edit Thumbnail
* Turn on/off preview

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 04 14 At 10 04 42 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 04 14 At 10 04 42 AM" />
</Frame>

#### Lessons:

* Turn on/off comments
* Assign Owner
* Completion Settings
* Edit Thumbnail
* Turn on/off preview

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 04 14 At 10 06 05 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 04 14 At 10 06 05 AM" />
</Frame>

## Duplicate, Reorder, and Move Content

You can duplicate, reorder and [move content](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-move-content-between-spaces) at any time by selecting the three dot menu.

When you duplicate a Section, it will duplicate all the content inside as well

To reorder content, click on **Reorder** at the top of the content and drag and drop whatever you would like to move.

Select **"Finish Reordering"** when you are done.


# How Do I Track Member Completion and Progress?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-track-member-completion-and-progress



When creating or managing [**Lessons**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons) inside the [**Course feature**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-build-a-course-in-my-mighty-network), you can set both **unlocking** and **completion** requirements. These settings help guide members through your Course in the order and pace you choose.

To update settings for a Lesson, open the Lesson and select **Manage Lesson Settings**.

<img alt="" />

## Unlock Options for Lessons

These are the unlock options available today:

<img alt="" />

## None

The Lesson is available immediately when the member starts the Course.

## Sequential

Members unlock the Lesson only after completing the previous one.This is a per-user experience, so unlock timing varies by member.

## Timed

The Lesson unlocks a set number of days after a member joins the Space.

* Unlocks at the exact join time (e.g., joined at 12pm → unlocks at 12pm).
* Members are notified when new material unlocks.
* If new Lessons are added after a member joins, timers still apply to the **original** join date.
* If a member leaves and rejoins, the timer still uses the **first** join date.
* Bulk-selecting Timed Unlock applies the **same unlock day** to all selected Lessons.
  * To stagger unlocks (e.g., Day 7 → Day 14 → Day 21), set each Lesson individually.

## Scheduled

The Lesson unlocks on a specific date and time.

* To keep it hidden until the unlock date, set the Lesson to **Hidden**.
* If Visible, members can see the Lesson title but can’t access content until the unlock time.

## Important

Any unlock changes apply to **existing members and new members**.

To change the Unlock Settings for multiple Lessons at once, hover your cursor over a Lesson and tick the box to the left. You'll then see the option to select multiple Lessons or Select All.

## What Locked Lessons Look Like

Locked Lessons will have a time icon, when hovering over it will show when the Lesson will unlock.

<img alt="" />

## Unlock Notifications

For **Scheduled** and **Timed** unlocks, you can choose whether members receive a notification.

* **Toggle ON** → Members receive a notification when the Lesson unlocks.
* **Toggle OFF** → No notification is sent.

This toggle is disabled for all other unlock types.

<img alt="" />

## Completion Tracking for Lessons

These are the available completion options:

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 14 At 8 44 18 AM" />
</Frame>

## None

The completion of the Lesson won't be tracked.

## Visited

A member must open the Lesson to complete it.

## Button

A member must click **Mark as Complete**.

**Note:** If Unlock Settings = **None**, Button Completion does **not** block access to the next Lesson. To require completion, use **Sequential** unlocking.

## Video

A member must watch the entire **tracked** video.

* You can track **native MP4 uploads** or **embedded YouTube videos**.
* Loom, Vimeo, and Wistia **cannot** be tracked.
* Only **one** tracked video per Lesson.
* Choose the tracked video using the **timer icon**.
* Members may fast-forward through both embedded and native videos.

Video resumes where members left off only when tracking is enabled.

## Additional Notes

* You cannot reset completion on behalf of a member.
* Edits to completion settings apply immediately to all members.
* If you add a new video and enable tracking, members who previously completed the Lesson **stay completed**.
* If you choose any of the completion options, there will be a checkmark next to the Lesson once it's been completed.

## Completion Automation

You can use Automations to assign **Badges, send confetti and more** when members complete a:

* Lesson
* Section
* Quiz

[**Learn more here**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network)

## Measuring Member Completion

If completion tracking is on, you can see each member’s progress at a glance.

Go to:

**Space Settings > Members > Member List**

You’ll see:

* % complete
* Last Lesson or Quiz viewed
* Last Lesson or Quiz completed

Completion data also appears in the downloadable member list and inside the Members feature (if enabled in the Space).

## Reset Progress

You can also allow members to reset their Course progress:

1. Go to the Space’s **gear icon**.
2. Select **Features > Course > Reset Progress** and toggle it on.

When enabled, members can reset their progress:

* From the **Next Up** card (three-dot menu).
* On both web and mobile.

## What happens when progress is reset:

* Lesson progress and Quiz attempts are cleared.
* Locked content may become locked again.
* Hosts cannot reset progress on a member’s behalf.
* Previous Quiz attempts still appear in the CSV export.
* If a removed member rejoins with the same account, their previous Course progress is restored.

## Understanding the “Next Up” Section

The **Next Up** section guides members through the Course based on your settings.It appears only when:

* Completion tracking is enabled, **and**
* Unlock or completion rules apply.

**Space Hosts do not see Next Up** (members only).


# What Kind of Media Can I Upload Into a Course?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/what-kind-of-media-can-i-upload-into-a-course



You can add several types of content to your Course, including images, videos, media, and file attachments. These can appear in your [**Overview**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons), [Sections, and Lessons](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons).

## Adding a Primary Image or Video

First, you will add a **hero image or video URL at the top of your content.**

* **Recommended image size:** 2560 x 1440 pixels (16:9 ratio)
* **Supported video platforms:** YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, and more

To delete or change media, select **the media** and use the **trash icon.**

## Formatting Text

Highlight any text in the editor to:

* Add **headers** (five levels available)
* Apply **bold**, *italic*, strikethrough, or underline
* Add **quotes** or change text **color** and **highlight color**
* Insert **hyperlinks**

## Adding Rich Media

To upload media within your Course:

1. Press **Enter** to create a new line.
2. Select the **+** button on the left side of the editor.
3. Choose to add a **photo**, **video**, [**media embed**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-external-embeds), **file attachment**, or **section divider**.

To add a line of text below a media item, hover under it and click the arrow that appears.

## How to Upload a Video

1. Open the **Overview**, a **Section**, or a **Lesson**.
2. Click the **+** icon to open the quick insert toolbar.
3. Select **Video.**
4. Choose your video file. You’ll see a progress bar during upload, and the file will appear greyed out while it processes.
5. Once processing is complete, you can update the preview thumbnail, enable video tracking, and save.

## Video Tracking

Video Tracking allows you to require members to watch an entire video before they can move to the next Lesson.​ [Learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-track-member-completion-and-progress) about completion features in Courses.

## Upload Limitations

* **Files larger than 250 MB cannot be uploaded.**
  * As a Host, you can decide if you want your members to upload 250MB or keep them at a smaller file upload limit: 25MB. You can make this decision in Admin > Member Settings
* **Videos larger than 4 GB cannot be uploaded.**

## Additional Notes

* • The max video **upload size of 4 GB** applies to: Network Hosts<br />• **The max file upload size of 25 MB** applies to: Network Hosts, Space Hosts or Space moderators.
* **Storage limits:** On newer plans (Explore, Launch, Scale, Growth), course videos count toward your Network's storage limit. Legacy plans with unlimited course videos are not affected by this change.
* Videos cannot be downloaded from a Course.
* Supported file types include **.mp4**, **.mov**, **.m4v**, and many others (full list below).
* You can’t save or close content while a video is uploading. You *can* save during processing and navigate elsewhere in your Mighty Network. You’ll receive a notification when processing finishes.
* You can continue embedding video from other platforms. Previously embedded videos don’t need to be changed unless you prefer to upload them natively.
* Members must watch the entire tracked video to unlock the next Lesson or resource.
* Playback speed controls are available for both natively uploaded videos and YouTube embeds on web and mobile web.
* If a video is paused, it resumes where the member left off—[**Video Tracking must be turned on**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-track-member-completion-and-progress) for this to work.

## Supported File Types

* **video/mp4:** mp4, mpg4, f4v, f4p, mp4v
* **video/webm:** webm
* **video/avi:** avi
* **video/ogg:** ogg, ogv
* **application/ogg:** ogx
* **video/mpeg:** mp2, mp3g, mpe, mpeg, mpg, m1v, m2v
* **video/3gpp:** 3gp, 3gpp
* **video/x-ms-asf:** asf, asx
* **video/x-ms-wmv:** wmv
* **video/quicktime:** qt, mov
* **video/mp2t:** ts, mts, m2ts, cpi, clpi, mpl, mpls, bdm
* **video/x-flv:** flv
* **video/x-matroska:** mk3d, mks, mkv
* **application/mxf:** mxf

## Using Hashtags in Courses

You can add [**hashtags**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-hashtags-work-in-my-mighty-network) (#) to connect related Course content.Start typing a hashtag, and a list of existing hashtags or highlighted ones in your Space will appear.

To learn how to Build a Course, [**check out this article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-build-a-course-in-my-mighty-network).


# Can I Add Marketing Pixels to My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/can-i-add-marketing-pixels-to-my-mighty-network



Yes! Once you’ve upgraded to the [**Launch Plan or higher**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan), you can add your own **marketing pixels**—including a Facebook (Meta) Pixel or TikTok Pixel—to track conversions from your ads and optimize your campaigns.

## Events Tracked by Meta and TikTok Pixels

Mighty Networks currently supports several standard tracking events:

* **CompleteRegistration:** Triggers when a new member joins your Mighty Network.
* **AddPaymentInfo:** Fires whenever a user adds payment information.
* **InitiateCheckout:** Fires when a user begins the checkout process.
* **CompletePurchase (TikTok)** / **Purchase (Facebook):** Fires when a purchase is completed.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 36 38 AM" />

## How to Add Your Marketing Pixels

1. Go to **Admin > Integrations > Marketing Pixels.**
2. Enter your **Meta Pixel ID** or **TikTok Pixel ID.**
3. Read and accept the [**Terms of Use**](https://www.mightynetworks.com/terms-of-use?utm_source=intercom\&utm_medium=getting_started\&utm_campaign=our_policies\&utm_content=) to activate tracking.

Once added, your pixel will immediately begin tracking eligible events.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 36 56 AM" />

## Cookie Banner and Privacy Settings

When you enable Marketing Pixels, your Cookie Privacy Banner will automatically display a **“Do Not Sell”** button, giving members control over whether their information is tracked.

If a member selects **“Do Not Sell,”** their activity will not be tracked.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 37 20 AM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 37 20 AM" />

If you don’t use Marketing Pixels, members instead see a **“Reject Targeting Cookies”** option on the banner.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 37 35 AM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 37 35 AM" />

If you add pixels later, members will be **re-prompted** with the updated cookie banner.

This ensures transparency and compliance with global privacy standards.

### About the “CompleteRegistration” Event

When a new member completes registration **and accepts all cookies**, Mighty Networks temporarily activates your pixel to fire the **CompleteRegistration** event.

The pixel is **not maintained during regular site usage**, ensuring strong privacy protection and optimal site performance.

# Does Mighty Networks Have Built-In Affiliates?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/does-mighty-networks-have-built-in-affiliates



<iframe />

## How to Set Up Affiliate Integrations on Mighty

On the [**Scale Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-business-plan)\*\* and up\*\*, you can set up a paid affiliate integration for your Mighty Network.

Go to **Admin > Integrations > Affiliate Programs** to get started.

Mighty integrates directly with [**Rootabl**](https://withrootabl.com/mighty/) and [**Rewardful**](https://www.rewardful.com/), two affiliate platforms that make it easy to track and reward referrals for your paid plans.

Both integrations work if you’re taking payments on Mighty through a [**Stripe account**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network), and they only track purchases made on the **web** (purchases made via iOS or Android will not be credited).

If a member upgrades, downgrades, or changes plans, both integrations continue to track the revenue associated with that member.

Commissions automatically update based on the new subscription price, following your rules in Rootabl or Rewardful.

If a member pays in installments, the payout schedule is managed through your settings on the affiliate platform.

\[[*Note: if you take payments off-platform and are interested in using a paid affiliate program, check out the options below.*](#:~:text=Affiliate%20Options%20if%20You%20Take%20Payments%20Off%2DPlatform)]\([https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform))

## How to Set Up Your Integration

Setup is quick:

1. Go to **Admin > Integrations > Affiliate Programs**.
2. Paste your personalized **Rootabl** or **Rewardful** ID into Mighty.
3. Share your **plan links** with affiliates.

You can manage affiliate payouts, rules, and campaigns directly within Rootabl or Rewardful.

Learn how to connect and use **Rootabl**, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/can-i-integrate-my-mighty-network-with-rootabl).

Learn how to connect and use **Rewardful**, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/can-i-integrate-my-mighty-network-with-rewardful).

The campaigns you set up in either Rootabl or Rewardful will allow you to specify the affiliate payouts that you’d like to offer for each specific plan.

## How It Works

* You define affiliate payouts in Rootabl or Rewardful for each plan.
* Mighty’s **plan share links** can be visible or hidden (External or Internal).
* Only **new members** to your Mighty Network are credited as eligible referrals.

You can use one paid affiliate integration at a time, but you can also use it [**alongside Mighty’s free Ambassador Program**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-use-the-mighty-networks-ambassador-program).

## Using Affiliate Programs with Off-Platform Payments

If you take payments outside Mighty, you can connect your preferred affiliate service directly to that payment platform.

**Options to explore:**

* [Rootabl](https://withrootabl.com/mighty/) *(also supports off-platform payments)*
* [Rewardful(also supports off-platform payments)](https://www.rewardful.com/?via=brand\&utm_id=13807429166_121840508822\&utm_cid=13807429166\&utm_agid=121840508822\&utm_dev=c\&utm_devicemodel=\&utm_mt=e\&utm_source=google\&utm_medium=cpc\&utm_campaign=geoWW_Brand\&utm_term=rewardful\&gad_source=1\&gclid=Cj0KCQjwr9m3BhDHARIsANut04YiO4sn-g_vfgOrjUZJBgKuEW-o7HUY1P7XIhzomKiKllO2vlPSDjQaAt5GEALw_wcB)
* [ThriveCart](https://support.thrivecart.com/help/the-complete-affiliate-setup-walkthrough/)
* [Affiliatly](https://www.affiliatly.com/)

After a member purchases externally, send them a **hidden plan invite** to your Mighty Network.​[Learn more about setting up plans for off-platform payments.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Which Mighty Plans can use the new Affiliate integrations?**

The Rootabl and Rewardful integrations are available for Hosts on the Scale plan and up.

**Do my affiliates have to be my members?**

Nope! You can build an affiliate network that goes beyond your members on Mighty. They don’t have to be members IN your Mighty Network to refer people TO your Mighty Network.

**Can I use these programs if I run payments off-platform?**

No, you need to run web payments through Mighty in order for these integrations to work.

**Are affiliate programs part of my Mighty subscription or are they an additional fee?**

These are integrations, so you’ll need to subscribe to additional software to use them. Rootabl offers a [<u>special discount for Mighty Hosts</u>](https://withrootabl.com/mighty/), and Rewardful’s pricing can be explored [<u>here</u>](https://www.rewardful.com/pricing).

**Can I use both Mighty’s Ambassador program and one of the affiliate partners?**

Launch Plans and up can enable the [<u>Ambassador program</u>](https://faq.mightynetworks.com/en/articles/3825219-how-do-i-use-the-mighty-networks-ambassador-program) to provide members with their own unique links to earn Bronze, Silver and Gold badges as they invite more members.

The paid affiliate integrations can be used in parallel with the Ambassador program if desired—but the two things use different links for referring members, so your affiliates' Rootabl links won't count towards Ambassador levels and vice versa.\
​\
One idea: Your top Ambassadors can then be invited into a paid affiliate program as a reward, to keep their momentum going.

**What if someone has cookies disabled?**

To adhere to privacy regulations, referrals are not tracked/applied for prospective members with cookies disabled.

**What if someone changes their email address?**

Both Rootabl and Rewardful affiliate links remain functional even if Host or member emails are changed.

**Are multiple currencies supported?**

Rootabl currently only shows charges and commissions in USD. Affiliates can be paid out commissions in their preferred currency (any currency supported by Stripe).

[<u>Learn more</u>](https://help.rewardful.com/en/articles/6057044-choosing-a-display-currency) about currencies on Rewardful.

**Can I share free plan links with these affiliate integrations?**

Affiliates can share free plans and they will be able to see who they have referred.

On Rootabl, they will only receive commission rewards upon purchase.

**What if a prospective member is referred by multiple affiliates?**

Rootabl allows Hosts to determine if they’d prefer first or last-click attribution for prospective members.

Rewardful credits the last affiliate link followed by the prospective members.

**How do affiliate payouts work with plan trials?**

Hosts can specify a duration on Rootabl for extended trial lengths (before crediting the referrer), however on Mighty, this length is limited to 90 days maximum (after which the referral will no longer be credited).

On Rewardful, they will only receive commission rewards upon purchase.

**How do refunds work with affiliates?**

On Rootabl, refunds within 29 days are automatically tracked through Stripe and do not earn a commission.

If the refund window is 30 days or longer, Mighty Hosts need to [<u>reach out to Rootabl</u>](https://intercom.help/rootabl/en/) to extend the payout settings, as commissions are frozen and withdrawn 30 days after purchase to pay out affiliates.

Please refer to [<u>Rewardful’s refund policies</u>](https://friends.rewardful.com/terms).

**How are taxes handled?**

Rootabl takes care of your entire payout system, including reporting, tax document collection, and paying out affiliates in their preferred currency and location. This is done with a small fee on top of commissions. Learn more here.

Please refer to [<u>Rewardful’s tax policy</u>](https://friends.rewardful.com/terms).

**Can I use both Mighty’s Ambassador program and one of the affiliate programs?**

Yes! Launch plans and up can enable the Ambassador program to provide members with their own unique links to earn Bronze, Silver and Gold badges as they invite more members.

Paid affiliate programs can be used in parallel with the Ambassador program if a Host would like to do so.

**Can I use multiple affiliate programs at once?**

Only one paid affiliate integration at a time can be active on a Mighty Network.

**I use a different affiliate program, will you be adding support for it?**

We’ll be evaluating Host feedback as we consider adding support for additional affiliate programs.

**Do plan links shared with integrated affiliate programs work if I use SSO (Single Sign-On) on my Mighty Network?**

Yes!


# How Can I Customize My Mighty Networks Landing Page?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-customize-my-mighty-networks-landing-page



<iframe title="YouTube video player" />

Your **Landing Page** is the front door to your Mighty Network—a single-page website where you can share your **Big Purpose**, **Ideal Member**, and the **benefits** of joining your community.

It's accessible via your Mighty Network's [**subdomain**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/can-i-change-the-default-mnco-domain-for-my-mighty-network) or [**custom domain**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/can-i-use-my-own-web-domain-with-mighty-networks), and you can add unlimited text, photos, videos, and more.

Need inspiration? Review the [Mighty Branding Guide](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1keL3CuVbG8sBotTm9IkyPFKWZGoFnASUQvqTNzqnk54/edit?usp=sharing) for quick tips to create a beautifully branded Mighty Network.

## How to Set Up Your Landing Page

To get started, go to **Admin > Marketing > Landing Pages** — the direct path is `/admin/landing-page/settings`.

***You'll need to customize your Landing Page on the web version of Mighty Networks. Editing isn't available in the mobile apps.***

You can create multiple **drafts** of your Landing Page, but only **one published version** can be live at a time.

## Landing Page Sections

Your Landing Page is organized into **sections**, which you can edit, rearrange, duplicate, or delete.

It automatically honors your Network's **light** or **dark mode** settings.

**To edit a section:**

Hover over any section to see editing options in the upper middle

To add a new section, move your mouse to the middle of a section, then click the "+" icon.

**Here you will see the available section types:**

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 30 At 11 53 10 AM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 30 At 11 53 10 AM" />

### Heading

This adds a basic header area that can be used with or without media. It includes the option for an optional button that can be customized to load different destinations on your Mighty Network, or alternately use any URL you provide. Images should be at least 1920x1080.

### Centered Heading

This adds a centered version of the Heading section, without media. It includes the option for an optional button that can be customized to load different destinations on your Mighty Network, or alternately use any URL you provide.

### Media with Text

This adds a basic section that can be used with or without media. It includes the option for an optional button that can be customized to load different destinations on your Mighty Network, or alternately use any URL you provide. Images should be at least 1200x675.

### Full-Width Heading

This adds a section that bleeds all the way to the edges of the screen, with an optional image or video underneath the content. It includes the option for an optional button that can be customized to load different destinations on your Mighty Network, or alternately use any URL you provide. Media should be at least 3840x2160.

### Media

This adds a section specifically for an image or video (either an uploaded video file, up to 4 GB, or a video URL). Images should be at least 2400x1350.

### Story Block

This adds a stylized placement (with or without an image) that's great for focusing on a single feature or selling point. Images should be at least 560x560.

### Double Story Blocks

This adds a stylized set of side-by-side columns (with or without images) to help you shine a spotlight on top features. Images should be at least 320x320.

### Feature List

This adds a set of feature columns (with or without images) to help showcase what prospective members will get after joining your community.

### Benefits List

This adds a set of benefits (with a checkmark icon next to each) to help you easily outline reasons to join your community.

### FAQ

This adds a question and answer section, with the ability to reorder and add/delete questions. It's great for giving prospective members quick answers.

### Download App

This adds an area with links and a QR code to encourage members to download the app for the best mobile experience.

### Plan Carousel

This displays a carousel of all visible plans on your Mighty Network, with different ordering options to choose from.

### Featured Plan

This will allow you to highlight a specific plan.

As a note, you will need to make sure that the [visibility for the plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) is set to show on the Landing Page in order to feature it.

Here's a quick demo:

<iframe />

### Waitlist

This adds a **Waitlist** section, letting you collect interest and email signups before your Mighty Network, a new Plan, or an upcoming offering is ready to launch. Choose to create a new waitlist or add an existing one, then customize the heading, description, call-to-action button, background image, and an optional countdown timer.

Learn more in [How Do I Create a Waitlist?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-waitlist)

**Note:** Waitlists are currently available on web only.

## Editing Sections

Once you select a section to edit, a **right-hand panel** appears where you can:

* Edit text
* Add media
* Adjust layout and alignment
* Customize button behavior

## Publishing Your Landing Page

You can preview your Landing Page on desktop or mobile web by toggling the **device view** at the top of the screen.

After you publish, your Landing Page becomes visible to anyone who visits your Mighty Network on the web and isn't signed in.

To view your Landing Page as a visitor:

* Log out of your Mighty Network and use an incognito window, or
* Visit your Network's URL followed by **/landing** (for example, yournetworkurl.com/landing).

## Multiple Landing Pages

Hosts on the [**Growth Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan) and [**Mighty Pro**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/what-is-mighty-pro) can publish multiple Landing Pages at once, each with its own unique URL.

* Growth Plan Hosts can publish up to **3 Landing Pages**.
* Mighty Pro Hosts can publish up to **10 Landing Pages**.

Each Landing Page includes an **internal title** that only Hosts can see.

From the **three-dot menu**, you can:

* Edit Page
* Manage Page Settings
* Preview Page
* Copy Landing Page URL
* Duplicate as New Draft
* Publish or Unpublish Page
* Delete Page

Within **Page Settings**, you can:

* Rename the Internal Title
* Customize the URL path
* Choose whether it's your primary Landing Page
* Add SEO information

# How Do I Create an Email Newsletter?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-create-an-email-newsletter



On the [**Scale Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-business-plan) and up, you can seamlessly integrate your [**Kit**](http://kit.com/) account with your **Mighty Network** to send customizable email newsletters, drip campaigns, and more.

With this built-in integration, you can add the following Mighty content directly into your Kit emails:

* [Plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)
* [Articles](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network)
* [Events](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network)
* [Members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members)
* Lists (e.g., Top Articles, Top Members, and Upcoming Events)

**Note:** Posts aren’t included in this integration.

<Note>
  **Already connected Kit?** To move to the latest version of the integration, disconnect and then reconnect from your Mighty Network under **Admin > Integrations > Kit**. Your sync settings are saved to your Network and carry over, so confirm them once you reconnect.
</Note>

## Before You Begin

To use this integration, you’ll need a Kit account on the **Creator** or **Creator Pro** plan.

As a Mighty Network Host, you’ll also receive a [**30-day extended free trial**](https://app.kit.com/users/signup?promo=30MNE23) to try Kit and explore the integration.

## How to Connect Kit

You can connect from either Mighty or Kit.

### From Mighty Networks

1. Go to **Admin > Integrations > Kit**.
2. Select **Connect Kit**.
3. You’ll be redirected to [Kit](http://kit.com/), where you can either create a new account or log in to an existing one.

You will see two screens to authorize the connection

### From Kit

1. Go to the [Mighty Networks app details page](https://app.kit.com/apps/4177) or the [Kit App Store](https://app.kit.com/apps).
2. Select **Install** and follow the prompts to connect your Mighty Network.
3. If your Network uses a custom domain, you may be asked to enter your Network address to continue.

## Syncing Member Data

**Sync Member Data** is off by default. Enable it to sync member information between Mighty and Kit.

When you enable it, a confirmation message appears. Once syncing is active:

1. Mighty Network member information is synced to your Kit account.
2. Members receive the tags “Your Network Name” and “Mighty Networks Integration.”
3. If a member leaves, is banned, or deleted, the “Mighty Networks Integration” tag is removed.
4. Updates to member names or emails in Mighty automatically sync to Kit.
5. Members who have unsubscribed from marketing emails aren’t synced.

## Limited Memberships

[Limited memberships](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership)—those with access to specific Spaces only—are also synced and receive three tags:

* **Mighty Integration**
* **\[Network Name]**
* **Limited Member \[Network Name]**

To find active limited members, filter by members with both **Mighty Integration** and **Limited Member \[Network Name]** tags.

For more information on syncing your member data, [check out this article](https://help.kit.com/en/articles/8440987-managing-mighty-networks-subscribers).

## Syncing Tags

If **Sync Member Data** is enabled, you’ll also see the option to **Sync Mighty Tags**.

<u>Tags</u> are internal member segments that can be synced with Kit to create email audiences (for example, “Legacy Members” or “First-Time Homebuyers”).

When a new Tag is created in Mighty, it automatically appears in Kit as:<br />(Network Name) (Mighty)

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot2026 03 23at11 45 12AM" />
</Frame>

## Syncing Waitlist Leads

If you're running a [Waitlist](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-waitlist), you can automatically sync waitlist signups to Kit.

1. Go to **Admin > Integrations > Kit**.
2. Turn on **Sync Waitlist Emails**.

Waitlist signups are sent to Kit with the **Waitlist Name** and **Mighty Networks Integration** tags. Once someone creates an account, their Network tag is added too.

**Note:** Turning on syncing will sync existing signups retroactively.

## Deleting or Editing Tags

If you delete a Tag in Mighty:

* Members are unsubscribed from that Tag in Kit.

Any changes made directly in Kit (like renaming or deleting a Tag) will be overwritten during the next sync. Mighty is always the **source of truth** for Tags.

## How to Use the Integration

To start using the integration:

1. In Kit, go to [**Send > Broadcast**](https://help.kit.com/en/articles/2934648-creating-sending-and-sharing-broadcasts) or [**Sequence**](https://help.kit.com/en/articles/2502629-creating-and-sending-a-sequence-in-convertkit).
2. Open the email editor and click the **+** icon.
3. Choose from new **Mighty Networks content blocks** to add content directly from your Network.

## How to Disconnect Kit

You can disconnect Kit from either Mighty or Kit. Disconnecting from your Mighty Network is the most reliable way to fully end the connection on both sides.

### From Mighty Networks

1. Go to **Admin > Integrations > Kit**.
2. Select **Disconnect**.
3. Confirm the disconnection when prompted.

### From Kit

1. Go to the [Mighty Networks app details page](https://app.kit.com/apps/4177) or the [Kit App Store](https://app.kit.com/apps).
2. Select **Uninstall**.
3. Confirm in the pop-up window.

**Note:** It may take a few minutes for changes to fully sync after disconnecting.

Even after disconnecting, any synced members will remain subscribers in Kit, and you can still send emails that contain Mighty content you’ve already added to drafts.
