# How Do I Segment My Members with Audiences?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-segment-my-members-with-audiences



Audiences ([Launch plan and up](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan#whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-launch-plan)) let you deliver the right message to the right members in your Mighty Network. They pair well with [**promotional banners**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-set-up-promotional-banners-in-my-network) and [**Automations**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network)!

To create a new audience:

* **Go to Admin > Promotions > Audiences.**
* Select **Create Audience**.
* Give your audience a name (for example, “Plan Members”).
* Choose one or multiple **Attributes**, such as:
  * Network
  * [Plan membership](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)
  * Space access
  * [Tags](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members)
  * [Custom fields](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-fields)
  * [Badges](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members)
  * **Referred by Member(s)**
* (Optional) Exclude members based on specific criteria.

  <img alt="Screenshot2026 02 27at9 05 02AM 2" />

## Quick Tips for Building Audiences

Tags are one of the most flexible ways to define audiences. Here are a few ways to use them:

* Tag Network Hosts to create an **All Hosts** audience.
* Use **Does Not Have Tag: Network Host** to reach all members except Hosts.
* Tag members based on interests, participation, plan type, or access level.
* Segment by engagement, such as **RSVP’d to Event** or **Completed Challenge.**
* Combine tags with plan membership, Space access, custom fields, or badges for even more precision.


# How Do I Set Up Promotional Banners in My Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-set-up-promotional-banners-in-my-network

Learn how to target audiences with promotional banners

<iframe />

**Promotional Banners** let you display custom messages to specific member audiences for a set period of time. Use them to highlight a new offer, share a discount, or drive action—right where your members already are.

You can target banners to different member segments using attributes like [plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) membership, [tags](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members), or [badges](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/what-are-streaks-and-recognitions).

## Step 1: Create an Audience

Before creating a banner, define the audience you want to target.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 03 36 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 03 36 PM" />

1. Go to **Admin > Marketing > Audiences.**
2. Click **Create Audience.**
3. Give your audience a name (for example, “Plan Members”).
4. Choose one or more **Attributes**, such as:
   * Network
   * [Plan membership](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)
   * Space access
   * [Tags](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members)
   * [Custom fields](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-fields)
   * [Badges](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members)
5. (Optional) Exclude members based on specific criteria.

This lets you narrow down exactly who sees your message.For example, target “Members on a paid plan excluding those tagged ‘Founding Member.’”

For more information on Audiences, [**check out this article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-segment-my-members-with-audiences).

## Step 2: Create the Banner

Once your audience is ready:

1. Go to **Admin > Marketing > Promotional Banners.**
2. Click **Create New Banner.**

Then fill out the banner details:

* **Internal Title:** For your reference.
* **Headline:** The main message (for example, “Enjoy 50% Off Our New Offering”).
* **Description:** (Optional) Supporting text (for example, “Half off for a limited time”).

### Add a Button (Optional)

You can include a call-to-action button:

* **Label:** Choose the text (for example, “Redeem”).
* **Link:** Direct it to a Plan, an internal URL, or any external link.

## Step 3: Choose the Audience

Select the audience you created in Step 1. Only members who meet that audience’s criteria will see the banner—and only in areas of the Network they have access to.

## Step 4: Set a Schedule

You can control when your banner appears and disappears.

* **Start Date & Time:** Leave blank to publish immediately.
* **End Date & Time:** Leave blank to keep the banner running until manually turned off.

For example, schedule a banner from **Sept 8 at 12 PM** to **Sept 15 at 5 PM.**

## Step 5: Allow or Prevent Dismissal

You can let members permanently dismiss the banner. If you leave this unchecked, the banner remains visible until it expires or you manually deactivate it.

## Step 6: Review and Create

Once everything looks good, click **Create.**

If your start time is in the future, the banner will appear as \*\*Scheduled.\*\* You can **view, edit, duplicate, or deactivate** banners anytime from **Admin > Marketing > Promotional Banners.**

Here's what a banner looks like on web:

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 02 19 PM" />

And on mobile:

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 02 44 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 02 44 PM" />

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who can use Promotional Banners?

Promotional Banners are available on the **Launch Plan and up.**

* **Launch Plan:** Up to 2 total (live or scheduled)
* **Scale Plan:** Up to 5
* **Growth Plan:** Up to 10
* **Mighty Pro:** Up to 15

If you’ve reached your limit, you can still create new banners, but they’ll remain inactive until you deactivate an existing one.

### How does scheduling work?

* If the **Start Time** is blank, the banner goes live immediately (as long as you’re under your banner limit).
* If the **Start Time** is set, it activates automatically at that time.
* If the **End Time** is set, it deactivates automatically when that time is reached.
* If the **End Time** is blank, it stays live until manually turned off.

Once scheduled, a banner counts toward your total limit (for example, 1 live + 1 scheduled = 2 total on the Launch Plan).

### What if a member qualifies for more than one banner?

If a member qualifies for multiple active banners, they’ll see the **most recently created** live one.

### Can I Customize Banners?

Yes. You can customize:

* The headline
* The description
* The CTA button label and link (Plan or URL)

At this time, banners don’t support images. They’re designed to display consistently across all devices.

The color of your banner matches your Network’s **theme color**:

* If you’re using **basic colors**, it uses your theme color.
* If you’re using **advanced colors**, it matches your advanced button color.

You can adjust colors under **Admin > Branding > Colors.**

### Where can I link the CTA button?

You can link the button to:

* A **Plan** (ideal for promotions)
* An **internal URL** (like an event or Space)
* An **external link** (like a sponsor site or form)

### Does the Audience Builder work outside of banners?

Yes! You can use Audiences inside of Automations.

[Check out this article to learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network).


# How Do I Use the Mighty Networks Ambassador Program?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-use-the-mighty-networks-ambassador-program



<iframe />

Your **Ambassador Program** is a built-in member referral system that encourages and rewards members for inviting others to join your Mighty Network.

The Ambassador Program becomes available when your Mighty Network is on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) or higher. It’s designed to motivate members to share your Network based on its value and impact—not through paid commissions.

If you’re looking for a paid affiliate model, you can connect an affiliate integration alongside the Ambassador Program.

Learn more about affiliates [**in this article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/does-mighty-networks-have-built-in-affiliates).

## How to Enable the Ambassador Program

By default, the Ambassador Program is turned off.

To enable it:

1. Go to **Admin > Members > Ambassador Program.**
2. Toggle the feature on.

### When you enable your Ambassador Program:

* You can send an **announcement** to your current members by going to **Manage > Send an Announcement.**
* New members automatically receive an **in-app notification** and **email** encouraging them to refer others.
* Each member gets a **personalized referral link**, available anytime from the **Invite page** or their **profile** in the mobile app.

**Note:** If a member shares their referral link directly, it won’t appear in the *Invites Sent* list. That list only tracks invitations sent through the built-in email feature.

You can track your Ambassadors and their referrals from your **Members** page.

* Hosts on the [**Launch Plan and up**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) can [download the Member List](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-download-my-member-data) to see detailed referral data.
* Members can view their referral count and Ambassador level on the [**Invite**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members) page.

To send an announcement, your Mighty Network must have at least one member. If you’ve already sent one, you’ll need to disable and re-enable the Ambassador Program to send another.

## How the Ambassador Program Works

When members refer new people who join your Mighty Network, they automatically earn an Ambassador level:

* **Bronze Ambassador:** 2+ referrals
* **Silver Ambassador:** 10+ referrals
* **Gold Ambassador:** 25+ referrals

As members level up, they receive a notification and can see their status on their profile.

Once enabled, Ambassador levels can’t be renamed or reset.

### If Your Mighty Network Is Accessible Through Plans

* Members can share invites from the **Invite page**, **Invite icon** (on web), or their **referral link**.
* Invitees skip the landing page and go straight to sign-up, where they select a Plan.
* Once the invitee joins a Plan (or completes a free trial, if offered), the referring member earns credit.
* Invitees aren’t automatically granted free access to paid Plans. To let them join for free, you can send them an invite link for a **hidden Free Plan**.

### If Your Mighty Network Is Invite-Only

* Members can invite others from the **Invite page**, **Invite icon** (on web), or their **referral link**.
* Invitees can join your Mighty Network without approval.
* When they sign up, the referring member automatically receives credit.

## Adding Custom Rewards

You can add your own rewards to recognize Ambassadors as they reach new levels.

To do this:

1. Go to **Admin > Members > Ambassador Program > Manage Additional Ambassador Rewards.**
2. Add rewards and instructions for each level.

Examples of rewards Hosts often use:

* 10% off a community shop
* A free tote bag or t-shirt
* A featured “Member of the Month” spotlight
* A complimentary event ticket

Example messages to share when a member levels up:

* “You’re now a Silver Ambassador! Enjoy 10% off in our online store using this code: **XYZ**.”
* “Congrats on referring 10 new members! Here’s your early access code for our next event: **XYZ**.”
* “You rock! A Host will reach out soon to feature you as our Member of the Month.”

You can also automate these rewards using our [**Automations**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network) or with [**Zapier**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-use-zapier-with-mighty-networks) when members reach a new level.

You can update or disable rewards anytime.

## Turning Off the Ambassador Program

To turn off the Ambassador Program:

1. Go to **Admin > Members > Ambassador Program.**
2. Toggle the feature off.

## Tracking Ambassador Data

To view referral data and Ambassador activity, visit your [**Ambassadors Dashboard in Mighty Insights™**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/what-is-mighty-insights#:~:text=in%20the%20data.-,Ambassadors,-If%20you%20have).


# How Does SEO Work for My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-does-seo-work-for-my-mighty-network



If you are on the [Scale Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-business-plan#whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-scale-plan) and above, you have the option to decide if you want member posts and profiles to be seen by search engines like Google. Search indexing is not available while you are on a Free Trial or a Free Plan.

You can find this setting by **clicking on your profile picture in the top right corner > Admin > Setup > Privacy & Access** and scroll down until you see **Search Indexing**.

<img alt="" />

By default, this toggle will be switched "on" so that your Mighty Network is crawled and indexed by search engines like Google and Yahoo.

If you want to make it so that member posts and profiles are seen by the search engines, all you have to do is select "Anyone" under Who Can View Content Inside Your Network in your [Network Privacy and Access Settings](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network).

<img alt="" />

If your Mighty Network is accessible through [plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network), only the landing page will be indexed in search engines. You have the option to turn off search indexing for your Mighty Network's Landing Page by switching the toggle to "off".

switch the toggle to "off." Your [Landing Page](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-customize-my-mighty-networks-landing-page) will always be searchable, but all other pages of your Mighty Network will not be indexed by the search engines.

**Important note:** If Search Indexing is off then image previews when sharing links externally may not work as expected.


# What AI Features Does Mighty Networks Have?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have



<iframe title="YouTube video player" />

Every premium plan on Mighty ([Launch Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and higher) includes access to our proprietary **AI-powered features**, built to help you and your members save time, spark creativity, and grow your community faster.

## How to Manage AI Features

You can manage all AI features by going to **Admin > General > AI Features**. From there, you can toggle individual features on or off, or turn off all AI features in your Mighty Network.

## Available AI Features

Below is a breakdown of each AI feature and where to find it.

## Make It Better

**Available on:** Launch Plan and up

Instantly improve your writing in Posts, Articles, Chats, and more. Highlight any text, then select the **sparkle icon** to see options like:

* Fix Spelling and Grammar
* Shorten
* Elaborate
* Change Tone (Casual, Fun, Professional, Sincere, or Witty)

## Show Similarities

**Available on:** Launch Plan and up

Found on member profiles, this feature highlights what you and another person have in common—automatically.

## Profile Writing Assistant

**Available on:** Launch Plan and up. Helps you and your members complete the **About Me** section. Select **Get Me Started**, answer three quick questions, and a profile will be generated.To try again, delete the text and start over

## Start a Conversation

**Available on:** Launch Plan and up. When opening a new Direct Message or Group Chat, select **Suggest a Conversation Starter**.You’ll see a draft message based on shared interests and profiles. You can edit it, send it, or click **Try Again** for a new suggestion.

## Icebreaker Suggestions

**Available on:** Launch Plan and up. Helps Space Hosts spark engagement with great first questions.Go to **Space Settings (gear icon) > Features > Feed > Manage**, then scroll to the bottom to toggle **Icebreaker Question** on.

Select **Suggest Ideas** to view new prompts or adjust the tone of the question.

## Activity Assist

**Available on:** Launch Plan and up. Re-engage members directly from your [member list](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members).

Go to **Admin > Members > Member List**, sort by **Last Active**, then select the **three-dot menu** next to a member’s name and choose **Reach Out**.From there, select **Suggest a Conversation Starter** to generate a message.

To learn more, check out the article, [How Can I Easily Re-Engage My Members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-easily-re-engage-my-members).

## Suggested Hashtags

**Available on:** Launch Plan and up. Appears in Posts, Articles, and more.Suggested hashtags automatically appear in Spaces without Highlighted Hashtags.Look for the **sparkle icon** to explore ideas.

## Instant Course Outline

**Available on:** Launch Plan and up (web and mobile web only). Helps you and your Space Hosts quickly create a Course outline. Select **Get Started**, then enter your Course idea, desired length (for example, five lessons), and audience level (beginner, advanced, etc.). A suggested outline will be generated instantly.

## AI Search Summaries

**Available on:** Scale Plan and up. Helps you and your members find results faster with convenient AI-assisted search summaries.

## Infinite Question Engine

**Available on:** Scale Plan and up Automatically generates polls and questions tailored to your community or course. It uses your **Space Description** or your [**Network’s Big Purpose**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/whats-a-big-purpose) to create prompts that keep engagement flowing.

To learn more, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-use-the-infinite-question-engine).

## Chat with Cohost

You can also ask Cohost anything inside of your Mighty Network to get help instantly from our Help Center, People Magic Profit course, and more.

It is our [People Magic GPT](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-people-magic-gpt) right inside your Network!

Cohost knows your Network's Big Purpose, description, and billing plan, and all Network Hosts can see and participate in any conversation.

To learn more, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-chat-with-cohost).

## Common Questions

## One of the AI features gave me strange results. How do I report it?

We’re still improving every day! Please share what you experienced using the **Need Help** button in the lower right corner of your Mighty Network, or email us at [**help@mightynetworks.com**]().

## How does Mighty’s AI integration work?

When an AI-powered feature is used, Mighty securely sends the selected information through **Anthropic and/or OpenAI’s APIs**, runs it through our **Community Design™ framework**, and returns a custom result. None of your community content is used to train or improve Anthropic or OpenAI’s models.

## Is my Mighty Network’s data shared with Anthropic or OpenAI?

No. Mighty’s AI uses Anthropic and/or OpenAI technology through API calls only. Your community’s content remains private and secure.


# What is the People Explorer?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-is-the-people-explorer



All plans on Mighty Networks include a dynamic and engaging feature called **People Explorer**, which helps surface connections between members.

The People Explorer on a profile highlights interactions and relationships within the same Mighty Network. It’s influenced by factors like who someone follows and who they’ve engaged with through reactions and comments on similar posts.

## Global Members

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-is-the-people-explorer/Productivity_Members_People-Explorer.png)

In the **[Global Members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-global-features)** view, profiles are displayed in clusters:

* **Top Members**

* **Members Near You** (within 300 km)

* **New Members**

Hovering over a profile enlarges it and opens a preview card with the member’s mini bio and options to **View Profile** or **Chat**.

* If chat is toggled off at the Network level, you’ll only see **View Profile**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-is-the-people-explorer/Productivity_Members_People-Explorer-Selected.png)

Clicking a profile expands it further to show what you and that member have in common—if **[Show Similarities](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have)** is toggled on under **Admin > Setup > AI Features**.

If **Show Similarities** is toggled off or all **Mighty Co-Host™** features are turned off, only the member’s mini bio will display.

From the expanded view, you can choose to **Chat** or **View Profile**.

* Again, if chat is toggled off at the Network level, you’ll only see **View Profile**.

You can also control the order of the **Explore** tab by going to Global Features > Members and toggle off "Show Explore Tab First"

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-is-the-people-explorer/Screenshot-2025-11-12-at-3_04_29-PM.png)

## On a Member Profile

The **People Explorer** also appears directly on member profiles.

Hovering over a profile enlarges it and shows the member’s mini bio. From there, you can see your similarities or **Chat**—depending on which features are enabled.

* If either feature is toggled off, **View Profile** will replace those options.

**Note:** The People Explorer feature becomes visible on a new member’s profile only after they’ve participated in the Network.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-is-the-people-explorer/Screenshot-2025-11-12-at-3_00_43-PM.png)

## People Explorer in Spaces

On web, if the **Member** feature is toggled on within a Space, you’ll see a tab called **Explore**.

In this tab, profiles are organized in clusters:

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-is-the-people-explorer/NomadMoney_Members_People-Explorer.png)

Hovering over a profile enlarges it and opens a preview card with the person’s mini bio and options to **View Profile** or **Chat**.

* If chat is toggled off at the Network level, only **View Profile** will appear.

Clicking a profile expands it to show shared similarities—if **[Show Similarities](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have)** is toggled on under **Admin > Setup > AI Features**.

If **Show Similarities** or all **AI features** are turned off, only the member’s mini bio will display.

From there, you can **Chat** or **View Profile**.

* If chat is toggled off, you’ll only see **View Profile**.

You can also control the order of the **Explore** tab within the Space by toggling **Show Explore Tab** on or off under **Space Settings > Space Features > Members**.


# Does Mighty Networks Offer a Free Trial?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/does-mighty-networks-offer-a-free-trial



Yes! Mighty Networks offers a 14 day Free Trial of the [Growth Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan#whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan) with no credit card required. This allows you time to explore the features and begin building your community.

You'll have access to all the features of the [Growth Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan#whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan) — Courses, Spaces, Chat, Livestreaming, Video Uploads, and much more during that time (excluding [Mighty Insights](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/what-is-mighty-insights)). You'll also have access to our awesome Customer Advocacy team via the 'Need Help' button in the bottom right corner of your Mighty Network, in case you need assistance getting set up.

If you're looking for the best way to get started, check out our [7 Day Build a Mighty Network Challenge](https://community.mightynetworks.com/spaces/12898937/events) which will walk you through the product and the strategy so that you can make the most of your trial.

Once your free trial ends (or before!), you can lock in those features and [upgrade to whatever plan is right for you!](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/which-mighty-network-plan-is-right-for-you)

If your Free Trial lapses, then your Mighty Network will move to our Free Plan.

The highlights of our Free Plan are:

* 1 Host & 1 Moderator
* Unlimited Spaces
* Unlimited Members
* 1 Custom Landing Page
* 10 GB of storage space
* Network is accessible via our Mighty Networks iOS and Android Apps

If you decide to upgrade to a paid plan, you can do so at any time, and none of the content you created on your free trial will be lost! Simply turn on the premium features when you re-upgrade. Any questions, feel free to drop us a [note in Need Help](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-get-help).

We’re excited to see what you create!


# What’s Included in the Mighty Networks Explore Plan?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/exploreplan



Learn about the Explore Plan

If you’re just getting started, the Explore Plan is the simplest way to begin building your Mighty Network.

It’s designed for new Hosts who want to test an idea, explore how Mighty works, and start bringing people together—without added complexity.

You can create Spaces, invite members, and begin building your first community experience in minutes.

## What You Get with the Explore Plan

The Explore Plan includes the core features you need to launch and learn:

* **Your own Mighty Network website, 100% ad-free**
* **Free Mighty apps on iOS and Android**
* **Unlimited members**
* **Unlimited Spaces**
* **1 Host and 1 moderator**

Inside your Spaces, you can:

* **Create Posts to start conversations**
* **Upload photos, GIFs, and files**
* **Use Chat with threads and emoji reactions**
* **Message members directly**
* **Build Activity Feeds**
* **Create Events**

You can also:

* **Charge for access with subscriptions or one-time payments**
* **Offer free trials and promo codes**
* **Use basic member management tools**
* **Chat with [Mighty Cohost](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-chat-with-cohost) (up to 25 messages per day)**
* **Build interest with [Waitlists](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-waitlist) before you launch**

## What the Explore Plan Is Best For

The Explore Plan is ideal if you want to:

* Test a new community idea
* Build your first group of members
* Experiment with different Spaces and formats
* Start simple before adding more structure

It gives you a low-lift way to validate your Big Purpose and begin creating connection.

## Key Limitations to Know

The Explore Plan keeps things intentionally simple. That means:

* Spaces support a single feature (not multi-feature Spaces)
* Limited admin tools and automation
* No advanced customization or integrations

As your community grows, you may want more flexibility to combine features in Spaces, create more advanced experiences, or scale your offers.

## Explore Plan Pricing

The Explore Plan is available at:

* \$29 per month when billed annually
* \$35 per month when billed monthly

## When You’re Ready to Grow

As you gain traction, you can upgrade to a paid plan like the Launch Plan, Scale Plan, or Growth Plan to unlock:

* More Hosts and moderators
* Advanced features like courses and automations
* Lower transaction fees

## Where to Go Next

Once you’ve explored the basics, check out the Launch plan to expand your community.

Join [Mighty Community](https://community.mightynetworks.com/) to see how other Hosts are building, testing, and growing their Networks.

## Week of 8/10/26

## Updated

## More Image Download Formats

Images are now easier to download, reuse, and share!

You can now choose between **PNG, JPG, and AVIF** when downloading images from the Feed, Articles, and Course Lessons on web and mobile.

* On web, select **Download Image** from the three-dot menu and choose your preferred format. If a post includes multiple images, they’ll download together in a ZIP file.
* On mobile (iOS 8.279.80 and Android 8.279.47), simply long press an image and choose the format you want.

## Keep Automations Running as Your Team Changes

Important workflows shouldn’t stop just because the person who created them is no longer part of your Network.

Here's what's changed:

* Automations from former Hosts are now reassigned to a current Host so they can keep running.
* The Automation moves to the longest-tenured Host, who will receive a notification.
* Actions like Badges, invitations, and Plan access will run as the reassigned Host.
* Send DM Automations are the exception, they’ll still pause if the original sender is no longer a Host.

## Updated

## Cohost Approval Cards Are Here

Cohost can now take on more work while keeping you in control of important decisions.

When you ask Cohost to take an action that requires confirmation, it will pause and show you an **Approval Card** before anything happens.

Depending on the action, you may see a simple confirmation or an extra warning for changes that are harder—or impossible—to undo.

This means you can confidently ask Cohost to do more, knowing you’ll still have the final say.

Alongside Approval Cards, we’ve also added [**16 new Cohost capabilities**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-chat-with-cohost#how-do-i-chat-with-cohost), opening up even more ways to get things done directly through Cohost! 🙌

Starting with an empty Network can make it hard to know what to do first.

New **empty states** now provide helpful guidance and recommended next steps throughout the product, making it easier to start building, invite people in, and create momentum.

This is available on web now, with mobile to follow.

## Network MCPs Are Here

You can now connect your Mighty Network to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more. This feature is available on the **Scale Plan** and up.

## Authenticated iFrames and Vibe Coding on Mighty

Hosts on the **Scale Plan** and up now have a set of powerful new options that allow you to create custom (or vibe coded) experiences embeddable directly into your Mighty Network.

Get started by checking out our new [Vibe Coding on Mighty](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/vibe-coding-on-mighty) Help Center article.

Here are some of the new updates that make this magic all possible:

* Hosts and moderators can now freely embed any iframe (including for custom or vibe coded projects) — no more waiting for Mighty to approve it.
* We've created a set of starter sample projects on Lovable to instantly "remix" and edit to your liking before publishing and adding (as an iframe embed) into your Network.
* Just drop in your vibe coded app as an embed, let your members connect to it (just like granting a custom calendar app access to your Google Calendar, as a real-world example), and you're good to go.
* On the Scale Plan and up and interested in the Headless API beta? Let us know.
* Finally, Hosts will now see an option when embedding any iframe to give the embed full width on desktop browsers.

## An Improved Invite Experience

We've improved the experience for member-to-member invites.

Previously, invite links took prospective members directly to account creation, without giving them any context about your Mighty Network first.

Now, when a Landing Page is enabled, invite links will take prospective members there before they're prompted to create an account.

It's a small change that creates a much better first impression — and can help improve the join experience for new members!

## Plan Milestone Trigger

You can now automate actions based on how long someone has been a member of a specific Plan.

This [new trigger ](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network#how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network)focuses specifically on **Plan membership milestones** and fires once when a member reaches the selected milestone day.

It works across subscription, installment, and free plans, and is available on the **Scale plan and up.**

This creates new opportunities for onboarding, milestone celebrations, and engagement follow-ups.

## Chromecast Support on Android

Members can now cast videos directly from the Mighty Networks Android app (version 8.266.45) to Chromecast-enabled TVs.

A huge upgrade for communities looking to create a more seamless viewing experience across devices!

## Cleaner Pages & Single Events Experience

We've made a small but impactful change to Pages and Single Events.

The **"Only Visible to Hosts"** banner has been removed, creating a cleaner viewing experience and editing experience!

Host-only actions like **Edit** and **Hidden/Visible toggles** now live more naturally within the feature tab menu alongside other management actions.

## iOS Prompt to Update App

Members using older versions of the iOS app will now receive a helpful prompt encouraging them to update their app once per week.

This new feature helps reduce issues caused by outdated app versions—making it easier for members to stay up to date with the latest improvements, fixes, and features.

Cohost can now help you **build, organize, and grow your community faster**.

* Create Spaces, Collections, and Payment Plans

And if Cohost can't complete something directly yet, it'll point you exactly where to go—usually just a few clicks away.

This powerful addition lets Hosts create a [custom Audience](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-segment-my-members-with-audiences) based on who invited a member—using each member's unique referral link available in the Invite feature.

It unlocks the ability to:

* Show custom promotional banners to a specific member's referrals
* Trigger targeted Automations
* Tag referrals for syncing with external systems
* Direct referrals to the right coach's Space

It's flexible, too. You can:

* Include referrals from multiple members (e.g., ANY coach)
* Or exclude referrals entirely (targeting everyone *except* referred members)

# Legacy Plans
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/legacy-plans

If you're on a legacy Mighty plan, you can read below to see how your standard plan features generally overlap with the [latest available plans](/for-hosts/meet-mighty/which-mighty-network-plan-is-right-for-you). 
To see any additional features, adjusted limits or bonuses you may have unlocked on your legacy plan, please visit Admin > Your Plan.

## Upgrading from a legacy plan

When you upgrade from a legacy plan to a current plan, you'll automatically keep any superior features from your legacy plan. This means you won't lose valuable capabilities you currently have, such as:

* Unlimited flex spaces
* Higher storage limits
* SSO (Single Sign-On)
* Custom email domains
* Unlimited custom fields
* Unlimited hosts
* Other premium features

These features will be preserved as overrides on your new plan, ensuring a smooth upgrade experience without losing functionality you depend on.

## Scale Plan

Past equivalent plans include:

* Business Plan 2024
* Business Plan 2025

## Launch Plan

Past equivalent plans include:

* Courses Plan
* Business Plan (Legacy)

## Other Plans

The following plans are no longer available:

* Community Plan (2025)
* Community Plan (2024)
* Community Plan (Legacy)
* Brand Plan
* Indie Plan
* Starter Plan
* Creator Plan
* Free Plan

On one of these retired plans and looking to upgrade? [The Launch Plan](/for-hosts/meet-mighty/which-mighty-network-plan-is-right-for-you) is a great next step, and includes access to the powerful and flexible Courses feature.

# What is Mighty Pro?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/what-is-mighty-pro



[Mighty Pro](https://www.mightynetworks.com/pro) allows creators, entrepreneurs and brands to deliver a unified member experience with courses, memberships, events, challenges, livestreaming, and more on their own branded apps.

## Branded Mobile Apps

Mighty Pro includes your own branded native mobile apps, both for iOS for iPhone and iPad, and Android—available for direct download in the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

Mighty Pro-branded native mobile apps on iOS and Android are different from web-based alternatives in three ways:

* Member Experience—natively developed mobile apps take full advantage of the software development kits (“SDKs”) of their respective platforms. This means faster, more intuitive Member experiences that result in higher engagement.

* Performance—natively developed mobile apps are faster than web-based alternatives because they execute operations directly on a device rather than needing to call a server for every action. This also contributes to faster, more intuitive Member experiences and higher engagement.

* Positive Ratings and Reviews—natively designed and developed mobile apps present a better branding and marketing opportunity because of a more optimal member experience and faster performance. This directly results in more people seeing and trying your branded native mobile apps than brands that rely on web-based alternatives or the web alone.

By choosing Mighty Pro, your branded native mobile apps package includes all new features developed for Mighty Pro automatically available for your iOS and Android apps, and ongoing maintenance and performance improvements.

All this is delivered without slow and expensive custom development. We’ll have your apps live in the app stores within 4-6 weeks.

## Schedule a call to explore Mighty Pro.

If you’d like more information about Mighty Pro and your own branded apps, the best way to start is to book a short call with our team.

We’d love to hear what you’re trying to build and can show you how our most successful customers are using Mighty Pro.

To schedule your call or request more information, [you can reach out here.](https://www.mightynetworks.com/pro)
