# Who Founded Mighty Networks?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/who-founded-mighty-networks



Mighty Networks was founded by Gina Bianchini (CEO), Tim Herby (CTO), and Thomas Aaron (Chief Product Officer, or CPO). You can learn more about what inspires them (in their own words) and the philosophy behind Mighty Networks on our [About Page](https://www.mightynetworks.com/about).

Gina previously launched a platform called Ning in 2007, which gave people a way to create their own social networks.

These were social networks that creators built and owned. They brought members together around interests, passions, and goals, but with a twist:

* It was their branding
* It was their choice of features
* It was their members

The creativity and connections that emerged from Ning attracted nearly 100M around the world and had a profound impact on Gina.

It was that potential for a new internet culture and a different relationship we could have with technology that inspired her to create Mighty Networks with Tim and Tom.

They had a vision for a world with a million unique, vibrant communities, all mastering something interesting or important together.

This is a world where:

* You can host a community, course, or membership in your own space under your own brand—away from the algorithms, distractions, and noise of social media.
* But you’re not just building a community, course, or membership. Our platform is unique in that you are able to create your own culture. A culture you can design to get members results and transformation they can’t get on their own.
* Your members can meet the other members in totally new and fresh ways. They can quickly find people they have the most in common with, and go on quests together that you set up — through online courses, challenges, experiences, and collaborations — just not possible yet anywhere else.


# Can I Change My Prices?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-change-my-prices



Yes, you can!

## How to Raise Prices for a Subscription Plan for New Members

Yes, you can raise prices for new members while keeping existing members on their current subscription rate. To do this, you’ll hide the original plan and create a new, higher-priced version.

## Step 1: Hide Your Existing Subscription Plan

Go to the plan’s settings and open the **[Visibility & Sharing](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear)** tab.

Uncheck all boxes under **Choose Where This Plan Appears**.

This removes the plan from being shown or sold anywhere, but existing members will continue paying their current price with no changes.

## Step 2: Duplicate the Plan

1. Go to **Admin > Plans > Plan List**

2. Hover over the plan you want to duplicate

3. Select the **three-dot menu**

4. Choose **Duplicate Plan**

This creates a copy of the plan with the same structure and access.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-change-my-prices/Screenshot-2025-11-19-at-2_15_34-PM.png)

## Step 3: Update the Price

Open the duplicated plan and update the price to your new subscription rate.

## Step 4: Make the New Plan Visible

In the **[Visibility & Sharing](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear)** tab, select at least one option under **Choose Where This Plan Appears**.

## Step 5: Update Any Share Links

If you previously used plan share links to sell the lower-priced plan:

* Delete the old share links from the hidden plan

* Create new share links for the higher-priced plan

* Use the new links in any emails, posts, or promotional materials

## Raising Prices for Existing Members

If you also want to raise prices for existing members, you’ll need to **move them to the new plan**.

Check out our article on *[moving members between plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-members-move-between-plans)* for step-by-step instructions.


# Can I Charge in Multiple Currencies?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-charge-in-multiple-currencies



In your Mighty Network, you can sell plans in up to **10 different currencies**.

The **country of your [Stripe account](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network)** determines which currencies you can present

[plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) in and which currencies you can accept payouts for. If you haven’t connected Stripe yet, you can learn how to get started in our Stripe setup article.

## Sell Existing Plans in New Currencies

If you already sell paid plans and want to support additional currencies, you’ll need to add each new currency one at a time. Every paid plan in your Network—existing or newly created—must include a price in each currency you choose to support. Free plans aren’t affected.

## Add a new currency

1. **Go to Admin > Plans & Access > Currencies**.

2. Select the **+** icon, then choose a currency from the drop-down menu.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-charge-in-multiple-currencies/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-9_45_27-AM.png)

## Set Plan prices in the new currency

After adding a currency, you must add a price for **every** paid plan. You can:

* **Manually** enter prices, or

* **Autofill and Review** prices using today’s exchange rates as calculated by Stripe.

After reviewing prices, complete the confirmation step to finish adding the currency.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-charge-in-multiple-currencies/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-9_46_05-AM.png)

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-charge-in-multiple-currencies/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-9_47_15-AM.png)

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-charge-in-multiple-currencies/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-9_48_10-AM.png)

## Set visibility

Newly added currencies begin as **Hidden**. To make a currency available for purchase:

* Click the **three-dot menu** next to the currency

* Select **Make Currency Visible**

You can also change your Network’s **default currency** from this menu.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-charge-in-multiple-currencies/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-9_50_32-AM.png)

## Important notes

* You **cannot edit prices** for a currency after it has been added.

  * If no one has purchased a subscription in that currency yet, you can delete it and add it again to reset prices.

* Prices **do not automatically update** as exchange rates change.

  * To change a price, you must create a **new plan** with updated pricing in each supported currency.

## Create New Plans to Sell in Multiple Currencies

If you have never sold plans before, you’ll need to connect Stripe and create your first plan to start offering multiple currencies.

1. Go to **Admin > Plans & Access > Plan List**.

2. [Create your plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan).

After your first plan is created, you can add more currencies using the steps above.

If you’ve already sold plans and want to create a new plan:

1. Create the plan and price it in your **existing** currencies.

2. Add your **new** currency.

3. You’ll then set prices for **all** plans—including the new one—in the new currency.

**Keep in mind:**

* Once a currency is added, **every new plan** must be priced in all supported currencies.

* The **Autofill** tool is only available when you add a currency—not when creating new plans.

## What Your Members Will See

If you make your [plan visible](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) on your [landing page](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-customize-my-mighty-networks-landing-page), visitors will see a currency selector in the upper right corner. Mighty Networks will:

* Show the currency that best matches where the visitor is located, if supported.

* Show your **default currency** if the visitor’s currency isn’t supported or their location can’t be identified.

Visitors can switch currencies unless they have previously purchased a subscription (see below).

If your plan appears anywhere else, members will also see a currency selector showing the currencies you support.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-charge-in-multiple-currencies/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-9_51_52-AM.png)

## Subscription currency lock (Stripe requirement)

Once someone purchases a **subscription**, they must make all future subscription purchases in that same currency. In this case, we only show that currency and hide the selector.

If someone has only made **one-time purchases**, they can purchase future plans in any visible currency.

## FAQs

### Which currencies can I sell in?

You can choose up to **10** currencies from among the 135+ presentment currencies Stripe supports. Every plan must have a price in each currency you support.

### Are multiple currencies available on iOS plans?

No. Multiple currencies are only supported on the web.

### Will prices update automatically when exchange rates change?

No. To change a price, create a new plan with updated pricing in each currency.

### If I’ve sold plans in USD, do I have to keep supporting USD?

Yes. However, you can **hide** USD so new buyers won’t see it. Members who previously purchased in USD will continue to see and pay in USD.

### Will members still see currency options after purchasing a subscription?

No. After a subscription purchase, they will only see the currency they originally used. Members who have made only one-time purchases will still see all visible currencies.

### How does currency conversion work on iOS?

Apple handles all currency conversion for plans purchased on iOS.

### Can I choose the default currency for my Mighty Network?

Yes. The default currency is used when we can’t identify a visitor’s location or when their local currency isn’t supported.If you’ve already sold plans, your default currency is **USD**, but you can change it.

### What determines which currencies I can present plans in?

Your Stripe account’s **country** determines which currencies you can present plans in.

### What determines which currencies I can receive payouts in?

Your Stripe account’s **country** also determines which currencies you can accept payouts for.

### Can I delete a currency I’ve added?

Yes—as long as no one has purchased a subscription in that currency. If you simply don’t want to offer it moving forward, you can **hide** it instead. Existing subscribers will continue paying in that currency.

### Can existing members change the currency they pay in?

No. Members with subscriptions must continue paying in their original currency.Members with only one-time purchases can buy in any visible currency.

A workaround is to remove the member, delete the customer in Stripe, and have them sign up again. Or, they can sign up with a new email address (though this creates a separate account).

### Can I offer certain currencies to some members but not others?

No. Currency visibility applies to your entire Mighty Network. You can hide a currency, but existing subscribers will continue to see and use it.


# Can I Have a Plan with No Payment Gate?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-have-a-plan-with-no-payment-gate



Yes, you can create a plan without any payment language or checkout process.

A plan with **no payment gate** can be helpful when:

* You collect payments through an [external payment tool](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform) and want to grant access to your Network or Spaces after someone pays off-platform.
* You want to bundle Spaces together and provide access through a simple link—without showing pricing or triggering checkout.

Note: You can also now [directly add members to Spaces or your Network](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members).

## Free Plan vs. a Plan With No Payment Gate

These two options look different to members:

* Free Plan: Members see standard plan details and the word "Free" during checkout.
* Plan With No Payment Gate: Members see an **Access** button. When they select it, they are taken directly into your Network or Space—no checkout flow and no payment prompts.

## How to Create a Plan With No Payment Gate

* Go to **Admin > Plans > Plan List**.

* Select the **+** icon in the upper right corner to [create a new plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan).

* Set up the access you want to provide (Network, one Space, or multiple Spaces).

* Continue to the **Gates** section.

* Make sure the **Payments** gate is **toggled off**.

* (Optional) Add [Screening Questions and/or Approvals](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members) if you want additional steps before granting access.

* The next page will confirm that there are no payment gates

* Select **Finish** to view a preview of how the plan will appear to members.

## After creating the plan:

1. Open the plan from the **Plan List**.
2. Go to the **Visibility & Sharing** tab.
3. Create and copy a share link.

You can use this link to give members direct access to your plan.

To learn more about taking payments off-platform, [click here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform).


# Can I Offer a Free Trial on a Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-offer-a-free-trial-on-a-mighty-network



You may want to give new members the option to explore your paid subscription plans with a **Free Trial** before they start paying. Adding a Free Trial is optional when you create a subscription plan, and each plan can have its own trial length.

**Note:** Free Trials are not available for one-time, installment or free plans.

## How Free Trials Work

A Free Trial gives members temporary access to your plan without being charged. When someone starts a Free Trial, they’ll enter their credit card information, but they won’t be billed until the trial ends.

Members receive notifications before their Free Trial expires and are responsible for [managing their own subscriptions](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-manage-my-membership-or-space-purchases). If a member cancels their Free Trial, access is removed immediately—they won't be able to continue the remaining trial period.

**iOS exception:** If someone cancels through the App Store, they may keep access until the end of the trial. Apple manages all billing changes and notifications for iOS purchases.

Free Trials allow your members to get short-term access to your plan for a period of time without being charged. When someone starts a Free Trial, they will be prompted to enter their credit card details. However, they will not be charged until the Free Trial is up.

## How to Set Up a Free Trial

1. Go to **Admin > Plans > Plan List**.

2. Create a new subscription plan or edit an existing one.

3. When prompted, select a **Free Trial** length. Available options include:

   * 3 days

   * 1 week

   * 2 weeks

   * 1 month

   * 2 months

   * 3 months

   * 6 months

   * 7 months

   * 8 months

   * 9 months

   * 10 months

   * 11 months

   * 1 year

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-offer-a-free-trial-on-a-mighty-network/Screenshot-2025-11-19-at-11_15_13-AM.png)

## How to Remove or Change a Free Trial

To update the Free Trial on an existing subscription plan:

1. Go to **Admin > Plans > Plan List > Select the Plan > Settings > Platform Information**.

2. Open each platform (Web, iOS, Android) to update its Free Trial duration.

3. To remove a Free Trial entirely, select **None**.

Changes only apply to **new members**. Anyone already in a Free Trial will keep the original duration from when they joined.

You can also use this process to add a Free Trial to a plan that didn’t previously have one.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-offer-a-free-trial-on-a-mighty-network/Screenshot-2025-11-19-at-11_20_45-AM.png)

## Managing Failed Payment Methods After a Free Trial

If a member’s payment method fails at the end of their Free Trial:

* On **web purchases**, they receive a **7-day grace period**.

  * Stripe automatically retries the payment one day after the first failure, then every two days until day 7.

  * If payment still fails on day 7, the member loses access.

* On **iOS purchases**, the grace period is **16 days**.

  * Apple handles all retries and notifications through the App Store.


# Can I Set Up Age Verification In my Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-age-verification-in-my-mighty-network



Yes you can! This guide is for setting up [Yoti](https://www.yoti.com/), a third-party platform and approved Ofcom provider that meets OSA regulatory requirements for age verification for content in your Network.

## Part 1: Set up Yoti

1. **Submit Yoti's interest form.**

   * [Submit Yoti's form](https://www.yoti.com/contact/business/) and note that it's for Mighty Networks. When reaching out, refer to their no-code portal, Digital I.D. option.

2. **Complete onboarding with Yoti.**

   * Verify your business with Yoti and complete their additional onboarding steps.

3. **Create your Yoti verification application.**

   * In Yoti, set up and configure the app you'll use to send verification sessions.

**Questions while setting up Yoti? [Yoti's support team can help you](https://yoti.my.site.com/yotisupport/s/contactsupport).**

## Part 2: Configure your Mighty Network

Age verification with Yoti works through [Screening Questions and Approvals](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members) on Mighty Networks. These features are only available on Plans.

Any content that needs age verification must be behind a [Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan).

## 🟡 If it's just some content that needs age verification

**Step 1:** Move that content into its own **Space** (if it's not already). This makes it easier to apply age verification without changing access to your entire Network.

**Step 2:** [Create a Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) that includes that Space.

## 🟠 If you're age-gating an existing Space (or multiple Spaces)

**Step 1:** If those Spaces aren't already part of a Plan, create one (or more).

You can either:

* Make one Plan per Space, or

* Bundle them together in a single Plan, depending on how you sell access.

## 🔴 If the entire Network needs age verification

**Step 1:** [Create a Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) that includes **Network Access**.

**Step 2:** Add any other Spaces that the member should get access to upon joining the Network.

For additional help on Plans, check out our full guide on setting up Plans here.

**🟢 Once your Plans are set up**,

1. **Turn on Screening Questions and Approval for all Plans.**

   * Go to the Plan your new members will join.

   * Enable Screening Questions and Approval ([see here for more details](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members)).​

2. **Add a clear Screening Question.**

   * Use this text (copy/paste):​\*"An age-verification link will be sent to your email. Please answer 'Yes' below to confirm you understand it's required and that you will complete it."\*

## Part 3: Verify existing members

1. **Export your current UK members.**

   * Export your **[Member List](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-download-my-member-data)** and filter for members located in the **UK**.

2. **Send Yoti verification sessions in bulk.**

   * Use Yoti's **bulk upload** (up to **200** people at a time) to send verification links.

3. **Notify your members of the requirement with a deadline.**

   * Let them know when verification is due and that **unverified accounts may be removed** after that date.

## After Setup

## How the new-member flow works

1. A person signs up for a **Plan** that has **Screening Questions** and **Approval** turned on.

2. They see your Screening Question that says an **age-verification link** was sent by email and they must complete it.

3. Once they submit their Screening Question, you'll receive a notification that someone wants to join the Plan. Then you will **send a Yoti verification session** to the applicant.

4. Once Yoti shows **verified**, you **approve** them in Mighty to join the Plan.

5. After approval, they can access the community.

## How the existing-member flow works

1. Export your **Member List** and filter for **UK** members.

2. Use Yoti's **bulk upload** (up to **200** people at once) to send verification sessions.

3. Customize the email to include the **deadline** and **reason**.

4. When the deadline passes, **cross-check** Yoti's **verified list** with your Mighty Networks **Member List** and **remove** any who did not verify.


# Can I Set Up Required Questions and Approval for Access?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members



Yes, you can!

When setting up a plan on the web or mobile, you can add **Required** **Screening Questions** and **Approval Gates**.

To get started, create a new plan by going to **Admin > Plans > Plan List** and selecting the **+** icon.

[**To learn more about the first steps for setting up a plan, check out this article.**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-gate-access-to-all-or-parts-of-my-mighty-network)

## Step 1: Add Screening Questions and Approval

On the **Gates** page of plan setup, you’ll see options for **Screening Questions** and **Approval**. Each gate can be toggled on independently, which gives you several combinations:

* **Screening Questions only:** The member answers the questions and can purchase immediately.
* **Approval only:** The member must be approved before they can purchase.
* **Screening Questions + Approval:** The member answers questions and must be approved before purchasing.

## Step 2: Set Up Screening Questions

On the next page, you’ll add Screening Questions:

* You can create **up to five** custom questions.
* Each question can be marked **Required** or **Optional**.
* Members answer in a text field (max 500 characters).
* The format is currently **long-form text only**. Multiple choice is not available.
* Every plan must include at least **one required default question**. This cannot be removed.
* You can download question responses from the [**Plan Member Download**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-download-my-member-data) list.

## Step 3: Configure Pricing and Additional Settings

Further down the page, you’ll set up:

* Whether the plan is **free** or **paid**
* Whether it’s a **one-time purchase** or a **subscription**
* Which **platforms** the plan appears on
* Whether you want to offer a **Free Trial**

If you want to create a plan **with**[**out a payment gate**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-have-a-plan-with-no-payment-gate) that skips checkout entirely, see this article.

For help understanding all plan options, [**review this article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan).

## Step 4: Finish and Make the Plan Visible

Select **Finish** to create the plan.

In the upper right corner, toggle the plan to [**Visible**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) so members can purchase it.

Here is a step-by-step tutorial on creating a plan with these features.

## Member Experience

After you create a plan, you can choose where it appears.

Go to the plan’s settings (**Admin > Plans > Plan List > select plan**) and open the [**Visibility & Sharing**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) tab.

If the member doesn't have an account yet, they will be prompted to create one.

* They create an account by adding their name, email, and password.
* They are prompted to add a profile photo.
* Next, they answer your Screening Questions.
* After submitting answers, they can edit them if needed.

## If an Approval Gate is enabled

After the member submits their answers, they will see a **Pending Approval** screen.

Once approved by a Host:

* They receive an email notification.
* They can return to the plan and see that their status has changed.
* They click **Confirm Payment** to finalize their purchase.

**Note:** Members receive one approval email. Additional reminder emails are **not** sent.

## If only the Questions Gate is enabled

Members go **straight to the purchase page** after answering the questions.

## If only an Approval Gate is enabled

Members see the **Pending Approval** screen after creating their account and adding a profile photo.

## Collections and About Pages

When plans are visible in a [**Collection**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections) or on a [**Space/Network About Page:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-find-the-about-page-for-my-space-or-mighty-network)

1. Members see **Choose Plan**.
2. They answer Screening Questions (if enabled).
3. They see the **Approval** screen (if enabled).
4. Once approved, they can click **Confirm Payment**.
5. They are taken to the payment screen.

If only Screening Questions are enabled, members go directly to the purchase page. If only Approval is enabled, they wait on the Pending Approval screen.

If someone is invited directly to a Space, they are still required to answer screening questions and/or be approved to join.

## Invitations

If someone is [**invited**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members) to your Mighty Network or Spaces via an invite link, they will also complete Screening Questions and/or Approval, if enabled.

## Host-Initiated Plan Moves

<Note>
  When a Host moves a member to a different plan via **Admin > Plans > Plan List**, screening questions and approval gates on the destination plan are **bypassed**. The member is moved directly without being required to answer screening questions or receive approval, even if those gates are enabled on the destination plan.

  If you need members to complete screening questions or approval, have them request access through the standard checkout flow or an invite link instead. Learn more about [how members move between plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-members-move-between-plans).
</Note>

## Managing Approvals and Answers

When someone requests approval to join a plan:

* Hosts receive an **email** and **in-app notification**.
* You can view responses by going to **Admin > Plans > Plan List**, selecting the plan, and opening the **Members** tab.

## Notes

* Approval requests **do not expire**. They remain until you approve or deny them.
* The approval email includes the member’s name, the plan, and a direct link to review.
* The in-app notification also takes you directly to the Members tab.

You can also access the Members tab anytime by going to **Admin > Plans > Plan List** and selecting the plan.

## Space Hosts

[**Space Hosts**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-space-hosts-and-space-moderators-have) can view and approve Screening Questions **only** for plans that include the Space they host.

## When a Member’s Request Is Declined

If a request is declined:

* The member receives an **email notification** with a **See Status** button.
* The button takes them to the plan’s About Page, where they will see:
  * A **See Status** button (top right)
  * A **Membership Status** banner

Clicking either shows the declined status.

## Decline reasons

If the Host selects a reason, it will appear in the member’s view. Options include:

* Responses were insufficient
* Responses violated community guidelines
* Other (with a custom explanation)

If the Host selects **I do not wish to answer**, the member will see a simple “Request to Join Declined” message.

## Next steps for the member

Members can:

* Select **Close** to exit
* Select **Cancel** to withdraw their declined request

Withdrawing allows them to request access again.

## Free Trials With Screening Questions and Approval

If a plan includes a [Free Trial](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-offer-a-free-trial-on-a-mighty-network) and the member is awaiting approval:

* Their Free Trial does **not** start until the Host approves them
* The trial begins only after the member is approved and confirms the purchase


# Can I Take Payments Off Platform?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform



Mighty’s [**integrated payment features**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) make it easy to set up **one-time purchases**, [**subscriptions**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-installment-plans-and-subscription-intervals-and-subscription-intervals) with flexible intervals, and [**installment plans**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-installment-plans-and-subscription-intervals-and-subscription-intervals)—all with a smooth checkout flow. Members on the web can also use **Apple Pay** or **Google Pay**, and they can manage their payment information and subscriptions securely in one place.

If you need to take payments **off-platform** and then grant access to your Mighty Network, you can do that using **plans**.

[Plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) offer the most flexibility for gating access to your **Mighty Network**, individual **Spaces**, or both. They also let you bundle multiple Spaces with Network access, making it simple to give someone the right access after they make a purchase off-platform.

## Set Up Your Plans

Follow the [**steps in this article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)\*\* \*\*to create a plan.

Your first step is deciding what members should access on Mighty after they’ve completed their purchase off-platform.

Add access to your **Network** and/or specific **Spaces** to the plan you create.

If you **exclude** Network access from a plan, anyone who joins that plan will become a [**limited member**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership)—unless they already have Network access through another plan.

When you reach the **Choose Your Gates** step, keep all gating options turned **off**.

This allows people to join the plan in a single, simple flow with **no payment**, [**screening questions**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members), or [**approval**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members) required.

Once you’ve finished setting up your plan, decide how you want to invite people to join it so they can access everything you’ve included.

## Invite People to Your New Plans

Once you’ve created a plan without gates—and included everything someone should access in your Mighty Network after their off-platform purchase—you can choose how you want people to join. You can send direct invites or share a link to the plan.

## Send Invites to a Plan

Under [**Send Invites for This Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-a-default-plan-for-invites-beta), you’ll see the option to send **one-time use links** for joining the plan. Select the **Invite Form** link to open a page with the plan preselected and the option to send direct email invitations.

## Choose How People Join

You can decide whether people should:

* **Land on the Plan Landing Page**, or
* **Skip the Landing Page** and go straight to creating an account or signing in

### Plan Landing Page

If you send people to the Plan Landing Page, they’ll see the plan’s image, description, and a call to action to **Access** the plan. From there, they’ll create an account or sign in (if needed) and will be instantly added to everything included in the plan—such as your Network and any bundled Spaces.

### Skip the Landing Page

If you skip the Landing Page, people will go directly to the create-account or sign-in flow and will then be added immediately to everything included in the plan.

### Add Invitees

You can add individual email addresses for people who purchased off-platform or upload a CSV file. We recommend adding custom invite text so members understand how to access what they purchased.

## What Members Receive

Members will receive an email with your invite text and a button to **Access Now**, which walks them through joining the plan.

After you send an invite, invitees also receive **three automatic reminder emails**—sent after **3, 10, and 30 days**—if they haven’t joined yet.

## Use a Share Link for a Plan

In the [**Visibility & Sharing**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) tab, you can also generate a **Share Link for This Plan**. Share links can be used multiple times.

We strongly recommend using share links only when you’re embedding them inside a button or hyperlink in your post-purchase pages or emails. This helps keep the experience clean and avoids making the share link visible to members.

### Plan Landing Page vs. Skip Landing Page

Share links follow the same two options:

* **Plan Landing Page:** Takes people to a simple landing page with the plan image, description, and **Access** button. After creating an account or signing in, they are instantly added to everything included in the plan.
* **Skip Landing Page:** Takes people directly to the create-account or sign-in flow, then adds them immediately to the plan’s included access.

## Managing Share Links

You can delete and regenerate share links at any time by selecting **Delete All Links** at the bottom of the **Visibility & Sharing** tab.

## How to Set Up a Zap That Automatically Invites Someone to Your Plan

In this example, we’ll walk through setting up a Zap that automatically invites someone to your Mighty Network when they make a payment in Stripe.

## Set Up Your Trigger

### Choose App

Select **Stripe** as your Trigger app. You’ll need to sign in to your Stripe account so Zapier can connect to it.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 2 52 39 PM" />

### Select Trigger Event

Next, choose the specific Stripe Trigger you want to use. For this example, select **New Subscription**, which activates whenever a subscription is purchased.

## Set Up Your Action

After your Trigger is configured, you’ll set up the Action.

### Choose App & Event

Select **Mighty Networks** as your Action app. Then choose the Action **Plan Action**.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 2 52 57 PM" />

**The Action type will be “Invite to Plan”**

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 2 53 13 PM" />

**And search for the plan name to invite them to.**

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 2 53 32 PM" />

### Add Email Addresses

Under **Email Addresses**, select **Enter text** and map the **Email Address** field that comes in from your Stripe Trigger.

### Add Invite Text

Customize the invite text that will appear in the email notification sent to members.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 2 53 47 PM" />

### Choose the Landing Flow

Finally, decide whether you want the member to land on the **Plan Landing Page** or **Skip the Landing Page** and go directly into the create-account or sign-in flow before being added to the plan.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 2 54 05 PM" />

### Test and Turn On Your Zap

After you’ve finished setting up the Action, Zapier may prompt you to run a test to confirm that the data is transferring correctly. Once the test succeeds, Zapier will let you know that your Zap is ready to turn on.

## How to Set Up a Zap to Remove a Member from a Plan

If you want to automate canceling a member’s access when their external subscription ends, you can create a Zap that removes them from a plan.

In this example, we’ll use **Stripe**.

## Set Up Your Trigger

Select **Stripe** as your Trigger app, then choose the Trigger **Canceled Subscription**. This activates the Zap whenever a subscription is canceled in Stripe.

## Set Up Your Action

Select **Mighty Networks** as your Action app. Choose **Plan Action**, then set the Action Type to **Remove from Plan**.

From there:

* Search for and select the plan you want to remove the member from.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 2 54 30 PM" />

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 2 54 49 PM" />

* Under **Email Addresses**, map the email sent from Stripe so Zapier knows which member to remove.
* Run a test to make sure the Zap is working properly.

## Important Notes

* If a member has access to multiple plans that include overlapping Spaces, removing them from one plan **does not** remove their access to any overlapping Spaces.
* If a member joined your Mighty Network with a **different email address** than the one used for their off-platform purchase—or if they changed their email before canceling—the Zap will fail. Zapier will notify you, and you’ll need to remove the member manually.

## Additional Resources and Support

Zapier offers a comprehensive [Help Center](https://zapier.com/help) with guidance on [creating Zaps, managing](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/8496326119565-Manage-your-Zaps) your workflows, and troubleshooting issues. It’s a great place to get extra help as you set up or refine your automations.


# Does Mighty Networks Charge a Transaction Fee?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/does-mighty-networks-charge-a-transaction-fee



When you use Mighty Networks’ [payments feature](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan), a small transaction fee is applied to each purchase made in your Mighty Network. These fees are automatically deducted from your earnings in Stripe.

## Transaction Fee Structure

Transaction fees vary based on your Mighty Network plan:

* On the [Explore Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/untitled-page), a 5% transaction fee applies.
* On the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan), a 2% transaction fee applies.
* On the [**Scale Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-business-plan), a 1% transaction fee applies.
* On the [Growth Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan#whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan), a .50% transaction fee applies.
* On the **Growth Free Trial**, a 5% transaction fee applies.

This fee is **not charged to your members**. It’s automatically deducted from the amount you receive in your connected **Stripe** account.

You can learn more about how payments and payouts work in [this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-get-paid-from-my-mighty-network).

## Stripe as Our Payment Processor

Mighty Networks uses **Stripe** to securely process all web-based payments. In addition to Mighty Networks’ transaction fee, Stripe and most credit card companies collect a small processing fee—typically between **2.5% and 5%** per transaction.

These Stripe fees are automatically deducted before funds appear in your Stripe balance.

There are **no Stripe fees** for purchases made through the **Mighty Networks iOS app**.

Learn more about [how to connect and use Stripe with your Mighty Network](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network).

## Supported Stripe Countries

Stripe operates in a wide range of countries, which you can view on [Stripe’s website](https://stripe.com/global). Please note that **cross-border accounts** in **India, Malaysia, Brazil, and the Philippines** are subject to certain Stripe restrictions.

At this time, **PayPal and other payment providers** are not supported directly in the Mighty Networks product.

## iOS Purchases and Apple Fees

For purchases made through the **Mighty Networks iOS app**, payments are processed through **Apple In-App Purchases** and managed via the App Store.

Apple charges a **15% transaction fee** per transaction under its standard policy. Mighty Networks does **not apply any additional transaction fee** to iOS purchases.

When creating a plan, you can choose to **increase the iOS price** to offset Apple’s required fees. This helps keep your earnings consistent across platforms.

***For Hosts on Mighty Pro, the iOS transaction fee percentage depends on whether your team has enrolled in Apple’s App Store Small Business Program.***


# How Can I Move Paying Members from Another Platform to Mighty Networks?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-can-i-move-paying-members-from-another-platform-to-mighty-networks



If you’re moving to a Mighty Network from another platform, you may already have members who are paying for access to your community or Space. If your members are **not** paying, you can learn how to move them using [bulk invites in this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members).

You won’t be able to transfer their membership directly or create accounts for them. Instead, we recommend encouraging them to join your Mighty Network by offering a [**Free Trial**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-offer-a-free-trial-on-a-mighty-network) that covers more time than they have left on their existing subscription. The extra time becomes a simple, generous incentive for making the move.

## Step 1: Organize your members into cohorts

Group members based on how much time they have remaining in their current subscription. With Free Trial lengths available in 1-month increments from 1–12 months (plus shorter options of 3 days, 1 week, and 2 weeks), you can match cohorts closely to the time they have left:

* **11–12 months remaining**
* **10–11 months remaining**
* **9–10 months remaining**
* **8–9 months remaining**
* **7–8 months remaining**
* **6–7 months remaining**
* **3–6 months remaining**
* **1–3 months remaining**
* **1 month or less remaining**

Members with **lifetime access** should be grouped separately.

## Step 2: Create hidden Plans with matching Free Trial lengths

For each cohort, create a [hidden subscription Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) that grants access to your community or Space.

Set the renewal price and choose monthly or annual billing based on how they were previously paying.

Free Trials can be set to 3 days, 1 week, 2 weeks, or any whole month from 1 month up to 1 year (1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, or 12 months). Recommended Free Trial lengths:

* **1-year Free Trial** → Members with 11–12 months remaining
* **11-month Free Trial** → Members with 10–11 months remaining
* **10-month Free Trial** → Members with 9–10 months remaining
* **9-month Free Trial** → Members with 8–9 months remaining
* **8-month Free Trial** → Members with 7–8 months remaining
* **7-month Free Trial** → Members with 6–7 months remaining
* **6-month Free Trial** → Members with 3–6 months remaining
* **3-month Free Trial** → Members with 1–3 months remaining
* **1-month Free Trial** → Members with 1 month or less remaining

For members with **lifetime access**, create a **hidden free Plan** that grants permanent access.

## Step 3: Create and send Share Links

After setting up your Plans:

1. Generate a **Share Link** for each Plan.
2. Email each cohort with the Share Link that matches their remaining subscription time.
3. Invite them to claim their extended Free Trial and join you on your Mighty Network.

Even if members receive more free time than what remains of their old subscription, the added value helps create goodwill and increases the likelihood they’ll transition smoothly.


# How Do I Choose Where Plans Appear?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear



After you create a plan, you can choose where it appears to members and visitors. To manage this, go to **Admin > Plans > Plan List**, then select your plan and open the **Visibility & Sharing** tab.

Any option you enable here will make the plan visible instead of hidden.

You can choose to show a plan on:

* **Landing Page and Global Header**

* **Collections**

* **Network or Space About Page**

When a plan becomes visible—or when you create plan share links—the plan becomes active.

If any Spaces in the plan were previously **[Invite-Only](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space)**, they will automatically switch to **Accessible Through Plans**.

You can make these plans visible on:

* **Landing Page and Global Header**

* **Collections**

* **Space About Page**

(Plans that grant access to the full Network or [full memberships](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership))

You can make these plans visible on:

* **Landing Page and Global Header**

* **Collections**

**Use when:**

* If your **[Network visibility](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network)** (**Who Can View Content Inside Your Network**) is set to **Anyone**, visitors can view and join your plan directly from the **Network About** page.

# How Do I Connect and Disconnect Stripe to My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network



Mighty Networks uses **Stripe** as our third-party payment processor to ensure all transactions are secure and reliable.

When you connect your own Stripe account, you'll get paid directly through Stripe—meaning Mighty Networks never stores or processes your members' credit card details. Stripe currently supports **credit cards, debit cards, and prepaid cards**.

You can manage your payments, refunds, and customer details directly in Stripe.​

Learn more about Stripe on [stripe.com](https://stripe.com).

**Note:** Stripe is available in 46 countries. You can view supported countries [here](https://stripe.com/global).

At this time, Mighty Networks does **not support PayPal or other payment processors.**

## How to Connect Your Stripe Account

1. Go to **Admin > Payments > Stripe** — the direct path is `/admin/stripe`.
2. Choose **Connect Stripe Account**.
3. Follow the prompts to either:
   * Connect an existing Stripe account, or
   * Create a new Stripe account directly from the setup screen.

Once connected, your Mighty Network is ready to process payments, subscriptions, and one-time purchases instantly.

## Changing or Disconnecting Your Stripe Account

If you only need to change the **bank account** where Stripe sends payouts, you can do this directly in your Stripe dashboard without disconnecting from Mighty Networks.

Refer to [Stripe's Help Center guide](https://support.stripe.com/questions/update-existing-bank-account-information) for step-by-step instructions, or [contact Stripe Support](https://support.stripe.com/) if you need additional help.

If you need to disconnect your Stripe account completely:

1. Click the **Need Help** button in the bottom right corner of your Mighty Network.
2. Send a message to our team who will assist you with next steps.

## Important Notes About Stripe

## Manage Plans Only in Mighty Networks

Always manage, edit, or deactivate your **Plans** inside Mighty Networks—never in Stripe.

Why this matters: Making changes to Plans directly in Stripe can cause serious issues, including loss of subscribed members and deletion of Plans.

You can still:

* View transactions
* Manage individual payments
* Issue refunds

...all directly within your Stripe account.

## Re-Enabling Payments

If you deactivate payments and later decide to re-enable them, you'll need to connect a **new Stripe account** when setting up payments again. You can't reuse the same account that was connected previously.

## Multiple Mighty Networks

Each Mighty Network must have its **own Stripe account connection**.

If you manage multiple Networks:

* Create a separate Stripe account for each one.
* You can manage multiple Stripe accounts under a single email address by using [Stripe's "multiple accounts" feature](https://stripe.com/docs/account/multiple-accounts).

Each Stripe account can only be linked to **one Mighty Network** at a time. This ensures that notifications like failed payments are properly routed to the correct Network.

For more information about multiple currencies and Stripe, [**check out this article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-currencies-can-i-charge-in-on-mighty-networks).


# How Do I Create a Plan?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan



<iframe title="YouTube video player" />

**Plans** offer the most options and flexibility for gating access to your Mighty Network, Spaces, or both.

Use plans if you want to require people to do one or more of the following when joining:

* Pay (Payments gate)
* Answer questions (Screening Questions gate)
* Request approval (Approval gate)
* Or a set of Spaces in a [Collection](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections)

You can set [where plans appear for people to join](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear), or choose to make them accessible by a link only and share that link with specific groups of people.

## Before You Start

Decide how you want to sell access to your courses, events, or experiences. Check out Mighty Networks’ [recommendations](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-gate-access-to-all-or-parts-of-my-mighty-network) before creating your first plan.

### Looking for guidance? [Chat with Cohost!](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-chat-with-cohost#how-do-i-chat-with-cohost)

Cohost can help you with:

* Naming
* Pricing
* Gates
* Sales Pitch
* Benefits List
* Descriptions

It will even create the Plan for you!

## Create a New Plan

1. Go to **Admin > Plans & Access > Plan List**.
2. Click the **Create Plan** button in the top-right corner to create a new plan.

This is the first screen you will see:

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 27 27 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 27 27 PM" />

## Step 1: Choose What’s Included

**Network Access:**

* Members get [full access](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) to your entire Network, including private messaging and all Spaces.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 27 50 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 27 50 PM" />

**Space Access**

* Members get access to [just one Space or a bundle of Spaces](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership)—perfect for courses, paid communities, or special events.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 28 05 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 28 05 PM" />

Finally, decide [**where members will land**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/can-i-customize-the-landing-space-for-my-members) after they join the plan.

## Step 2: Fill in the Details

* **Plan Name:** The name people will see when joining.
* **Internal Note:** Only visible to Hosts and helpful for tracking similar plans. This is also useful when filtering plan data in [Mighty Insights™](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/what-is-mighty-insights).
* **Image or Video:** Adding an image or video makes your plan look dynamic and appealing, and this image will appear in any prompts to join the plan as well as the top of the plan page
* **Sales Pitch:** A short tagline that appears alongside the plan name to explain why people should join this plan. (120 characters max).
* **Benefits List:** This list highlights the benefits your members receive or the access they will get when they join or purchase this plan. We recommend adding at least three!
* **Description:** Explain what’s included, who it’s for, and why it’s valuable. You can add text, links, or images.

If you don’t add a custom description, the plan will automatically use the existing description from your Network or Space.

## Step 3: Choose Your Gates

On the next screen, you’ll see the ability to add gates.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 28 24 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 28 24 PM" />

Enabling any of the options listed will take you through a flow to customize and set up those gates.

* [**Screening Questions:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members) Ask up to 5 questions before someone can join.
* [**Approval:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members) Require Host approval before joining.
* **Payments:** Charge for access using [**Stripe**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network).
* [**Web3 Token Gating:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-token-gated-plan) Require a specific crypto token for access.

If you leave all gates off, anyone can join your plan in one simple step—no payment, questions, or approval needed.

## Step 4: Set Pricing

If you add a payment gate, choose one of these options:

* **Free:** Open to everyone (shows “Free” label). If you don’t want “Free” to appear and you don’t want to charge for access, we recommend going back one step and turning off the Payments gate.
* **One-Time Payment:** Members pay once for lifetime access.
* **Subscription:** Charge on a recurring basis (daily, monthly, annually, etc.).
  * You have the option to offer members a recurring subscription they can cancel anytime (daily, weekly, monthly, annually, etc...). You can have two subscription interval options set up per plan. [Learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-installment-plans-and-subscription-intervals).
  * Members retain access to what’s included in the plan as long as they continue paying for the subscription.
  * When you offer both a monthly and annual subscription, we recommend giving members a discount for choosing the annual option, and the savings will be clearly shown.
  * All interval options are available on web and mobile web. Only monthly and annually are available on iOS.
* **Installments:** Split a one-time payment into multiple charges.
  * This setup allows a one-time purchase plan to be split into multiple payments. [Learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-installment-plans-and-subscription-intervals).
* **Combine Offers:** Show two options side by side (for example, monthly vs. annual). [Learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-installment-plans-and-subscription-intervals).

## Step 5: Choose Platforms

Decide where your plan will be available:

* **Web:**
  * Charge up to \$10,000 per plan (or more if processed [off-platform](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform)).
* **iOS:**
  * iOS plan prices must be chosen from Apple’s preset list, which ends in **999**. Apple charges a **15% fee** on all in-app purchases made through the **Mighty Networks iOS app**.
  * All payments are processed and managed through the **App Store**—Mighty Networks does **not** charge any extra transaction fees.
  * Each plan goes through **Apple’s review process** before it’s approved; you’ll get an **email notification** once approved.
  * You can **increase your iOS price** to offset Apple’s required fees if desired.
  * If you’re on **Mighty Pro** with your own branded app, our team will guide you through a **different setup process** for iOS purchases.
  * **Note:** Apple automatically **converts currency** based on the buyer’s location. Choose from preset prices (up to \$999).
* **Android**
  * Paid plans can be promoted, but purchases happen on the web.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 28 45 PM" />

### You can also add:

* **Free Trials:**
  * Offer a 3-day to 1-year trial. [Learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-offer-a-free-trial-on-a-mighty-network).
* **Subscription Groups:** Connect related subscription plans so members can easily switch between them.
  * Within a group, members can browse a carousel of available plans and, if you’ve offered multiple billing intervals, choose the one that works best for them. [Learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-subscription-group).

## Step 6: Taxes and Payouts

* Payments from the **web** go straight to your **Stripe account**.
* Payments from **iOS** are handled by Apple, and Mighty Networks sends payouts monthly.
* If using **Quaderno**, you can set a tax category for automatic tax handling. [Learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-taxes-work-with-my-mighty-network).

If you are on [Mighty Pro with your own branded apps](https://www.mightynetworks.com/pro), the Apple payout process will be different, and iOS purchases will flow directly into the bank account you have connected to your Apple Developer Account. [Learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-get-paid-from-my-mighty-network)

## Step 7: Finish and Share

Once you've created your plan, you'll see a preview of how it will look to your members.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 08 46 PM" />

Click **Create Plan**.

Then, go to **Admin > Plans & Access > Plan List > (select your plan) > Visibility & Sharing** to choose where your plan appears and how you want to share it.

## Visibility

* If the plan includes access to the **Network**, you’ll see the option to make it visible in places like the Network About Page.
* If the plan includes access to a **Space or bundle of Spaces**, you’ll see the option to make it visible on the Collection where the Space lives, or on the Space About Page.

To learn more, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear).

## Sharing

### Invite to Plan

* These invites are one-time use, and cannot be used again once an account has been created. [Learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-a-default-plan-for-invites-beta)

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 29 41 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 29 41 PM" />

* Creating a share link gives you a direct way to share your plan. You’ll see two or three link options, depending on what’s included or if the plan combines multiple offers.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 29 54 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 29 54 PM" />

Takes people to a detailed page showing the plan’s name, image, benefits, description, and a call to action depending on whether payment is required.

# How Do I Create a Subscription Group?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-subscription-group



A **Subscription Group** links related subscription Plans together so that members can:

* Move between Plans in the same group
* See a **carousel** of available Plans in **Personal Settings > Plans and Access**
* Choose a different **billing interval** (for example, monthly or quarterly) if multiple options are available

Each Subscription Group creates a single upgrade or downgrade path for your members.

This feature is ideal for tiered memberships—for example, Bronze, Silver, and Gold Plans—where you want members to easily move between levels without canceling their existing Plan.

Example: A member on the Bronze Plan can upgrade to Silver instantly within their settings because both Plans belong to the same Subscription Group.

## How to Set Up Subscription Groups

## 1. Create Your Plans

First, create the subscription Plans you want to include in your new Subscription Group. Plans in a Subscription Group must:

* Be **subscription** or **free Plans** (one-time Plans aren’t supported).
* Be available for purchase on the **web** (not in-app).

You can learn more about creating Plans [here](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/1611085-browser-support).

### 2. Create the Subscription Group

1. Go to **Admin > Marketing > Subscription Groups.**
2. Click the **+** icon in the upper-right corner.
3. Add a **name** and select the **platform** (web or iOS).
4. Choose the Plans you want to include in this group.
5. **Order your Plans** with the highest-tiered Plan at the top, followed by lower-tiered Plans in descending order (e.g., Gold → Silver → Bronze).

## 3. Add a New Plan to an Existing Group

When you create a new Plan, you’ll see an option to assign it to a Subscription Group.

**Important notes:**

* On **web**, you can add or remove a Plan from a group at any time.
* On **iOS**, you must assign the group during Plan creation.
* Each Plan can only belong to **one Subscription Group**.
  * If you want a similar Plan in another group, duplicate the Plan first.
* You can set the **order** of Plans within a group separately for web and iOS.

## How Members Move Plans

Members can change Plans from **Personal Settings > Plans and Access.**

1. Select their current Plan.
2. Click **Change Plan.**
3. A carousel will appear showing the other Plans in the same Subscription Group.

When members select a new Plan, they’ll see:

* The Plan’s benefits and description (as added by the Host)
* Available billing intervals (for example, monthly or quarterly)
* Pricing details

After confirming, their subscription updates immediately—no need to cancel or lose access first.

## How Subscription Groups Affect Plan Movement

Subscription Groups determine how members can move between Plans. The experience varies slightly by platform.

## Members on Plans Inside a Subscription Group

* **Web:** Members can only move between Plans in the same group. Hidden Plans within the group will not appear in the upgrade carousel.
* **iOS:** Members can only move between Plans in the same group. Hidden Plans will still appear and can be selected.

## Members on Plans Outside of a Subscription Group

* **Web:** Members can move to any **visible Plan** that’s also outside a group.
* **iOS:** Members **cannot move** between Plans unless those Plans are in a Subscription Group.

## How to Test the Member Experience

To see how Subscription Groups work in action:

1. Create a **test member account** and join your Mighty Network.
2. Go to **Personal Settings > Plans and Access.**
3. Try upgrading or downgrading between Plans in the same group to confirm the experience.

## Best Practices

* Use Subscription Groups for **tiered offerings** (for example, Bronze → Silver → Gold).
* Keep group names clear and descriptive so it’s easy to manage multiple sets.
* Test both **web** and **iOS** experiences if your Network supports in-app purchases.


# How Do I Create a Token-Gated Plan?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-token-gated-plan



Token-Gated plans let you gate access to your Mighty Network, a Space, or a bundle using a Web3 token instead of a traditional payment.

A plan can use **Stripe payments** *or* **token-gating**, but not both at the same time.

If you want to offer both options, you can create two separate plans that unlock the same Network, Space, or bundle.

## Why You’d Use Token-Gated Plans

Token-gating lets you verify whether someone holds a specific token, NFT, or minimum token amount before joining. This is useful if you’re running an NFT community, offering exclusive access to token holders, or validating identity or ownership via blockchain.

## How to Create a Token-Gated Plan

1. Go to **Admin > Plans > Plan List**.

2. Select **Create Plan**.

3. When you reach the **Gate** section, select **Token-Gating**.

4. Continue to the **Configure** panel to set up your requirements.

From the Configure panel, you can set the following:

### Token Type

Select the token type you want to use. We currently support:

* **ERC-20** (cryptocurrency)

* **ERC-721** (NFTs)

* **ERC-1155** (NFTs)

### Chain

Choose the blockchain network. Today we support **[Ethereum Mainnet](https://ethereum.org/en/enterprise/)**. Additional chains will be added in the future.

If needed, you can also select an optional **Layer 2 protocol** (currently **[Immutable X](https://www.immutable.com/)**).

### Token

Choose an existing token from the dropdown, or paste the token’s **Contract Address** directly into the field.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-token-gated-plan/9218965636493)

### Minimum Amount

Set the minimum amount required in a member’s wallet.

* For an NFT, enter **1** to confirm ownership of a specific asset.

* For ERC-20 tokens, enter the required token amount.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-token-gated-plan/9219056518285)

### Token ID (NFTs only)

If you selected **ERC-721** or **ERC-1155**, you can optionally enter a **Token ID** when you want to require a specific NFT.

If an NFT has multiple copies (each with its own Token ID) and you want to allow all copies, leave this field blank and enter only the contract address above.

If you are configuring based on an NFT listed on OpenSea, you’ll find the Contract Address and Token ID in the **Details** section of the NFT’s OpenSea listing.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-token-gated-plan/9218960196109)

## Previewing Your Token-Gated Plan

After configuring your settings, you’ll move to the **Preview** step. Here you can view what members will see before joining and return to earlier steps to make changes.

## Managing Token-Gated Plans and Members

Token-Gated plans appear alongside all other plans in your **Plan Details** page.

**Important:** Members on Token-Gated plans cannot currently be moved to another plan.

To learn how members purchase Token-Gated plans, review our [related article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-purchase-a-token-gated-plan).


# How Do I Create a Waitlist?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-waitlist



Waitlists let you collect interest before your Mighty Network, a new Plan, or an upcoming offering is ready to launch. 

Instead of sending members to an experience that isn't available yet, you can create a waitlist, add it to a landing page, and start building your audience before launch.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Waitlist Marketing Image 1" title="Waitlist Marketing Image 1" />
</Frame>

**Note:** Waitlists are currently available on web only.

## **Create a Waitlist**

You can create a waitlist from a[ <u>Landing Page</u>](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-customize-my-mighty-networks-landing-page#how-to-set-up-your-landing-page) or directly from the Waitlists page in Admin.

### **From a Landing Page**

* Go to **Admin** > **Marketing** > **Landing Pages**.
* Create a new landing page or edit an existing one.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 06 23 At 10 10 10 AM 2" title="Screenshot 2026 06 23 At 10 10 10 AM 2" />
</Frame>

* Add a **Waitlist** section.

* Choose **Create New Waitlist** (or you can choose an existing one)

* Complete your waitlist settings:
  <Frame>
    <img alt="Screenshot 2026 06 23 At 10 12 12 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 06 23 At 10 12 12 AM" />
  </Frame>
  * **Internal Name** (for your reference)
  * **Customize the confirmation message** -this is the message that people who join the waitlist will receive
  * **Close Date and Time** (optional)
    * If you would like to have a countdown timer, choose this option
  * **Auto-Invite on Close** (optional)
  * If you enable **Auto-Invite on Close**, choose whether people should be invited to:
  * Your Mighty Network, or
  * A specific Plan and[ <u>where you would like them to land</u>](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan#plan-landing-page):
    * Plan Landing Page
    * Create Account Page
    * Sign in Page

* Customize the invitation message that will be sent when the waitlist closes.

* Save your waitlist.

### **From the Waitlists Page**

1. Go to **Admin > Marketing > Waitlists**.
2. Select **Create Waitlist**.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 06 23 At 10 24 32 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 06 23 At 10 24 32 AM" />
</Frame>

Then follow the same steps as above to setup the waitlist.

## **Customize Your Waitlist**

Once your waitlist has been created, you can customize how it appears on your Landing Page.

You can edit:

* Heading and description
* Call-to-action button text
* Background image
* Optional countdown timer

The colors that it shows are from your[ <u>Network branding colors</u>](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-network-branding#colors).

When you're ready, **click Save.**

## **Waitlist Notifications**

### **Host notifications**

As a Host, you will receive a notification (email, in-app or push) whenever someone joins a waitlist.

This notification is turned on by default and you can manage it by going to **Personal Settings > Notifications**

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 14 At 8 19 48 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 14 At 8 19 48 AM" />
</Frame>

### **Waitlist confirmation emails**

When someone joins your waitlist, they'll automatically receive a confirmation email letting them know they've successfully signed up. The email also includes an unsubscribe link.

If they are a full member, they will also get an in-app or push notification.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 06 22 At 3 20 47 PM" title="Screenshot 2026 06 22 At 3 20 47 PM" />
</Frame>

**Tip:** We recommend joining your own waitlist with a test email address to confirm both the signup confirmation and confirmation email look the way you expect.

## **Managing Waitlists**

To manage your waitlists, go to:

**Admin** > **Marketing** > **Waitlists**

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 06 23 At 10 24 32 AM 2" title="Screenshot 2026 06 23 At 10 24 32 AM 2" />
</Frame>

From here you can:

* View all waitlists
* Edit waitlists
* Sort waitlists
* View waitlist leads
* Manually close a waitlist
* Delete a waitlist

## **Manage Leads**

All waitlist signups are available in:

**Admin** > **Members** > **Leads**

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 06 23 At 10 25 52 AM 2" title="Screenshot 2026 06 23 At 10 25 52 AM 2" />
</Frame>

This page also includes [**Sent Invites** and **Requests to Join**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-sent-invites-and-requests-to-join), making it the central place to manage prospective members.

From the Leads page you can:

* Search by email address
* Filter by:
  * Date
  * Status
  * Waitlist
  * Source landing page

On the[ <u>Explore plan and above</u>](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/exploreplan#what%E2%80%99s-included-in-the-mighty-networks-explore-plan) you will be able to

* See lead emails
* Invite individual leads
* Send bulk invitations
* Download leads as a CSV

## **Sync Waitlists with Kit**

If you use the[ <u>Kit integration</u>](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-create-an-email-newsletter#how-do-i-create-an-email-newsletter), you can automatically sync waitlist signups.

To enable syncing:

1. Go to **Admin** > **Integrations** > **Kit**.
2. Turn on **Sync Waitlist Emails**.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 14 At 8 22 18 AM 1" title="Screenshot 2026 07 14 At 8 22 18 AM 1" />
</Frame>

Note: syncing will not be on automatically and emails will not sync retroactively

Waitlist signups are sent to Kit with the following tags:

* **Waitlist Name**
* **Mighty Networks Integration**

Once someone creates an account, their Network tag will also be added.

After enabling the integration, create a test signup to verify that new waitlist leads are syncing correctly.

## **Close a Waitlist**

You can manually close a waitlist at any time.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Marketing** > **Waitlists**.
2. Select your waitlist.
3. Click **Close Waitlist**.

If **Auto-Invite on Close** is enabled, everyone on the waitlist will automatically receive your invitation email.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### **Do people need a Mighty Networks account to join a waitlist?**

No. Anyone can join a waitlist by submitting their email address on your landing page.

### **Can I invite people later?**

Yes. You can invite individual leads or send invitations in bulk from **Admin** > **Members** > **Leads**.

### **Can I automatically invite everyone when my waitlist closes?**

Yes. Enable **Auto-Invite on Close** when creating your waitlist.

### **Can I add Leads to a Space, plan etc?**

At this time, Leads haven't created a full account yet, so they can't be managed as full or limited members.

### **Can people see where they are in line?**

No. Waitlists do not display a person's position.

### **Can I limit the number of people on a waitlist?**

Waitlists do not currently support capacity limits.

### **Can I create a waitlist for an individual Space?**

Waitlists are added to landing pages and can invite people to your Network or a specific Plan. They are not available for individual Spaces.
