# How Do I Directly Add Existing Members to My Network or Spaces?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-directly-add-existing-members-to-my-network-or-spaces



<iframe />

With the Direct Add feature, [Network Hosts and moderators](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-network-hosts-and-network-moderators-have) can instantly add existing members to Spaces or the Network without sending invites or requiring any action from members.

### Use Direct Add to:

* Give [full members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) immediate access to one or more Spaces
* Upgrade [limited members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) to full Network access
* Automate membership assignments through [Automations](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network) or [Zapier](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-use-zapier-with-mighty-networks)

**Important Notes:**

* Only [Network Hosts and moderators](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-network-hosts-and-network-moderators-have) can use this feature.
* Only members who already have accounts in your Mighty Network can be directly added to Spaces or the Network.
* If a member later joins a plan that includes the Space, their access becomes tied to the plan.
* Adding will bypass plan requirements (paid or free), screening questions, approvals, or member actions.
* We do not support directly adding to a plan. Consider [moving members to plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-members-move-between-plans) instead.
* Direct Add does not add members to plans, so any plan gates do not apply when directly adding members.
* If a member leaves a Space they were directly added to, they lose the ability to rejoin it and must be added again by the Host or join through another route.
* If you are adding a large number of members, it may take a while for them to be added. You will get a notification when they have all been added successfully.
* If you add a Network Host to a Space, they will join as a [Space Host](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-space-hosts-and-space-moderators-have).

## How Do I Directly Add a Member to My Network or Spaces?

You have three options:

* Add a single member
* Add members in bulk
* Use Mighty Automations or Zapier to add a member

## Add a Single Member

Step 1: Open the Member List

* Go to **Admin > Members > Member List**.

Step 2: In the member list, select the three-dot menu next to the member’s name.

Whether you can directly add a member to Spaces or the Network depends on their member type.

You can add:

* “Add to Network” will show if the member is [**a limited member.**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership)
* “Add to Spaces” will show if the member is a [full member](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership).

## Add Members in Bulk

Step 1: Open the [Member List](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members)

* Go to **Admin > Members > Member List**.

Step 2: Select multiple members in the member list

* Click the “Bulk Actions” menu.
* Select “Add to Network” [**to upgrade limited members to full member**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership)**s.**
* Select “Add to Spaces” to give [full member](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership)**s** access to one or more Spaces.

If you are adding members to Spaces, you can select multiple Spaces to add them to.

Bulk Add makes it easy to onboard new groups or reorganize members across Spaces!

## Notifications

As a Host, you will receive email and push notifications (if enabled) when:

* Members have received access to Spaces and/or the Network
* Members were not successfully added.

Members will also receive notifications when they have been added to Spaces or the Network.

## Automate Directly Adding Members

You can use [**Automations**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network) or [**Zapier**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-use-zapier-with-mighty-networks) to add members automatically.

[**Automations:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network)

* Actions
  * Add to Network (limited members only)
    * Add limited members to the Network immediately, skipping the invite flow.
  * Add to Space(s) (full members only)
    * Adds full members to Space(s) immediately, skipping the invite flow.

[**Zapier Actions:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-use-zapier-with-mighty-networks)

* Direct Add Member to Space
* Direct Add Member to Network​ (only limited members)**​**​​


# How Do I Gate Access to All or Parts of My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-gate-access-to-all-or-parts-of-my-mighty-network



Plans offer the most options and flexibility for gating access to your Mighty Network, Spaces, or both.

Use plans if you want to require people to do one or more of the following when joining:

* Pay (Payment gate)
* Answer questions (Screening Questions gate)
* Request approval (Approval gate)

You can set [where Plans appear for people to join](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear), or make them [accessible only via a link ](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan#:~:text=Create%20Share%20Links%20for%20Your%20Plan)and share them with specific groups.

## Choose Your Gates

Question and approval gates can be added to any plan and are valuable for screening potential members and gathering information about them at signup. [Learn more about setting up screening questions and approval here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members-before-purchasing).

For the rest of this article, we’ll focus primarily on setting up payment gates for your Network and Spaces, and the [Privacy & Access Settings](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network) you’ll pair with them.

But first, regardless of which option you choose, know that you can always:

* **Create Spaces set so that anyone in the Network can view content inside** and **Anyone Can Join** (meaning all Network members), and consider making these Spaces Auto Join if you want all Network members to join them.
* **Create Spaces that are accessible only to select Network members** by keeping those Spaces set to Invite-Only, or by creating a hidden plan with no payment gate and setting the Spaces so that only logged-in Space members can see they exist.
* **Offer** [limited memberships](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) by creating a subscription plan that includes only access to Space(s) and not the Network. This option is ideal for setting up a value journey, standalone courses, or a lead magnet that funnels into full Network access.
* **Set up one-time purchase plans that include only access to Spaces**, so members keep access to these Spaces regardless of whether they are also on a plan that includes the Network.

## Recommended Option #1

## Screen for Access to the Network, Then Charge for Subscription Access to Spaces

This option will work best for most Networks.

## How to Set Up Your Network

**1. Require approval to join the Network**

* Create **a plan with an approval gate (but no payment gate) that includes the Network** and set it to appear on your **Network Landing Page**. This helps protect against bad actors and spammers joining your Network.

**2. Decide who can view content inside your Network**

* To help people get a sense of what’s inside your Network, including any plans they can purchase later, set your Network to **Anyone can view content inside**. People will be able to see all plans that appear on visible Collections and **Space About Pages**.
* Alternatively, if you don’t want people to be able to preview your content or any plans on visible Collections and **Space About Pages**, you can set your Network so that **Only logged-in members can view content inside**. Then, decide if you want to promote plans that include only Spaces on your **Network Landing Page**.

## How to Set Up Your Spaces

**1. Charge for access to Spaces**

* Create plans with subscription payment gates that **include access to a Space or bundle of Spaces, but not the Network.**
* Set these plans to appear on the Collection and **Space About Pages**.
* Note:
  * Anyone who leaves their plan granting access to the Network will retain access to these Spaces as limited members.
  * Anyone who joins only these plans that include access to Spaces (i.e., who doesn’t also have access to your Network through another plan) will be a limited member.
  * To prevent the above two scenarios from occurring and ensure that everyone who joins any plan is a full Network member, include the Network in your plans. Then, you can decide if you want these plans to appear on the **Network Landing Page** in addition to the Collection and **Space About Pages**.

**2. Allow anyone to find and see your gated Spaces**

* Set your payment-gated Spaces so that **Anyone in the Network can see them, making it easy for people to find and purchase access**.

**3. Decide who can view content inside your gated Spaces**

* If you want people to be able to preview the content of a Space before purchasing access, set the Space to **Anyone in the Network can view content inside**. Keep in mind that if you choose this option *and* your **Network is also set to Anyone can view content inside**, then visitors can also see inside the Space.

## Recommended Option #2

## Charge for Subscription Access to Your Network

This is the simplest way to structure your Network and plans, and it offers options for expansion later on.

## How to Set Up Your Network

**1. Create a plan with a subscription payment gate that only includes the Network**.

**2. Set the Network so that Only logged-in members can view content inside.**

* Alternatively, you can set your Network to **Anyone can view content inside**. However, this means that visitors will also be able to see inside any Spaces set to **Anyone can see this Space** and **Anyone in the Network can view content inside**.

## How to Set Up Your Spaces

**1. Set your Spaces to Anyone Can Join** and **Anyone can see this Space** so that members can choose which Spaces they want to join. Make these Spaces auto-join if you wish for all Network members to join them automatically.

**2. Later, if you want to expand on this structure, you can:**

* **Create plans that include only Spaces, not the Network**, then offer them to Network members and/or as limited memberships. This is perfect if you want to create a home for your lead magnet or offer a standalone course that both limited members and full Network members can access.
* **Create plans that include your Spaces and the Network** so that new members can purchase directly from your Network's landing page, and/or existing members can move across plans as they upgrade or downgrade without paying for the Network twice or losing access to it.

### A Few Notes on Limited and Full Membership Plans:

* **A member can be on multiple plans that include the Network** (full membership plans) **and** **multiple plans that do not include the Network** (limited membership plans) at the same time.
* **Any plan that includes the Network is a full membership plan** and will be available to join as long as it’s visible somewhere (on the Network Landing Page, Network About Page, Collection Page, or Space About Page) or a person has access to the plan through an invite to the plan or a plan share link.
* **Any Plan that does not include the Network is a limited membership** **plan** and will be available to join as long as it’s visible somewhere (on the Network Landing Page, Collection Page, or Space About Page) or a person has access to the plan through an invite to the plan or a plan share link.

***If you do not want to offer limited memberships, then every plan you create must include the Network.***


# How Do I Get Paid?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-get-paid



This article outlines all the details of how you get paid when you [**create Plans for members to buy**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan), how to access your reports, how transactions are defined, and how tax collection works.

If you don't find answers here, please reach out to us directly via [Need Help within your Mighty Network](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-get-help).

## Your Plan Payments

We want you to get paid quickly and reliably! Mighty Networks processes all payments through **Stripe**, our trusted third-party payment processor, which is supported in [**46 countries**](https://stripe.com/global).

We do not currently support PayPal or other payment processors, but you can use an external payment method if needed. To learn more, see [Can I Take Payments Off Platform?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform)

## Connecting Stripe

When you add your first Plan, you’ll be prompted to [**connect your Mighty Network to Stripe**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network).

* For all **web purchases**, payments are collected directly through Stripe. You can link a bank account and transfer funds there.
* For **iOS app purchases**, payments are processed by Apple via **In-App Purchase**. Apple sends bulk payments to Mighty Networks, and we deposit those funds into your connected Stripe account.

iOS payments take **8–12 weeks** to process and typically arrive **about one month behind** the current date. This delay is due to Apple’s payout schedule.

## Your Income Reports

Your **Income Reports** show how much you’ve earned from selling Plans within your Mighty Network.

Each report includes:

* **Gross revenue** by Plan
* **Fees** and **taxes collected**
* **Net revenue** (after fees)
* **Apple payouts** (if applicable)

Income Reports also summarize past activity, including revenue received through Stripe. They display the currency your Network is settled in on Stripe, regardless of which currencies are enabled on your Network. To learn more about selling in multiple currencies, see [Selling in Multiple Currencies](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-charge-in-multiple-currencies).

## How to View Income Reports

Go to **Admin > Plans & Access > Income Reports**.

From here:

* Each Income Report represents a specific **time period**.
* Your **first report** will be ready **8–12 weeks** after setting up your first active Plan.
* You’ll receive ongoing reports **mid-month**, covering the **previous 8 weeks** (to align with Apple’s payout delay).
* Click any individual Plan in the overview to view a detailed breakdown.

Mighty Pro Hosts: If you have your own branded iOS app, Apple fees will not appear in your Mighty Networks Income Reports. You can find full details within your **App Store Connect** account.

## Income Information in Stripe

You can also view revenue directly in Stripe:

1. Log into your **Stripe account**.
2. Go to **Product Catalog > Analyze**.
3. Review data such as:
   * [**Total MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue)**](https://support.stripe.com/questions/understanding-monthly-recurring-revenue-\(mrr\)) by product
   * [**Active Subscribers**](https://support.stripe.com/questions/understanding-active-subscribers) by product
   * **Total Subscription Quantity** by product

These reports show performance by product over the past two years.

**Note:** Plan names from Mighty Networks do not transfer to Stripe. You’ll need to identify plans by **subscription interval** and **price**.

*Please note that Plan names do not transfer from Mighty Networks to Stripe, so you need to identify each plan based on the subscription interval and price*.

## Transaction Fees

When a member purchases a Plan, several fees may apply.

## Mighty Networks Transaction Fee

Mighty Networks charges a [**platform transaction fee**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/does-mighty-networks-charge-a-transaction-fee#does-mighty-networks-charge-a-transaction-fee), which varies depending on your Network’s Plan level. This fee is automatically deducted from your **Stripe account**.

## Stripe Fees

Stripe (and most credit card companies) also charge a small processing fee, typically **2.5%–5%** for web purchases. There are **no Stripe fees** for iOS purchases.

You can find more details in our article on [Using Stripe with Your Mighty Network](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network).

## Apple Fees

For purchases made through the **Mighty Networks iOS app**, all payments are processed through **Apple In-App Purchases** and managed via the App Store.

Apple takes a **15% transaction fee** per purchase. Mighty Networks does **not** charge a transaction fee for iOS purchases.

**Tip:** You can set a **higher price on iOS** to offset Apple’s required transaction fee.

**Mighty Pro Hosts:**

If you’re part of the **App Store Small Business Program**, your Apple transaction fee percentage may differ.

## Taxes

As a Host using payment features on Mighty Networks, you are responsible for any applicable taxes—both where you are located and where your members are purchasing from.

To simplify this, we integrate with **Quaderno**, a third-party tax tool that connects directly with Stripe and supports flexible tax setup.

## Default Tax Setting

By default, **no taxes** are collected for member purchases made on web. This includes both new purchases and ongoing subscriptions.

## Collecting Taxes via Quaderno

To collect taxes, set up **Quaderno** to integrate with your Stripe account and Mighty Networks purchase flow. For setup instructions, see [Setting Up Taxes with Quaderno](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-taxes-work-with-my-mighty-network).

## iOS App Purchases

For all purchases made through the **iOS app**, Apple handles tax collection and remittance directly with the appropriate tax authorities.


# How Do I Give Access to Spaces and Not the Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-give-access-to-spaces-and-not-the-network



[**Limited memberships**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) let you offer a standalone experience—such as a course, live event, or lead magnet—within a single Space or across several Spaces **without** giving people full access to your Network.

By limiting access to Network-level features like private messaging, the [Global Feed](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-global-features), and [Global Members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-global-features), you can:

* Keep your broader community gated, exclusive, or reserved for paying members.
* Use individual Spaces as entry points to generate leads and interest without opening your entire Network.
* Sell programs or experiences on their own while keeping your full community experience separate for members on higher-tier plans.

Check out the article, [**“What is a Full vs. Limited Membership?”**](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/11508714-what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) for more information on what a limited member has access to.

## How to Set Up a Limited Membership

* [**Create the Space or Spaces**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces) you want to include in your limited membership.
* Go to **Admin > Plan List** and click the **+** icon to [create a new plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan). Limited memberships must be offered through a plan—not through invites.
* In **Plan Details**, add the Space(s) you want to include.​**Do not** add Network access. Limited memberships only grant access to specific Spaces.
* Decide whether you want the plan to require **payment**, **screening questions**, and/or **approval**.
* For more information on these settings, see our [**article on setting up a plan.**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)

**Important:** Limited members can **only** join Spaces through paid plans. Invites and "Anyone Can Join" settings do not apply to limited members for Space access—they must have a valid payment for a plan that includes the Space.

### For a full tutorial, check out the video:

<iframe />

## Choose Where Your Plan Appears

After creating your plan, decide where it should appear. Selecting any of these options makes the plan **visible** instead of hidden:

* **Network / Space Landing Page**
* **Collection Page**
* **Space About Page**

Making a plan visible—or creating Share Links—activates the plan. When a plan becomes active, any Spaces included in the plan will automatically switch from **Invite-Only** to **Accessible Through Plans**.

For details on these options, [**check out this article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear).


# How Do I Invite Directly to a Plan?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-invite-directly-to-a-plan



After you [create a plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan), you can invite people to join it directly.

These invites are one-time use. Once someone creates an account with an invite, it can’t be used again.

If your Mighty Network is set to [**Accessible Through Plans**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network), you should use **Invite to Plan**.

Go to **Admin > Plans**, select the plan that includes Network access, then open the [**Visibility & Sharing**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) tab.

From here, you can invite people in two ways:

## 1. Send Invites for This Plan

You can enter email addresses individually or upload a CSV file to invite multiple people at once (CSV uploads are available on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and higher).

Invite to Plan emails are one-time use.

## 2. Share a Link for This Plan

You can copy a **Share Link** for your plan. Anyone with the link can use it to join.

In both cases, people will still need to complete any gates you’ve set—**payment**, **questions**, or **approval**.

## 3. From the Invite Page

You can also invite people to a plan from **Admin > Invite** by selecting **Invite to Plan**.

Next, choose the plan you want to invite someone to.

Decide where you want people to land when they click the invite link in their email or in-app notification:

### Plan Landing Page

This page lets people sign in or sign up. It’s the best option when your plan includes purchases for both new and existing members.

### Skip the Landing Page

This takes people directly to account creation. It’s best for inviting new members.

Add the email address (or addresses) of the people who purchased [off-platform](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform). You can also upload a CSV file to invite multiple people at once.

Edit your invite message, then click **Send**.

Your invitees will receive an email with your message and a button to **Access**.

After you send an invite, the system automatically sends up to three reminder emails at 3, 10, and 30 days.

Here is a video of what a member experiences when invited to a paid plan:

<iframe />

Here is a video of what a member sees when invited to a plan [without a payment gate](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-have-a-plan-with-no-payment-gate):

# How Do I Invite Members to a Space?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-invite-members-to-a-space



The best way to invite people to your Space depends on [the privacy](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space) setting for your Space.

Access to your Space will be one of the following:

* Accessible Through Plans
* Invite-Only
* Anyone Can Join

**If your Space is set to Accessible Through Plans**, you should use [Invite to Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-a-default-plan-for-invites-beta).

In **Admin > Plans & Access > Plan List**, click the plan that includes the Space you want people to join, then navigate to the Visibility & Sharing tab.

Towards the bottom, you will see an option to “Send Invites for This Plan.”

This will open up the invite form with the plan already selected:

**Invite to your plan via email**.

* Invite to Plan emails are one-time use and cannot be reused once an account has been created using the invite. For more information, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform#:~:text=upper%20right%20corner).-,Invite%20to%20Plan,-After%20you%20create).
* You can enter an email address directly in the field or upload a CSV list of email addresses you want to invite all at once (available on the Community Plan and higher-tier plans; see below for more details)

**Important note:** If you have limited members, you will need to use the plan share link or invite them to the plan so they can access additional Spaces.

**If your Space is set to Invite-Only or Anyone Can Join**, you should use invites and not plans to invite people to your Space.

To invite to a Space, go to the Space and click **Manage > Invite.**

You can also hover over the Space in the left navigation bar > select the three-dot menu > and Invite

In the invite form, you can invite members using a share link, by email, or by @mention:

You can also manage your [Sent invites](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-sent-invites-and-requests-to-join) on this page.

Once you've sent out an invite, your invitees will automatically get three email reminders from our system. These invite reminders go out after 3, 10, and 30 days.

## Auto-Join Spaces

You can easily add all current and future members to a Space by selecting “Auto-Join” in the Space Privacy & Access settings.

Note: You will need to be a Network Host on the Mighty Network to see this option.

This will automatically add all current and future members of your Mighty Network to this Space. Neither Hosts nor members will receive notifications when they're auto-joined to a Space, and they can leave these Spaces at any time.


# How Do I Invite People to My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-invite-people-to-my-mighty-network



Invite new members to your Mighty Network from your **Invite** page in **Admin**—or share a link to help people join fast.

## Where to Find Your Invite Page

To get started, go to **Admin > Members > Invite**. This is your main **Invite Page** for sending email invites or sharing your Network's invite link.

For Hosts, on desktop, you can click the Global Header (your Network Name in the upper left-hand corner of your Network) and a menu will appear where you can choose the option to invite members.

<img alt="Screenshot 2026 01 21 At 8 25 54 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 01 21 At 8 25 54 AM" />

For members, they can find the invite icon in the upper right corner:

<img alt="Screenshot 2026 01 21 At 8 27 11 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 01 21 At 8 27 11 AM" />

## Add Members Directly

On your **Invite** page, you'll see an option to [**Add Members Directly**](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/1611079-leave-a-network-or-group). This lets you **skip the invite flow** and give members immediate access to **either your Network or a Space**.

To learn more, check out the article, "[How Do I Directly Add Existing Members to My Network or Spaces](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members)?"

## How to Invite People

If your Network is set to [Invite-Only or Anyone Can Join](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network), you'll want to invite people directly to your Network rather than to a plan.

You can invite new members in a number of ways:

Enter an email address directly or upload a CSV list.

Each invite is **one-time use**—once someone joins with that email, the link expires.

Copy and share your invite link anywhere. Anyone who joins through it will automatically get access to your Mighty Network.

If you're on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) or higher, you can upload a CSV file to invite multiple people at once.

Your CSV should include:

* First Name (optional)
* Last Name (optional)
* Email Address (required)

After uploading, you'll confirm your list and customize your invite message before sending.

**Batching details:**

* Invites are sent in batches of **50 at a time** to prevent emails from going to spam.
* If you want to send more at once, upgrade to the [**Scale Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-business-plan) and contact the Mighty Networks Team through the **Need Help?** button.
* The maximum CSV size supported is **100,000 records**. For larger lists, split your invites into smaller files and upload them separately.

You may see invites temporarily queued in the **Sent Invites** tab before they send.

To learn how to invite people to a specific Space, check out this article "[How Do I Invite Members to a Space?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members)"

## Inviting Through Plans

If your Network is set to [**Accessible Through Plans**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network), it's best to [invite people to the plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-a-default-plan-for-invites-beta).

1. Go to **Admin > Plans**.
2. Click the plan you want people to join.
3. Open the **Visibility & Sharing** tab.

From there, you can:

* Copy a **plan share link** to share anywhere, or
* Select **Send Invites for This Plan** to open the invite form.

For more information, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-a-default-plan-for-invites-beta).

## Invite New People as Hosts or Moderators

When sending email invites, you can choose to invite people as **members**, **Hosts**, or **moderators**. Use the **Network Permissions** dropdown in the invite form. The default is **Invite as members**.

## Track and Manage Your Invites

After sending an invite:

* Recipients automatically get up to **three reminders** (after 3, 10, and 30 days).
* Invites **expire after four weeks** if not used.

You can view, resend, or revoke invitations from **Admin > Members > Invite > Sent Invites**.

To learn more, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members).

## Member Invite Options

To control who can send invites in your Network:

1. Go to **Admin > Setup > Privacy & Access**.
2. Under **Who Can Invite Members to Join Your Network?**, choose:
   * **Any Network Member**, or
   * **Only Network Hosts and Moderators.**

If you select **Only Hosts and Moderators**, the Invite Page will only be visible to them. Networks set to **Anyone Can Join** automatically allow members to send invites.

**Note:**

## Set a Default Invite Message

To customize your default invite message:

1. Click your profile picture in the top-right corner.
2. Go to **Admin > Setup > Privacy & Access**.
3. Scroll to **Who Can Invite Members to Join Your Network?**
4. Enter your message under **Default Invite Message**.

This message will appear for anyone with permission to send invites.

## Add the Ambassador Program for Member Referrals

As a Host, you can reward members for inviting others by enabling the [**Ambassador Program**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-use-the-mighty-networks-ambassador-program). It tracks referrals, awards badges, and lets you create manual rewards.

The Ambassador Program is available on paid plans starting with the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan).

This is different from an [**Affiliate Program**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/does-mighty-networks-have-an-affiliate-program), which automates payouts. [Learn how to set up an Affiliate Program here.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/does-mighty-networks-have-an-affiliate-program)

## Welcome Experience for Invited Members

When someone joins your Mighty Network from an invite link:

* They'll see a celebratory pop-up (with confetti!) encouraging them to start a chat with their invite sender.
* Invite senders get a notification when their first invitee joins.
* If the [Ambassador Program](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-use-the-mighty-networks-ambassador-program) is enabled, members receive messages as they reach new levels.

## Keep Your Invite Reputation Strong

To make sure your invites send quickly and avoid spam filters:

* Upload clean, verified email lists.
* Avoid sending large batches of outdated or invalid addresses.
* If your list is very large, send invites through your **Share Link** using a third-party email tool like Mailchimp or [Kit](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-create-an-email-newsletter-for-my-mighty-network).


# How Do I Manage Members’ Access to Spaces and the Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-members-access-to-spaces-and-the-network



This article covers how Hosts and moderators can give and remove access to Spaces and the Network.

On Mighty, the **Privacy & Access Settings** of your [Network](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network) or [Space](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space) determine how members access it.

The options include:

* **Invite-only**: An invitation is required to join
* **Anyone Can Join**: Anyone can join the Network, or any Network member can join the Space
* **Accessible through Plans**: Members join a [plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) to get access to the Network and/or Spaces

Note: A Network or Space can be set to **Anyone Can Join** and be **Accessible through Plans** at the same time, but these options cannot be combined with **Invite-only** access.

## Managing Access with Inviting

If your Network or Space is **set to** **Invite-only**, [inviting](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members) is how you grant access, because an invite serves as a single-use token and is the only way to join. An invitee must accept the invite to join.

If your Network or Space is **not set to Invite-only**, inviting is simply a tool to make people aware that your Network or Space exists and that you want them to join.

* If the Network or Space is set to **Anyone Can Join**, the invitee can choose whether to accept and join.
* If the Network or Space is **Accessible through Plans**, the invitee sees the option to join via plan, which typically requires approval, answering questions, or making a payment. The invite does not serve as a token granting access.
* [**Invite to Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-a-default-plan-for-invites-beta) is a separate invitation type that serves as a single-use invitation to a plan. The invitee still needs to answer questions or make a payment if the plan requires it, but they do not need approval to join.

## Managing Access with Plans

Because they offer so much functionality, **plans are the best way to control who can access your Mighty Network and/or Spaces.**

To give members access to a plan, you can either send them a link to a specific plan or use [Invite to Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-a-default-plan-for-invites-beta). Plans can also appear on your landing pages.

You can also:

* Move members between plans. Click [here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-members-move-between-plans) to learn more.
* Remove members from plans manually (scroll down for steps), and via [automations](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network), [Zapier](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-use-zapier-with-mighty-networks), and Mighty’s [API](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/does-mighty-networks-have-an-api).

## Managing Access with Direct Add and Remove

To bypass inviting and plan flows, you can directly add [full members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) to a Space or to multiple Spaces, and you can add limited members to the Network. You cannot directly add members to a plan except through Mighty’s API. Click [here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members) to learn more about Direct Add.

You can also remove members from Spaces or the Network manually (scroll down for steps), and via [automations](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network), [Zapier](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-use-zapier-with-mighty-networks), and Mighty’s [API](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/does-mighty-networks-have-an-api).

**Note:** While members are free to delete or deactivate their membership in your Network, or cancel a plan that gives them access to the Network or Spaces, they cannot leave a Space that grants access only via a plan, or leave a free, non-paid, or one-time purchase plan.

## Members Leaving the Network and Spaces

There are restrictions on members’ ability to leave a Space if the Space is part of a plan.

* Members cannot cancel a free, non-paid, or one-time purchase plan.
* Members cannot leave a Space that only grants access via a plan.
* Members can cancel a subscription plan that gives them access to the Network or Spaces.
* Members can delete or deactivate their membership in your Network.

## Removing a Member from a Plan

To remove a member from a plan:

1. Go to **Admin > Plans > Plan List**.
2. Select the **plan name**.
3. Open the **Members** tab.
4. Select the **three-dot menu** next to the member’s name > **More > Remove from Plan**.

You can choose whether to remove them **immediately** or **at the end of the billing period**.

### Removal at the Billing Period end occurs when:

* A Host removes a member from a subscription plan and chooses for it to occur at the **end of the billing period**.

### Immediate removal occurs when:

* A Host removes a member from a subscription plan and chooses for it to occur **immediately**.
* A Host removes a member from a **Free**, **Non-Paid**, or **One-Time Purchase** plan.

### After removal:

* The member immediately loses access to the Spaces or Network included in that plan.
* Billing stops automatically (if applicable), and no refunds are given.
* They remain in your Network’s member list unless they leave or you remove them.
  * If the plan you remove them from includes Network access, they’ll lose access and be removed from your member list.

Note: Members marked *Pending – Payment* cannot be removed until the plan is fully deactivated.

## Removing a Member From a Space or Network (when not on a Plan)

If someone has access to a Space or your Network and is not on a plan, you can remove them manually.

### Remove a member from a Space

1. Go to the **Space Admin** (gear icon)
2. Navigate to the **Member List**.
3. Select the three-dot menu next to the member’s name > **Remove from Space**.

### Remove a member from your Network

1. Go to **Admin**
2. Navigate to the **Member List**
3. Select the three-dot menu next to the member’s name > **Remove from Everything**.

Removing someone from a Space only removes access to that Space. Removing them from everything will remove all access they have.

Click [here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-content-and-moderation-tools-do-i-have-in-my-mighty-network) to learn how to remove and ban members.


# How Do I Manage My Plans?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-my-plans



<iframe />

Once you've created [at least one plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) in your Mighty Network, you can view and manage all of your plans in one place. This page shows a full list of plans you've created, along with options to view, sort, and edit each one.

## How to Access Your Plans

Go to **Admin > Payments > Plans** — the direct path is `/admin/payments/plans`. You can also get there by clicking your **profile picture** in the top right corner > **Admin > Payments > Plans**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-my-plans/Screenshot-2025-11-11-at-2_24_51-PM.png)

## Understanding the Plans List

At the top of your Plans page, you'll see columns that show key information about each plan:

* **Plan Name**

* **Status** (Hidden or Visible)

* **Includes** (what the plan gives access to)

* **Network Access** (whether the Network is included)

* **Plan Type** (Space, Network, or Bundle)

* **Price (web)**

* **Price (iOS)**

* **Token**

* **Date Created**

* **Members**

You can sort your Plan List by several criteria, including:

* Plan Name (A–Z or Z–A)

* Date Created (Latest or Earliest)

* Status (Visible listed first)

* Price (Low to High or High to Low)

* Number of Members (Low to High or High to Low)

## Filters

Use the **Showing** filter to refine what you see by **Status**, **Network Access**, **Plan Type**, or **Pricing Type**.

* **Status:** Visible, Hidden, Pending, Rejected (iOS only), Deactivated

* **Network Access:** Included or Excluded

* **Plan Type:** Bundle, Network, or Space

* **Pricing Type:** Free, One-Time Payment, Subscription, Token-Gated, Installment, or Other

## Managing Your Plans

From the Plans page, you'll see your full list of plans with filters and sort options at the top.

Click any **plan name** to see the total number of members on that plan, including members in a Free Trial (if applicable).

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-my-plans/Screenshot-2025-11-11-at-2_26_41-PM.png)

Each plan has a **three-dot menu** on the right with management options:

* **[Invite to Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-a-default-plan-for-invites-beta):** Invite by email, upload a CSV, or import contacts. Edit the invite message if needed.

* **View Income Report:** See Gross Revenue, Fees, and Net Revenue for a date range. Reports summarize income from Stripe and Apple purchases.

* **[Change Visibility](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear):** Switch between **Visible** and **Hidden**.

* **Message All Members:** Send a message to everyone currently on that plan.

* **Download Member Information:** Download a CSV of all members in the plan.

* **Manage Spaces in Plan:** **[Add or remove Spaces](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-spaces-in-a-plan)** connected to this plan.

* **Duplicate Plan:** Create a copy of an existing plan and edit details like price, name, or billing interval.

* **Deactivate Plan:** Permanently deactivate a plan so it's no longer available for purchase or management.

**Note:** Deactivation is permanent. To make a plan temporarily unavailable, set it to **Hidden** instead.

## What Happens When You Deactivate a Plan

* **Free Plans:** Members immediately lose access.

* **One-Time Payment Plans:** Members retain access as long as they remain active in your Network.

* **Subscription Plans:** Members keep access until the end of their current billing period.

* **Free Trial Members:** Immediately lose access.

Members will see a notification:

"Your subscription to \[Plan Name] has been canceled."

By default, deactivated plans are hidden. To display them, open **Showing > Status** and select **Deactivated**.

## Managing Token-Gated Plans and Members

Token-Gated Plans appear with all other plans in your Plan List. Currently, members of Token-Gated Plans **can't be moved** to another plan.

* **Learn how [members purchase Token-Gated Plans](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/1611084-become-an-ambassador)**

* **Learn [how to set up Token-Gated Plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-token-gated-plan)**

## Auto-Created Plans

In some cases, Mighty Networks automatically creates plans on your behalf (for example, during certain migrations or platform updates). These plans appear in your Plan List alongside the plans you create yourself, but they have a few special considerations:

* **Moving members:** You can move members **to and from** auto-created plans the same way you would with any other plan. No backend support is required for member moves.

* **Deactivating auto-created plans:** As a safeguard, Hosts **can't deactivate auto-created plans on their own**. If you need one of these plans deactivated, please [contact our support team](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/getting-started-with-mighty-networks/community-support-resources/how-do-i-contact-mighty-networks-support) and we'll take care of it for you.

* **Everything else:** All other management options (editing details, changing visibility, messaging members, managing Spaces, etc.) work the same as with any other plan.

## Editing a Plan

Click a plan name to open its **details view**. You'll see tabs with all relevant information and settings.

## Members Tab

View and filter member details such as:

* **Member Name**

* **Email**

* **Status** (Pending, Free Trial, Active, Past Due, or Canceled)

* **Membership Type** (Full or Limited)

* **Last Active**

* **Platform**

* **Next Billing Date**

* **Subscribed Since**

* **Interval**

You can also filter by:

* **Pending – Approval / Payment / Answers** (for Plans using **[Screening Questions or Approvals](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members))**

* **Have Answers / No Answers**

To learn how to manage members' access to Spaces and your Network, **[check out this article.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-members-access-to-spaces-and-the-network)**

## Settings Tab

Review key details including:

* Available platforms

* Approval status

* [Free Trial](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-offer-a-free-trial-on-a-mighty-network) period details

* Tax category

* Pricing information

* Target audience

* Membership benefits

## Details Tab

Edit your plan's:

* **Plan Name**

* **Sales Pitch**

* **Featured Image or Video**

* **Benefits List**

* **Full Description**

* **[Visibility & Sharing](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear)** options

## Important Note About Plan Changes

Always manage, edit, or deactivate plans **within your Mighty Network's Payments section**. Managing plans directly in **Stripe** can cause data loss, including deleted plans and missing members.

You can still use Stripe to manage payments or [issue refunds at any time](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-happens-when-a-member-cancels-or-requests-a-refund).


# How Do I Manage My Leads?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-sent-invites-and-requests-to-join



Network Hosts and moderators can manage everyone who hasn't joined their Mighty Network yet from one place: the Leads page. This includes people you've invited, people waiting on approval for a plan with [screening questions](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members), and people who've signed up for a [waitlist](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-waitlist).

### How to Find the Leads Page

To manage your leads, go to **Admin > Members > Leads**.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 14 At 3 00 51 PM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 14 At 3 00 51 PM" />
</Frame>

You can use the **search bar** to find a specific lead by name or email.

From here, you can manage 3 types of leads: **Sent Invites**, **Requests to Join**, and **Waitlist Leads**.

### Sent Invites

#### Sorting Options

You can sort your invite list by:

* **Last Updated:** Newest or Oldest (default)
* **Invited At:** Newest or Oldest (based on when the invite was created)
* **Name:** A–Z or Z–A (by recipient first name)

#### Filters

You can filter your invite list by:

* **Status:** Sent, Opened, Clicked, Joined, Stale, Bounced, Spam, or Unsubscribed
* **Reminded:** Yes (invites that have been resent) or No (invites sent only once)
* **Invite To:** Filter by specific Plans that have associated invites

You can select multiple options within each filter to see invites matching any of your selections.

#### Definition of Statuses

**Invite Sent**

* The invitee was sent an email invitation.
* **Actions you can take:** Open the three-dot menu next to the person's name to **Remind** (resend the invitation immediately) or **Revoke** (cancel the invitation; if they click the link, they'll be redirected to your landing page).

**Clicked**

* The invitee clicked the invitation link but didn't complete creating a profile.
* **Actions you can take:** Use the three-dot menu to **Remind** or **Revoke** the invitation.

**Joined**

* The invitee accepted the invitation and joined your Mighty Network.
* **Actions you can take:** Select the three-dot menu to **View Profile**.

**Reminder Sent**

* Once an invite is sent, Mighty Networks automatically delivers up to 3 reminders — after 3, 10, and 30 days.
* **Actions you can take:** You can still manually **Remind** or **Revoke** the invitation from the three-dot menu.

**Stale**

* After the final reminder (30 days), the invitation becomes "Stale." The invite link becomes invalid 30 days later.
* **Actions you can take:** Choose **Invite Again** to resend or **Revoke** to cancel. If your original invitation included a custom message, it will be reused when you resend.

**Unsubscribed**

* The invitee unsubscribed from Mighty Networks emails and didn't receive the invitation.
* **Actions you can take:** Contact the Mighty Networks Team via the **Need Help?** button (bottom right corner when logged in on web) or email [**help@mightynetworks.com**](mailto:help@mightynetworks.com).

**Invalid**

* The invitation wasn't delivered because the email address was invalid.
* **Actions you can take:** Contact the Mighty Networks Team for assistance.

**Revoked**

* The invitation was revoked, and the join link no longer works. The invitee won't receive a notification.
* **Actions you can take:** Choose **Invite Again** to resend. If the original invitation had a custom message, it will be reused.

**Spam**

* The invitee marked your invitation as spam in their email provider.
* **Actions you can take:** Contact the Mighty Networks Team via **Need Help?** or email [**help@mightynetworks.com**](mailto:help@mightynetworks.com).

#### Preventing Spam and Invalid Invites

Mighty Networks takes spam prevention seriously, and we have several mechanisms in place to protect Hosts and members from abuse of our system.

When inviting new members to join your Mighty Network, always start with a **clean, verified list of email addresses**. This helps ensure that your invites are sent quickly and reliably.

If the list you upload includes invalid email addresses, addresses that bounce, or addresses from suspicious domains, your invites will be automatically **flagged and not sent**. When this happens, you'll receive a **notification** letting you know that your invite list needs to be cleaned and validated before sending again.

If you'd prefer to skip email validation altogether, you can share your **Invite Link** directly through a third-party email platform such as **Mailchimp** or **Kit** for faster delivery.

#### How to Validate Email Addresses

Mighty Networks cannot validate or reveal which specific email addresses were flagged. However, you can use a third-party validation service to clean your list before sending more invites.

Both of the options below are **GDPR compliant**:

* **DeBounce:** Identifies bounced, disposable, or deactivated emails.
* **NeverBounce:** Offers bulk list cleaning and automated email verification.

After validating your list, try sending your invites again through your Mighty Network.

### Requests to Join

If you've added [screening questions or approval](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members) requirements to any plan, you can manage requests to join from the Leads page.

In this table, you'll see each person's first name, last name, email, date requested, plan name, and status. You can also view their answers if screening questions are enabled.

From here, you can:

* **Approve** or **Decline** requests (use the three-dot menu to decline).
* **View Answers** for anyone who completed screening questions.
* See who has already **Joined** your Mighty Network.

#### Who Can Approve Requests

* **Network Hosts** can view and approve all requests across the Network.
* **Space Hosts** can only approve requests for plans that include their own Space.
* Space Hosts won't see requests for plans that include the full Network or other Spaces.

### Waitlist Leads

Everyone who signs up for a waitlist also shows up on the Leads page, so you have one place to see every prospective member, no matter how they found you.

From the Leads page, you can filter waitlist signups by:

* **Date**
* **Status**
* **Waitlist** (which waitlist they signed up for)
* **Source landing page**

On the Explore Plan and above, you can also:

* See lead emails
* Invite individual leads
* Send bulk invitations
* Download leads as a CSV


# How Do I Manage Spaces in a Plan?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-spaces-in-a-plan



## How to Add or Remove Spaces

* Go to **Admin > Plans > Plan List** and select the plan you want to update.

* Open the **three-dot menu** in the upper right corner and choose **Manage Spaces in Plan**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-spaces-in-a-plan/Screenshot-2025-11-19-at-12_10_47-PM.png)

* On the next page, you can:

  * **Add or remove Spaces** from the plan

  * Set the **Plan Landing Space**, which is the first Space members will land on when they join the plan

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-spaces-in-a-plan/Screenshot-2025-11-19-at-12_11_25-PM.png)

* Select **Next: Message** to send a message to your members about the updates you’re making.

  * Members will receive [notifications](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/what-notifications-do-my-members-get) by email or push, depending on their preferences.

* Review the changes on the final page, then confirm and submit.

## How Access Changes for Members

* **Removing a Space:** All members on the plan lose access to that Space **immediately**.

* **Adding a Space:** All members on the plan gain access **immediately**.

* **Adding the Network:** Members on the plan become **[full members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership)**.

* **Removing the Network:**

  * If members don’t have Network access through any other plan, they become **[limited members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership)**.

The **price of the plan does not change** when you add or remove Spaces.

## Important Notes

* You cannot remove the **last remaining Space** from a plan.If you no longer want the plan to provide access, you’ll need to **deactivate the plan** from the same three-dot menu.
