Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-a-default-plan-for-invites-beta



As part of the newest privacy and plan updates, previously Secret Networks with Internal plans will have a **hidden plan automatically created** to grant access to the Network.

All **current members** will be moved to this hidden plan.

Your Network and Space invites will automatically point to this new plan to ensure a smooth transition. If you would like, you can set another plan as the default.

## How To Set a Default Plan

Go to **Admin > Privacy & Access** and scroll to the section "Set Default Plan for Network Invites"

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-a-default-plan-for-invites-beta/Screenshot-2025-07-09-at-11_11_09-AM.png)

You’ll see a dropdown where you can choose the plan you want all Network invites to direct people to.

Here you can choose:

* A default plan or set it to **No Default Plan**

Depending on the plan you choose, there is a message that will explain the access members get:

* **If the plan includes the Network:<br />​** "Anyone who joins this plan will be a full Network member."

* **If the plan includes only Space(s):<br />​** "Anyone who joins this plan and is not already a full Network member will join as a limited member with access to only the included Space(s)."

* **If no plans are selected:<br />​**"If the Network is set to Invite-Only or Anyone Can Join, any Network invite will allow people to join immediately. If the Network is Accessible Through Plans, people who accept a Network invite or click on a Network invite link will see any visible plans on the landing page."

Moving forward, we suggest the following options to invite people to your Network:

* **[Invite to Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan#:~:text=Invite%20to%20the%20Plan%20or%20Create%20a%20Share%20Link)**[option or the Plan Share Link](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan#:~:text=Invite%20to%20the%20Plan%20or%20Create%20a%20Share%20Link)

* Make this plan visible and [add gates](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members-before-purchasing) to it, like screening questions or approvals ​​


# How Do I Set Up a Space That Full Members Can Join but Limited Members Must Pay For?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-a-space-that-full-members-can-join-but-limited-members-must-pay-for



**Here's how to set up a Space where:**

* Anyone who is already a [full member](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) of your Network can freely access the Space (i.e., no additional plan required)
* At the same time, [limited members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) can access the Space by purchasing a [plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)

In effect, the Space will be set to [**"Anyone Can Join"**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space) for full members and also have plans attached that give access to limited members.

**Important:** Limited members can **only** join Spaces through paid plans. Even if a Space is set to "Anyone Can Join" or a limited member receives an invite, they still require a valid payment for a plan that includes the Space in order to access it.

## Step 1: Set the Space's privacy and access so anyone in the Network can see and join it

* Within the **Space Settings,** navigate to [**Privacy & Access**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space).
* Under **"Who Can View Content Inside This Space?"** select either option.
* Under **"Who Can See This Space?"** select **"Anyone in the Network"**
* Under **"How Do People Join This Space?"** select **"Anyone in the Network can join this Space without restrictions".**

At this point, full members of your Network will be able to see and join the Space without needing a paid plan.

## Step 2: Create the paid plan for limited members

Since you also want to allow [limited members](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/1611084-become-an-ambassador)to pay for access, you need to [create a plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) that *includes the Space* but *not* the entire Network. Since you also want to allow [limited members](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/1611084-become-an-ambassador) to pay for access, you need to [create a plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) that *includes the Space* but *not* the entire Network.

* Go to **Admin → Plans → Plan List → + (Create Plan)**.

* In the plan creation step, choose "Space Access" (i.e., select the option that gives access to one or more Spaces but NOT full Network access).

* Select the Space from Step 2 to include in this plan. Do *not* include the full Network. This ensures members on this plan are "limited members".

* Configure the payment gate for the plan (set price, subscription vs. one-time, etc.).

## Step 3: Choose where the plan appears

1. On the plan's [**Visibility & Sharing**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) tab, choose where the plan should appear. This will depend on your [Network's Privacy & Access](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network) Setting for **"Who Can View Content Inside Your Network?".**
   * If your Network is set to **"Anyone,"** then select all three options: Landing Page and Global Header, Collections, and Space About Page. Limited members will be able to see the Space in their navigation.
   * You can choose to show the plan only on the Landing Page and the Global Header if you don't want full members to see it, but then it won't appear for limited members either.
   * If your Network is set to **"Only logged-in members,"** then select only [Landing Page](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-customize-my-mighty-networks-landing-page)and Global Header, since limited members won't be able to see the Space, [Collection](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections), or [Space About Page](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-find-the-about-page-for-my-space-or-mighty-network) to purchase the Plan. Limited members will not see the Space in their navigation.

2. For either option, consider creating a [**promotional banner**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-set-up-promotional-banners-in-my-network) targeting limited members that promotes the Space's plan. You would set up your audience for the banner by excluding any Network members or targeting [limited members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) on a specific plan to join the plan for the Space you just set up. Once they join that plan, they will no longer see that banner.

3. On the plan's [**Visibility & Sharing**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) tab, choose where the plan should appear. This will depend on your [Network's Privacy & Access](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network) Setting for **"Who Can View Content Inside Your Network?".**
   * If your Network is set to **"Anyone,"** then select all three options: Landing Page and Global Header, Collections, and Space About Page. Limited members will be able to see the Space in their navigation.
   * You can choose to show the plan only on the Landing Page and the Global Header if you don't want full members to see it, but then it won't appear for limited members either.
   * If your Network is set to **"Only logged-in members,"** then select only [Landing Page](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-customize-my-mighty-networks-landing-page) and Global Header, since limited members won't be able to see the Space, [Collection](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections), or [Space About Page](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-find-the-about-page-for-my-space-or-mighty-network) to purchase the Plan. Limited members will not see the Space in their navigation.

4. For either option, consider creating a [**promotional banner**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-set-up-promotional-banners-in-my-network) targeting limited members that promotes the Space's plan. You would set up your audience for the banner by excluding any Network members or targeting [limited members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) on a specific plan to join the plan for the Space you just set up. Once they join that plan, they will no longer see that banner.

**Note:** If a limited member with Space access through a plan becomes a full member, they will still have access to the Space, but they may want to consider canceling their plan if they are still paying for it, since they now have automatic access as a full member.

With this setup, you get the desired model: one Space visible and joinable by all full members and accessible via paid purchase for limited members.


# How Do I Set Up Installment Plans and Subscription Intervals?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-installment-plans-and-subscription-intervals



<iframe />

[Plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) are the most flexible way to give members access to your Mighty Network, individual Spaces, or both.

Before creating your first plan, decide what you want to charge for and which parts of your Network you want to gate.

If you need help thinking through that decision, check out our article on choosing the right plan setup.

## Creating a New Plan

To create a new plan:

1. Go to **Admin > Plan List**.
2. Select the **“+”** icon to create a new plan.
3. In the **Pricing Type** menu, you’ll see the option to set up **Installments or Subscriptions.**

**Installments** **allow a** **one-time purchase plan** to be split into multiple scheduled payments (for example, monthly).

**Subscriptions offer ongoing billing** (daily, weekly, monthly, annually, etc.).

## Creating an Installment Plan

When creating an installment plan, you’ll define:

* **Total cost** of the plan
* **Billing interval**, which can be:
  * Weekly
  * Every two weeks
  * Monthly
  * Quarterly

The system automatically calculates each payment amount. There’s no deposit or partial access, and members must complete the full installment schedule to keep access.

## Important Notes

* If a member defaults on a payment, they cannot resume the same installment schedule. You can create a new plan or coordinate a separate arrangement.
* Installments are available only for **one-time purchase** plans (not subscriptions).
* Billing is handled through [**Stripe**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network), including automatic retries for failed payments.
* Mighty Networks manages access based on payment status. If the final retry fails, the member will automatically lose access.
* You can track each member’s payment progress in **Plan Details**.

## Creating a Subscription Plan

A subscription plan charges members on an ongoing schedule. Subscriptions support multiple billing intervals, including:

* Daily
* Weekly
* Monthly
* Annually

Subscriptions are recurring by design. Members will continue to be billed until they cancel, and access remains active as long as payments succeed. Billing and retries for failed payments are handled through [Stripe](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network).

## Combine Offers

When creating a plan, you can combine multiple pricing options for the same Space or bundle.

Examples include:

* Custom Subscription intervals subscription
* One-time payment vs. installments

These options appear side-by-side on the plan detail page so members can choose what works best for them.

## Member Experience

When Installments are enabled for a one-time purchase, members can choose to:

* Pay in full ​**or**
* Pay using installments

## Here’s what members can expect:

* The **first payment** is charged immediately, and members get full access right away.
* Because installments are not subscriptions, members **commit to completing all payments** and cannot cancel or reschedule.
* If a payment fails, Stripe will retry it automatically for **7 days**, and members will receive prompts to update their billing details.
* If all retries fail, access is removed automatically.
* A defaulted installment plan **cannot be resumed**. The member must start again with a new plan or contact the Host.
* Members can track their payment status under **Personal Settings > Plans and Access**.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## For Hosts

Do I receive the full amount upfront? No. Payments are processed on the installment schedule through Stripe.

Can I use Installments with a free trial or deposit? Not at this time.

What happens if a member stops paying? Stripe will retry the payment. After the final failed attempt, Mighty Networks removes access automatically.

Can I manually restart a member’s installment after a default? No. You’ll need to create a new plan or provide access another way.

Can I add installments to an existing one-time plan? No. You’ll need to create a new plan.

Can I offer multiple installment options in one plan? No. Each plan supports one installment configuration.

## For Members

What if I miss a payment? Stripe will retry your payment for 7 days. If all retries fail, your access will be removed and the plan can’t be resumed.

Can I cancel or modify my Installment Plan? No. Installments must be completed in full.

Can I use Installments on subscriptions? No. Installments only apply to one-time purchases.

Why don’t all one-time purchases offer installments? Hosts choose whether to enable installments for each plan.


# How Do I Set Up Promo Codes?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-promo-codes



<iframe />

**Promo Codes** let you offer discounts or free access to paid plans in your Mighty Network. You can use them to reward loyal members, promote special events, or test new offers without changing your core pricing.

Each promo code can apply to one or more paid plans, and you can control how long it stays active and how many times it can be used.​

## How to Create a Promo Code

## Step 1: Go to Promo Codes

To get started:

1. Go to **Admin > Plans & Access > Promo Codes.**

2. Click **the "+" icon in the upper right corner**

## Step 2: Add Basic Details

In the setup screen, you’ll enter:

* **Promo Code Name:** The internal name for your reference.

* **Code:** The exact text members will enter (for example, SUMMER25 or FREEMONTH).

* **Description (optional):** A note about what the code is for (for example, “50% off for our summer launch”).

**Tip:** Keep your code simple and easy to share.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-promo-codes/Screenshot-2025-11-06-at-3_45_25-PM.png)

## Step 3: Set the Duration

The **duration** determines how long the discount applies.

For **one-time payments**, the discount always applies to the **initial purchase** only.

For **subscriptions**, you can choose:

* **Once:** Applies only to the first charge of a subscription. Can be a percentage or fixed-amount discount.

* **Forever:** Applies every time the subscription renews. Can only be a **percentage** discount.

* **Repeating:** Applies to each renewal for a set number of months.

  * For annual subscriptions, set the number of months to match the billing interval (for example, 12 months = 1 year).

  * The number of months can’t exceed 99.

  * Can be a percentage or fixed-amount discount.

## Step 4: Choose the Discount Type

Select one of the following:

* **Percentage Off:** Apply a percentage discount (for example, 25% off).

* **Amount Off:** Deduct a fixed dollar amount (for example, \$10 off).

* **Free Access:** Offer 100% off to create a free-access link.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-promo-codes/Screenshot-2025-11-06-at-3_52_16-PM.png)

## Step 5: Apply to Plans

Choose whether you’d like the promo code to apply to **all Plans** or \*\*specific Plans.\*\*You can assign up to **20 Plans** per promo code using the dropdown menu.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-promo-codes/Screenshot-2025-11-06-at-3_53_20-PM.png)

## Step 6: Review Important Notes

Before saving, keep these in mind:

* Promo codes can be used with any **currency**, but fixed amounts must be entered manually for each currency.

* You can’t add new currencies to an existing promo code. To support additional currencies, create a new one.

* Promo codes work with **Free Trials**—the discount applies after the trial ends.

* You can’t edit a promo code after it’s created (except for the **Internal Note** field).

* You can’t create a **100% discount** promo code for a one-time payment Plan (only for subscriptions).

  * To offer a one-time 100% discount, create a **Free Plan** instead.

* Taxes and Stripe fees apply to the **discounted price.**

## Step 7: Save and Share the Promo Code

When you’re ready, click **Create.**

Members can enter the code during checkout on web. You can also append a promo code directly to your plan URL by adding `&promo_code=YOURCODE`.

**Note:** Use ALL CAPS when typing your promo code in the link.

Promo codes can’t be combined with other discounts or offers—members can only use one at checkout.

## How to Manage and Track Promo Codes

You can make a code inactive or reactivate it from the **three-dot menu** next to the code.

**Important callouts:**

* You can create a promo code with the same name as another one as long as the other version is **deactivated.**

* You can only have **one active promo code** with the same name at any given time.

* You can’t reactivate a promo code if another active code with the same name exists.

Clicking on a promo code shows a list of members who redeemed it, along with more details in the **Details** tab. A member will appear in the list for every time they've redeemed the code.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can I edit a promo code or coupon code after it’s been created?**

Only the internal description can be changed.

**Can members use more than one code at checkout?**

No, they can only use one promo code at a time.

**Can I see on Stripe if the promo code was applied to members?**

You can easily see if a promo code was applied on a subscription and one-time payment information will show in the price a member paid.

**How are Stripe processing fees taken?**

Processing fees are calculated on the discounted amount (the price a member pays, after the promo code is applied).

**Can I make a promo code expire automatically?**

Not yet, but you can manually deactivate it at any time and reactivate it in the same menu. You won’t be able to fully delete a promo code.

**Do promo codes work on mobile or iOS?**

Promo codes currently only work on the **web** and mobile web, not on mobile apps.

**Where do members enter a promo code?**

On web, there’s a **“Have a promo code?”** field during checkout.

**Can I limit how many times a promo code is used?**

Any member who has the code can redeem it as many times as they would like. Being able to restrict the code per member or per Plan is on the roadmap.

**Are promo codes case‑sensitive?**

When creating a promo code, it will automatically convert to UPPERCASE. If you are sharing a Plan link with a promo code parameter on the end (\&promo\_code=YOURCODE) ensure that you type the promo code in all UPPERCASE.

**Can I apply or remove a promo code for a specific member?**

Not at this time, but it’s a feature under consideration. You can always remove a member from a Plan or move them to a different one.

**Can I apply a promo code to an existing subscription?**

Not at this time, but this is something we are planning on adding in the future.


# How Do I Switch My Network Between Plans, Invite-Only, and Anyone Can Join?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-switch-my-network-between-plans-invite-only-and-anyone-can-join



## Change from Accessible Through Plans to Anyone Can Join

1. Go to [**Admin > Privacy & Access**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network).
2. Open **Advanced: Allow Anyone to Join Without Restrictions**.
3. Check **Anyone can join immediately without restrictions**.

Your [**Network Landing Page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-customize-my-mighty-networks-landing-page) will now show a **Join** option. All existing members keep the plans that currently give them access.

If you don’t want people to see a plan listed alongside the Join option, open the plan’s settings and make it **hidden** by unchecking all boxes under **Choose Where This Plan Appears**.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 13 57 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 13 57 PM" />

## Change from Accessible Through Plans to Invite-Only

To switch to Invite-Only, all active plans that include Network access must be made inactive.

1. Open [each plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-my-plans) that includes the Network.
2. Go to [**Visibility & Sharing**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear).
3. Uncheck all boxes under **Choose Where This Plan Appears** to hide the plan.
4. Click **Delete all links** at the bottom (if none were created, skip this step).

Existing members will keep their plan-based access, but the plans will no longer be visible or available for anyone new to join.

Once plans are inactive, update your Network’s **Privacy & Access** settings. You can now send [invite links or email invites](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members). Only invited people will see the option to join.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 14 22 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 14 22 PM" />

## Change from Invite-Only or Anyone Can Join to Accessible Through Plans

1. [Create a plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) that includes your Network and any Spaces you want to include.
2. Make the plan active by selecting at least one option under **Choose Where This Plan Appears** or by creating Share Links.
3. If your Network was set to **Anyone Can Join**, go to [**Network Privacy & Access**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network) and uncheck **Anyone can join immediately without restrictions**.

Existing members keep their current access, but they will not be placed on a plan. Going forward, people must join your Network through a plan. Anyone invited directly to the Network will be taken to the available plans.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 14 45 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 14 45 PM" />

If you want to learn how to change your **Space** from Accessible Through Plans to Invite-Only or Anyone Can Join and the reverse, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-switch-my-space-between-plans-invite-only-and-anyone-can-join).


# How Do I Switch My Space Between Plans, Invite-Only, and Anyone Can Join?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-switch-my-space-between-plans-invite-only-and-anyone-can-join



## Change from Accessible Through Plans to Anyone Can Join

1. Click the **gear icon** for the Space.
2. Go to **Privacy & Access**.
3. Select **Anyone in the Network can join this Space without restrictions**.

You’ll also see the option to **Enable Auto Join** if you want all current and future Network members added automatically.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 11 36 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 11 36 PM" />

Once updated, members who aren’t yet in the Space will see a **Join** option. All existing members keep their current plan access.

If you don’t want people to see a plan listed alongside the Join option, open the plan’s settings and make the plan **hidden** by unchecking all boxes under [**Choose Where This Plan Appears**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear).

## Change from Accessible Through Plans to Invite-Only

To switch to Invite-Only, you must make all active plans that include this Space inactive.

1. Open each plan that includes the Space.
2. Go to the [**Visibility & Sharing**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) tab.
3. Uncheck all boxes under **Choose Where This Plan Appears** to hide the plan.
4. Scroll to the bottom and click **Delete all links** (skip if none were created).

Existing members keep their plan-based access, but the plans will no longer be visible or available for anyone new to join.

Once plans are inactive, update the Space’s [**Privacy & Access**](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/6666839-how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space) settings. You can now send [invite links or email invites](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members), and only invited people will see the option to join.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 11 59 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 11 59 PM" />

## Change from Invite-Only or Anyone Can Join to Accessible Through Plans

1. [Create a plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) that includes the Space (and any other Spaces you want the plan to unlock).
2. Make the plan active by selecting at least one option under [**Choose Where This Plan Appears**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) or by creating Share Links.
3. If the Space was set to **Anyone Can Join**, open **Space Privacy & Access** and uncheck **Anyone in the Network can join this Space without restrictions**.

Existing members will still have access to the Space, but they won’t be on a plan. Going forward, people must join the Space through a plan. If someone is invited to the Space directly, they’ll be taken to the available plans.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 12 24 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 12 24 PM" />

If you want to learn how to change your **Network** from Accessible Through Plans to Invite-Only or Anyone Can Join and the reverse, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-switch-my-network-between-plans-invite-only-and-anyone-can-join).


# How Do Members Move Between Plans?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-members-move-between-plans



You can move members between subscription plans in your Mighty Network. Members can also move themselves between eligible subscription plans.

Plan moves are supported **only for subscription plans**.

The move feature does **not** support:

* one-time purchase plans
* interval plans (fixed installment plans)
* moves to or from token-gated plans

If a member is on a one-time purchase plan or installment plan, the option to move will not appear. Hosts also can’t move members into those plan types.

## **Member-Initiated Plan Moves**

Members can move between eligible subscription plans from:

**Personal Settings > Plans and Access**

They can move only:

* Between plans available on web, or
* Between plans within the same subscription group

Plans must be visible to the member in order to appear.

## **Free Trial Rules**

* Members can’t move while currently on a free trial.
* If moving to a plan that includes a free trial, the trial is skipped and billing begins immediately.

## **When Does a Member Move Happen?**

The timing depends on whether the system considers the move an upgrade or downgrade.

### **Immediate Moves**

A move happens immediately when:

* The member upgrades to a higher-priced plan
* The member moves to an equal-priced plan with the same or longer billing interval\
  (Example: monthly → annual at the same price)

### **End-of-Billing-Cycle Moves**

A move is scheduled for the end of the billing cycle when:

* The member downgrades to a lower-priced plan
* The member moves to an equal-priced plan with a shorter billing interval\
  (Example: annual → monthly at the same price)

The system treats moving to a shorter billing commitment as a downgrade.

## **How Billing, Charges, and Refunds Work**

When a move happens immediately between paid subscription plans:

* The member is charged for the new plan, and
* A prorated refund is issued for the unused time on the current plan.

There is **no scenario where a member only pays a prorated amount.**\
An immediate move always includes:

1. A charge for the new plan, and
2. A prorated refund for unused time on the previous plan.

If a move is scheduled for the end of the billing cycle:

* No refund is issued.
* The member keeps access to their current plan until the cycle ends.
* The new plan billing starts on the next billing date.

All payments are processed in USD.

## **Plan Move Scenarios**

### **Free or Access Plan → Paid Plan**

* Move happens immediately.
* If a payment method is on file, the system attempts to charge it.
* If not, the member must add billing information within 7 days.
* If billing isn’t added within 7 days, the move is canceled.

### **Paid Plan → Free or Access Plan**

* Move happens at the end of the billing cycle.
* No refund is issued.

### **Paid Plan → Paid Plan**

The new plan may be higher-priced, lower-priced, or equal-priced.

* Upgrades happen immediately.
* Downgrades happen at the end of the billing cycle.
* Equal-priced moves depend on billing interval (see above).

If the move happens immediately:

* The member is charged for the new plan.
* A prorated refund is issued for unused time on the previous plan.

## **Subscription Groups**

Within a [subscription group](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-subscription-group):

* Members can move only to plans in the same group.
* Members can change billing intervals if multiple intervals are available.

On web, hidden plans in the group won’t appear.\
On iOS, hidden plans may appear and can be selected.

## **Host-Initiated Plan Moves**

Hosts can move members between subscription plans from:

**Admin > Plans > Plan List**

**Limitations:**

* Members who purchased through iOS can’t be moved by a Host.
* Moves are supported only for subscription plans.
* Token-gated plans aren’t supported.
* If moving to a plan with a free trial, the trial is skipped.

<Note>
  Host-initiated plan moves **bypass screening questions and approval gates** on the destination plan. The member is moved directly without being required to answer screening questions or receive approval, even if those gates are enabled on the destination plan. If you need members to complete screening questions or approval, have them request access to the plan through the standard checkout flow or an invite link instead.
</Note>

**For Host-initiated moves:**

* The default behavior is to schedule the move at the end of the billing cycle.
* You can select **Immediately** if you want the move to happen right away.

**If the move happens immediately:**

* The member is charged for the new plan.
* A prorated refund is issued for unused time on the previous plan.

The billing cycle resets when the first payment on the new plan processes.

## **How to Move a Member (Host)**

1. Go to **Admin > Plans > Plan List**.
2. Open the **Members** tab on the member’s current plan.
3. Select the three-dot menu next to their name.
4. Select **Move to Plan**.
5. Select the new plan.
6. Choose **Immediately** or **Next Billing Cycle**.
7. Select **Submit** and optionally send a message.

## **Pending Moves and Statuses**

In a plan’s **Members** tab, you may see:

* **Active** — The member is active on the plan.
* **Pending Move – Billing Cycle** — Scheduled for end of cycle.
* **Pending Move** — Waiting for billing info or payment authentication.

Members in a Pending Move state can’t change their billing cycle date until the move completes.

**Do not deactivate plans with pending moves. Instead, hide the plan until all moves complete.**

## **Automatic Cancellation of a Pending Move**

If a member has a scheduled move (for example, a downgrade at the end of the billing cycle) and then independently purchases the target plan through the normal checkout flow:

* The system automatically cancels the pending move.

This prevents duplicate subscriptions and ensures the member ends up on the correct plan.

## **Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)**

If a card requires authentication:

* The move pauses until verification is complete.
* The member receives email, in-app, and push notifications (if enabled).
* A red banner appears prompting verification.

The member has 7 days to complete authentication.\
If not completed, the move is canceled.

## **Failed Payments**

If payment for a new plan fails:

* The member has 7 days to update billing information.
* If payment still fails, the move is canceled.
* The Host is notified.

## **Canceling a Plan Move**

Hosts can cancel a scheduled move from the three-dot menu by selecting **Cancel Plan Move**.

Members receive a notification when a move is canceled.

If a scheduled move is canceled after billing issues, the member may receive up to a 14-day total grace period to update payment information before access changes.

## **Notifications**

When a move occurs, members receive details via:

* Email
* In-app notifications
* Push notifications (if enabled)

Notifications include the previous plan, the new plan, and the effective date.


# How Do Members Purchase Access?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-members-purchase-access



Use [**plans**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) if you want to require people to do one or more of the following when joining:

* **Pay** (Payments gate)
* [**Answer questions**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members) (Screening Questions gate)
* [**Request approval**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-questions-and-approval-for-my-members) (Approval gate)

Once your plans are set up, members can purchase them on the web, in the Mighty iOS app, or in your custom app if you’re a Mighty Pro Host.

If you want to allow access using NFTs or cryptocurrency, learn more about [**Token-Gated Plans**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-token-gated-plan).

## Choose Where Your Plan Appears

After you create a plan, decide where you want members or visitors to be able to find it.

Go to **Admin > Plans > Plan List**, select your plan, and open the [**Visibility & Sharing**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-choose-where-plans-appear) tab.

A plan becomes **visible** (instead of hidden) when you select one or more of the following:

* [**Network Landing Page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-customize-my-mighty-networks-landing-page)
* [**Collection**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections)
* [**Space/Network About Page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-find-the-about-page-for-my-space-or-mighty-network)

If none of these options are selected, the plan remains **hidden** and can only be joined through a share link.

## How Members Purchase Plans on the Web

## Network Landing Page

When a visitor or non-member comes to your [**Network Landing Page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-customize-my-mighty-networks-landing-page), they’ll see all plans that you’ve made visible and can choose which one to purchase or access.

After selecting a plan, members will see a detailed view where they can review the plan’s subscription options and choose the payment frequency that works best for them.

**Create Account:** The new member enters their name, email, and password to create their account.

**Enter Payment Information**: Finally, the member enters their credit card details to complete the purchase.

Note: If you’d like to direct members straight to the Plans section on your landing page, just add /?choose\_a\_plan to the end of your URL, like so:

* **Original Landing Page URL:** [https://community.mightynetworks.com](https://community.mightynetworks.com)
* **Direct to Plans URL**: [https://community.mightynetworks.com/?choose\_a\_plan](https://community.mightynetworks.com/?choose_a_plan)

## Collections

Members—and visitors, if your Network visibility allows—will see any plans you’ve made visible in a Collection and can select **Buy** to continue.

After selecting a plan, a detailed view appears.

If they already have an account, they’ll see an option to enter their payment details and purchase the plan.

## Token-Gated Plans

With [**Token-Gated Plans,**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-token-gated-plan) members will see the required token or tokens listed directly on the plan page.

## After a Purchase

They will receive a receipt from Stripe with your Network name, the charge amount, and your contact details.

## How Members Purchase Plans on Mobile

## Plans on iOS

On iOS, new plans must be approved by **Apple** before members can purchase them. If you need expedited approval, select the [**Need Help?**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/explore-mighty/where-can-i-get-help) button in the bottom right corner of your Host account and ask our team to support the approval process.

Once approved, members can buy plans on iOS using Apple’s in-app payment system, which connects to their App Store account. [**Currency conversion**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-charge-in-multiple-currencies) is handled automatically based on the member’s location.

## Linking to the Web for Plan Purchases

As of **May 2025**, Apple’s policy guidelines allow Hosts in the **United States** to include direct links to the web for digital purchases. Policies vary by country and may change, so check Apple’s guidelines regularly if you serve members globally.

## Important Details About iOS Purchases

* Apple charges a 15% fee on each transaction made through the App Store.
* Purchases made through the App Store **cannot be canceled or refunded by you**.
* Members must manage and update their subscriptions directly in their **App Store account**.

## Plans on Android

When you sell paid plans, the Android app will let members know that purchases must be completed through a mobile browser or desktop.

## Bank Statements

1. For **web purchases**, members will see the **statement descriptor** you’ve set up in your Stripe account on their bank statement.
2. For **iOS purchases**, the charge will appear as **“Apple.com Bill.”**
3. Email confirmations for iOS purchases will display the **name of your Mighty Network**.

For help guiding your members on how to manage their purchases, [**check out this article.**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-manage-my-membership-or-space-purchases)


# How Do Taxes Work With My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-taxes-work-with-my-mighty-network



As a Host running a paid community or course on your Mighty Network, you’re responsible for managing any taxes related to your business. This may include taxes where you’re based as well as where your members are purchasing from.

To make tax management easier, Mighty integrates with **[Quaderno](https://quaderno.io/integrations/mighty-networks/)**, a third-party tax collection service that connects directly to your **[Stripe account](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network)**.

Once connected, Quaderno automatically calculates, collects, and reports taxes based on your business needs—helping you stay compliant and save time.

**Note:** Purchases made on iOS are processed through Apple, which handles all associated taxes directly.

## What You Can Do with Quaderno

With Quaderno connected to your Mighty Network, you can:

* Automatically calculate and collect taxes based on your configured tax jurisdictions

* Display applicable taxes in the purchase flow on web

* Collect billing addresses from members for accurate tax calculation

* Choose whether to show taxes separately or include them in your listed prices

* Exempt specific purchases, such as business-to-business (B2B) EU VAT transactions

* Access Quaderno’s reporting and notification tools

* Automatically deposit tax amounts into your Stripe account

Before collecting tax in any jurisdiction, your business must be registered with the appropriate tax authority. Once registered, you can configure those jurisdictions in Quaderno to calculate and report taxes accurately.

[Learn more on how to manage your tax jurisdictions on Quaderno](https://support.quaderno.io/tax-jurisdictions/).

## Setting Up Quaderno

1. Go to **Admin > Integrations > Quaderno** in your Mighty Network.

2. Click **Create Account** to sign up for Quaderno and [purchase a plan](https://www.quaderno.io/pricing).

   * Quaderno is not automatically included—you’ll need to create your own account.

3. During setup, Quaderno will ask which platform you sell on. Select **“None of them.”**

4. Follow the prompts to connect your **Stripe account**.

Once complete, return to **Admin > Integrations > Quaderno** in Mighty to confirm your connection.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-taxes-work-with-my-mighty-network/Screenshot-2025-11-05-at-4_20_11-PM.png)

## Turning On Tax Collection

After setup:

1. Go to **Admin > Integrations > Quaderno**.

2. Toggle **Tax Collection** **on**.

This enables automatic tax calculation for new member purchases and ongoing subscriptions. Tax rates will follow the settings you configured in Quaderno.

Note: Past transactions will not be affected.

## Optional Quaderno Settings

To ensure ongoing subscriptions stay accurate when tax rates change:

1. In your **Quaderno account**, go to **Settings > Preferences**.

2. Check **Automatically update Stripe subscriptions**.

## Collect Member Billing Addresses

During checkout, members are prompted to select their **country** and enter a **zip or postal code**.This data allows Quaderno to determine the applicable tax rate for each purchase.

If you choose to collect full billing addresses:

* Members must enter their **billing address** before completing a purchase.

* Returning members will be prompted to provide an address for any new transactions.

* Members can update their address anytime under **Personal Settings > Account > Billing Information**.

If a member enters invalid address data, the purchase will still complete, but **no taxes will be applied**. In this case, Quaderno may alert you to provide additional documentation or verification.

## Use Inclusive Taxes

If you’d like taxes to be included in your displayed prices (instead of added at checkout), you can enable **Inclusive Taxes** in Quaderno. When active, Quaderno will:

* Detect the applicable tax rate

* Deduct the tax amount from the total paid

* Record the tax automatically in your Quaderno reports

## Tax-Exempt Purchases

Quaderno supports tax-exempt validation for specific jurisdictions. Members in these regions can enter a valid tax ID during checkout to exclude taxes from their purchase.

Supported jurisdictions include:

* European Union (EU VAT)

* United Kingdom (VAT)

* Australia (ABN)

* New Zealand (NZBN)

Members can also add or update their Tax ID in **Personal Settings > Account > Billing**.

## If You Choose Not to Use Quaderno

If you do not connect Quaderno, **no taxes will be collected** by default for any new or ongoing member purchases.

# (Pro) How to Remove a Plan From Sale on App Store Connect
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/pro-how-to-remove-a-plan-from-sale-on-app-store-connect



If your App Store Connect Account Holder hasn’t provided their Individual API Key to the Mighty Team, you’ll need to deactivate any plans in your Mighty Network that include iOS availability. When you deactivate a plan, you must also make sure members can’t purchase it on iOS.

Only your App Store Connect Account Holder can update plan availability in App Store Connect.

## Manual Process

1. In App Store Connect, go to **Subscriptions** in the left navigation.

2. Find the subscription using the plan ID and open it.

3. Scroll to the **Availability** section and select **Remove from Sale**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/pro-how-to-remove-a-plan-from-sale-on-app-store-connect/AD_4nXf_rYv7nQzay8FCcoOzF2JhJe-xLO8HcsQawL1pgsR8whHv9YyJkihCZrLQGU__IGCpiCRH7_dnACN_GRj82iu2Yrehw5YpzmfCM4zmbstz6GRB72HLBOPzomwninpvQKi1aRyDVgkZb7RnL3UQOgvJdr3D)

**Important:** Choose **Remove from Sale**, not **Delete Subscription**.

1. When the confirmation modal appears, check the confirmation box and click **Confirm**.

2. Click **Save** in the top right corner to apply the change.

After saving, the subscription will show the **Developer Remove from Sale** status.

## How to Automate Removals from Sale

If you want this process handled automatically, you can provide the Mighty Team with your App Store Connect Account Holder’s Individual API Key. This allows us to initiate actions only the Account Holder can perform.

## Generate an Individual API Key

1. In App Store Connect, open the top-right menu and select **Edit Profile**.Make sure you're logged in as the Account Holder for your Mighty Network.

2. Scroll to **Individual API Key** and click **Generate Key**.

3. Send us the **Key ID** and the downloaded **API Key**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/pro-how-to-remove-a-plan-from-sale-on-app-store-connect/AD_4nXdKVp2Nz_3rTxiNszn_Nbzx8XdMPC6aB1sQJYKqPp81ahn4-jodS7-gAyBG8m2XZdjgtZU7sUmgB1ciTar1XQ1kwz0PG8KTzTW6KHpzpY8i_HmVep5nD8xMW1VLX7rp2MatU6MhAiPvBAVJenBp6j47R5A)

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/pro-how-to-remove-a-plan-from-sale-on-app-store-connect/Screenshot-2024-09-12-at-2_43_09-E2-80-AFPM.png)

**Important:** These keys are sensitive. Only share them with the Mighty Team.

Once we have your API Key and Key ID, we’ll configure your settings so that any plan you deactivate in your Mighty Network is automatically removed from sale on iOS.

Before sharing your API credentials, **[talk with our team](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-get-help)** members to understand whether this approach is right for you.


# What Currencies Can I Charge in On Mighty Networks?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-currencies-can-i-charge-in-on-mighty-networks



You can support up to **10 currencies** from among the [**129+ presentment currencies**](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#presentment-currencies) that Stripe supports.

Every Plan in your Mighty Network must include a price in each of the currencies you choose to sell in.

For example, you can’t choose to present some Plans only in GBP and others only in EUR—each supported currency must have a set price across all your Plans.

The country where your **Stripe account** is based determines:

* Which currencies you can [**present Plans for sale in**](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#presentment-currencies), and
* Which currencies you can **receive payouts in** through your [connected bank accounts](https://stripe.com/docs/payouts).

If you haven’t yet connected your Stripe account, see [How to Connect Stripe to Your Mighty Network](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network)

## Presentment and Settlement Currencies

Stripe uses two types of currencies:

* [**Presentment Currency:**](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#presentment-currencies) The currency members see when buying a Plan.
* [**Settlement Currency:**](https://stripe.com/docs/payouts) The currency you receive in your bank account through Stripe payouts.

The country where your [Stripe account](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-connect-and-disconnect-stripe-to-my-mighty-network) is registered determines which currencies you can offer as Presentment Currencies and which you can use as Settlement Currencies.

## When Presentment and Settlement Currencies Match

If you offer a currency that’s also supported as a Settlement Currency in your country, you can connect a bank account for that currency in Stripe.

When you present and settle in the same currency, Stripe doesn’t charge an exchange fee.

Example: If your Stripe account is based in the UK and you present Plans in GBP, adding a GBP bank account to Stripe allows you to settle in GBP with no exchange fees.

## When Presentment and Settlement Currencies Don’t Match

If your country doesn’t allow a bank account in a certain currency you want to support, you can still present Plans in that currency as long as it’s a supported Presentment Currency for your country.

In this case, Stripe will automatically convert payments from the Presentment Currency to one of your Settlement Currencies and apply an exchange fee.

Example: If your Stripe account is based in the U.S. and you present Plans in CAD (Canadian Dollars), your payout will convert to USD since you can’t settle in CAD. Here, CAD is the **Presentment Currency**, and USD is the **Settlement Currency** used for payouts.

## Adding Bank Accounts for Multiple Currencies

To use Plans in your Mighty Network, you’ll need to:

* Add at least **one bank account** to Stripe for one currency.
* Add additional bank accounts in Stripe for each extra currency you want to settle in.
* This helps avoid exchange fees when you’re both presenting and settling in the same currency.

## Supported Currencies

Stripe supports more than **129 currencies** for processing charges. You can find the full, always-up-to-date list directly on Stripe’s website:​ [Supported Presentment and Settlement Currencies on Stripe](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies)

**Notes:**

* Currencies marked with \* are not supported by American Express.
* Some currencies are [zero-decimal](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#zero-decimal) (for example, JPY), meaning they don’t use cents.
* When referencing a currency in Stripe’s API or code, use the **ISO code in lowercase** (for example, usd, eur, gbp).

Also, note that the three-letter ISO code is provided for each currency below, but you should provide the ISO code in all lowercase letters when making the [charge request](https://stripe.com/docs/api#create_charge).

* TZS
* UAH
* UYU\*
* UZS
* [VND](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#zero-decimal)
* [VUV](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#zero-decimal)
* WST
* [XAF](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#zero-decimal)
* XCD
* [XOF](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#zero-decimal)\*
* [XPF](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#zero-decimal)\*
* YER
* ZAR
* ZMW

## Key Things to Know

* You can pick **up to 10 currencies** to support at once.
* Each Plan must have a price listed in all supported currencies.
* Your **Stripe account’s country** determines which currencies are available for both Presentment and Settlement.
* To avoid exchange fees, present and settle in the same currency.
* You can still sell in other currencies even if you can’t open a bank account for them—Stripe will automatically convert payouts.
* Exchange fees are handled by Stripe during conversion.

If you have questions about your Stripe account or what currencies you’re allowed to sell in, you can reach out to [Stripe Support](https://support.stripe.com/).


# What Happens When a Member Cancels or Requests a Refund
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-happens-when-a-member-cancels-or-requests-a-refund



## How Members Can Cancel Their Subscription

Members can cancel their subscriptions at any time. The process depends on where they originally made the purchase.

## Web Purchases

1. Log in on a **desktop web browser**.

2. Go to **Personal Settings > Plans and Access > Cancel Subscription**.

## iOS Purchases

If the member purchased the plan through the **Mighty Networks iOS app**, they’ll need to cancel directly through Apple:

1. Go to **Settings > \[Your Name] > Media & Purchases**.

2. Choose **View Account**.

3. Scroll to **Subscriptions**.

4. Find the Mighty Networks subscription.

5. Select the subscription and tap **Cancel**.

Members can also visit **reportaproblem.apple.com** to request a refund or manage their Apple subscriptions.

## Mobile Web

On a mobile device, members can cancel using a browser (not the app):​**Profile > Your Purchases > Active Subscriptions > Cancel Subscription.**

## What Happens After Cancellation

When a member cancels their subscription:

* They retain access until the **end of the current billing period**.

* The cancellation takes effect on their **next billing date**, and they will not be charged again.

* Members cannot leave a paid plan immediately unless they **delete their account** or the **Host removes them** from the plan.

**Note:** If a member’s payment fails and their subscription becomes **Past Due**, the plan may automatically cancel. You won’t receive a cancellation email in that case. Learn more in [What Happens When Members of My Mighty Network Are Past Due on Their Payments?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-happens-when-members-are-past-due-on-their-payments)

## Free, Access, or One-Time Payment Plans

For members on **Free** or **Access Plans**, or those who made a **One-Time Payment**, there isn’t a built-in cancel option. If they want to leave the plan:

* They can contact you, the **Host**, to be manually removed, or

* They can reach out to **Mighty Networks Support** for help, or

* They can delete their account.

## Notifications for Hosts

When a member cancels a subscription, you’ll receive an **email notification** during the week their subscription is scheduled to end.

If multiple subscriptions are ending, the email will list all of them. You can click **View Member** or **View Members** in the email to see their profiles and reach out directly—this is a great way to learn why they’re leaving and gather feedback.

## How to Refund a Member

Refunds are handled entirely by you, the Host. Mighty Networks does not automatically issue partial or full refunds when a member leaves, is removed, or is banned.

Refunds are always at your discretion.

## Refunding Web Purchases

For purchases made on the web, refunds can be issued manually through your connected **Stripe account**.

To issue a refund:

1. Log in to your **Stripe dashboard**.

2. Go to **Payments** and find the transaction.

3. Hover over the payment and click the **refund icon**.

4. Confirm the refund.

**Note:** Stripe’s transaction fees are non-refundable. The refunded amount will be the original charge **minus the transaction fees**.

After refunding, you may want to revoke the member’s access to the plan by selecting the [three dot menu next to their name in the member list](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members).

## Refunding iOS Purchases

Transactions made through the **iOS app** are processed by Apple, not Stripe. You’ll see “Free” transactions in Stripe for these members, as Apple handles billing directly.

If a member requests a refund for an iOS purchase:

1. Have them go to **reportaproblem.apple.com**.

2. Sign in with their Apple ID.

3. Select **Report a Problem** next to the Mighty Networks purchase.

4. Choose a reason for the refund and submit the request.

If needed, you or the member can also contact **Apple Support** for additional help. For reference, review [Apple’s refund policy here](https://support.apple.com/billing).

Because Hosts cannot refund iOS purchases directly, you can also choose to:

* Provide an **iTunes Gift Card**, or

* Send funds manually via **PayPal**, **Venmo**, or another service.

## Best Practices

* Always communicate refund policies clearly with members before they join a paid plan.

* Encourage members to cancel directly through the platform they used to purchase (web or iOS).

* Avoid managing cancellations or refunds directly in Stripe for iOS purchases—Apple handles those separately.

## Need Help?

If a member requests a refund through Mighty Networks Support, our team will connect them with you by email to help resolve the issue.

For further guidance, reach out using the **Need Help** button in the bottom right corner of your Mighty Network.


# What Happens When Members Are Past Due on Their Payments?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-happens-when-members-are-past-due-on-their-payments



If [payments are enabled](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) in your Mighty Network and at least one of your Plans is a **subscription** or [Installment Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-set-up-installment-plans-and-subscription-intervals-and-subscription-intervals), members will have a **card on file** that’s automatically charged when their payment renews.

Members on **annual subscriptions** receive an email reminder **30 days before renewal**.

For **monthly subscriptions**, renewal information is included directly in the payment confirmation email members receive each billing cycle—so they always have visibility into their upcoming charge.

If a card expires or a payment fails, the member enters a **Past Due** state. During this time, our system automatically prompts them to update their card information—you don’t need to follow up manually.

## How Past-Due Members Are Prompted to Update Card Details

When a payment fails, the **grace period** begins.

During the grace period:

* The member is marked **Past Due**, visible in **Admin > Plans & Access > Plan List** under the affected Plan.

* You can view all past-due members at **Admin > Plans & Access > Past Due Members.**

* When the member signs in, a **banner** appears along the bottom of the screen prompting them to update their card details. The banner links directly to the page where they can do so.

## Grace Periods by Platform

**Web (Stripe Payments):**

* The grace period lasts **7 days**.

* Mighty Networks automatically sends **three reminder emails** prompting the member to update their payment information.

* These reminders are spaced throughout the grace period using machine learning to optimize timing.

* Stripe retries the failed payment automatically—once after one day, and then every two days until day seven.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-happens-when-members-are-past-due-on-their-payments/7325444162189)

**Free Trial Members:**

* Members on a [Free Trial](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-offer-a-free-trial-on-a-mighty-network) follow the same **7-day grace period** process.

**iOS (Apple Payments):**

* The grace period lasts **16 days**.

* Apple handles all billing notifications directly through the **App Store**.

## What Happens When a Past-Due Payment Is Resolved

When the member updates their card and the payment succeeds:

* The charge is processed immediately.

* The member’s **billing cycle** stays the same—their next renewal date does not change.

## What Happens When a Past-Due Payment Isn’t Resolved

If the member doesn’t update their payment information within the grace period:

* They **lose access** to the Plan on **day seven** (or **day 16** for iOS purchases).

* To regain access, they’ll need to purchase the Plan again and update their card details during checkout.

## What Happens If a Past-Due Member Cancels Their Plan

If a member cancels their Plan while it’s in a **Past Due** state, the cancellation is **immediate**, and they’ll lose access to that Plan right away.

## What Does “Pending Payment” Mean?

“Pending Payment” can indicate:

* The member started checkout but didn’t complete it.

* Their card requires **[Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)](https://stripe.com/guides/strong-customer-authentication)** approval from their bank.

## What Is Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)?

**Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)** is a **[European regulatory requirement](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=uriserv%3AOJ.L_.2018.069.01.0023.01.ENG\&toc=OJ%3AL%3A2018%3A069%3ATOC)** designed to reduce fraud and make online payments more secure.

SCA applies to **new card purchases online**, not recurring subscription renewals. Banks must decline payments that require SCA if they aren’t properly authenticated.

## What Happens When You Move a Member and Their Payment Fails

If you move a member to a **Paid Plan** and the payment fails, here’s what happens:

* The **member** receives an email, in-app message, and (if enabled) a mobile push notification that says:

  * *“Action Required: Your Host switched your Plan but payment didn't process. Please update your billing info ASAP. Once you do, you’ll be moved and refunded as needed.”*

* The member has **7 days** to update their billing information before the Plan move is canceled.

* You as the **Host** receive an email, in-app message, and (if enabled) mobile push notification that says:

  * *“**\[Member Name]** needs to update their billing information for **\[Plan Name]**. Once their billing information is updated, they’ll be subscribed to **\[New Plan Name]**.”*

* If the move required **SCA verification**, the member also receives:

  * *“Action Required: Please verify your billing information for your move to **\[New Plan Name]**. Once verified, you’ll be subscribed.”*

* If the member doesn’t update their billing info in time, the **Plan move is canceled**, and you’ll receive a notification confirming the cancellation.

## Extended Grace Period for End-of-Cycle Moves

If you moved the member at the **end of their billing cycle** and they don’t update their payment information, they get an **additional 7 days** on their previous Plan—creating a total **14-day grace period** before removal.


# What is a Full vs. Limited Membership?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership



Full memberships provide access to your entire **Network**, while limited memberships offer access to a specific set of **Spaces** and features.

Whether someone becomes a full or limited member depends on what their **plans** give access to.​

Limited memberships let you offer a standalone experience—such as a course, live event, or lead magnet—inside a single Space or a bundle of Spaces, without unlocking your full Network.​

## Why Use Limited Memberships

By restricting access to Network-level **Global Features**—including private messaging, the Global Feed, or Global Members—you can:

* Keep your broader community gated, exclusive, or reserved for paying members.
* Use individual Spaces as entry points to introduce new people to your work.
* Sell standalone programs or experiences while keeping your full community experience separate for those on a higher-tier plan.​

## How Limited Members Join Spaces

**Important:** Limited members can **only** join Spaces through paid plans. This means:

* **Invites do not grant access** to limited members for Spaces
* **"Anyone Can Join" settings do not apply** to limited members for Spaces
* Limited members **must have a valid payment** for a plan that includes the Space in order to access it

This restriction ensures that limited memberships remain properly gated and prevents unintended access escalation.

## What Limited Members See

Here’s an example of what the limited member experience can look like:

</Frame>

## Below is a detailed guide to the features accessible to each member type:

***Important notes:***

* If you set your [Network Privacy & Access settings to "anyone can view content inside the Network,](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network)" these definitions may shift because a limited member can see what a visitor/non-member sees (e.g. Collections with Spaces that anyone in the Network can see, promoted Spaces, etc.).
* **If you demote a full member to a limited member** (by removing the Network from any of the Spaces they are on) they will lose access to their private chats and any of the Global Features. If you add the Network back and restore them to full membership, then they will be able to access their previous chat messages.
* Limited members cannot become Space Hosts or Space moderators.

# Can I Customize the Landing Space for My Members?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/can-i-customize-the-landing-space-for-my-members



**Landing Spaces** let you curate where people land when they enter your Mighty Network. You can set different Landing Spaces for new members, returning members, and visitors.

To get started, go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Landing Spaces**. From there, you can set one, two, or all three Landing Space options.

Only Spaces set to **[Anyone Can Join](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space)** and **auto join** will appear in the dropdown menu.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/can-i-customize-the-landing-space-for-my-members/Screenshot-2025-11-24-at-1_25_23-PM.png)

## Landing Space for New Members

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/can-i-customize-the-landing-space-for-my-members/Screenshot-2025-11-24-at-1_26_02-PM.png)

The Space you select is where someone lands the first time they enter your Mighty Network after creating an account.

If a member is invited through a specific Space, they will land in the Space they were invited to instead of the Landing Space for New Members.

The selected Space must be **[Anyone Can Join](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space)** and **auto join**.

## Landing Space for Returning Members

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/can-i-customize-the-landing-space-for-my-members/Screenshot-2025-11-24-at-1_26_11-PM.png)

The Space you choose becomes the default Space for:

* Returning members

* Network Hosts, Space Hosts, Network moderators, and Space moderators

Members will see this Landing Space when they sign in on a new device or return after signing out. If a member stays signed in, their last-visited Space will load instead.

## Landing Space for Visitors

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/can-i-customize-the-landing-space-for-my-members/Screenshot-2025-11-24-at-1_26_18-PM.png)

This option appears only in **[Anyone Can Join](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network)** Mighty Networks.

The selected Space is where visitors—people who have not created an account—will land when they first view your Mighty Network. The Space must be **Anyone Can Join** and **auto join**.

If no Landing Space is set, visitors and returning members will land on the first Global Feature, first joined Space, or first Collection in the Left Navigation Panel.

### Plan Landing Space

If you want to customize the Landing Space for members who join through a plan, you can set it up during **[plan creation](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/can-i-customize-the-landing-space-for-my-members/Screenshot-2025-11-19-at-12_23_53-PM.png)

You can also edit this anytime by going to **Admin > Plans > Plan List**, selecting the plan, and opening the **Settings** tab. Under **Spaces & Audiences**, you’ll find the **Plan Landing Space** setting.


# Can I Customize the Navigation in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/can-i-customize-the-navigation-in-my-mighty-network



<iframe />

On the [Launch Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and above, you can add up to **four custom navigation links** in the left-hand menu of your Mighty Network. These links can point to **external websites** or **internal pages** you want to feature.

Custom navigation links are visible to members:

* On the web, in the **left-hand navigation panel**
* On the [**Mighty Networks iOS and Android apps**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/does-mighty-networks-have-an-app), when members open the side menu

They’re perfect for linking to your online store (for example, a Shopify site) or any other resource you want to make easily accessible.

## How to Add a Custom Navigation Link

1. Click your **profile picture** in the top right corner.
2. Go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Navigation Links**.
3. Type in the **title** and **URL** for each link you want to add.
4. Save your changes.

You can add up to four links. If you already have four and want to change one, simply edit or delete an existing link.

## How Members See Navigation Links

### On the Web

Custom navigation links appear in the left-hand navigation panel. When a member clicks one of these links, it will open in a **new browser tab**.

### On Mobile (iOS and Android)

When members open the side menu in the Mighty Networks app, they’ll see your navigation links there.

Tapping a link opens it in an **in-app browser**, so we recommend linking to a **mobile-friendly website** for the best experience.


# Does Mighty Networks Have an App?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/does-mighty-networks-have-an-app



Your Mighty Network is always within reach. You can access it from the **desktop web**, **mobile web** (through your Network’s [subdomain](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/can-i-change-the-default-mnco-domain-for-my-mighty-network) or [custom domain](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/can-i-use-my-own-web-domain-with-mighty-networks)), or our **[native iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1081683081?utm_source=intercom\&utm_medium=getting_started\&utm_campaign=download_mobile_apps\&utm_content=) and [Android apps](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mightybell.mb\&hl=en_US\&gl=US)**.

More than 65% of engagement across Mighty Networks happens on mobile—so we highly recommend downloading the app for the best experience.

## Download the Mighty Networks App

You can download the free Mighty Networks app from the **App Store** or **Google Play Store** by searching for **“Mighty Networks.”**

* **iOS:** Compatible with iPhone and iPad. Requires iOS version 15 or higher.

* **Android:** Works on all current Android devices.

You can also download the app directly from your **Personal Settings** page:

1. On the web, go to **Personal Settings > Download the App.**

2. Open your phone’s camera and scan the QR code that appears.

3. Follow the link to download the app for your Mighty Network.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/does-mighty-networks-have-an-app/Screenshot-2025-11-06-at-2_34_37-PM.png)

To see which devices support our app, [check out this guide here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/browser-and-device-support).

## Finding Your Mighty Network on the Mobile Apps

After you’ve installed the app, you’ll see two options when you open it: **Sign In** or **Discover Networks.**

* **Sign In**: Enter your email to receive a link to all Mighty Networks you’re part of.

* **Discover Networks**: Search for your Mighty Network by name and sign in when prompted.

Once you’ve signed in, the app will remember your Mighty Network until you log out.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/does-mighty-networks-have-an-app/new-app-sign-in.png)

To join another Mighty Network:

1. Open the left navigation panel.

2. Tap **Switch Networks.**

3. Select the **+** button to search for and add another Mighty Network.

## Accessing Hidden Mighty Networks

If your Mighty Network’s [privacy](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network) setting is **Only invited members can see and find it**, it won’t appear in the app’s search results.

To access your hidden Network:

1. Log in to your Mighty Network using your **mobile web browser.**

2. Tap the prompt at the bottom that says **View in App.**

3. Follow the link to open your Mighty Network in the app.

You’ll only need to do this the first time you visit.

## Enabling Mobile Push Notifications

Mobile Push notifications are **off by default.**

To turn them on:

1. Download the **Mighty Networks App.**

2. On the web, click **Download App** to generate a QR code, then scan it with your phone.

3. After downloading, you’ll be prompted to **enable notifications.**

To manage them later, go to **Profile Picture > Personal Settings > Notifications** and toggle **Mobile Push** on or off.

If you previously denied notifications, go to your **device settings** to manually enable them.

## Internet Connection Requirements

Course and video content require an active internet connection. Members must be connected to **Wi-Fi** or within a **cellular data range** to access content. Offline access is not currently supported.


# How Do I Add and Manage Features in a Space?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space



You can add features like **Course**, **Events**, **Chat**, and more to any Space in your Mighty Network.

## Add a Feature

* Go to the Space where you want to add a feature.
* Select the "plus" icon to add features.
* You can also remove "turn off", reorder or rename the features from the three dot menu next to the feature.

<img alt="New Space Features" />

You can have one feature or any combination of them. Each feature can be renamed (up to 40 characters), reordered, or toggled on or off at any time.

## Manage Features

To manage any of the features, you can select the three dot menu and easily get to the feature settings, rename, reorder, edit or change the visibility.
