## Available Space Features

## Chat

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 8 56 17 AM" />

Create an open conversation area where all members in the Space can post, reply, and react.

* Members can upload emojis, GIFs, and more.
* Use **@mentions** to tag other members—they’ll receive a notification.
* Both Hosts and members will see pop-up notifications on web and mobile when there’s a new chat message.

To learn more, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-does-chat-work-in-a-mighty-network).

## Feed

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 8 56 34 AM" />

The **Feed** lets you and your members create, view, and engage with posts within a Space-specific stream.

You can customize the Feed by:

* Renaming it
* Choosing the **Default Display Style** and **Default Sort Order**
* Selecting who can post (Everyone, Only Hosts and Moderators)
* Turning on or off specific post types (Posts, Articles, Polls, etc.)

## Members

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 8 56 52 AM" />

Every Mighty Network includes the [**People Explorer**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-is-the-people-explorer), which helps members connect and discover others in their Spaces.

You can filter profiles by:

* **All**
* **Top**
* **Nearest**
* **Hosts**
* **Online**
* **Explore**

You can also toggle the **Show Explore Tab** on or off to move the Explore tab to the beginning or end of the Members list.

To learn more, [check out this article.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-is-the-people-explorer)

## Course

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 8 57 10 AM" />

Available on the **Launch Plan** and above, the **Course** feature helps you organize structured content like course material, resource libraries, or directories.

Within a Course, you can:

* Rename the feature
* Add and name **Lessons** and **Sections**
* Choose between **Thumbnail** or **List View**
* Set whether content can be previewed

To learn more, [check out this article.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-build-a-course-in-my-mighty-network)

## Discovery

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 8 58 08 AM" />

The **Discovery** feature gives your Space a visual layout to highlight key content, members, and features.

* You can show, hide, or reorder up to **eight sections** by dragging and dropping.
* Discovery helps members find what’s most important at a glance.

To learn more, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/whats-the-discovery-feature).

## Events

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 8 58 32 AM" />

Activate **Events** in your Space to schedule gatherings that include RSVP, messaging, and integrations with third-party services.

* Events appear in the Space Feed (if enabled) and in the **Global Feed** for members who have access to the Space—or for public events.
* You can choose who can create Events: **Everyone** or **Only Hosts and Moderators**.

To learn more, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network).

## Single Event

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 8 58 50 AM" />

Available on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and above, this feature creates a standalone [**Single Event page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network).

It’s ideal for one-time events you want to highlight separately from other Spaces or recurring content.

## Page

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 8 59 06 AM" />

Available on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and above, a **Page** is a static, article-style feature that you can use for evergreen content, announcements, or resources.

* You can toggle **comments and reactions** on or off.
* Pages start as **Hidden**—make them visible when you’re ready to publish.
* You can include or remove a title by editing the “Add a Title” field.

**Page Notifications:**

* The Page creator receives all comment notifications.
* Page ownership cannot be transferred.

## Hashtag List

The **Hashtag List** surfaces [highlighted hashtags](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-use-hashtags-in-my-mighty-network) within your Space.

To add one:

1. Go to **gear icon > Space Features > Hashtag List**.
2. Toggle it on.
3. Rename the feature if you’d like.

**Note:** The **Feed** feature must also be enabled for the Hashtag List to appear.

## Important Notes

* You can’t currently add the same feature type more than once in a Space (for example, two Feeds).
* Every Space can include any combination of available features.
* We’re exploring support for multiple instances of the same feature—share your feedback in the [Mighty Networks product roadmap](https://portal.productboard.com/xzueeglxeumrzzs7kq5fzcqt/tabs/4-in-development)!

To learn more about managing Spaces in your Network, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces).


# How Do I Chat with Cohost?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-chat-with-cohost



**Mighty Cohost** is your all-in-one assistant for building and running your community.

Available on the [**Explore Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/exploreplan) and above, Cohost is trained on our [Community Design](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/whats-community-design)™ framework, help center and more!

It's designed to help you design, launch, and grow a thriving Mighty Network—while answering your questions 24/7.

## Chat with Cohost

In the upper right corner of your Mighty Network on web, you'll find the Cohost icon next to your personal settings.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Open Cohost" title="Open Cohost" />
</Frame>

On mobile, you'll see it on your bottom navigation

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 29 At 1 06 44 PM" title="Screenshot 2026 05 29 At 1 06 44 PM" />
</Frame>

All **Network Hosts** can view and participate in Cohost conversations, however you will only see your messages with Cohost. You can **rate a response** with a thumbs-up or thumbs-down to help improve future results.

The two icons next to the Cohost name will show you:

* **Clock icon** — Your conversation history and updates from the Mighty team
* **Close icon** — Closes the Cohost panel

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 04 At 9 32 52 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 05 04 At 9 32 52 AM" />
</Frame>

## What you can do with Cohost

Cohost helps you take action and move faster. Here’s what it can do today. For actions that need confirmation, you’ll see an approval card first — [more on that below](#approve-important-actions-before-they-happen).

<Frame>
  <img alt="Cohost Marketing Image" title="Cohost Marketing Image" />
</Frame>

### Create and set up

* [**Spaces**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces#how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces) — Create new Spaces using available templates
* [**Collections**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections#how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections) — Create Collections and add new Spaces to them
* **Rename** — rename existing Spaces and Collections, your Network name
* **Reorder** — Spaces in existing Collections
* [**Web address**](/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/can-i-change-the-default-mnco-domain-for-my-mighty-network) — change your Network's `mn.co` subdomain after confirming the exact new address
* [**Plans**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan#how-do-i-create-a-plan) — Set up pricing and monetization for your Network, including:
  * Naming
  * Pricing
  * Gates
  * Sales pitch
  * Benefits list
  * Descriptions

### Customize your Network

* Update your [**Big Purpose**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/whats-a-big-purpose#big-purpose)
* Store and refine your [community design](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/whats-a-big-purpose#what-is-community-design) (Ideal Member, goals, themes, and more) to personalize guidance

### Get guidance and support

* Search the Help Center for step-by-step articles
* Get direct links to the right settings pages
* Help with strategies for community building, growth, and engagement

### Take action, with your approval

* Send announcements and manage invite requests
* Manage members, Badges, Tags, and Profile Fields
* Manage Course Spaces, Events, and Landing Pages
* Manage plans and subscriptions
* Manage Marketing Banners

### Find your way faster

For actions like renaming, reordering, or deleting, Cohost will guide you to the exact place in your settings so you can complete it in just a few clicks.

## Approve important actions before they happen

Cohost can now take on more of the work, and you always keep the final say. When you ask Cohost to do something that needs confirmation, it pauses and shows you an approval card in chat first. Nothing happens until you tap Approve.

If you’d rather not move forward, just leave the card alone. Cohost won’t take the action without your approval.

### Actions Cohost can take with your approval

Ask Cohost to handle any of the following, and it’ll show you an approval card first:

**Announcements and invites**

* Send an announcement to members
* Approve or reject a join request, individually or in bulk

**Members**

* Remove a member from your Network (they can rejoin later)
* Delete a Badge
* Delete a Tag
* Delete a Profile Field
* Delete an option from a Profile Field

**Spaces and events**

* Delete a Course Space and its contents
* Cancel a single occurrence of a recurring Event
* Unpublish a Landing Page

**Payments and plans**

* Cancel a member's subscription (takes effect at the end of their current billing period)
* Remove a member's access to a plan
* Delete a plan group (the plans inside it stay intact)
* Archive a plan (archived plans can't be reactivated)

**Marketing**

* Delete a Marketing Banner

<Note>
  Cohost conversations work independently of your Network's [private chat settings](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-does-chat-work-in-a-mighty-network#private-chat-options). Even if private chat is turned off for members, you can still chat with Cohost.
</Note>

**Message limits by plan:**

* **Explore Plan:** 25 messages/day
* **Launch Plan:** 100 messages/day
* **Scale Plan and above:** Unlimited messages


# How Do I Create and Manage My Collections?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections



**Collections** make it easy to organize your Spaces in Mighty Networks. You can group related Spaces together, hide Collections while you’re setting things up, or feature specific Spaces or Plans for members to explore.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 16 00 PM" />

### Looking for guidance? [Chat with Cohost!](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-chat-with-cohost#how-do-i-chat-with-cohost)

It will be able to name and create your new Collection.

## How to Create a Collection

It’s easy! You have two ways to create one:

**From the main navigation:**

* Go to the bottom of the left-hand menu.
* Select **Create > Collection**.
* Add a **name** and an optional **tagline**.

<img alt="New Collection" />

**From Admin:**

* Go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Collection List**.
* Click **Create Collection**.

<img alt="New Collection2" />

## How to Access Collection Settings

Both **Network Hosts** and **Network Moderators** can access Collection Settings.

You can open **Collection Settings** in a few ways:

* Go to the Collection and click the **gear icon**.
* Go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Collection List**, then use the **three-dot menu > Manage Collection**.
* From the left-hand navigation, **hover over the Collection name** and click the **three-dot menu > Manage Collection**.

**Note:** The images and videos shown in a Collection come from the [primary image or video](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-space-branding) for each Space.

## Collection Details

In **Collection Details**, you can:

* Rename the Collection
* Add or edit a tagline
* Hide or delete the Collection

## Reordering

You can reorder both **Spaces within a Collection** and **Collections themselves**:

* **Reorder Spaces:**
  * Go to Drag and drop them in the order you want.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 17 50 PM" />

* **Reorder Collections:**
  * Go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Collection List > Reorder Collections**.

## Collection Visibility

Hiding a Collection controls whether it appears in the left-hand menu for members who haven’t joined any Spaces inside it.

* **Hosts and Moderators** always see all Collections.
* Hiding a Collection doesn’t change the [**privacy**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space) of the Spaces inside.

**Possible reasons to hide Collections:**

* Hide Collections as a **staging area** for Spaces you’re still building.
* Create a **Collection** just for Hosts and Moderators to coordinate.

## Deleting or Sharing a Collection

* **Delete:** Go to **Manage Collection Settings** or use the **three-dot menu > Delete**.
* **Share:** In the **three-dot menu**, select **Share** to copy a direct link.
  * This link shows members all the Spaces within the Collection.

Collections themselves don’t have privacy settings — but the Spaces inside them do. If you want to sell access to Spaces in a Collection, check out [**“How do I Create a Plan?”**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)

If a member sees a **“See More”** prompt under a Collection after joining all visible Spaces, it means the Collection has hidden Spaces they can’t access.

## Featuring Plans or Spaces

You can highlight **Plans or Spaces** within a Collection:

* **To feature Plans:**
  * Go to **Manage Collection** > **Reorder Spaces and select the Plans Carousel**
* Members will see a scrolling row of featured plans.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 18 12 PM" />

* **To feature Spaces:**
  * Click the **three-dot menu** next to a Space and choose **Add this to > Featured Section**.

## Collection Limits

You can have up to **30 Collections** in your Mighty Network. Once your Collections are set up, start **adding Spaces** to them to organize your community.


# How Do I Create and Manage My Spaces?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces



You can create a Space that’s a **course, group, resource library, chat Space, event**, or something completely custom.

### Looking for guidance? [Chat with Cohost!](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-chat-with-cohost#how-do-i-chat-with-cohost)

It will help you name and even create your new Space.

## Create a Space

You can create a new Space in a few ways:

**Select the “Create a Space” icon** at the bottom of the left-hand navigation.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 9 09 42 AM" />

**Go to a Collection** where you’d like to add a Space and select **three-dot menu > Create a Space**.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot2026 02 11at11 40 28AM" title="Screenshot2026 02 11at11 40 28AM" />
</Frame>

**From Admin:** Go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Spaces > Create Space**.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 9 10 26 AM" />

Each option will take you to the **Choose a Space Template** page. To learn more, check out [What Kinds of Space Templates Are Available?](/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-kinds-of-space-templates-are-available).

Space creation happens in the background, so you can continue working while your Space is being set up. You'll receive a **push notification** and an **email** when the Space is ready.

By default, new Spaces are visible only to **logged-in members** until you choose a privacy setting or add a payment option for access.

## Space Settings

After creating a Space, you can manage its settings in two ways:

**From inside a Space:**

* Go to the Space you want to manage.

</Frame>

**From the left navigation panel:**

* Hover over the Space name.
* Click the **three-dot menu** next to it.

<Frame>

</Frame>

## Setup

## Basics

In **Basics**, you can update your Space name, tagline, description, and the Collection where the Space lives.

* **Space Name:** up to 40 characters
* **Space Tagline:** up to 100 characters
* **Space Description:** up to 10,000 characters

You can also delete the Space from this section.

## Privacy

Each new Space starts as **Invite-Only**. You can adjust this in **Privacy & Access**.

* To learn more, see [How Do I Set the Privacy Settings for a Space?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space)
* To charge for access, see [How Do I Create a Plan?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)

## Space Branding

**Space Hosts** and **Space moderators** can customize the design of a Space with a custom color, logo, image, or video. [Learn more.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-space-branding)

## Space Features

You can add, remove, rename, and reorder Space features such as **Course**, **Feed**, and **Chat**

[Learn more](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space)

## Content Highlights

As a Space Host, you can set up a **Welcome Section** or [**Featured Section**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-and-manage-featured-and-welcome-sections) that appears to the right of the Space Feed (if the Feed feature is enabled).

You can also display a [**Highlighted Hashtag List**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-hashtags-work-in-my-mighty-network) in this same area.

These sections can include pinned posts such as polls, articles, questions, and events.

**To add or reorder posts:**

* Go to your Space on web.
* Use the **three-dot menu** next to a post or event to pin it to feature it.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 9 13 47 AM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 9 13 47 AM" />

* To reorder posts, go to **Space Admin > Content Highlights** and drag and drop posts into your preferred order.

## Members

In **Member Space Admin**, you can:

* View and manage the [**member list**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members).
* [Download the list](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-download-my-member-data) (available on the **Scale Plan** or higher).
* Use **Bulk Actions** to send [messages](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-message-members-in-my-network), add or remove [badges](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members), and manage [tags](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members).

**As a Space Host, you can also:**

* View member email addresses.
* Click the **eyeball icon** to view privacy reminders or unhide emails.

## Invites

From here, you can [invite members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-invite-people-to-my-mighty-network), [manage your sent invites](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-manage-sent-invites-and-requests-to-join), and approve any requests to join your Space.

## Moderation

You can manage your [reported content](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-content-and-moderation-tools-do-i-have-in-my-mighty-network) from here.

## Plans

Create and manage **Plans** from here. For more details, see [How Do I Create a Plan?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)

## Managing Spaces

### Duplicating a Space

You can duplicate a Space to quickly create a copy of its setup and structure.

1. Hover over the Space in the left navigation panel.
2. Click the **three-dot menu > Manage > More > Duplicate**.

You’ll see a summary of what will be duplicated:

**Space Settings:**

All Space details (like branding and taglines) will be copied except for the Space’s name and privacy settings.

* The duplicate will be renamed **\[Copy] Space Name**.
* Only logged-in members can view or search for it.
* Plans connected to the original Space will **not** be duplicated.

Feed: All Feed display settings will copy. You’ll choose how to handle posts in the next step.

Course: The Overview, Lessons, and Sections will be duplicated and set to **hidden**. Comments and reactions will not be copied.

Members: Hosts and moderators will be added automatically, but members will not.

Page: All page settings and content will copy, but comments and reactions will not.

Events: All event settings will copy. You’ll choose which events to duplicate. Duplicated events become **drafts**.

Chat: All chat settings will copy, but chat messages will not.

Discovery: All Discovery settings will copy, but Featured and Welcome Sections may not include content that wasn’t duplicated.

### Choose What to Duplicate

On the next page, you’ll decide how to handle posts in your duplicated Space, including Quick Posts, Polls and Questions, Articles, and Events.

You can choose to:

* Not duplicate any posts
* Duplicate all Host and Moderator posts
* Duplicate all posts

Comments, reactions, event RSVPs, poll answers, drafts, and scheduled posts will **not** be duplicated.

After you make your selections, you’ll see an indicator showing that the Space is duplicating.

Once finished, you’ll receive both a **push notification** and an **email** confirming the duplication is complete.

## Reorder and Move Spaces

You can reorder how Spaces appear to members in the left-hand navigation.

1. Go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Collection List**.
2. Hover over a Collection > **three-dot menu > Manage Collection > Space Order > Reorder Spaces**.
3. Drag and drop Spaces into your preferred order.

You can also use the **three-dot menu** next to a Space to move it to the **Top** or **Bottom** of the list.

To move a Space to a Different [Collection](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections)

1. Select the three dot menu next to the Space: **Move Space > Change Collection**

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot2026 02 11at11 47 45AM" title="Screenshot2026 02 11at11 47 45AM" />
</Frame>

When you move a Space to a different Collection, all of its content — including feed posts, events, and chat messages — moves with it. The Space may take a few moments to fully appear in the new Collection as the system updates.

For managing Collections, check out [How Do I Create and Manage My Collections?](/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections).

## Deleting Spaces

To delete a Space:

1. Open the **three-dot menu > More > Delete**.
2. Confirm when prompted.

**Important:**

* Deletion cannot be undone. If you prefer to hide the Space instead, consider archiving it.
* If the Space is part of a plan, you’ll see a pop-up confirming that deletion will **remove access for all members.**
* If it’s the only Space in a plan (and the plan doesn’t include the Network), you must **deactivate the plan** before deleting the Space.

## Archiving Spaces

Archiving hides a Space from view without deleting its content.

To archive a Space:

1. Click the **three-dot menu > Archive**.
2. Confirm when prompted.

Archived Spaces appear greyed out in **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Space List**.

* You can **unarchive in the three dot menu** to restore it.
* Archived Spaces can’t be deleted until they’re unarchived.
* Collections with archived Spaces can’t be deleted.

When a Space is archived:

* All content, including posts and interactions, becomes inaccessible to all current members.
* Spaces that are part of a plan are removed from it and plan members lose access.
* The last Space in a Bundle will be skipped from archiving.
* The Space is still visible in your Admin.
* You can unarchive the Space at any time.
* Auto-join settings remain active for archived Spaces. However, if a Space's privacy is changed to a non-joinable setting (such as Invite-Only), auto-join is automatically turned off to maintain consistency.
* Notifications are cleared and won't return when unarchived.
* [Infinite Question Engine](/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-use-the-infinite-question-engine) Auto-Post is disabled and scheduled IQE posts are canceled. You will need to re-enable Auto-Post manually after unarchiving.

### Bulk Archiving

You can archive multiple Spaces at once:

1. Go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Space List**.
2. Select the Spaces you want to archive using the checkboxes.
3. Choose **Bulk Actions > Archive**.
4. Confirm when prompted.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 04 24 At 11 52 42 AM" />
</Frame>

<Warning>
  Spaces that are part of a plan will be removed from it and plan members will lose access. The last Space in a Bundle will be skipped from the bulk archive
</Warning>

You will receive an **email and in-app notification** when the bulk archive finishes. If any Spaces could not be archived, you will receive a failure notification.

### Bulk Unarchiving

You can unarchive multiple Spaces at once:

1. Go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Space List**.
2. Filter for **Archived** Spaces.
3. Select the Spaces you would like to unarchive using the checkboxes.
4. Choose **Bulk Actions > Unarchive**.

You will receive an **email and in-app notification** when the bulk unarchive finishes. If any Spaces could not be unarchived, you will receive a failure notification.

### Activity Indicators

Each Space includes activity indicators to help you and your members stay up to date:

* **Pulsing circle (“hint”):** Appears on Auto Join Spaces when a member is added.
* **Number badge:** Shows new chat messages.
* **Bold or half circle:** Indicates new posts or interactions.
* **Square with a dot (iOS):** Indicates unseen chat messages.
* **White circle on menu (iOS):** Indicates unseen Space activity.

**Tip:** Viewing content in the [Global Feed](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-global-features) won’t clear the activity indicator until you also view it inside the Space.


# How Do I Edit My Mighty Profile?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-edit-my-mighty-profile



When you create a Mighty Network, you’re automatically designated as the **Host** of your new community.

We call admins or creators “Hosts” because building a Mighty Network should feel more like hosting a great party than managing admin work.

## Switching Between Mighty Networks

Each Mighty Network is standalone, which means you’ll need to create a separate profile and login for every Network you join. (You can use the same login information across Networks if you’d like.)

Once you log in for the first time, switching between Networks is quick and seamless:

* **On mobile:** Use the Mighty Networks apps to switch between communities without logging in again.
* **On web:** Go directly to the Network’s URL in your browser, and you’ll be logged in automatically.

## Your Host Profile

As the Host, you also have your own personal profile within your Mighty Network.

To edit your profile, click on the photo in the upper right corner > Personal Settings > Edit Profile.

You can add:

* **Profile photo:** Minimum size 500 × 500 pixels (cropped into a circle). A default image appears until you upload one. Check out how to [customize the style of these photos](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-network-branding#:~:text=Default%20Profile%20Images) so they fit your community vibe.
* **Cover photo:** Appears as a horizontal banner on desktop and a vertical background on mobile. The ideal size is 1920 × 1080 pixels. Choose an image that isn’t too busy and can be cropped cleanly.
* **Short bio:** Fully searchable within your Network.
* **Location and timezone:** Optional, but helpful for connecting with nearby members.
* **About Me:** A short introduction that automatically posts to the Activity Feed on web (not visible in mobile apps).

You can also add up to **10 personal links**—for example, your social media profiles, website, or blog. When you add social media links, the platform name and icon will appear automatically. Links to specific videos (like YouTube) will display the video title.

**Note:**

* Twitter and Instagram links only display the platform name, even if you link to multiple profiles or posts.
* Private Facebook profiles or groups will appear as “Facebook.”

## Other Profile Features

You can customize your Mighty Network with additional profile elements, including:

[**Custom Fields:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-fields) Add fields such as profession, interests, or other personal details.

[**Badges:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members) Assign to members to recognize accomplishments or participation.

[**Member Discovery:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-is-the-people-explorer) The People Explorer connects members that have similar interests, location and more!

## Profile Assist (AI Feature)

If your Mighty Network is on the **Launch Plan** or higher, you can enable **Profile Assist**, an AI feature that helps you and your members write your “About Me” section.

Select **Get Me Started**, answer three quick questions, and a draft will be generated for you. You can edit or delete the text at any time if you’d like to start over.

## Delete or Deactivate Your Account

To deactivate your personal account:

1. Log in to your Mighty Network on web
2. Go to **Profile Photo > Personal Settings > Account**.
3. Scroll to the bottom and select **Deactivate My Account**.

You can reactivate your account anytime by logging in with the same email. Your posts, profile intro, “About Me,” saved drafts, followed members, and chat messages will be restored. However, you’ll lose any custom fields, bookmarked posts, and access to Spaces (unless your plan includes them).

To permanently delete your account, use the link under **“To permanently delete your account, click here.”**

**Important:** This action cannot be undone.

If you’re the **Host** who created the Mighty Network, you can only deactivate your account—not delete it. To fully remove your Network, you’ll need to **cancel your plan** and [**delete your Mighty Network**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/data-security-at-mighty-networks). If you’re the sole Host, you must either assign a new Host or delete the entire Network before deactivation.

## Manage Your Cookie Settings

You can update your cookie preferences anytime by going to **Personal Settings > Account > Cookie Settings**.

If you’re in a GDPR country, you’ll see additional cookie management options.

For more details on cookie categories and usage, see our [Mighty Networks Cookie Policy](https://www.mightynetworks.com/cookie-policy).

For more information about managing your profile and personal settings, check out [**Your Personal Settings in Mighty Networks**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-manage-my-personal-settings).

# How Do I Set the Privacy Settings for a Space?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space



When you [create a new Space](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces), you can control exactly how people find, join, and participate in it. By choosing different combinations of the settings below, you can support a wide range of use cases—from welcome Spaces to exclusive, members-only experiences.

To configure your Space’s privacy, go to **Space** **Admin > Privacy & Access** and decide the following:

## How Do People Join This Space?

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space/AD_4nXc77o_juIGfAOetvFt1RiKV_imVnhynWkOIFEty0Q_L6WSfP4UdQy6tw22v97m2qquIXLDjMlIaQqFgwueFIS-GmFQ12xOH87u0DS3cQ_7u9Utzqh3AevvrxClBDzp_MhBgzLef2A)

Access to your Space can be one of the following:

* **[Accessible Through Plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)** (required for creating limited memberships)

* **Invite-Only**

* **Anyone Can Join**

Every new Space is set to **Invite-Only** by default, since no plans exist yet and the Space isn’t ready for members.

**[Plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)** offer the most flexibility for how people join your Space. Use plans if you want people to do one or more of the following before joining:

* Pay

* Answer questions

* Request approval

Plans also make it easy to bundle access to multiple Spaces in a single flow.

Once you create a plan that includes the Space and make it active (by selecting at least one visibility option or creating **plan share links**), the Space automatically becomes **Accessible Through Plans**.

If you decide not to use plans, choose one of the following:

**Keep your Space set to Invite-Only**Best if you want to tightly control access by only allowing people with an invite (one-time or multi-use) to join. This option doesn’t require members to pay, answer questions, or request approval.It also lets you choose whether Space members can invite others who can then join without restrictions.

*Note: This option does not support limited memberships.*

**Set your Space so that Anyone Can Join**Any logged-in Network member can join without restrictions.This option is ideal for open Spaces such as general discussions or resource hubs.

You can also make a Space **Auto Join**, which automatically adds members to the Space when they join your Network—perfect for welcome or onboarding Spaces.

## Who Can View Content Inside This Space?

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space/Screenshot-2025-11-05-at-11_46_22-AM.png)

Decide who can see the content and features within your Space. You can let people preview activity before joining, or keep everything visible only to members.

**Anyone in the Network**All Network members—whether or not they’ve joined the Space—can view posts, profiles, and activity within it.If your Network is set so that anyone can view content, visitors will also be able to see these Spaces.This option is best when you want to showcase what’s happening inside a Space to encourage participation.

**Only logged-in Space members**Only people who have joined the Space can see its content and members.This option is best for creating exclusive experiences such as courses, premium offers, or private groups.

## Who Can See This Space?

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space/Screenshot-2025-11-05-at-11_46_29-AM.png)

Decide who can search for and see that your Space exists. You can make it visible in its Collection and in search for all Network members, or restrict it to those who have access through an invite or plan.

**Anyone in the Network**The Space appears in its Collection and in global search. All members can see the name, icon, and description—even if they can’t access content without joining.This option is best when you want people to easily discover and join your Space.

**Only logged-in Space members**The Space appears only in navigation, search results, or its Collection for members who’ve already joined.This option is best when you want the Space to remain hidden from others unless they have a link or a plan that includes access.

*Note: If your Network allows “Anyone” to view content and you want those visitors to see specific Spaces, make sure to [promote them](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-promoted-spaces).*

## Who Can Invite Members to Join This Space?

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space/Screenshot-2025-11-05-at-11_46_36-AM.png)

Decide who can invite new members to join your Space.

**Any Space member**All Space members can see the option to invite others.

**Only Space Hosts and moderators**Only Hosts and moderators can send invites.

This setting matters most for Spaces set to **Invite-Only**, since it determines whether members can invite others who can then join without restrictions.

* An invite to a Space set to **Accessible Through Plans** requires the invitee to join via a visible plan.

* An invite to a Space set to **Anyone Can Join** allows Network members to join freely, since the Space is already open.

To set privacy and access for your Network, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network).


# How Do I Set the Privacy Settings for My Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network



<iframe />

You can control how people discover, join, and engage in your Mighty Network. The settings below let you customize your Network for anything from an open community to an exclusive, gated experience.

To configure your Network's privacy settings, go to **Admin > General > Privacy** — the direct path is `/admin/privacy`.

Here you'll decide:

1. **How people join your Network**
2. **Who can view content inside your Network**
3. **Who can find your Network**

## Network-Level Privacy

To configure your Network's privacy, go to **Admin > General > Privacy** and decide the following:

## How Do People Join Your Network?

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 53 45 AM" />

Access to your Network can be set to one of the following:

* [**Accessible Through Plans**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)
* **Invite-Only**
* **Anyone Can Join**

By default, new Mighty Networks start as **Invite-Only**—since no plans exist yet and you're not ready for members.

Most Hosts, however, set up **plans** because they offer the most flexibility in how people join. Use plans if you want members to:

* **Pay**
* **Answer questions**
* **Request approval**

Plans also let you offer access to both your Network and Spaces in a single flow.

Once you create a plan that includes the Network and make it active (by selecting where it appears or creating **plan share links**), your Network automatically becomes **Accessible Through Plans**. From then on, anyone invited must join through a plan.

If you don't want to use plans, choose one of the following:

* **Invite-Only** — Best if you want to tightly control access by sending invites (one-time or multi-use) without requiring payment, approval, or screening questions.
* **Anyone Can Join** — Best for fully open Networks where anyone can join without restrictions. We don't recommend this option for most Networks since anyone on the Internet will be able to join and participate.

## Who Can View Content Inside Your Network?

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 54 02 AM" />

You can decide who can see member profiles, visible Collections, and public Spaces.

Note: Only [**promoted Spaces**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-promoted-spaces) will be visible to visitors.

Choose one of the following:

* **Anyone (including visitors and logged-out members)** — Ideal for Networks that are **Accessible Through Plans**, since it allows public previews while gating participation.
* **Only logged-in members** — Ideal for private Networks that want all content visible only to members.​

## Who Can Find Your Network?

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 54 15 AM" />

This setting determines who can search for and see that your Network exists.

Choose one of the following:

* **Anyone** — Your Network appears in Mighty search and app discovery, and can be indexed by search engines. Best if you want your Network to be discoverable.
* **Only people who are invited** — Your Network is hidden from search, not listed in discovery, and cannot be indexed. Best for private or exclusive communities.

## Who Can Invite People to Join Your Network?

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 54 28 AM" />

You can also control who can send invites:

* **Any Network member**
* **Only Network Hosts and moderators**

If you want your members to participate in the [**Ambassador Program**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-use-the-mighty-networks-ambassador-program), set this to **Any Network member**.

This setting matters most for **Invite-Only** Networks. When enabled, members can invite others who can then join freely.

For Networks **Accessible Through Plans**, invitees must still join via a visible plan. We recommend using **Plan Share Links** instead of direct invites.

For Networks set to **Anyone Can Join**, members can already join freely.

## Search Engine Indexing

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 54 40 AM" />

When your Network is discoverable (set so that anyone can find it), you can choose how search engines index your content.

* If your [**Landing Page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-can-i-customize-my-mighty-networks-landing-page) is enabled, decide whether search engines can index it.
* If anyone can view content inside your Network, decide whether search engines can index that content.

If your Network is set to **Only invited members can find it**, neither your Landing Page nor your content will be indexed.


# How Do I Set Up a Welcome Checklist?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-a-welcome-checklist



<iframe />

The **Welcome Checklist** is a global onboarding feature in your Mighty Network that helps new members explore key actions and content when they first join. It's a simple, customizable way to guide members through their first steps and ensure they understand your community's purpose and features.

The Welcome Checklist appears as a **flyout on the right side** of the screen for all full members with Network access. It's available on both desktop and mobile, and progress syncs automatically across devices.

**Note:** The Welcome Checklist is only available to [**full members**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) with Network access. Limited members do not have access.

## Why Use the Welcome Checklist

The Welcome Checklist helps you:

* Onboard new members quickly and consistently.
* Direct people to important posts, Spaces, or events.
* Encourage engagement with default actions like commenting or reacting.
* Track which members have completed key onboarding steps.

## How to Set Up the Welcome Checklist

1. Go to **Admin > Engagement > Welcome Checklist** — the direct path is `/admin/member-welcome-checklist`.
2. **Customize your Checklist:**
   * Rearrange items using the **three-line menu**.
   * Add content such as **Articles**, **Posts**, **Spaces**, **Events**, **Lessons**, or **Sections**.
3. **Add Mighty Suggestions** (defaults include):
   * Fill Out Your Profile
   * Adjust Your Notifications
   * Download the App
   * React to Something
   * Add a Comment
   * Start a Chat
   * Invite Someone to the Network
   * Follow a Member in the Network
   * RSVP to an Event
   * Introduce Yourself
4. **Add Custom Actions:**
   * You can include actions tied to specific Spaces.
   * The Space's visibility must be set to **Who Can See This Space? → Anyone in the Network** for members to access it.
5. **Write a Welcome Article (optional):**
   * A Welcome Article is a great way to introduce your community's purpose, values, and key features.
   * For inspiration, check out the Welcome Article in **Mighty Community**.
6. **Preview Your Checklist:**
   * Available on web only, this allows you to see what members will experience.
7. **Disable the Checklist:**
   * Turn the feature off anytime from the same setup menu.

## Important Notes

### Flyout Visibility

* Once a member completes the Welcome Checklist, the flyout disappears permanently.
* If you want members who have completed the Checklist to see new items, enable the **Welcome Checklist** in **Global Discovery** settings.

### New Content for Incomplete Checklists

* If a member hasn't finished their Checklist, any new items you add will automatically appear in their flyout.

### Tracking Progress

* When you download your **Member List**, you'll see which members have completed the Welcome Checklist.

## Member Experience

**For Members Who Have Completed the Checklist:**

* The flyout disappears once all items are finished.
* New Checklist content remains visible in the **Global Discovery** section if it's toggled on.

**For Members Still Working on the Checklist:**

* Any new items you add appear automatically, ensuring their Checklist stays current.

## Tips for Creating an Effective Welcome Checklist

* **Keep it short:** Focus on the five to seven most important actions for new members.
* **Mix content types:** Include a variety of items—Spaces, posts, events—to showcase what your Network offers.
* **Include quick wins:** Early tasks like "React to a Post" or "Follow a Member" help members feel immediately connected.
* **Revisit regularly:** Update your Checklist as your Network grows or changes focus.

## Automations

On the Scale plan and up, we have a trigger for "Completed Welcome Checklist". This means, you can set up an Automation that completes an action (e.g., assigning a badge, sending a welcome message) whenever a new member completes the checklist.

To learn more, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network).

# How Do I Set Up My Space Branding?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-space-branding



<iframe />

You can add your own colors, logo, image, or video to any Space in your Mighty Network to make it feel uniquely yours.

## Where to Find Space Branding

Go to the Space you want to customize and click the **gear icon > Space Branding**.

From here, you can update your Space’s color, imagery, and header design.

## Colors

Choose a custom **Space Color** that appears in the Space header, polls, discovery cards, tags, and more.

Your **Network Color** will still appear in some places—like links and icons—to maintain consistency across your Mighty Network.

## Imagery

### Space Logo

Upload a logo with **square dimensions**, at least **500 x 500px**. You can even upload a **GIF** for an animated look.

You can upload **two versions** of your logo—one for **light mode** and one for **dark mode**.

Select **Suggestions** to instantly generate matching logos based on your Space or Network colors.

### Primary Image or Video

Add a main image or video to represent your Space visually. We recommend a **16:9 ratio** and at least **1920 x 1080px** for best display quality.

Your primary image or video:

* Appears prominently in your [**Collection view**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-collections)
* Displays on your [**About page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-find-the-about-page-for-my-space-or-mighty-network)
* Can be featured on your [**Space Plan landing page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan)

### Space Banner

On [**Launch Plans**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and higher, you can add a **Space Banner** that appears at the top of your Space.

On **web** and **Android** (app version 8.276.81 and up), upload a separate banner image just for mobile to give your Space a look tailored to every screen. iOS support is coming soon.

### Space Branding Image

Adding a **Space Branding Image** appears below the Space Banner and gives you even more flexibility with your branding.


# How Do I Set Up the Basics for My Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-the-basics-for-my-network



Getting started with your community setup can feel like an easy place to get stuck—but have no fear!

We’ve got you covered.

To begin, click your **profile picture** in the top-right corner, then go to **Admin > General > Basics**.

## Add Your Name, Tagline, and Description

Start by choosing a **name**, **tagline**, and **description** for your community.

Next to each field, you’ll see a **“Suggestions”** button. This is part of our [**AI-powered features**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have) that can help you with naming, branding, and more.

All you need to do is fill out your [**Big Purpose**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/whats-a-big-purpose), and we’ll generate helpful suggestions for the rest of your community setup.

## Additional Setup Options

On the **Basics** page, you can also add:

## Companion Website

If you have an external website you’d like to link, you can add it here. It will appear on your Network’s **About** page.

## Location

You can include a **physical location** for your Network, if applicable.


# What are Global Features?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-global-features



Global Features appear at the top of your left-hand navigation.

These features—**Feed**, **Discovery**, **Members**, and **Events**—aggregate activity and content across all Spaces in your Mighty Network. You can reorder, rename, or toggle them on or off anytime.

Only **full members** can see Global Features. Limited members do not have access.

To learn more, check out [What Is Full vs. Limited Membership?](/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership)

## How Members See Global Features

When new members join your Mighty Network, they’ll land on the first Global Feature you’ve enabled. If no Global Features are turned on, they’ll land in the first Space in your left-hand menu.

You can also choose a specific Space where new members land first.

To learn more, check out [Can I Customize the Landing Space for My Members?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/can-i-customize-the-landing-space-for-my-members)

## Overview of Each Global Feature

## Feed

The **Global Feed** brings together content from all Spaces that a member can access—plus any Spaces where content is visible to all members.

Members can react, like, and comment on posts directly from the Global Feed. Introduction posts for new profiles will also appear here (you can toggle these off in settings).

To manage Feed settings: Go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Global Features > Feed > Manage** and adjust preferences such as:

* **Hide Posts from Spaces with Content Any Network Member Can View** – removes content from those Spaces in the Global Feed, but not from search, the Welcome Checklist, or the Featured Section.
* **Toggle Introduction Posts** – control whether new member introductions appear in the Feed.

### Searching and Filtering in the Feed

In the Feed, you can search and filter by:

* **Content type:** Articles, Events, Comments, Custom Fields, Hashtags, and Spaces
* **Filters:** Everything, Personal Feed, Your Activity, From Your Hosts, Near You, Unanswered, Quick Posts, Questions and Polls, Articles and Events
* **Sort by:** Top (most relevant), Newest, or Oldest

You can also apply multiple filters at once.

### Creating Content from the Global Feed

You can create new content directly from the Global Feed without switching Spaces.

* On web: Click **+ Create** above the Global Features in the left-hand navigation.
* On mobile: Tap the **+** icon.

Then:

1. **Choose Your Space** – select from Spaces where you can post.
2. **Pick Your Content Type** – options depend on the Space and your permissions.
3. **Get Posting** – you’ll be taken to the selected Space to share your post.

### Who Can Create Content

* **Hosts:** Full access to create, based on enabled content types.
* **Moderators:** Can post if permissions allow.
* **Members:** Can post if permissions allow.

## Discovery

Use **Discovery** to feature posts, Events, or Spaces that you want everyone to see when they open the Discovery page on web or in the Mighty Networks app.

If a Space added to Discovery isn’t visible to Network members, its content won’t appear until someone joins that Space. To make it visible, adjust your [**Space’s privacy**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space) settings.

## Members

The **Members** feature (available on [Launch Plans](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and above) lets people explore your community through [**People Explorer**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-is-the-people-explorer), which helps members find others they might connect with.

Profiles appear in clusters such as:

* Explore
* All
* Top
* Near You (within 300 km)
* Newest
* Hosts
* Ambassadors
* Online Now

You can control the order of tabs:

* Go to **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Global Features > Members > Manage**.
* Toggle **Explore First** to place that tab first, or turn it off to have “All” appear first.

If the Global Members feature is off, the “Online Now” icon won’t appear. To view who’s online in a Space, open the Space’s member list and filter for **Online Now**.

## Events

The [**Events**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network) feature shows all Events from Spaces a member belongs to. Each member only sees Events from Spaces they have access to.

To learn more, check out [How Do I Create Events in My Mighty Network?](/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network)

## Leaderboard

The Leaderboard feature highlights the people who receive the most recognition for each [Community Value](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-does-gamification-work-in-my-mighty-network#how-does-gamification-work-in-my-mighty-network).

They make your community’s culture visible.

<img alt="Screenshot2026 02 11at8 45 44AM 1" />

To learn more, check out ["How Does Gamification Work in My Mighty Network?"](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-does-gamification-work-in-my-mighty-network#how-does-gamification-work-in-my-mighty-network)

## Managing Global Features

You can reorder, rename, and toggle each Global Feature on or off from **Admin > Spaces & Navigation > Global Features**.

This gives you full control over which features appear in your Network’s navigation and how your members experience your community.


# What Are Promoted Spaces?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-promoted-spaces



**Promoted Spaces** help Hosts and moderators highlight important or interesting Spaces they want members to discover.

Promoted Spaces appear in your Network’s left navigation panel with a **star icon** that matches the Space color (which you can customize in **[Space Branding](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-space-branding)**).

## How to Promote a Space

[Space Hosts and moderators](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-space-hosts-and-space-moderators-have) can promote any Space that’s visible to **[Anyone in the Network](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network)**.

**To promote a Space:**

1. Open the **three-dot menu** next to the Space name in the left navigation, **or**

2. From the **list of Spaces** within a Collection, select **Promote in Navigation Panel.**

Once promoted, the Space will appear with a star icon in your Network navigation for members who haven’t joined it yet.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-promoted-spaces/Screenshot-2025-11-06-at-1_43_37-PM.png)

## How Members See Promoted Spaces

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-promoted-spaces/Screenshot-2025-11-06-at-1_45_43-PM.png)

When a Space is promoted:

* Members who **aren’t yet part of the Space** will see a **star icon** next to it in the left navigation.

* After they **join the Space**, the star icon disappears for that member.

This makes Promoted Spaces a simple way to surface new or featured Spaces without cluttering the navigation.

## How Hosts and Moderators See Promoted Spaces

Hosts and moderators will only see the **star icon** for Spaces they are *not* members of.

To see all currently promoted Spaces in your Mighty Network, go to:​**Admin > Navigation and Spaces > Space List.**


# What Do Member Profiles Include in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-do-member-profiles-include-in-my-mighty-network



<iframe />

When you create a Mighty Network, you’re automatically designated as the **Host** of your new community.

## Switching Between Mighty Networks

Each Mighty Network is standalone, which means your members need to create a separate profile and login for every Network they join.

Once you log in for the first time, switching between Networks is quick and seamless:

* **On mobile:** Use the Mighty Networks apps to switch between communities without logging in again.

* **On web:** Go directly to the Network’s URL in your browser, and you’ll be logged in automatically.

## Member Profiles

Members have their own personal profile within your Mighty Network.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-do-member-profiles-include-in-my-mighty-network/Screenshot-2025-11-04-at-11_04_12-E2-80-AFAM.png)

To edit their profile, click on the photo in the upper right corner > Personal Settings > Edit Profile.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-do-member-profiles-include-in-my-mighty-network/edit-profile.gif)

They can add:

* **Profile photo:** Minimum size 500 × 500 pixels (cropped into a circle). A default image appears until you upload one. Check out how to [customize the style of these photos](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-network-branding#:~:text=Default%20Profile%20Images) so they fit your community vibe.

* **Cover photo:** Appears as a horizontal banner on desktop and a vertical background on mobile. The ideal size is 1920 × 1080 pixels. Choose an image that isn’t too busy and can be cropped cleanly.

* **Short bio:** Fully searchable within your Network.

* **Location and timezone:** Optional, but helpful for connecting with nearby members.

* **About Me:** A short introduction that automatically posts to the Activity Feed on web (not visible in mobile apps).

They can also add up to **10 personal links**—for example, your social media profiles, website, or blog. When they add social media links, the platform name and icon will appear automatically. Links to specific videos (like YouTube) will display the video title.

**Note:**

* Twitter/X and Instagram links only display the platform name, even if you link to multiple profiles or posts.

* Private Facebook profiles or groups will appear as “Facebook.”

## Profile Assist (AI Feature)

If your Mighty Network is on the **Launch Plan** or higher, you can enable **Profile Assist**, an AI feature that helps you and your members write your “About Me” section.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-do-member-profiles-include-in-my-mighty-network/Screenshot-2025-11-04-at-11_09_08-E2-80-AFAM.png)

Select **Get Me Started**, answer three quick questions, and a draft will be generated for you. You can edit or delete the text at any time if you’d like to start over.


# What is the Feed and How Does It Work?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work



You’ll find the **Feed** feature in two main places across your Mighty Network:

**Global Feed:** Found in the upper-left navigation under **Feed** — shows posts from all Spaces a member can access.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 29 At 1 20 24 PM" title="Screenshot 2026 05 29 At 1 20 24 PM" />
</Frame>

**Space Feed:** Found inside an individual Space — shows posts created within that Space only.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Community" title="Community" />
</Frame>

Both types of Feed help members stay connected and make it easy to see what’s happening across your Mighty Network.

## The Global Feed

The **Global Feed** is a centralized stream of activity where everyone can explore and interact with content from the Spaces they belong to.

Members can like, react, or comment on posts directly in the Global Feed.

### Create Posts Directly from the Global Feed

You can also create content from the Global Feed without navigating into a Space first.

* On web, click the **Create** button at the top of the Feed.
* On mobile, tap the **+** icon.

Then:

1. Choose a **Space** where you want to post.
2. Select a **post type** (such as Post, Article, or Event) based on what’s available in that Space.
3. You’ll be taken directly to that Space to publish your content.

It’s a quick shortcut for posting anywhere in your Network.

## Space Feed

Each individual Space can also have its own **Feed**.

The Space Feed works just like the Global Feed—but everything you post here lives within that specific Space.

From a Space Feed, you can post:

* [**Posts**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-a-post-in-my-mighty-network)
* [**Articles**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network)
* [**Events**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network)
* [**Polls and Questions**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-polls-questions-in-my-mighty-network)

## Searching and Filtering in the Feed

In both Global and Space Feeds, you can search and filter to find the content you need.

Click the **Showing** button to search across:

* Articles
* Events
* Comments
* Custom Fields
* Hashtags
* Spaces

### Filter Options

You can refine what you see using filters such as:

* Everything
* Personal Feed
* Your Activity
* From Your Hosts
* Near You
* Unanswered
* Posts
* Questions and Polls
* Articles
* Events

You can apply multiple filters at once to customize your view.

### Sort Options

Click **Showing By** to sort results by:

* **Top** (most relevant)
* **Newest** (most recently published)
* **Latest Activity** (most recently engaged)
* **Oldest** (earliest published)

## Hashtags

**Hashtags** help organize posts and activity across your Mighty Network.Each post can include multiple hashtags to make related content easier to find.

To learn more, check out [How Do I Use Hashtags in My Mighty Network?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-use-hashtags-in-my-mighty-network)


# What is the People Magic GPT?

Did you know you can get strategy insight, content, and ideas with just a few questions?

## Chat with Cohost

## FAQs

**What is a custom GPT, and how does it work with People Magic Profit?**

This is a custom GPT created using OpenAI's ChatGPT chatbot. It uses our own documentation about People Magic Profit, community design, and Mighty Networks. It doesn't learn from or take any information from your Mighty Network. The information in your Mighty Network is never shared outside of it or used to train other AI models.

**Do I need to pay to use ChatGPT?**

No, you don't need to pay to use ChatGPT. However, if you're not on one of ChatGPT's paid plans, you may hit a usage cap and might have to wait a few hours before asking more questions. You don't have to be on a specific Mighty plan to use the GPT.

**How does ChatGPT's memory feature work with custom GPTs?**

Custom GPTs do not have access to the memory feature. Each session with a custom GPT starts fresh. The memory feature is available only for individual accounts and isn't linked to custom GPTs. For more details, refer to the [documentation on how memory works with GPTs](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8983148).

**Are my interactions with the People Magic GPT used for AI training?**

OpenAI's free users' data may be used for training unless they opt out, while paid users (Plus, Team, Enterprise) can disable this option in their settings. You can manage this by following the instructions provided [in the settings](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/5722486-how-your-data-is-used-to-improve-model-performance).


# What Kinds of Space Templates are Available?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-kinds-of-space-templates-are-available



You can [create a Space](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces) that is a course, group, resource library, just a chat Space, an event, or customize your own!

We provide you with Templates to get started, and from there, you can edit the features inside of each Space.

To access the Templates, first [create a new Space](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces).

Creating a new Space will take you to a page where you can Choose a Space Template

A Chat Template will include the following features:

* Chat
* Members

A Feed Template will include the following features:

* Feed
* Members

A Cohort Course Template will include the following features:

* Course Community (Feed)
* Course Materials (Course)
* Members

A Content-Only Course Template will include the following features:

* Course Materials (Course)
* Members

A Live Challenge Template will include the following features:

* Challenge (Course)
* Events
* Feed

An On-Demand Challenge Template will include the following features:

* Challenge (Course)

An Event Template will include the following features:

* Calendar of Events (Events)
* Attendees (Member Feature)

* Page Feature

* Course

From there, you will be able to toggle on and off Space Features by going into the Space and clicking the gear icon > Features.

## Ideal Member

Your Ideal Member is a person in **transition**.

They’re in the middle of a meaningful change — starting something new, leaving something behind, or figuring out what’s next. 

When you design for someone in transition, your community becomes more focused and relevant. The right people recognize themselves quickly and understand why this space matters to them.

This keeps your focus on outcomes, not activity. Instead of asking what to post or host next, you’re grounded in what actually helps members move forward.

## Your Offer

Your Offer explains how your community delivers value.

It connects your Big Purpose to the experiences members actually have inside your Mighty Network. When your Offer is clear, members understand what they’re committing to and why it’s worth their time.

What your members actually pay for and get. This is where you design the activities, structure, and results that make your community valuable.

## Monthly Themes

## Weekly Calendar

# What's The Discovery Feature?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/whats-the-discovery-feature



On the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and higher, you can customize what your members see in **Global Discovery** and in the **Discovery** feature inside each Space.

## Global Discovery Feature

Global Discovery aggregates content from all the Spaces a member has access to. You can rename it, reorder its sections, or turn it off.

You can display up to **8 sections** at a time

## Sections available in Global Discovery

* Featured
* Upcoming Events
* Top Posts
* Members Near You (up to 50 km)
* Top Members
* Top Spaces
* Events Near You
* Welcome Checklist
* Spaces Near You
* Top Spaces (A Collection)
* Spaces Near You (A Collection)
* **Custom Sections**

**Top Spaces (A Collection)** creates a carousel of Spaces within a Collection.​ **Spaces Near You (A Collection)** shows nearby Spaces within a Collection.

You can rearrange these sections at any time.

## Discovery in Spaces

To manage Discovery inside a Space:

1. Open the Space.
2. Go to [**Space Features**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space) (gear icon).
3. Select **Discovery**.
4. Toggle Discovery on or off and choose which sections to display.

Sections available in Space Discovery

* Featured
* Top Posts
* Upcoming Events
* Top Members
* Members Near You (up to 50 km)
* Events Near You
* Members with the same Custom Field answers
* Welcome

## Managing Discovery Sections

You can drag and drop the sections to change the order and show or hide sections by using the checkbox.


# How Do I View As A Member?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/How-Do-I-View-as-a-Member



**Member view (available on the [Launch plan and up](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan#whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-launch-plan))** lets you preview your Mighty Network from different member perspectives so you can confirm what people see and access.

Member view consists of three preview experiences:

* **View as a specific member**
* **View as a plan member**
* **View a plan join flow**

These tools help you understand how access, plans, and onboarding appear to members across your Network.

Member view is available on **web** and is designed for **Network Hosts**.

### **Why Use Member View?**

Member view helps you verify that your Network experience works exactly as intended.

You can use it to:

* Confirm what members can access based on their plan
* Troubleshoot questions about gated content
* Check visibility across Spaces and Collections
* Preview promotional banners or targeted content
* Validate plan setup before sharing a plan
* Resolve member support questions faster

View as specific member and view as plan member are **read-only**, which protects member privacy while letting you explore the Network from their perspective.

## View as a Specific Member

To preview your Network as a member:

1. Go to Admin > **Members** 
2. Select the member you want to view as.
3. Click the \*\*three dot menu > \*\*“View as \[Member Name, e.g., Bob]”.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot2026 02 17at3 49 21PM" />
</Frame>

You can also find this three dot menu on:

* The [<u>member detail page</u>](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-is-the-member-detail-page#what-is-the-member-detail-page)
* Member profiles 

When you view as the member, you will see a bar at the top of your screen. 

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot2026 02 17at3 17 03PM" />
</Frame>

Selecting the dropdown will allow you to switch between available members:

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot2026 02 17at3 18 08PM" title="Screenshot2026 02 17at3 18 08PM" />
</Frame>

When you’re finished, click “Exit” in the upper right corner to return to your account.

**Important note: If you are logged into a different account on the same browser (but a different tab), it will disrupt the member view experience. We recommend opening up a new browser window before viewing as a member.**

## **What You Can and Can’t Do in the Specific Member View**

### **You can:**

* Navigate your Network as that member
* View Spaces, Collections, and content available to them
* Confirm plan-based access and visibility
* Confirm notification settings

### **You can’t:**

* Send messages or access direct messages
* Post, comment, react, or edit content
* Make purchases or join spaces
* Change account settings
* View sensitive information such as payment details
* View as Network moderators
* View as members who haven’t accepted our terms of use (see screenshot)

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot2026 02 17at3 50 47PM" title="Screenshot2026 02 17at3 50 47PM" />
</Frame>

## **View as a Plan Member**

This option lets you preview your Network as a **member who has joined a specific plan**.

Mighty generates a simulated **plan member**, which shows exactly what someone on that plan would experience after joining.

This is useful when you want to confirm:

* which Spaces the plan unlocks
* how gated content appears
* what members can access after purchase

Like the specific member view, this experience is **read-only**.

### **Simulated plan members:**

* Do **not appear** in your Network
* Do **not trigger automations**
* Do **not appear in analytics or queries**
* Are automatically removed after use

### **How to View as a Plan Member**

1. Go to **Admin > Plans and Access > Plans**.
2. Find the plan you want to preview.
3. Select the **three-dot menu**.
4. Select **View as Plan Member**.

You can also access this option from the **plan detail page**.
