# Does Mighty Networks have Language Localization?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/does-mighty-networks-have-language-localization



Mighty's software is now available in…

* French
* Spanish
* Brazilian Portuguese
* German
* Italian
* Dutch

That means that people who have those language preferences will be able to see the buttons and notifications and all the other system-generated text in your Mighty Network in that language. So if your audience is primarily Spanish-speaking and that's who you want to attract, you can set that tone from the start.

## How to Set the Default Language for Your Network

\
As the Host, you'll be able to set a default language that will act as a fallback for first-time visitors and members on web, who:

* Don't have a preferred Language set on web and
* Whose browser language is not supported (English, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German, Italian, Dutch).

So if your audience is primarily Spanish-speaking and that's who you want to attract, you can set that tone from the start.

Go to **Admin > General > Language** and select the default language:

<img alt="Languages setting in Admin with English selected from the list of supported languages" />

## How Members Set Their Preferred Language

Members can **control what language they see** by setting their preferred Language on web, and their App Language on mobile.

**Web**

This setting (optional) determines the language your members see your Mighty Network in, on web, along with the language used for their notifications and notification emails. It does not control the language they see in the app.

It is an optional setting for members but, if set, we will respect it over the default Language you set as a Host.

Members can change their Language anytime on web > **Personal** **Settings** **> Language**

By default, the app uses the device's language (when supported). Members can change this at any time by updating their **App Language** in their mobile settings.

Email, push notifications, and in-app notifications use the **Member Preferred Language**, which can only be set on the web. This setting is separate from the App Language.

**You can share **[**this help center article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/HowDoISetMyPreferredLanguage#how-do-i-set-my-preferred-language)** with your members.**

## What Language People See

**On Web**

Whenever someone views your Network on web, we choose what language to display in this order:

* The language they have set as their preferred Language in their Personal Settings on web
* The language they have set as their browser language on web (if English or a supported non-english language)
* The default Language for the Network
* English

**On Mobile**

On mobile, whenever someone opens the app, we choose what language to display in this order:

* The App Language
* The device language (if English or a supported non-English language)
* English

## Localization FAQs

### What about \[insert your favorite language here]?

We'll be evaluating demand and interest for other languages and will make sure you have the chance to let your voice be heard!\
Right-to-left languages, like Arabic and Hebrew, have additional complexities so we can't promise they will come quickly. But still—let us know what other languages you're looking for, we'll see what we can do

### ​What will and won't be translated?

The member-facing product experience will be translated, including core navigation, onboarding flows, key features, emails and notifications.

Content you or your Hosts *write*, like this article I'm writing, or a course lesson, won't be automatically translated. But you can write them in whatever language you'd like! Same goes for videos or voice notes—they'll remain in the language you produce them in. User-generated content translation is an interesting challenge we're excited to explore in the future.

### Do all tiers of Mighty get this?

Oui! Yes, all Mighty Hosts will have this amazing ability.


# Does Mighty Networks Integrate with Google Analytics?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/does-mighty-networks-integrate-with-google-analytics



The option to integrate [**Google Analytics**](https://www.google.com/analytics/) web tracking with your **Mighty Network** is available for Hosts on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and above.

Google Analytics captures **aggregate data** about visitors to your Mighty Network and serves as a powerful supplement to [**Mighty Insights™**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/what-is-mighty-insights). It can help you better understand where your traffic is coming from and how visitors interact with your pages.

## What You Can Track with Google Analytics

With Google Analytics connected, you can track:

* The number of new people who click on your **Landing Page** link
* The number of visitors coming from a specific source (for example, visits from Instagram)
* Aggregate data based on web visits—such as visitor location, time spent on your Network, or time spent on a specific page

**Tip:** To track visits from a particular source, set up a dedicated [**Google Analytics campaign**](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/1033863?hl=en#zippy=) with custom UTM parameters.

## How to Integrate Google Analytics with Your Mighty Network

Before you begin, make sure you’ve created a **Google Analytics 4 (GA4)** property.

* Create your new **GA4 Property** in Google Analytics and choose **Web** as the platform.
* Navigate to **GA4 Property > Admin > Setup Assistant > Data Collection > Manage Data Streams**.
* Copy your **Measurement ID** (for example, G-XXXXXXXXXX).
* In your Mighty Network, go to **Admin > Integrations > Google Analytics**.
* Paste the Measurement ID into the field labeled **Web Measurement ID**.

Once your Measurement ID is added, data should begin populating within **24 hours**.

**Note:** Only **Google Analytics 4** properties are supported.

<iframe />

Note: Google [ended support for Legacy Universal Analytics properties on 7/1/23](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/11583528?hl=en).


# How Do I Enable SSO for My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/how-do-i-enable-sso-for-my-mighty-network



Single Sign-On (SSO) is an advanced integration available on the [**Growth Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan) and [**Mighty Pro**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/what-is-mighty-pro).

This feature lets you create a unified login experience between your **Mighty Network** and your external website or service. With SSO in place, your external system manages member authentication and account settings—giving you full control over how your members log in.

Because SSO replaces Mighty’s built-in login and account management system, you’ll need an **established external service** and an **experienced technical team** to ensure everything runs smoothly.

## How SSO Works

Once enabled, SSO replaces Mighty’s native login system with your external authentication provider.

You’ll still be able to use all available **privacy and access settings** for your Mighty Network, and you can offer both **full** and **limited memberships** to your members.

### ​Ready to proceed?

Please share our [SSO implementation guide](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/sso-implementation-guide) with your technical team.

## A Few Frequently Asked Questions

**Is there a way for my technical team to test the integration before enabling it on my main Mighty Network?**

Yes! In fact, we recommend it. Full details are available in our [SSO implementation guide](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/sso-implementation-guide).​​**​**

**What protocols do you support to set up the SSO?**

We only support [OAuth 2.0](https://oauth.net/2). OAuth 2.0 is the industry-standard protocol for authorization used by Facebook Connect and other authentication services. ​​**​**

**What happens if I enable SSO, and then decide later to disable it?**

​\_​\_Disabling SSO will require all existing members to use Mighty's login flows and account management system going forward. As long as members log in using the same email address they were using with your external system when the SSO integration was in place, they will be able to set a new password with Mighty and seamlessly continue accessing their account and activity in Mighty.​​**​**

**What happens to SSO if I downgrade my Growth Plan or Mighty Pro?**

​\_​\_Mighty Networks that downgrade will behave the same as Networks that disable SSO (as outlined above).

​**​What happens if I get locked out of my Network?**

After you finish setting up the SSO integration, you will receive a Host backdoor URL. You will be able to access your Network with that link if your SSO setup is broken or not working properly.

**What if my members report frequently needing to sign in?**

The likely cause is a missing refresh\_token, or a refresh\_token that expires too soon. Some SSO providers may also require an ‘offline\_access’ scope (or similar) to allow us to keep your members logged in.

As a best practice, we recommend extending your account session times (also known as the refresh token) to 30 days. This will ensure that when a member participates, they aren’t continually prompted for their account name and password.


# How Do I Embed a Shopify Buy Button in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/shopifybuybutton



You can use Shopify's Buy Button sales channel together with [Lovable](https://lovable.dev/) to create an embeddable shopping experience that works seamlessly inside your Mighty Network.

This approach lets members browse and purchase products without leaving your Network.

This is especially useful for:

* Selling merchandise to members
* Offering discounted products only available inside your community
* Creating members-only storefronts for premium plans
* Embedding a single product or an entire Shopify collection

**Note:** This workflow uses Shopify, Lovable, and Mighty Networks to sell physical products. Lovable is a third-party service and may require a paid plan to complete the project.

## **Before you begin**

You'll need:

* A [<u>Shopify store</u>](https://www.shopify.com/ppc/online-store?term=shopify%20store\&adid=708037487907\&campaignid=21535067445\&branded_enterprise=1\&BOID=brand\&utm_medium=cpc\&utm_source=google\&matchtype=e\&network=g\&gad_source=1\&gad_campaignid=21535067445\&gbraid=0AAAAADp4t0pDovXKQo6Qsq93exPvGdhvl\&gclid=CjwKCAjwmozTBhAeEiwAkEGZzs_PHRXDBQ5QKyG_HJZAxUYO8YuUdVwn92MZnzKKYZyfe9oksLLC_RoCTFQQAvD_BwE)
* The **Buy Button** sales channel enabled in Shopify
* A product (or collection) you'd like to sell
* A [<u>Lovable</u>](https://lovable.dev/) account

## **Step 1: Enable Shopify Buy Button**

In Shopify:

1. Go to **Sales Channels**.
2. [<u>Add the **Buy Button**</u>](https://apps.shopify.com/buy-button) sales channel if it isn't already installed.
3. Open the Buy Button sales channel.
4. Create a Buy Button for your product (or collection).

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 27 At 9 30 51 AM" />
</Frame>

While configuring your Buy Button, you can customize:

* Product layout
* Button color
* Product display
* Checkout style

When you're finished:

1. Click **Generate Code**.
2. Copy the JavaScript embed code.

## **Step 2: Create your embedded experience in Lovable**

Head to our [**Shopify Lovable Template**](https://lovable.dev/projects/8b40c7dd-a889-4177-99b5-59eac4b8fbaa)

Select remix to make your own template

Connect it to your Shopify store by pasting the JavaScript code into the chat

When Lovable asks additional questions:

* Make the project **Public**
* Publish the project once generation is complete
* Choose a custom URL if desired

The finished project will provide a public page that can be embedded inside Mighty Networks.

## **Step 3: Embed the experience in Mighty Networks**

In your Mighty Network:

1. Open the page where you'd like to display your products.
2. Edit the page.
3. Add an **Embed** section.
4. Paste the iframe code from your Lovable project.
5. Save your changes.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 27 At 9 31 45 AM 1" />
</Frame>

Members can now browse and purchase products directly inside your community.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Image (1) 1" />
</Frame>

## **Using multiple products**

If you're embedding multiple individual Buy Buttons on the same page, each embedded Buy Button runs independently. This means each button maintains its own shopping cart, which can create separate cart experiences.

For a smoother shopping experience, consider embedding a [**Shopify Collection**](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/collections) instead of multiple individual Buy Buttons. A collection provides a unified storefront and shared shopping cart for all included products.

## **Troubleshooting**

### **I don't see the Buy Button sales channel**

Make sure the Buy Button sales channel has been added to your Shopify store from **Sales Channels**.

### **My embed doesn't display correctly**

Verify that:

* Your Lovable project is published publicly.
* You've embedded the project using an iframe snippet:

\<iframe src=“YOURURL” width=“100%” height=“500” title=“My Application” style=“border:none;”>\</iframe>

### **Why are there multiple shopping carts?**

Each embedded Buy Button initializes its own Shopify checkout. If you want shoppers to add multiple products to the same cart, embed a [Shopify Collection](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/collections) instead of several individual product Buy Buttons.

<br />


# Vibe Coding on Mighty
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/vibe-coding-on-mighty



Mighty is helping to usher in a new world in which our best-in-class, secure and extensible platform and native features can seamlessly co-exist with your own custom software, with all member interactions and content blending together seamlessly to help amplify our powerful people magic experience.

## **Getting Started**

Whether you’re a seasoned developer or interested in trying out “vibe coding” (creating your own applications using emerging AI tools), we’re here to help!

Let’s start by defining some basic terms…

**Admin API (Application Programming Interface):** On Mighty, our [<u>Admin API</u>](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/admin-api) lets you (as a Host) connect 3rd-party services to your Mighty Network, then push and pull information. *Example: syncing your community’s member data with Salesforce or another CRM.*

**Headless API:** Our [<u>Headless API</u>](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/headless-api) (currently invite-only) lets you create custom applications that *your members* can connect and interact with as themselves. *Example: embedding a custom “personality quiz” for members to take, then share their results.*

**Embeds (iframes):** The way 3rd-party applications and websites can be [<u>embedded directly</u>](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-external-embeds#how-to-embed) into your Mighty Network. When coupled with either API and our “authenticated iframes” feature, custom applications can now seamlessly integrate with your community.

Note: For the most seamless iframe experience across all platforms, you'll need to ensure that you're on the following builds or later:

* iOS: 8.274.80
* Android: 8.274.43

At the very highest level, interested Mighty Hosts on the [Scale plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-business-plan#whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-scale-plan) and up can now easily create custom experiences that work seamlessly across all platforms (web, iOS and Android) using Embeds and either of our available APIs.

## **Lovable Library**

There are many services that can help you on your vibe coding journey (including [<u>Replit</u>](http://replit.com/), [<u>Netlify</u>](https://www.netlify.com/) and more), but we’re big fans of [<u>Lovable</u>](https://lovable.dev/), and have created a library of sample starter applications for you to easily “remix” and adjust for your own community.

They’re all pre-configured to work with any Mighty Network, and you’ll simply need to add your community’s API keys and basic information when asked.

Just create a [<u>Lovable</u>](https://lovable.dev/) account, then choose from one of our starter options to remix (make your own editable copy).

### **Important Notes and Tips**

* When creating a new OAuth Application, you can decide how much access (and for which roles) to offer, and we always suggest keeping it scoped as narrowly as possible (only ask for what your app will need). Additionally, keep the “Confidential client” option checked and the “Skip consent screen” unchecked (these are the defaults anyway) unless needed for your specific case.
* When customizing your application, always be sure to prompt Lovable to properly store secrets (like API keys/secrets) or sensitive information (it should never appear in the code, and Lovable will help you with this).
* Before publishing and launching, ask Lovable to do a security review on your project.
* We’ll continue adding and updating our sample projects, so please check back often!<br />

# What is Mighty Insights™?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/what-is-mighty-insights



Mighty Insights™ gives you powerful tools to analyze and understand your Network's activity across multiple dashboards. With interactive charts and detailed metrics, you can uncover how your members engage with your content, Spaces, and each other—helping you make smarter decisions to grow your community.

<iframe title="YouTube video player" />

## Key Details About Mighty Insights™

* **Desktop Access Only:** Mighty Insights™ is available exclusively on desktop web.
* **Data Timing:** Metrics are updated on a 24-hour delay and reflect data as of the previous day (GMT/UTC time).
* **Paid Plans Only:** Mighty Insights™ is available on all paid plans. If you're on a Free Trial of the Growth Plan, you won't have access to this feature.

## Important Notes About Mighty Insights™ Metrics

* **Hosts Are Excluded from Most Metrics:** Mighty Insights™ primarily focuses on data from Moderators and Members, excluding Network Hosts from many metrics. For instance:
  * The "Total Members" count in Mighty Insights™ does not include Hosts.
  * Certain charts, like the "Course Interactions" chart, also exclude interactions by Hosts.
  * However, some fields, such as the Host and Member Engagement Table and Total Contributions, track data from both Hosts and Members.​
* **For Full Member Counts, Use the Member List:** The [Member List](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members) (including its [downloadable version](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/can-i-download-my-member-data)) provides a complete count of both Hosts and Members. Click "Select All" to see your full member count.​
* **Data Updates Every 24 Hours:** Mighty Insights™ updates every 24 hours, so metrics may lag compared to real-time data available in the Member List or elsewhere in your Network.​
* **Using the Glossary for Clarity:** To confirm whether specific metrics include Hosts, refer to the "Glossary" tab within Mighty Insights™ for detailed definitions.​
* Why Your Data Might Seem Higher or Lower Than Expected: Metrics in Mighty Insights™ may appear differently than anticipated due to:
  * The exclusion of Hosts from many metrics.
  * The 24-hour delay in data updates within Mighty Insights™.

## Getting Started

Access Mighty Insights by clicking Network Admin (gear icon) near your profile picture in the top-right corner > **Mighty Insights** — the direct path is `/admin/mighty-insights`.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 06 02 At 10 16 20 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 06 02 At 10 16 20 AM" />
</Frame>

Mighty Insights are viewable by Network Hosts and moderators on our plans.

They cannot be viewed by Space Hosts.

**What's available depends on your role:**

* **Launch Plan and up:**
  * **Network Hosts:** Access to all Mighty Insights.
  * **Network moderators:** Access to all Mighty Insights except the **Plans** tab and the **Income Details** tab.

## Dashboards at a Glance

In Mighty Insights, you have two dashboard groupings:

* **All Network:** dashboards for your entire Mighty Network.
* **Space Features:** dashboards focused on specific Space features.

## Overview

Your **Overview** dashboard shows the level of member activity in your Mighty Network at a glance. It includes:

* **Total Contributions**
  * Total Contributions are the sum of actions members, moderators, and Hosts take within your Network. Contributions include Reactions, Comments, Posts, Shares, Chat Messages, Direct Messages, RSVPs, and more.
* **Contributing Members**
  * Contributing members are members that have made a contribution which includes Reactions, Comments, Posts, Shares, Chat Messages, Direct Messages, RSVPs, and more.
* **Active Members**
  * Active members are the total number of members that visit during the selected time period.
* **Total Members**
  * Total members in your Mighty Network

**Data refresh:** daily at **2am UTC**.

You can filter the data for a selected date range and also filter for [**Tags**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members) [or](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members) [**Badges**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members) to see overall contribution data by segment.

# Understanding Your Data

## Host & Member Engagement Table

Shows a ranking of your most active Hosts, moderators, and members by **Engagement Score**.

Columns: Join Date • Visits • Last Visit • Post Clicks • Total Contributions • Published Posts Created • Comments • Reactions • Votes • RSVPs • Shares • Messages Sent • Courses Started • Courses Completed • Lessons Started • Lessons Completed • Current Streak • Max Streak • Recognitions Received • Recognitions Given • Points Received • Current Points

**Engagement Score calculation (weights):**

* Posts Created: **20** (Introductions count as **10**)
* Post Clicks: **1**
* Comments: **10** (includes comments on Courses)
* Reactions: **2**
* Votes: **8**
* RSVPs: **10**
* Messages Sent: **4**
* Followers: **0**

You can download the full list of top Hosts, moderators, and members from the three-dot menu in the upper-right corner.

From this table, clicking a name provides [**Link to Member Detail Page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-is-the-member-detail-page) (you can select the date range on that page).

### Subscription History table—"Subscription Renewal (Yes/No)" column:

* **No:** First payment of a new subscription (not a renewal).
* **Yes:** All payments after the initial one (renewals of an existing subscription).

## Active Members by Cohort

**Active Members by Cohort** helps you understand who is contributing in your Mighty Network—both by posting and interacting with posts—based on how long they've been members. Cohorts group members by tenure (for example: 0–30 days, 31–90 days, 90+ days).

Reviewing this view regularly can help you keep engagement balanced across new and long-time members.

### What to Look For

* **Lower activity from members who joined in the last 90 days**This can be a sign that new members need more support or encouragement to participate. Consider prompts, welcome threads, or low-stakes ways to "break the ice."
* **Lower activity from long-time members**This may indicate it's time to re-engage veteran members with new challenges, Events, or conversations to help them stay connected over time.

Healthy engagement typically includes contributions from both new and seasoned members.

## Activity by Platform

The **Activity by Platform** charts show what percentage of your Mighty Network's activity comes from each platform: **Web/Desktop**, **iOS**, **Android**, and **Web/Mobile**.

* The first chart displays the **overall percentage** of activity by platform.
* The second chart shows how activity changes **over the selected date range**, helping you spot usage trends across platforms.

## Active Members

You'll also see active members across **Hourly**, **Daily**, **Weekly**, and **Monthly** timeframes. Frequent visits are a strong indicator that members find your Mighty Network valuable.

As a rule of thumb:

* **Daily Active Members** are your most engaged and committed members.
* **Monthly Active Members** tend to be more casual.

These insights can help you set goals—for example, converting more Monthly or Hourly Active Members into Weekly or Daily Actives over time.

The chart includes the industry-standard **DAM/MAM** and **WAM/MAM** ratios. These show, out of your **Monthly Active Members (MAM)**, what percentage visit **daily** (**DAM**) or **weekly** (**WAM**). These ratios help you understand how frequently your members are showing up.

We've also included recommended targets based on our research into what makes a successful, long-lasting, and growing Mighty Network. In these Networks:

* **20%** of members show up **daily**, and
* **50%** show up **weekly**.

These benchmarks can help you set goals and track member engagement over time.

## Active Members Heatmap

The **Active Members Heatmap** shows when your members were most active over the past two years. Darker shaded days indicate higher activity, giving you a useful guide for when to schedule posts or Events for the most impact.

## Member Retention Rate

Your **member retention rate** metrics show the percentage of new and existing members who return to your Mighty Network over time. You can view retention across **7-day**, **30-day**, and **Weekly Member Retention by Cohort** timeframes.

In the weekly cohort view, the most recent cohort usually does not represent a full Monday–Sunday week. This is intentional—each member in that cohort must have been in your Mighty Network for at least **14 days** to ensure the retention data is meaningful.

These retention benchmarks are based on our internal research. We've found that thriving, long-lasting communities typically meet or exceed these metrics.

Even if members aren't actively contributing, they may still be spending meaningful time in your Mighty Network and getting value. These insights can help you make better decisions about when and how to encourage participation—especially during onboarding or through periodic reminders that reinforce your community culture.

Your **member growth charts** can be filtered by individual Spaces or by your overall Mighty Network. These charts show how your membership is growing and what percentage of new members are joining through an invite or referral.

A low referral percentage may indicate an opportunity to grow your Mighty Network by activating members through a referral campaign or the [**Ambassador Program**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-use-the-mighty-networks-ambassador-program).

## Private Chat

The **Private Chat dashboard** shows analytics for private and group messaging between your members. High levels of private messaging can be a strong indicator that members are connecting with each other and getting value from your Mighty Network.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 06 02 At 2 25 09 PM" />
</Frame>

This dashboard only includes private and group chats. It does **not** include Space Chat activity, which appears in the **Space Features** dashboard.

You can track private and group messaging activity in your Mighty Network by reviewing the number of direct messages sent and how members are using Private Chat. These insights help you understand engagement beyond public posts and comments.

**The Private Chat dashboard includes:**

**Total Number of Private Chat Messages:** The total direct messages sent during the selected date range.

**Message Senders:** A count of members who sent at least one private or group message.

**Total Active Conversations:** Shows the total number of active 1:1 and group chat conversations during the selected period.

**Active Members Using Private Chats:** Shows the percentage of active members who sent at least one private or group message.In successful Mighty Networks, **15% or more** of members use Direct Message.

**Total Private Messages Sent by Role:** Breaks down direct messages by Network role.

**Total Active Conversations by Role:** Shows how many active conversations occurred by Network role.

**% of Private Chat Messages Sent per Platform:** Shows the distribution of private messages sent from:

* iOS App
* Android App
* Web | Mobile
* Web | Desktop

**Top 50 Private Chat Message Senders:** Highlights the members who sent the most private or group messages, with filtering available by current role.

## Plans

The **Plans dashboard** shows your subscription and purchase activity over time. You can view subscriptions by the currency they were sold in, convert revenue metrics into 10 different currencies, and click into charts—such as **Subscriptions** or **Free Trials Started**—to see the list of members included on a specific date.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 06 02 At 2 29 05 PM" />
</Frame>

The currency chart displays the **top 10 most frequently used currencies**.

Revenue shown is the **total revenue for the selected date range**, regardless of currency.

You'll see an overview of:

* Est. Total Revenue: Estimated revenue from subscriptions and one-time purchases.
* Est. Subscription Revenue: Estimated revenue from subscriptions started or renewed during the date range.
* Est. Purchase Revenue: Estimated revenue from one-time purchases.

### Subscriptions Started and Renewed by Plan

A breakdown of subscription activity by plan, including:

* Plan Name
* Payment Platform
* Subscription Interval
* Plan Price
* Monthly Price
* of Starts
* of Renewals
* Estimated Revenue

### One-Time and Installment Purchases by Plan

* **Plan Name**
* **Pricing Type**
* **Plan Price**
* **# of Installments**
* **Installment Amount**
* **# of Transactions**
* **Estimated Revenue**

In the **three-dot menu**, you can open the list of **one-time purchases**, which links you to the **Payment Purchases** dashboard.

The **Payment Purchases** dashboard includes:

* **Name** (of the purchaser)
* **Created At** date
* **Plan Name**
* **Pricing Type**
* **Currency**
* **Plan Price**
* **Promotion Price**
* **Promo Code**

### Subscriptions

* Active Subscriptions: The number of active paid subscriptions (excludes free subscriptions and free trials).
* Active Subscribers: The number of members with active paid subscriptions (excludes free trials).
* Churn Rate: The percentage of subscriptions that have churned out of all subscriptions that either churned or renewed.
* Subscriptions Started: The number of new paid subscriptions started during the selected date range.
* Subscriptions Renewed: The number of subscriptions renewed during the selected date range.
* Subscriptions Churned: The number of subscriptions that ended during the date range.
* Subscriptions Canceled (Stripe only) The number of cancellations recorded via Stripe.
* Subscription Movement Due to Plan Switch: Tracks subscriptions that changed because a member switched plans.

**Subscription Free Trials**

* Active Free Trials: The number of members currently on a free trial.
* Free Trials Started: The number of free trials initiated during the date range.
* Free Trials Ended: The number of free trials that ended during the date range.

**Advanced Subscription Metrics by Plan**

This chart shows the **Lifetime Value (LTV)** of a plan—an estimate of the total revenue an average subscription is expected to generate over its full lifetime.LTV becomes available only after a plan has been active for **at least one full billing cycle**.

At the top of the Plans dashboard, you can filter by **Plan Name**, **Plan Interval**, and **Plan Internal Notes**.

A Plan Name will only appear once—so if you have multiple plans with the same name, use **Internal Notes** to distinguish between them.

**Note:** Only plans with at least one transaction in the past **24 months** will appear.

The first chart, **Estimated Total Revenue**, shows the estimated revenue from subscriptions and one-time purchases during the selected date range. This includes Mighty Networks fees but does **not** include Stripe or Apple fees.

Under **Subscriptions**, you can view several charts and tables that show subscription activity over the selected date range:

* Active Subscriptions: Shows the number of active paid subscriptions. Free subscriptions and free trials are not included.
* Subscription Retention Rate: Shows the number of subscriptions renewed and ended.The retention rate is calculated as:​ **Renewed Subscriptions ÷ All Subscriptions Up for Renewal**
* Subscriptions Started and Renewed: Shows the number of subscription starts, renewals, and subscriptions that started due to members moving between plans.
* Subscription Started and Renewed by Plan: A table showing the number of starts and renewals for each plan during the selected date range.
* Subscriptions Canceled: Shows the number of subscriptions canceled. Canceled subscriptions remain active until the end of the billing period.
* Subscriptions Churned: Shows the number of subscriptions that ended, including those that ended due to members switching plans.

### Subscription Free Trials

Under Subscriptions Free Trials you will be able to see

* Active Free Trials: Shows the total number of active free trials across all plans during the selected date range.
* Free Trials Started: Shows the number of free trials that began during the selected date range.
* Free Trials Ended: This chart includes two key metrics:
  * Number of Free Trials Ended: All free trials that concluded during the selected date range, including those that converted into paying subscriptions and those that did not.
  * Conversion Rate:
  * The percentage of ended trials that converted into paid subscriptions. Calculated as: **Converted Trials ÷ Total Trials Ended**
* **Important Note on Trial End Dates**
  * Trial end dates are determined by the scheduled end of the trial—not early cancellations.
  * For example, a 7-day free trial will appear as "ended" on day 7, even if the member cancels before that day.

### One-Time and Installment Purchases by Plan

Under **One-Time and Installment Purchases**, you can review activity and revenue for all one-time and installment-based plans.

* **Pricing Type**
* **Plan Price**
* **# of Installments**
* **Installment Amount**
* **# of Transactions**
* **% of Transactions** (the percentage of all one-time purchases attributed to that plan)

This data can help you understand the impact of marketing efforts by showing spikes in plan purchases that align with your campaigns or promotions. It also helps you tie changes in purchases back to milestones such as course cohorts wrapping up, a major marketing push, or media coverage.

You'll also see estimated revenue totals for these plans. These numbers are approximations, so we recommend using your **Income Details** tab for the most accurate revenue information.

**Note:** If you deactivate a plan, it will appear in the **Canceled Subscriptions** data.

## Downloading Member Data

Clicking any bar chart in the Plans dashboard opens a detailed view showing the individual members and data behind that chart.

To download this data—including member email addresses—open the **three-dot menu**, select **Download Data**, choose **CSV** or **Excel**, and select **As displayed in the data table**.

## Income Details

The **Income Details** tab shows daily updated income information from your Plans. You can sort and filter this data to review your revenue activity in more detail.

## Invoice Date

There are preset options to choose from, ranging from Today all the way back to the Previous Year.

You can also filter the data using a custom date range.

**Plan Name**

You can select any "Bundle Name" to see all of the members that have purchased that Plan.

**Payment Platform**

You will be able to sort either by Stripe payment or iOS (if enabled as an option).

**Payment Type**

This will display the subscription type categories for the plans available in your Network.

* **Name:** Purchaser name
* **Plan Name:** Name of the plan
* **Interval:** Payment interval (Monthly, Annual, or One-time)
* **Invoice Date:** Date the transaction took place
* **Currency:** Currency used for the charge
* **Amount:** Amount charged
* **Promo Code:** Promotion code applied, if any
* **Payment Platform:** Stripe or iOS
* **Payment Type:**
  * New Subscription
  * Subscription Renewal
  * One-time Purchase
  * *Also shows as New Subscription if a member moved plans*
* **Internal Notes:** Notes added during plan creation
* **Download Options:** All data can be downloaded

**Additional Notes**

* For total revenue summaries, go to the **Plans** tab or filter the Income Details report by date range, download it, and sum the totals.
* Sales tax, refunds, failed payments, and cancellations are **not** included in this data.

## Ambassadors

If you have the [**Ambassador Program**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/how-do-i-use-the-mighty-networks-ambassador-program) enabled, you'll have access to the **Ambassadors dashboard**.

At the top, you'll see the total number of **Gold**, **Silver**, and **Bronze** Ambassadors.

The table below displays a full list of your Ambassadors, including:

* Ambassador name
* Number of referrals
* Ambassador Level
* Dates when they reached **Bronze**, **Silver**, or **Gold** levels

## Storage

The **total storage used** in your Mighty Network is broken down by images, files, videos, and other uploaded formats—including livestream recordings. Avatars are **not** included in total storage. Course material videos are excluded from storage only on legacy plans with unlimited course videos; on newer plans (Explore, Launch, Scale, Growth), course videos count toward your storage limit.

You'll see your overall storage usage along with a percentage breakdown of the categories that make it up:

* **Images** – Any image file uploaded in posts or comments (excluding avatars)
* **Files** – Uploaded documents such as PDFs, spreadsheets, and similar formats
* **Videos** – Native videos uploaded to your Mighty Network
  * External embeds (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.) are not included
  * *Course material videos are excluded only on legacy plans with unlimited course videos; on newer plans (Explore, Launch, Scale, Growth), course videos count toward storage*
* **Audio** – Any uploaded audio file
* **Livestream Recordings** – Automatically saved recordings from livestreams
* **Other** – Any uploaded or attached file type not included in the categories above

## Feed

This dashboard includes data for the **Feed** Space Feature, covering posts (Posts, Articles, Polls, Questions) and interactions (comments and reactions).

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 06 02 At 2 34 46 PM" />
</Frame>

It shows you:

* Total Contributions: All posts and interactions from members and Hosts. This reflects overall engagement across your Mighty Network.
* Contributing Members: The number of members who contributed posts or interactions.
* Total Posts: The total number of posts created.
* % Member Posts: The percentage of posts created by members compared to Hosts.
* Feed Contributions: A breakdown of contributions within the Feed.
* Total Posts by Type: The volume of each post type (Quick Posts, Articles, Polls, Questions), showing content trends over time.
* Member Posts vs. Host Posts: A comparison of member-generated posts and Host-generated posts.
* Top Posts: A list of the posts with the highest engagement in the selected date range.

In the **Feed Contributions** chart, a **vote** refers to any interaction where a member selects an option in a poll. This includes responses in **Multiple Choice Polls**, **Hot Cold Polls**, and **Percentage Polls**. Each interaction where a member makes a selection counts as one vote.

A **share** is recorded when a member clicks the **Share** button on a post and successfully copies the link. Mighty Insights only counts shares that result in a copied link, ensuring each share reflects real member engagement and intent to distribute content.

This chart helps you spot engagement patterns and identify opportunities to diversify your content. If you notice slower periods, consider posting something new or prompting members to share updates to help increase activity in your Mighty Network.

This chart shows the proportion of posts created by Hosts compared to posts created by members. A higher percentage of member posts often indicates a more self-sustaining community, where members are actively helping each other and driving conversation.

If the percentage of Host-created posts is higher, it may be a sign that you have an opportunity to encourage members to contribute more—through prompts, questions, Events, or other participation cues.

The **Top Posts** chart shows detailed engagement data for your most interacted-with posts. For each post, you'll see:

* **Post Title**
* **Published Date**
* **Creator Name**
* **Network Role**
* **Post Type**
* **Space**
* **Post Clicks**
* **Total Contributions**
* **Comments**
* **Post Reactions**
* **Comment Reactions**
* **Votes**
* **Shares**

This data helps you understand how members interact with posts created by Hosts compared to posts created by members. If member-created posts receive less engagement, you may want to find ways to encourage more interaction—such as prompts, challenges, or conversation starters.

You can sort the table by any column and click a member name to open their **Member Detail** page or profile. Clicking a post title will open the post itself.

These insights can help you identify which content resonates most with your members. For example:

* Lots of reactions but few comments may signal an opportunity to spark more conversation.
* If certain content types (like polls) drive higher engagement—even if you don't post them often—you may want to include more of them in your content mix.

Engagement metrics such as reactions, comments, and post clicks reflect activity **within the date range you selected**.

# How Can I Set Up Automations in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network



Available on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and above, Automations let you automatically perform actions in your Mighty Network based on specific triggers.

You can use Automations to:

* Unlock rewards like secret courses, challenges, or 1:1 calls
* Open or close Event RSVPs
* Invite or remove people from Spaces or Plans
* Reward active members based on their engagement
* Celebrate members who attend Events
* …and much more!

## Triggers

The triggers you have available depend on the Mighty Plan you're on.

## How Do Automations Work?

Each Automation includes two parts:

* **Trigger** — What starts the Automation (e.g., a member completes a quiz or joins a Space)
* **Action** — What happens next (e.g., award a badge or send a message)

**Note:** Automations only apply from the moment they're created. They do not work retroactively, except for the [Member Inactive](#:~:text=the%20Android%20app-,Member%20Inactive,-Occurs%20when%20a) trigger, which applies based on general inactivity.

## How to Create an Automation

1. Go to **Admin > Automation > Create Automation** — the direct path is `/admin/automation`.
2. Give your Automation a clear, descriptive name.
3. Choose a **Trigger** (when something happens).
4. Choose an **Action** (what you want to happen).
5. Click **Create** — and your Automation goes live!

<img alt="Create Automation screen with the Trigger dropdown open, listing options such as Completed Lesson, Completed Quiz, and Completed Welcome Checklist" />

<img alt="Create Automation screen with the Action dropdown open, listing options such as Add Badge, Add Tag, and Send Private Message" />

## Filters

You can filter Triggers by selecting the "+" icon under Triggers:

* **Audience Filters** — [Launch plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and up - available on all Triggers except *Event Reached Number of RSVPs*.
* **AI Filters** —[Growth plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan) and up - available on *Commented on Post* and *Host Received Private Message*.

## Multiple Actions

Available on the [Launch plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and up, you can add **up to 3 actions** to a single Trigger.

Each action can include its own delay. They will run independently, so a failure in one won't stop the others.

<img alt="Three stacked Action cards on a single Automation, each with its own delay setting" />

## Add Delays to Actions

You can delay when an Action happens. Choose from:

* Immediately
* After 1, 3, 5, 10, or 30 minutes
* After 1 hour
* After 1 day

<img alt="Action delay dropdown open, showing choices from Immediately through After 1 Day" />

Here are a few examples of how you can use the delay feature:

* **Welcome and Introductions:** Delay introducing new members to Spaces or upcoming events, giving them time to settle in and complete their [Welcome Checklist](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-a-welcome-checklist).
* **Staggered Onboarding:** Create a phased onboarding experience by revealing resources or sending follow-up messages at specific intervals to avoid overwhelming new members.
* **Course Completion Badges:** Delay awarding a course completion badge to allow for review or a special congratulatory message.

## Managing Automations

You can manage existing Automations using the **three-dot menu** next to each Automation:

* **View/Edit** – Update any details.
* **Pause/Activate** – Temporarily stop or resume the Automation.
* **View Logs** – See up to 200 logs from the past 48 hours (includes timestamps, member names, and actions).
* **Delete** – Permanently remove the Automation.

You can also **search**, **filter**, and **sort** Automations by:

* **Status:** Active, Paused, Suspended, or Disabled
* **Space:** View Automations tied to specific Spaces
* **Date Created** or **Name** (A–Z or Z–A)

<img alt="Automation list with a row's three-dot menu open, showing View / Edit, Pause, View Automation Logs, Duplicate Automation, and Delete Automation" />

To see Automations for a specific Space: Go to the **three-dot menu > More > View Automation Workflows**.

<img alt="A Space's More menu open, with View Automation Workflows among the options" />

## Here are some suggestions to try out!

**Award engagement on a post**

Trigger: Comment on Post

Action: Add a Badge

Trigger: Event Reached Number of RSVPs

Action: Close Event RSVPs

Trigger: Converted Free Trial of Plan

Action: Add Tag

**Offer a Badge to members who complete quizzes**

Action: Add Badge

## Automations FAQs

**Is there a limit to how many automations I can set up and run?**

* No, other platforms limit you to a certain number of automations in a month. On Mighty, you can create and run as many automations as you'd like using the triggers and actions available on your Mighty plan.

**How do I troubleshoot my Automations?**

* You will want to check the Automation logs by going to the three-dot menu next to the Automation > View Automation Logs. This will show you the timestamp of the last action and other details that will help you diagnose the problem. As always, you can reach out to our Customer Advocacy team to assist.

**How fast are the automations?**

* They are near instant!

**Can I duplicate an Automation?**

* Yes! Just click the three dots menu next to the Automation you'd like to duplicate, then choose the "Duplicate Automation" option.
* If you try to save the duplicated Automation without making changes to any of its Trigger or Action settings, it will remain suspended until you make changes and re-save.

**Do I get notifications when a private message is sent on my behalf?**

* You won’t receive a notification, but as a Network Host, you have access to the automations list in Admin. There, you can click into "View Automation Logs" and see when messages have been sent and to what member. You will also see this message at the top of your conversation list.

**How can you tell whether someone else paused an Automation?**

* All Network Hosts have access to the Automations, which means that they can be paused by anyone. To check if they are paused or not, visit Admin > Integrations > Automations to see the list.

**What about adding a \_\_\_\_\_\_ trigger or \_\_\_\_\_\_\_ action?**

* We have a whole list of automations to add soon, and every new Mighty feature that is introduced brings the potential for new automations!

​

**​What about time delays, or the ability to add multiple triggers and actions into a single Automation?**

* Time delays are available on actions today! The ability to add multiple triggers and actions is still on our roadmap.
