# Can I Use External Embeds?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-external-embeds



**Radically expand** what your Mighty Network can do by embedding over **2,000 services** that look great on web, iOS, and Android.

Our embeds support a wide range of providers, including video, audio, images, slideshows, playlists, podcasts, maps, 3D content, forms, documents, puzzles, quizzes, graphs, infographics, and more

You can search for embeds that we support on [our website here](https://www.mightynetworks.com/features/embeds).

For additional embeds we support, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/additional-embeds).

## How to Embed

Embeds can be added to [**Articles**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network), [**Posts**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-a-post-in-my-mighty-network), [**Events**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network), [**Courses**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-build-a-course-in-my-mighty-network), and the [**Page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space) feature to bring additional functionality into your Mighty Network.

To embed content, open the service you want to use and look for a **Share** or **Embed** option. Copy the link, then paste it into the embed field in Mighty Networks.

Each service handles embeds a little differently, so you may need to try a few link formats to find the one that works.

**A quick note:** In addition to digital goods sales being required to adhere to mobile platform policies, most 3rd-party e-commerce services don't offer a full purchase experience within iframes, for cross-domain security reasons. We suggest either utilizing our [built-in payment features](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) or exploring our [support for external payment systems](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-take-payments-off-platform).

## Authenticated iFrames

For Hosts on the [Scale Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-business-plan#whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-scale-plan) and above who are building custom applications with Mighty's [Headless API](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/does-mighty-networks-have-an-api), authenticated embeds allow members to access embedded experiences using their existing Mighty account.

Examples include:

* AI-powered tools and assistants
* Custom member dashboards and portals
* Calculators, assessments, and interactive applications
* Applications built with Mighty's Headless API

When creating an embed, eligible Hosts may see an option to require authentication.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 08 At 1 59 46 PM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 08 At 1 59 46 PM" />
</Frame>

If the checkbox is selected, members who aren't signed in will be prompted to sign in or join the Mighty Network before accessing the experience.

Because authentication is handled through Mighty and your application's OAuth integration, members don't need a separate login. This creates a seamless experience where members can connect your application, review the requested permissions, and get started right away.

**Things to know:**

* Your application must be integrated with Mighty's Headless API and OAuth infrastructure.
* Signing out of Mighty does not automatically sign members out of the embedded application.
* This feature is available on web and mobile.
* On Free Plans, iFrame embeds continue to follow the existing approval process and allow-list requirements.

You can learn more in our [Headless API](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/does-mighty-networks-have-an-api) and [OAuth](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/how-do-i-manage-oauth-applications) documentation.

## Specific Embed Provider Instructions

We connect with thousands of well known apps today! Check out the specific embed instructions for your favorites:

## Canva

* Use the “Smart embed link” not the “HTML embed code"

## Calendly

* Use “Share Link” not “Add times to email” or “Add to website”

## Notion

* Due to limitations on the Notion side, Notion embeds only display a link card instead of a fully-interactive embed. If embedding Notion is important to you, you can consider using a third-party option like [Embed Notion](https://embednotion.com/)

## Instagram

* The copy embed code from Instagram is not an iframe and won't work. It will only work via a share link. If the account is private then the embed will not show.

## Video

* For Posts, simply paste the video’s URL into the text area, then press Enter to automatically display the embedded version.
* For an [Article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network), an [Event](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network), or the materials inside of the Table of Contents, you can embed video directly by using the "Add Video" option when you open up the + button.
* Copy the full URL where the video is hosted (not the full embed code or the Share Links for other Platforms), paste it into the field where you see "Video URL," and add an optional thumbnail. The video will then be embedded directly into your content, and members can watch it without leaving your Mighty Network.

## YouTube

* You can embed YouTube videos that are set to **Unlisted**, but not **Private**.
* Vertically filmed videos may display a zoomed-in horizontal thumbnail.
* Grainy or incorrect thumbnails will not be recognized. If your thumbnail isn’t displaying correctly, check your YouTube video settings and make sure it meets YouTube’s recommended specs (1280 × 720).

### Forcing Closed Captions On

To force closed captioning to play automatically on an embedded YouTube video:

1. Log in to your YouTube account and open **YouTube Studio**.
2. In the left menu, go to **Content** and select your video.
3. Click the **pencil icon** to open video details.
4. Scroll to **Show More**.
5. In the **Tags** section, add:​**yt:cc=on**
6. Click **Save**.
7. *Please note that closed captioning does not work on iOS for YouTube videos due to restrictions with Apple.*

### About multiple caption tracks

If your video includes multiple caption languages, switching between them won’t be available in the embedded player. The embed will display only the first caption track.

## Vimeo

If you're embedding **private videos** from Vimeo, there's one additional step required to ensure the videos play on the web and in the [**Mighty Networks iOS and Android apps**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/does-mighty-networks-have-an-app).

When adjusting the [privacy settings](https://vimeo.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/224817847-Privacy-settings-overview) for each video on **Vimeo.com**:

1. Set the privacy option to **Hide from Vimeo**.
2. Under **Where can this video be embedded?**, choose **Specific domains**.
3. Add **both** of the following approved domains:
   * Your Mighty Network's [**custom domain**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/can-i-use-my-own-web-domain-with-mighty-networks)
   * **mn.co**​\*(The video will not play in the mobile apps if “mn.co” is not included.)\*
4. Set the embed sizing to **Fixed**, not **Responsive**.

Showcases (playlists) cannot be embedded at this time.

Here is an example of how this was configured for a video embedded in Mighty Community:

## Searchie (Membership.io)

* Searchie does not offer an API for course progress tracking. If you want to track progress within a Course, use **native video uploads** or **YouTube** instead.
* We also do not currently support embedding Searchie widgets.

## Wistia, Loom, Dailymotion, and Rutube

You can embed videos from **Wistia**, **Loom**, **Dailymotion**, and **Rutube** by using **Insert Embed** when creating or editing an **Article**, an **Event**, or any material inside a **Table of Contents**.

1. Copy the **video URL** (not the full embed code).
2. Paste it into the embed field.
3. The video will appear directly in your content.

\*\**Closed captioning does not work on iOS for Loom videos due to Apple restrictions.*

## Grain

You can embed videos from **Grain** by using **Insert Embed** when creating or editing an **Article**, an **Event**, or any material inside a **Table of Contents**.

1. Copy the **video URL** from Grain (either a recording URL like `grain.com/share/recording/...` or a highlight URL like `grain.co/highlight/...`).
2. Paste it into the embed field.
3. The video will appear directly in your content.

Grain uses iframe embeds and supports both recording URLs and highlight URLs.

## Music Playlists

## SoundCloud

Use the **full embed code**, not just the link, to ensure the playlist or track embeds correctly.

## MP3 Audio Files

Copy the full **.mp3 file URL** from its host, paste it into the embed field, and it will embed directly in your content.

## Google Maps

### In Google Maps

1. Search for the location.
2. Click the location you want to embed.
3. Select the **Share** icon.
4. Choose **Embed a map**.
5. Select a size and click **Copy HTML**.

### In your Mighty Network

1. Open the Article where you want to embed the map.
2. Click inside the body of the Article.
3. Select the **+** icon.
4. Choose **Embed**.
5. Paste the HTML code from Google Maps.

**Note:** Maps created using Google’s **Custom Maps** feature cannot be embedded.

## Typeform

To embed a Typeform, paste the **default form URL** into the embed field.Do **not** use the full embed code or a customized Typeform link—only the default link from the Typeform **Share** page is supported.

## Google Slides, Google Docs, and More

To embed a Google Slides presentation:

1. Open the presentation.
2. Go to **File > Share > Publish to Web**.
3. Select **Embed** and copy the embed code.
4. Use **Insert Embed** in an Article, Event, or Lesson to add it.


# Can I Use GIFs in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-gifs-in-my-mighty-network



You can absolutely add GIFs across your Mighty Network! Just click the **GIF** icon and type a keyword to search for the perfect one.

Whether you're adding a GIF to a **Post**, **Comment**, or **Chat**, the process is the same:

1. Select the **GIF** button in the bottom-left corner of the composer.

2. Search by keyword (for example, “celebration” or “thanks”).

3. Choose your favorite GIF and send or post it.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-gifs-in-my-mighty-network/8546504989453)

## Adding a GIF to an Article

1. Save the GIF file (as a **.gif**) to your device.

2. In your Article, select **Add Image**.

3. Upload the saved GIF file.

## Content Ratings and Usage

All GIFs available through the built-in picker are rated **G/PG** and provided by **Tenor**.

**Note:** You cannot use Tenor GIFs for commercial purposes or on behalf of third parties.

## How to Turn GIFs On or Off in Your Network

Hosts can manage GIF access for all members.

1. Go to **Admin > Members > GIFs.**

2. Toggle **GIFs** on to allow members to post GIFs.

3. Toggle **GIFs** off to remove the GIF picker from all areas of your Network.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-gifs-in-my-mighty-network/gifs.png)

## How to Turn Off GIF Autoplay (Personal Setting)

If you prefer that GIFs don’t autoplay on your account:

1. Go to **Personal Settings > Appearance and Sounds.**

2. Toggle off **Autoplay GIFs.**

This stops GIFs from automatically looping while you scroll.


# Can I View My Mighty Network in Dark Mode?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-view-my-mighty-network-in-dark-mode



[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-view-my-mighty-network-in-dark-mode/Screen_Shot_2021-10-21_at_4_38_35_PM.png)

Members can view your Mighty Network in **Light Mode** or **Dark Mode** on both mobile and web.

## Mobile App (iOS and Android)

Members using the iOS or Android app will see your Mighty Network in Light or Dark Mode based on their **device settings**.

## iOS

**Settings > Display & Brightness > Appearance**

## Android

**Settings > Display > Dark theme**

Hosts cannot disable Dark Mode or set a default mode for the entire Network. However, members can adjust their device settings to prevent automatic switching.

## Web

Dark Mode is also available on the web.

Members can switch between Light and Dark Mode by:

* Clicking their **profile icon** and toggling the Dark Mode icon, or

* Going to **Personal Settings > Appearance and Sounds**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-view-my-mighty-network-in-dark-mode/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-3_51_03-PM.png)

## Light and Dark Mode Imagery

You can upload **different images** for Light Mode and Dark Mode in your Network branding settings to ensure your visuals look great in both themes.

To learn more, **[check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-network-branding)**.


# How Can I Make My Mighty Network More Accessible to the Visually Impaired?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-can-i-make-my-mighty-network-more-accessible-to-the-visually-impaired



We want to support you in making your Mighty Network visually accessible for all members. Color choices play a big role in readability, usability, and overall accessibility—especially when text or icons appear on top of your selected colors.

## How to Set Your Network Colors

To customize your Mighty Network’s colors:​ \*\*Profile photo > Admin > Branding > Colors \*\*(You can learn more about [Network branding](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-network-branding) options in this article.)

## How to Set Colors for a Space

To customize colors for a Space:​\*\*Gear icon > Space Branding > Colors \*\*(You can learn more about [Space branding](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-space-branding) options in this article.)

## How Mighty Handles Text and Icon Contrast

You have full control over your header, button, and brand colors. When text or icons appear on top of your chosen colors, Mighty automatically adjusts them to **black** or **white** based on contrast needs to keep things visually accessible.

If a selected color isn’t accessible, Mighty will recommend alternatives and offer suggestions—though you can always save any color you choose.

These accessibility adjustments are based on the [**Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)**](https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/wcag/). To meet the WCAG AA standard (the baseline for accessible design), the contrast ratio between text/icons and their background must be **at least 4.5:1**.

Below are examples of how Mighty applies these standards across headers, buttons, and text links.

## Header Colors

* Header icons appear **white** on dark header colors.
* They appear **black** on light header colors.
* Automatically inverting icon colors ensures header text remains readable across a wide range of background colors.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 36 03 PM" />

## Button Colors

Button text automatically switches to **white** or **black** depending on the button color.

Sometimes, a button color doesn’t provide enough contrast for either white or black text.

In this case:

* Slightly **darkening or lightening** the button color will help meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.
* Lightening the button too much can make its outline difficult to see or interact with, so it’s best to maintain enough contrast for both the text and the button shape.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 36 19 PM" />

## Text Links and Action Icons

Text links and action icons typically appear on a **white background**, so the color you choose for these elements should be on the **darker** side to maintain accessible contrast.

## Additional Resources

Need help choosing header or Event image sizes, where to place text, or what logo size to upload?

We created a handy cheat sheet to help you bring your brand to life across your Mighty Network.

### [Download it here](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1keL3CuVbG8sBotTm9IkyPFKWZGoFnASUQvqTNzqnk54/edit?usp=sharing)


# How Do Hashtags Work in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-hashtags-work-in-my-mighty-network



<iframe />

You can add hashtags to [**Posts**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-a-post-in-my-mighty-network), [**Chat messages**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-does-chat-work-in-a-mighty-network), [**Articles**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network), comments, [**Lessons and Sections**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons), [**Events**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network), and [**Questions & Polls**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-polls-questions-in-my-mighty-network) on web or mobile.

To add one, type a **#** followed by text—just like on other platforms. You can include multiple hashtags in the same piece of content.

## Hashtag Basics

Hashtags can include letters, numbers, or underscores. They can’t include other special characters (like **&** or **\$**) or extra spaces.

As you type, you’ll see a dropdown showing existing hashtags. Continue typing to create a new one.

The color of your hashtag will match your [**Space branding**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-space-branding).

## Highlighted Hashtags

**Hosts** can highlight up to **100 hashtags** in each Space.

The first 10 appear in the search dropdown; the rest appear under **See All**.

When someone searches or types a hashtag in a Space, the list of highlighted hashtags will appear automatically.

**To highlight a hashtag:**

1. Click the hashtag to view its search results.
2. Select **Highlight**.
3. Choose one or more Spaces where you want it highlighted.

Highlighted hashtags appear:

* In the dropdown when you click the search bar at the top of a Space
* In the **right-hand column** of the [**Feed**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work) (if the Feed is enabled)

**Note:** The right-hand column view is web only. On iOS and Android, highlighted hashtags don’t render inline in the Feed—members access them through the **Hashtag List** tab instead, which you enable per Space (see [**Hashtag List**](#hashtag-list) below).

To turn this off, go to **Space Admin > Space Features > Feed**, then toggle off **Display Highlighted Hashtags**.

## Visibility and Access

If a member has access to the **Space** where content lives, that hashtag will appear in their dropdown as an option.

If they don’t have access, it won’t appear.

When someone clicks a hashtag, they’ll see search results for all content across the **Mighty Network** that includes it, sorted by relevance.

If a member doesn’t have access to a Space where tagged content appears, that content will not show in their results.

Members can see hashtagged content in [**Spaces that are visible to anyone**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space).

To view all results for a hashtag across every Space:

1. Click **Search** in a Space.
2. Click the highlighted hashtag.
3. At the top of the results, de-select the Space filter to **Search All Spaces**.

**Note:** Search results include **Posts** and **Articles** with hashtags. They don’t include messages in **Chat Spaces** or **Private Chats**.

You can’t edit hashtags yet, but deleting a hashtag from a piece of content removes it from the system.

You can also sort hashtag results by **Top**, **Newest**, or **Oldest**.

## Hashtag Prompt

When creating **Posts**, **Articles**, or comments on web (and on iOS or Android for Posts), you’ll see a prompt to add a hashtag.

Click the prompt to insert a **#** where your cursor is. As you type, a dropdown will appear showing hashtags— including any **highlighted hashtags** in that Space.

## Hashtag List

On web, highlighted hashtags show up directly in the Feed's right-hand column. On **iOS and Android**, there's no right-hand column, so the **Hashtag List** tab is the only way members can browse a Space's highlighted hashtags on mobile—it doesn't turn on by default, so enable it if your members use the mobile app.

To display a list of highlighted hashtags in a Space:

1. Go to the **gear icon > Space Features > Hashtag List**.
2. Toggle the feature on.
3. Rename it to anything you like—your custom name appears in the right-hand column (for example, “Hashtabs”).

This feature appears on web and mobile alongside other Space features like **Chat** and **Discovery**.

Clicking it shows a full list of highlighted hashtags in that Space.

**Important:** The **Feed** feature must be enabled for the Hashtag List to display.

To manage your highlighted hashtags, go to **gear icon > Content Highlights > Highlighted Hashtags**. From there, you can **drag and drop** to reorder or create a new highlighted hashtag.

## Suggested Hashtags (AI Feature)

**Suggested Hashtags** is an AI-powered feature available on [**Launch plans**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and up. Suggestions appear in **Posts**, **Articles**, and more—especially in Spaces without highlighted hashtags.Suggested hashtags appear with a **sparkle icon**.


# How Do I Create a Post in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-a-post-in-my-mighty-network



A **Post** is a simple way to share a short update, images, a video, or a link with your members. You can also add a file.

Posts show up in the [Feed](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work) of a Space by default

## Turning Posts On or Off

To change this setting, go to:​ Space > Gear Icon > Features > Manage. Here, you can:

* Allow everyone to make Posts, or
* Limit Posts to Hosts and Moderators.

## How to Create a Post

**On web:** go to your [Feed](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work) and start a Post

**On mobile:** open the Mighty Networks iOS or Android app and tap the **pencil icon** at the bottom.

<iframe />

## You can add or create:

* A single photo or up to 6 photos
* A video file
* A video link (YouTube, Vimeo etc..)
* A file
* A [poll](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-polls-questions-in-my-mighty-network)
* Add a background image
* GIF
* Emojis

## Adding Text to Images

If you post a single image, you can add text either:

* **Below the image** (like a caption), or
* **On top of the image** (making it the background).

Tap or click the corner prompt to switch between these options.

## Image Sizes

* **21:9** (horizontal), or
* **3:4** (vertical).

The **3:4 ratio** works best if you want the image as a background. If not, any size will display as uploaded.

Note: very wide or tall images may get cropped, but the full image shows if someone clicks on it.

## Formatting

You can bold, italicize, add links and more by highlighting the text.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 40 39 PM" />

## Comments

You can turn comments **on or off** for any post.

**Who can control comments:**

* Hosts and Moderators: on any post in their Network or Space
* Members: only on their own posts

**How it works:**

* Open the three-dot menu on a post
* Toggle comments on or off
* Turning them off hides existing comments, but they come back if you turn comments back on

## Hashtags, GIFs, and Emojis

You can use [**hashtags, emojis, and GIFs**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-use-hashtags-in-my-mighty-network) in Posts, Chat, Articles, or comments.

## Hashtags

* Anyone can make hashtags.
* Type “#” plus your text (letters, numbers, or underscores).
* No spaces or special characters (&, \$, etc.).
* You can use more than one hashtag per post.
* Hashtags show up in a dropdown as you type.

Clicking a hashtag shows all posts across the Network that use it (unless the content is in a Space the member can’t see).

**Note:** If the hashtag is in a Space a member can’t access, it won’t show up for them.

To learn more about how hashtags work in your Mighty Network, including how to highlight them in a Space, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-hashtags-work-in-my-mighty-network).

## GIFs and Emojis

You can add GIFs and emojis to posts, comments, [chat](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-does-chat-work-in-a-mighty-network), or [Articles](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network).

## Posting in Your Mighty Network

When you finish creating a Post, select **Post** in the upper-right corner to publish it. Before you publish, you’ll see notification options, including **Notify All**.

## Notify All

If you select **Notify All**, every member with notifications enabled will receive an immediate push notification and email when your Post is published. Use this option only for important or time-sensitive updates that all members should see.

## Schedule a Post

You can also schedule a Post to publish at a later date and time. This feature is available on desktop and can be used for all content types, including **Posts**, **Articles**, **Events**, **Polls**, and **Questions**.

To schedule a Post, you must be the Space Host or Space moderator.

1. On web, open your Post draft.
2. Select the down arrow next to **Post**.
3. Choose **Schedule Post** and set the date and time.

## Managing Scheduled Posts

You can view and manage all scheduled Posts in your Mighty Network:

1. Select your profile picture.
2. Choose **Scheduled Posts**.

From here, you can:

* View all upcoming scheduled Posts from any Host or moderator.
* Select a Post to edit its content or scheduled time.
* Use the three-dot menu to **Move** or **Delete** a Post.

## Make it Better (AI Tool)

If you’re on the [Launch plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) (or higher) and have [AI enabled,](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have) you can highlight any text in your post and click the **“Make it Better” sparkle icon.**

Options include:

* Fix spelling and grammar
* Shorten or expand text
* Change the tone (Casual, Fun, Professional, Sincere, Witty)


# How Do I Create an Article in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network



Articles in your Mighty Network are like rich blog posts. You can use them to share updates, stories, or long-form content with your members.

## What You Can Do with Articles

Articles are flexible posts that can include:

* Formatted text (with headers, quotes, links, and more)
* Photos and embedded videos from YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, and Facebook
* Audio tracks, playlists, and other rich media embeds
* File attachments (up to 250MB per file). As a Host, you can decide if you want your members to upload 250MB or keep them at a smaller file upload limit: 25MB. You can make this decision in Admin > Member Settings

Once your Article is published, you can:

* Feature it in your [**Featured Section**](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/1611084-become-an-ambassador)
* Add it to your [**Welcome Checklist**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-a-welcome-checklist) to guide new members

## How to Enable Articles in a Space

You’ll need to enable Articles in each Space where you want to use them.

1. Go to the **Space** where you want to enable Articles.
2. Select the **Manage button > Space Features > Feed > Manage.**
3. Toggle **Articles** on.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 08 10 At 9 10 53 AM" />
</Frame>

From here, you can also choose who can create Articles:

* **Hosts and moderators only**, or
* **All members**

## How to Create an Article

1. Select the **Create** button.
   * On web, this button appears at the top of the page.
2. Choose **Article.**

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 08 10 At 9 11 26 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 08 10 At 9 11 26 AM" />
</Frame>

1. Add your title, text, images, or embeds.
2. Select **Post** when you’re ready to share it.

You can add:

* Unlimited photos
* One uploaded video
* Embedded videos (YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook, and more)
* Media embeds like Spotify, Typeform, or SoundCloud
* File attachments (individual files are limited to 25MB each)

## Adding a Primary Image or Video

First, you will add a **hero image or video URL at the top.**

This is what will appear in the [Feed](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-does-the-feed-work) and displays independently from what’s in the body of your Article.

* **Recommended image size:** 2560 x 1440 pixels (16:9 ratio)​**Supported video platforms:** YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, and more​**Supported video platforms:** YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, and more

To delete or change media, select **Edit** and use the **trash icon.**

## Notify All

If you select **Notify All**, every member with notifications enabled will receive an [immediate push notification and email](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/what-notifications-do-my-members-get) when your Article is published. Use this option for important or time-sensitive updates that all members should see.

## Schedule an Article

You can also schedule an Article to publish at a later date and time. This feature is available on desktop and can be used for any content type, including **Posts**, **Articles**, **Events**, **Polls**, and **Questions**.

To schedule an Article, you must be the [Space Host or Space moderator](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-space-hosts-and-space-moderators-have).

### How to Schedule an Article

* On web, open your Article draft.

When you schedule an Article, you’ll also see an option to **Notify All Members** when it goes live.

* If you enable this, all members will receive a notification as soon as the Article is published.
* If you don’t, the Article will appear in the feed, and members can find it through search or any hashtags you’ve added.

As the Host who scheduled the Article, you’ll also receive your own notification when it publishes. This includes:

* A bell notification inside your Mighty Network
* A mobile push notification (if you’ve enabled push notifications)

* Use the three-dot menu to **Move** or **Delete** a post.

## Managing Articles

## Turning on or off Comments

You can turn comments on or off at any time.

**Who can control comments:**

* Network Hosts and moderators: on any post in their Network or Space
* Members: only on posts they’ve created

**How to toggle comments:**

1. Open the **three-dot menu** on the post.
2. Select **Enable Comments** (toggle on to allow and off to not allow).

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 08 10 At 9 25 49 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 08 10 At 9 25 49 AM" />
</Frame>

Turning comments off hides existing comments but doesn’t delete them—they’ll reappear if you turn comments back on.

## Moving an Article to Another Space

1. Open the **three-dot menu** on the Article.
2. Select **Move.**
3. Choose the Space you want to move it to and select **Continue.**
   * The destination Space must have **Feed** and **Articles** enabled.
4. Choose whether to keep the post’s interactions and select **Move.**

If your Article includes media embeds, they won’t count twice toward your storage.

## Duplicating an Article

To duplicate an existing Article:

1. Select the **three-dot menu** in the Article.
2. Choose **Duplicate Article.**

You’ll receive a push notification when duplication is complete. Selecting that notification takes you directly to the copy so you can update its title and content.

## Working with Drafts

Your drafts are auto-saved while you’re working.

To access drafts:

1. Click your **Profile Image > Saved Drafts** on web.
2. Open your draft to continue editing or copy its URL to share with another Host.

**Note:** Changes to already published Articles aren’t auto-saved to drafts.

## Bookmark a Post

<iframe title="YouTube video player" />

It's easy to bookmark content! Whether it’s an Article, Post, Section, Lesson, Quiz, or Event, you can save it to revisit later. Just follow these steps:

1. Click the three-dot menu on the content.
2. Select “Bookmark.”

## Sharing Content from Your Mighty Network

When your Mighty Network’s privacy setting is set to **“[Anyone can view content inside](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network)”**, you and your members can share any **Post**, **Article**, **Event**, **Question**, or **Poll** publicly.

## How to Share a Post

1. Click the **three-dot menu** on the post you want to share.
2. Select **Share**.
3. Choose one of the sharing options:
   * Share directly to **Facebook**, **Twitter**, or **LinkedIn**
   * Create an **email** with a link to the content
   * **Copy the link** to share anywhere else

If your Mighty Network is set to **“Only logged-in members can see the content,”** the share options will include only:

* **Create an email** with the link, or
* **Copy the link**

In this case, the content is only visible to logged-in members of your Network or the specific Space.

## Editing the Photo or Text That Appears When Sharing

When sharing content publicly from a Mighty Network or Space that’s viewable to non-members, the shared link automatically includes a **preview image** and **snippet of text**.

This preview is generated through a **third-party service** and **cannot be edited directly**.If you update the post’s photo, that change should be reflected in the shared link preview as well.

## Make it Better (AI Feature)

This is an [AI feature](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have), that will help improve your writing.

Selecting the sparkle icon will allow you to:

* Fix spelling and grammar
* Shorten or elaborate
* Adjust tone (Casual, Fun, Professional, Sincere, or Witty)


# How Do I Create and Manage Featured and Welcome Sections?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-and-manage-featured-and-welcome-sections



On the [**Launch Plan** ](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan)and higher, you can use **Featured Sections** and **Welcome Sections** to highlight key content in your Mighty Network.

* The **Featured Section** helps you showcase important or timely posts to returning members.
* The **Welcome Section** helps you curate content specifically for new members when they join a Space.

Both appear to the right of the **Feed** (or **Global Feed**) and make it easy to keep your members engaged with the most important content.

## The Featured Section

Featured Sections function like **pinned posts** in your Mighty Network. You can add one or more [Articles](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network), [Posts](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-a-post-in-my-mighty-network), [Polls, Questions](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-polls-questions-in-my-mighty-network), [Events](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network), [Lessons](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons), [Sections](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons), or Spaces to highlight announcements, new content, or activities.

## How to Add a Featured Section

You can add a Featured Section in three places:

1. The [**Global Feed**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-global-features) (visible Network-wide)
2. Individual **Spaces** (if the Feed feature is enabled)
3. **Collections** (to feature Spaces or Plans in a carousel layout)

## Add or Remove Featured Posts

To add a post:

1. Go to the post you want to feature (on web).
2. Click the **three-dot menu** in the upper-right corner.
3. Select **Feature In...**
4. Choose whether to feature it in your **Global Featured Section** or a **Space Featured Section**.

To remove a post, repeat the same steps and **uncheck** the selected option or choose **Unpin**.

## Global Feed Featured Section

In the **Global Feed**, you can feature both content and Spaces.

* Content will only be visible to members who have access.

**To feature a Space in the Global Feed:**

* Click the **three-dot menu** next to the Space name.
* Select **Feature In...** and choose the**Featured Section**.

**To manage your Global Featured Section:**

* In the Global Feed, click **See More**, or
* Go to **Admin > Navigation and Spaces > Global Features > scroll to the bottom for Featured Section**.

## Featured Section in a Space

Each Space with the [Feed feature](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work) enabled can have its own Featured Section.

When you feature a post, it appears at the **top** of the section by default.

To reorder featured content:

1. Click the **gear icon** in your Space.
2. Select **Content Highlights > Featured Section**.
3. Use the **three-line menu** to drag and reorder posts.

## The Welcome Section

<iframe />

The **Welcome Section** is a Space-specific feature that helps new members discover key posts, events, and lessons when they join a Space. It appears to the right of the Space Feed and gives new members a clear, curated introduction to what matters most.

## How to Set Up a Welcome Section

1. Go to your Space’s **gear icon > Content Highlights > Welcome Section**.
2. Add content such as Articles, Posts, Polls, Lessons, or Events.
3. To add content directly from a post:
   * Click the **three-dot menu** on the post.
   * Select **Add This To... > Welcome Section**.
4. Use the **three-line menu** to rearrange items in your preferred order.

New members see the Welcome Section in their Feed for one week after joining.

## Pinning and Unpinning Content

**To pin a post:**

1. On web, open the post you want to feature.
2. Click the **three-dot menu** in the upper-right corner.
3. Select **Add This To...**
4. Choose **Welcome Section**, **Featured Section (Space)**, **Featured Section (Global)**, or **Welcome Checklist**.

**To unpin a post:**

1. On web, open the post.
2. Click the **three-dot menu** again.
3. Uncheck the section where it’s pinned.

**Note:** Pinning and unpinning content is available on web only.

## Reordering Content in the Welcome Section

When you add new content, it appears at the **front** of the section by default.

To change the order:

1. Click the **gear icon** in your Space.
2. Scroll to **Content Highlights > Welcome Section**.
3. Use the **three-line menu** to drag and reorder items.

## Why Use Featured and Welcome Sections

Both tools help you surface the most valuable content in your Mighty Network:

* The **Featured Section** engages returning members by keeping important or new posts front and center.
* The **Welcome Section** gives new members a strong first impression by showing them the most relevant content right away.

Used together, they create a seamless experience for both new and returning members.


# How Do I Create Polls & Questions In My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-polls-questions-in-my-mighty-network



<iframe />

**Polls and Questions** are the fastest way to spark engagement and conversation in your Mighty Network.

You can create them on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and higher, from the web, iOS, or Android apps

## Types of Polls and Questions

Your Mighty Network offers one **Question** type and **three Poll types**:

* **Question**
* **Multiple Choice Poll**
* **Hot Cold Poll**
* **Percentage Poll**

## Enable Polls and Questions

Polls and Questions can be created in any Space that has the [**Feed**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work) feature enabled.

As a Host, you can choose who can post them:

* **Everyone**, or
* **Only Hosts and Moderators**

Once enabled, open the **Create** menu in the upper-right corner to choose a Question or Poll.

## Single Questions

Create a single question and prompt members to share their answers. Responses for single questions are **public by default**, meaning members can see each other's responses.

## Multiple Choice Polls

Create a **Multiple Choice Poll** by selecting it from the post input field.You can add up to **five answer options.**

* Responses for multiple choice polls are **public by default**, meaning members can see who chose each option.
* To make responses private, check **Private Responses** before posting.
* You can change privacy settings until the first response is submitted.

Once posted:

* You can **edit the question text**, but **not the answer options**, to protect members’ original responses.
* Members can click any response after voting to see who chose that option (if Public Responses are on).

As members vote, results update in real time, showing how their choice compares to the rest of the Network.

## Hot Cold Polls

**Hot Cold Polls** measure sentiment along a spectrum from negative to positive.

They display as a horizontal bar where members select their answer on a sliding scale.

* Responses are **always private**, and this setting can’t be changed before or after posting.

## Percentage Polls

**Percentage Polls** allow members to express a response as a percentage.They’re great for gauging opinion strength or agreement levels.

* Responses are **always private**, and the privacy setting cannot be changed.

## View Poll Results as a Host

On the web, Network Hosts can view poll results without voting themselves.

To view results:

1. Open the full detail view of the poll.
2. Click the **circle with a checkmark icon** in the upper-right corner.

Note: Poll results can’t be exported, and individual member answers are not accessible.

## Bookmark or Mute a Poll

Open the **three-dot menu** in the upper-right corner of any poll to:

* **Bookmark Poll** – save it to your personal Bookmarks list.
* **Mute Poll** – stop receiving notifications about new comments or activity on that poll.

## Poll and Question Data in Mighty Insights

You can track Poll and Question engagement in your Network through the **Feed Contributions chart** in [**Mighty Insights**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/what-is-mighty-insights).

## The Infinite Question Engine

The **Infinite Question Engine** automatically generates Polls and Questions tailored to your community or course.

It uses your [**Space Description**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces) (or your Network’s [Big Purpose](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/whats-a-big-purpose), if there isn’t one) to create relevant engagement prompts—keeping conversations flowing without extra work.

This feature is available on the [**Scale Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-business-plan) and up.

To learn more, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-use-the-infinite-question-engine).

### Turn Comments On or Off

You can control whether people can comment on your Polls and Questions.

**Who can toggle comments:**

* **Network Hosts and Moderators:** on any post across the Network.
* **Space Hosts and Moderators:** on any post within their Space.
* **Members:** only on posts they created.

**How it works:**

1. Open the **three-dot menu** on a question or poll.
2. Select **Turn Off Comments** or **Turn On Comments.**

When comments are turned off, existing comments are hidden (not deleted) and will reappear if you turn comments back on.

## Additional Details

* Hosts can create **unlimited polls**.
* Members can post **one poll per hour** to prevent spam.
* Polls and Questions have a **190-character limit**.
* Polls can’t be edited, closed, or have answers changed once published.
* The color of your poll matches your [**Space Color**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-space-branding); text color adjusts automatically for readability.
* Trending Polls and Questions surface to more members automatically.


# How Do I Enable Desktop Notifications?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-enable-desktop-notifications



On web, you can turn on **desktop notifications** to receive popup alerts in your browser whenever you get a new notification and your Mighty Network tab is not in focus.

The notifications that appear will depend on your personal notification preferences in **Personal Settings > Notifications**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-enable-desktop-notifications/Screenshot-2025-11-17-at-3_51_21-PM.png)

You may also see a prompt to enable desktop notifications when you open the chat icon in the top bar of your browser.

## Troubleshooting Desktop Notifications

If you’re not receiving desktop notifications, follow the steps below for your browser and device.

### Google Chrome

1. Open Chrome.

2. Select **More > Settings**.

3. Go to **Privacy and Security > Site Settings > Notifications**.

4. Under **Default behavior**, choose **Sites can ask to send notifications**.

### Safari

1. Open **Preferences > Websites**.

2. Select **Notifications** in the left pane.

3. Use the dropdown next to any website requesting permission to allow or deny notifications.

### Firefox

1. Select the **lock icon** in the address bar.

2. Choose the **arrow** next to Connection status.

3. Select **More Information**, then open the **Permissions** tab.

4. Under **Send Notifications**, uncheck **Use Default** and choose **Allow**.

## If Browser Settings Don’t Work

You may need to adjust your computer’s notification settings.

### Mac

1. Open **System Settings > Notifications**.

2. Select the browser you want notifications from.

3. Turn on **Allow notifications**.

4. Choose how notifications appear (None, Banners, or Alerts).

5. Make sure sound and other notification options are enabled.

### Windows (PC)

1. Select **Start > Settings**.

2. Go to **System > Notifications**.

3. Turn on **Notifications** at the top of the page.

4. Under **Notifications from apps and other senders**, ensure your browser (e.g., Chrome) is turned on.

# How Do I Message Members in a Space?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-message-members-in-a-space



<iframe />

As a [**Space Host**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-space-hosts-and-space-moderators-have) [or Space moderator,](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-space-hosts-and-space-moderators-have) you can send a message to all members of a Space or target specific members. This is a quick way to share updates, announce Events, or highlight new activity.

## Message All Members in a Space

1. Go to the **Space gear icon**.
2. Select **Members > Member List**.
3. Open the **three-dot menu** in the upper-right corner.
4. Select **Message All Members**.

Add an optional **title** to your message, then write your announcement in the editor. You can highlight text to apply formatting or add links.

Once sent, members receive your announcement by email or push notification based on their [**personal notification settings**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-member).

## Important Notes

* All members of the Space—[**full**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) [and limited](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership)—receive the message.
* Members with notifications turned off will not receive email or push notifications.
* Members who haven’t logged in within **6 months** will not receive notifications.

## Message Specific Members in a Space

1. Go to the **Space gear icon > Members > Member List**.
2. Select members using the checkboxes next to their names, or click **Select All**.
3. Open the **Bulk Actions** menu (top right).
4. Select **Message Members**.

Write your message and click **Send**. Members will be notified via email or push notification based on their [**notification preferences**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-member).

## What Members See

* Members receive an in-app notification: **“Your Host \[Name] sent you a message.”**
* Clicking the notification shows your message.
* Clicking **Reply** opens a private chat with you.
  * *Reply is currently available on web only.*

## Additional Targeting Options

You can segment your Space or Network member lists to send more targeted messages—for example, to members on a specific plan, with a particular [**Tag**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members) [or Badge](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members), and more.


# How Do I Message Members in My Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-message-members-in-my-network



<iframe />

As a [**Network Host**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-network-hosts-and-network-moderators-have) [or Network moderator,](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-network-hosts-and-network-moderators-have) you can send messages to all full members in your Mighty Network or target specific members inside a Space. These messages help you share important updates, make announcements, and welcome new members.

## Message All Full Members in Your Mighty Network

To send a message to all [**full members**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership):

1. Go to **Admin > Members > Member List**.
2. Open the **three-dot menu** in the upper-right corner.
3. Select **Message All Full Members**.

Add an optional **title** to your message, then write your announcement in the editor. You can highlight text to add links or adjust formatting.

Members will receive your message by email or push notification, depending on their [**personal notification settings**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-member).

## Important Notes

* Only **full members** receive this message—**limited members** do not.
* You will **not** see updates in your own notifications when Members use the Message All Members feature.
* Members who haven’t logged in for **18 months** will not receive notifications.

## Customizing Welcome Messages

You can customize welcome messages in two ways:

## 1. Use Automations (Growth Plan and up)

Create an [**Automation**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network) that triggers when someone joins:

* Your Mighty Network, or
* A specific Space

Set the action to **Send a private message** to deliver a custom welcome automatically from any Host you choose.

## 2. Manually Message Recent Members

1. Filter your Member List by **Date Joined (Latest)**.
2. Select the members you want to message.
3. Go to **Bulk Actions > Send Message**.

## What Do Members See?

When a member receives a message:

* Their in-app notification says:​ “Your Host \[Name] sent you a message.”
* Clicking the notification opens the message.
* Clicking **Reply** opens a private chat with the Host.
  * *Reply is available on web only.*

## Additional Message Options

You can message your Space members and also welcome members to your Network and Spaces. Check out these articles for more information:

* [**How Do I Message Members in a Space?**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-message-members-in-a-space)
* [**How Do I Welcome New Members?**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-welcome-new-members)


# How Do I Move Content Between Spaces?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-move-content-between-spaces



You can move content between Spaces in your Mighty Network—and keep interactions and RSVPs when supported.

## Move Articles, Posts, and Events

If the Article or Post is pinned in the **[Welcome or Featured sections](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-and-manage-featured-and-welcome-sections)**, unpin it before moving.

1. Open the **three-dot menu** next to the post.

2. Select **Move**.

3. Choose the Space you want to move the content to.

4. If a Space is greyed out, that means the content type isn’t enabled in that Space.To enable it, go to the Space > **gear icon > [Space Features](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space) > Feed > Manage**, then toggle on the content type (Posts, Articles, Events, etc.).

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-move-content-between-spaces/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-1_55_26-PM.png)

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-move-content-between-spaces/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-1_56_09-PM.png)

Next, choose whether you want to **keep or remove interactions**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-move-content-between-spaces/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-1_57_13-PM.png)

### About Moving Events

* Only the **event creator** can move an Event.

* When moving an Event, the creator will see the option to **keep RSVPs**.

* You can duplicate an Event and change the Space if needed.

### Scheduled posts

Scheduled posts cannot be moved.To move a scheduled post:

1. Copy the content into a new Post, Article, or Question.

2. Reschedule the new post.

3. Delete the original.

## Move Lessons, Sections, and Quizzes

You can move **[Lessons](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons)**, [Sections,](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons) and **[Quizzes](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-add-a-quiz-to-my-course)** to another Space.

1. Open the **three-dot menu** for the item.

2. Select **Move Lesson**, **Move Section**, or **Move Quiz**.

3. Choose the Space you want to move it to.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-move-content-between-spaces/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-2_00_36-PM.png)

### What transfers when you move course content

* Content and settings

* Comments

* Member progress (see details below)

* Quiz responses

* Automations

* Any links to the content (Articles, Pages, Landing Pages, or emails) will continue to work

### About Moving Course Content

* The destination Space must have the **[Course](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space)** feature enabled, and you must have permission to create Lessons there.

* If you move a Section, **all Lessons in the Section** move with it.

* You **cannot** move the Course Overview.

* Moved content appears at the bottom of the list. You can reorder it after moving.Content cannot be moved in bulk at this time.

### Member Progress

* If a member is already in the destination Space, their progress moves with the content.

* If they are not in the Space, their progress will appear once they join.

## Move Multiple Posts

You can move multiple posts from one Space to another. This feature is available to both **Space Hosts** and **Network Hosts**.

1. Open the **three-dot menu** next to the Space in the left navigation.

2. Select **More > Move Multiple Posts**.

   * If you are a **Network Host** but not a Space Host, you will be prompted to become a Space Host first before proceeding with the bulk move.

3. Choose whether you want to move **All Posts** or posts with a **specific hashtag**.

   * This is helpful for reorganizing content across Spaces or updating your hashtag structure.

4. Select the destination Space.

   * You can only move posts to a Space where you are a **Host**.

5. Click **Move Posts**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-move-content-between-spaces/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-2_03_05-PM.png)

### About Moving Multiple Posts

* Reactions, comments, and interactions will move with the posts.

* If you don’t see certain posts, check whether their **[content types](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space)** are enabled in the destination Space.


# How Do I Use the Infinite Question Engine?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-use-the-infinite-question-engine



<iframe />

The Infinite Question Engine generates an ongoing list of questions and polls tailored to your Space or your [Network’s Big Purpose](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/whats-a-big-purpose).

It gives you an easy way to spark conversations, keep engagement consistent, and help members share their stories, experiences, and ideas.

This feature is available on [**Scale Plans**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-business-plan) and above.

## Why It’s Valuable

Great questions drive engagement. They help people connect, learn something new, and return to your Space. When we analyzed engagement patterns across Mighty Networks, we saw that the most effective questions are:

* Concrete and specific
* Answerable in under a minute
* Able to spark deeper conversation in the comments

The Infinite Question Engine creates an endless, relevant supply of these high-performing questions.

You can choose to have the feature auto-post questions daily or weekly, or manually schedule them whenever you prefer.

## How to Turn On the Infinite Question Engine

1. Navigate to the **Space** where you want to enable the feature.
2. Select the **gear icon**.
3. Go to **Space Features > Feed**.
4. Scroll to **Infinite Question Engine** and toggle it **On**.
5. Scroll to the bottom and select **Save**.
6. After saving, select **See Questions** to view your automatically generated list.

The list can include **Multiple Choice polls**, **Hot Cold polls**, **Percentage polls**, and standard questions.

## Enabling Auto-Post

If you toggle **Auto-Post** on, the Infinite Question Engine can automatically publish questions in the order they appear in your list.

You can choose:

* **Weekly** (Mondays at 7am PT)
* **Daily** (7am PT)

After enabling Auto-Post, you’ll also see an option to enable **Notify All**, which notifies all members in the Space when a new question is posted.

You’ll then see the **next post in the queue**, along with the questions that follow.

**Important:**

* The Space Host who turns on Auto-Post is shown as the post creator.
* If another Space Host toggles Auto-Post off and then on again, the future posts will appear as coming from their account.

If you prefer full control, keep Auto-Post off and manually post or schedule questions.

## Editing Questions

From the **three-dot menu** next to each question, you can:

* **Edit** the text
* Add elements such as hashtags
* **Regenerate** all questions using the refresh button

If you regenerate the full list, you’ll be asked to confirm before replacing all questions.

## Posting Questions

The three-dot menu also gives you the option to:

* **Post Now**
* **Schedule** the question for a future date and time

Both posting methods allow you to choose whether to **Notify All** members.

## How Attribution Works

When the Infinite Question Engine is first activated, it creates pending questions attributed to the Host who turned it on, but they are not posted automatically.

You have three ways to publish questions, each with its own attribution:

1. **Activate Auto-Post**
   * All questions generated after Auto-Post is enabled will be attributed to the Host who turned Auto-Post on.
2. **Schedule a Post**
   * Scheduled posts are attributed to the person who scheduled them.
   * Scheduled posts move into **Scheduled Posts**, where you can update, reschedule, or delete them before they publish.
3. **Post Immediately**
   * Questions posted via **Post Now** are attributed to whoever posts them.

This structure ensures clarity and avoids confusion about who authored each post.

## Privacy of Responses

## Multiple Choice Polls

* Responses default to **public**.
* You can change this before posting.
* After posting, you can adjust privacy until the first response is submitted (web only).

## Percentage and Hot & Cold Polls

* Responses are always **private**.
* Their privacy settings cannot be changed at any point.


# How Do I Welcome New Members?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-welcome-new-members



Welcoming new members each day is one of the simplest ways to help people feel recognized and connected from the moment they join your Mighty Network or Space

.

A quick welcome message goes a long way in creating an inviting, active community.

## Welcome New Network Members

Network Hosts and Network moderators can welcome new [**full members**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) at any time.

* Go to **Admin > Members > [Member List](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members)**.
* Open the **three-dot menu** in the upper-right corner.
* Select **Welcome New Members**.

You’ll see a list of everyone who has joined since the last welcome was sent. When you tap **Welcome New Members**, each person receives a short note from you by email or push notification, depending on their individual notification settings.

<img alt="" />

## Welcome New Space Members

1. Go to the **Space gear icon**.
2. Select **Members > Member List**.
3. Open the **three-dot menu** in the upper-right corner.
4. Select **Welcome New Members**.

<img alt="" />

## What Members See

After you tap on the button to **welcome new members**, those members will receive a quick note from you either via email or push notification, depending on [**their notification preferences**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-member)**.**

Here is what the **push notification looks like**

## Customizing and Automating Welcome Messages

There are two ways to personalize your welcome messages.

## Use Automations (Growth Plan and up)

You can create an [**Automation**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network) that triggers when someone joins your Mighty Network. The action can be set to send a **private message** from any Host you choose.

You can also send different welcome messages when members join specific **Spaces**, such as Courses or challenges.

## Send Manual Messages Using Filters

1. Go to the **Member List**.
2. Filter by**Joined Network (Latest)**.
3. Select the members you want to message.
4. Open the **bulk actions** menu and choose **Send Message to Full Members**.

To learn more about bulk actions and messaging, see our [related article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members).

## Notifications for Hosts

Hosts and moderators receive **real-time notifications** when a new member joins a Network or Space.

If many members join at once, they’ll be grouped into a single notification to avoid overwhelming your team.

You can click the notification to view new member profiles.

## Managing Welcome Messages Across Your Host Team

Every Host has access to the **Welcome New Members** feature, and the count of new members shown is unique for each Host. Because welcome notes come from individual Hosts, multiple Hosts may welcome the same new members.

If you want to avoid sending too many notifications to new members, consider designating **one Host** to send daily welcomes.

## Additional Ways to Welcome New Members

You can add a [**Welcome Section**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-and-manage-featured-and-welcome-sections) to the top of your Feed so new members immediately see helpful context about your Mighty Network.

Each new member also gets a **New Member** badge on their profile for their first 7 days.


# How Do Introductions Posts Work?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-introductions-posts-work



**Introduction posts** are one of the most engaging types of posts in your Mighty Network. Along with **[Questions](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-polls-questions-in-my-mighty-network)** [and Polls](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-polls-questions-in-my-mighty-network), they consistently help increase member engagement.

When someone joins your Mighty Network and completes their profile, an Introduction post is automatically created in the **[Global Feed](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-global-features)** to help them meet other members.

**Note:** Introduction posts appear only in the Global Feed on web and mobile. They don’t appear inside a Space.

# How Do Storage, Engagement Boosts and Livestreaming Limits Work?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-storage-engagement-boosts-and-livestreaming-limits-work



This article covers how storage works in your Mighty Network, how monthly Livestreaming limits are calculated, and how Engagement Boosts expand your limits.

## Storage Included by Plan

Each Mighty pricing plan comes with built-in storage

* **Launch Plan:** 200GB
* **Scale Plan:** 500GB
* **Growth Plan:** 1TB
* **Mighty Pro:** Contact our team for details

If you need more storage, you can add an Engagement Boost.

## What Counts Toward My Storage Limit?

The following count toward your storage:

* Uploaded videos in **Posts** and **Articles**
* Livestream recordings
* Photos
* GIFs
* Files

**These do not count toward storage:**

* Native videos uploaded to **Course Overview**, **Sections**, or **Lessons** (on legacy plans with unlimited course videos only; newer plans include course videos in storage limits)

## How to Check Your Storage

You’ll receive Network notifications as you approach or exceed your storage limit. You can also check anytime by going to:

**Admin > Mighty Billing Plan > Your Plan > Storage and Usage**

## Livestreaming Limits by Plan

Your monthly Livestreaming allowance depends on your pricing plan:

| ### Plan   | ### Monthly Hours | ### Simultaneous Viewers |
| ---------- | :---------------: | :----------------------: |
| **Launch** |         20        |            100           |
| **Scale**  |         30        |            200           |
| **Growth** |         40        |           1000           |

If you need more streaming hours or more viewers, you can purchase an Engagement Boost.

## Maximum Livestream Length

* Each Livestream can be up to **2 hours** long.
* Livestreams **cannot** be extended beyond the 2-hour limit.

## Do Livestream Hours Rollover?

No. Unused hours do not roll over. Your hours reset at the start of your billing month, based on the day you originally signed up.

## Do Non-Recorded Livestreams Count Toward Storage?

No. Only recorded Livestreams count toward your storage.

## How to Check How Many Livestream Hours You Have Left

Go to:

**Admin > Mighty Billing Plan > Your Plan > Storage and Usage**

You’ll see your remaining hours and an option to add an Engagement Boost.

## What Are Engagement Boosts?

Engagement Boosts let you increase your:

* Monthly Livestreaming hours
* Maximum simultaneous viewers
* Total storage

You can add a Boost by visiting:

**Admin > Mighty Billing Plan > Your Plan > Storage and Usage**

|                        | Launch Plan | Scale Plan | Engagement Boost Plan 1 | Engagement Boost Plan 2 | Engagement Boost Plan 3 |
| ---------------------- | :---------: | :--------: | :---------------------: | :---------------------: | :---------------------: |
| Streaming Hours/Month  |      20     |     30     |         30 hours        |         40 hours        |         50 hours        |
| **Concurrent Viewers** |     100     |     200    |           500           |          1,000          |          3,000          |
| **Total Storage**      |    200GB    |    500GB   |           2TB           |           3TB           |           4TB           |
| **Monthly Price**      |   \$119/mo  |  \$219/mo  |         +\$35/mo        |         +\$75/mo        |        +\$225/mo        |

**Mighty Pro and Growth Hosts:** Contact our team to purchase additional hours or storage.

## Are Engagement Boosts Refundable?

Engagement Boosts are **not** refundable. If your Mighty Network is canceled, you’ll keep Boost features through the end of your billing cycle.

## What Happens If I Downgrade My Boost?

You’ll receive a prorated refund for the difference between the higher Boost and the lower one.

## How to Cancel an Engagement Boost

Go to:

**Admin > Mighty Billing Plan > Your Plan > Storage and Usage > Cancel Boost**

## Livestream Permissions for Space Hosts and Moderators

On **Growth** and **Mighty Pro**, Network Hosts can enable Livestream permissions in specific Spaces for Space Hosts or Network moderators by contacting our team.


# How Does Chat Work in a Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-does-chat-work-in-a-mighty-network



**Chat** is a simple, powerful way for members to connect and keep conversations flowing—whether it’s one-on-one or in a group of any size.

## Ways to Use Chat

Here are a few ways you and your members can use chat in your Mighty Network:

* Introduce members to each other and then leave the chat
* Quickly coordinate meetup plans for a group in a group chat
* Reach out directly to someone who shares a common interest or goal
* Gather recommendations for books, movies, or music in a Space chat
* And much more

Chat is a light, engaging way to keep your members connected and let the people magic flow in your Mighty Network.

We offer:

* **Private chats** between 2 members
* **Group chats** with no limit on how many members you can add
* **Space chats** that let members connect inside each Space

# Types of Chat

## Private Chat

To start a chat with a member:

* Click the **chat** icon in the upper right corner.
* Select **+** to start a new chat.
* Search for and select the member you want to include.
* Click **Start Chat**

**Note:** Only [full members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) can access private and group chats.

You can also start a private chat by visiting a member’s profile and selecting **Chat**.

<Frame>
  <img alt="New Chat 1" />
</Frame>

## Group Chat

* Click the **chat** icon in the upper right corner.
* Select **+** to start a new chat.
* Search for and select the member you want to include.
  * You will be able to add up to 50 members at a time, however there is no limit to how many people can be in a group chat.

## Managing a Conversation

* Click on the three dot menu > Settings to see options to:
  * **Customize** the name of the chat
  * **Add/remove** people
  * **Mute** the conversation
  * **Bookmark** the conversation
  * **Archive** the conversation
  * **Leave** the conversation
  * Any participant can do this, including in a 1:1 chat.

  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 27 At 2 03 55 PM 1" title="Screenshot 2026 07 27 At 2 03 55 PM 1" />
</Frame>

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 01 47 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 01 47 AM" />
</Frame>

## Adding and Removing Members

### Adding Members

Go to conversation settings in the three dot menu and select the + icon  to add up to 50 members at a time. There’s no limit on how large a group chat can grow.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 32 30 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 32 30 AM" />
</Frame>

  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 03 07 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 03 07 AM" />
</Frame>

The member list won’t show people who are already in the chat, have private chat disabled, are blocked, or are limited members.

If a conversation with the same people already exists, we’ll ask whether you want to add them there or start a new conversation.

**Added members:**

* See the full conversation history from the beginning of the chat when they join
* Won’t get a notified that they were added but they will see an unread count on their chat icon for any messages they haven’t viewed yet

### Removing Members

Any member can select and remove another member from the conversation by clicking the three dot menu next to their name:

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 05 03 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 05 03 AM" />
</Frame>

**Removed Members**

* Won't get notified that they were removed
* If they happen to be inside the conversation when it happens, they’ll see a message that they’re no longer part of the chat. The conversation disappears from their list the next time they navigate away or refresh.

## System Messages

When someone is added, removed, leaves, or renames a conversation, everyone in the chat sees a message describing what changed.

## Space Chat

When **Space Chat** is [turned on](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space#:~:text=are%20the%20features%3A-,Chat,-An%20open%20chat), members can chat directly inside a Space.

<img alt="" />

You’ll see Space chat notifications:

* As a number indicator in the left navigation next to the Space
* In your **conversation list**

To learn how to manage the chat messages in the conversation list, check out the article "[How Do I Manage My Chat Messages?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-manage-my-chat-messages)"

You can delete messages by hovering over them and selecting **Delete**.

<img alt="" />

## Ways to Interact in Chat

## Voice Notes

<iframe />

You can record and send voice notes (up to 10 minutes long) in any type of chat on web or mobile!

<img alt="" />

**Voice Notes** will be on by default in every Space and you can toggle them on or off per Space.

You will not be able to toggle them off at the Network level.

Inside of **Space Admin > Features > Chat** you also have the ability to choose who (in a Space) is able to create Voice Notes:

* Hosts and moderators
* Everyone

The media in voice notes will count towards the [storage](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-storage-engagement-boosts-and-livestreaming-limits-work) for your Mighty Network.

<img alt="" />

## @ Mentions

In all types of chats, you can @ mention people by typing “@” followed by their name.

<img alt="" />

When you mention someone in a chat, they’ll get an in-app and mobile push notification.

If you mention someone who doesn’t have access to the chat, you’ll see an error message:

“This member will not be notified because they are not a member of this Chat.”

## Chat Replies

**Replies** help keep conversations organized, easier to follow, and more fun.

You can reply in Space, private, or group chats by selecting the **reply** icon.

When enabled, replies trigger in-app and push notifications.

Chat threads also appear in your **conversation list** and begin with “Replies to.”

To learn more, see [**How Do I Manage My Chat Messages?**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-does-chat-work-in-a-mighty-network#)

## GIFs and Emoji Reactions

React with [GIFs or emojis](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-gifs-in-my-mighty-network) by simply selecting the icons!

<img alt="" />
