## Add Files

You can also add files locally from your computer to a chat!

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 04 At 7 50 17 AM" />
</Frame>

## Private Chat Options

Network Hosts can choose to turn off private chat for all members or allow members to manage chat preferences individually.

To adjust these settings:

1. Go to **Admin > Members > Member Settings > Private Chat**.

From there:

* **Toggle off** private chat to prevent members from chatting directly. (The “+” icon to start a chat will be removed, but members will still receive Space chat notifications.)
* **Allow members to control private chat** individually by toggling the second option on.

When enabled, each member can go to **Personal Settings > Chat** to turn private chat on or off for themselves.

Because any participant can add someone to a conversation, a 1:1 chat isn’t guaranteed to stay just between 2 people unless everyone in it chooses to keep it that way.

## Start a Conversation (AI Feature)

Available on **the Launch plans and up**, [**Start a Conversation**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have) suggests conversation starters in new chats.

When opening a direct message or group chat with someone you haven’t chatted with before, select **Suggest a Conversation Starter**.

You’ll see a draft message based on your profiles and shared interests—you can send it as-is, edit it, or select **Try Again** for a new suggestion.

# How Does the Delphi Embed Work?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-does-the-delphi-embed-work



The **[Delphi embed](https://www.delphi.ai/)** allows members to interact with Delphi—a customizable AI assistant built from your own content—directly inside your Mighty Network, with a seamless, identity-aware experience across web, iOS, and Android.

While anyone on the [Delphi Builder plan](https://www.delphi.ai/pricing) and up can use the standard embed integration, the enhanced embed (with instant sign-in) for [Delphi Scaler plan](https://www.delphi.ai/pricing) and up is [application-only](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1iie_fsHwM_eAHOq5sYgSlfyT_0Yh3Fsmi9L9tWZWjak/edit) right now to make sure that everyone gets white-glove setup and support.

<iframe />

## What the Delphi Embed Includes

## Verified Identity Pass-through

When members are logged in and have a verified email, Mighty securely shares their verified email address and user ID with Delphi (after the member gives consent). This allows Delphi to:

* Recognize the member

* Restore previous conversations

* Maintain progress without additional authentication

If a member’s email is not verified, they will be prompted to verify it before continuing.

Delphi opens smoothly on any device and fits the member’s screen without extra scrolling. This works in Pages, Articles, and course lessons on web, iOS, and Android.

On web, Delphi can open in a clean, full-screen view that gives members more room to read, chat, and use voice features—similar to the experience on mobile.

## Where You Can Embed Delphi

On the **[Growth plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan)** and up, Hosts can embed Delphi in:

* **[Pages](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space)**

* **[Articles](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network)**

* **[Course Lessons](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons)**

## How to Add a Delphi Embed

* Select the Space where you want to add Delphi.

* Add or edit a **Page**, **Article**, or **Course Lesson**.

* Select **Add Embed**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-does-the-delphi-embed-work/Screenshot-2025-12-01-at-11_34_09-AM.png)

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-does-the-delphi-embed-work/Screenshot-2025-12-01-at-11_34_30-AM.png)

* Paste your Delphi embed code.

* Publish your changes.

## What Members Experience

Members interacting with Delphi will:

1. Open the embed in a modal-style or full-screen view.

2. Consent to sharing their verified identity (if needed).

3. Access previous conversations and progress automatically.

4. Use chat or voice without separate logins.

## Requirements

* Your Delphi team must enable the enhanced embed for your account.

* The enhanced experience requires the **Scaler** Delphi plan.

* Members must have a verified email for identity pass-through.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Will members know their information is shared with Delphi?**

Yes. Members must give consent before verified identity is shared.

**Is this experience white-labeled?**

Members will see that their information is shared with Delphi.

**Does this support chat and voice?**

Yes.

**How many Delphi products can a Host use?**

Up to 20 on the Scaler plan.

**Can a Delphi product be used as something other than a digital twin?**

Yes. It can represent a teaching assistant, coach, or any topic-specific guide.


# What Notifications Do My Members Get?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/what-notifications-do-my-members-get



Notifications help your members stay connected to all the activity happening in your Mighty Network.

This article covers how notifications are sent, what types members can expect, and how they can manage their preferences.

## How Members Receive Notifications

Members can receive notifications in **a few different ways**:

## In-App Notifications

* Delivered via the **bell icon** in the web or mobile app.
* Sent based on each member’s personal notification settings.

## Email Notifications (On by Default)

* Sent to the email address the member used to join.
* Members can choose their frequency:
  * **As Activity Happens**
  * **Daily Digest** (default setting)
* Can be turned off anytime in **Personal Settings > Notifications**.

## Mobile Push Notifications (Off by Default)

* Appear on a member’s mobile device when new activity occurs.
* Can be enabled or disabled in **Notification Settings** on mobile.

## Desktop Notifications

* Pop-up messages that appear in the browser when the Mighty Network tab isn’t active.
* Can be turned on or off in **Notification Settings**.

## Pop-Up Notifications (On by Default)

* Appear briefly in the bottom corner of the screen.
* Used for direct messages and Space chat messages.

## Managing Notifications

Members can manage their notification preferences anytime.

Go to:​**Profile Picture > Personal Settings > Notifications**

Here, members can toggle notifications for:

* Activity on their posts
* Mentions and comments
* Events, polls, and chats
* Email or push notification frequency

## Plan Deactivation Notifications

When you deactivate a **plan**, members may or may not receive notifications depending on the plan type:

* If the plan includes payments: Members receive an email notification that says: “Your subscription to \[Plan Name] has been canceled.”
* If the plan does not include payments (free plan): Members will **not** receive an email or in-app notification.

**Tip:** If you’re deactivating multiple legacy free plans, you can do so without sending cancellation emails.

Members will also **not** be notified if you manually remove them from a plan.

## Waitlist Notifications

When someone joins a [Waitlist](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-waitlist), they automatically receive a confirmation email—even if they don't have a Mighty Networks account yet.

If they're already a full member of your Network, they'll also get an in-app or push notification.

## Other Important Notifications

### Account Notifications (Cannot Be Disabled)

These are essential messages that always send, including:

* Welcome emails, invites, and reminders
* Password resets and sign-in confirmations
* [Badges](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members) awarded
* Login summaries
* Notifications when added to a Network or Space

### Payment Notifications

Members will automatically receive:

* Renewal reminders
* Payment success or failure emails (including payment update prompts)
* Free trial reminders (sent 3 days before the trial ends)
* Notifications when moved to a different plan

### Member Profile Notifications

Members receive alerts for:

* Reactions and comments on their posts
* @Mentions
* Event reminders
* Updates from Hosts

### Space Notifications

* Members can customize notifications for each individual Space.
* Changes to [**lessons or sections**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons) in a Space with the Course feature may also trigger notifications.

For a full breakdown check out our related articles:

* [What Kind of Notifications Will I Receive as a Member of a Mighty Network?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-member)
* [What Kind of Notifications Will I Get as a Mighty Networks Host?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-host)


# What Notifications Will I Get as a Host?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-host



<iframe />

Notifications keep you updated about activity happening in your Mighty Network. You can manage what you’re notified about—and how you’re notified—by clicking your profile picture and going to **Personal Settings > Notifications**.

If you want to see how notifications work for members, check out **[What Notifications Do My Members Get?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/what-notifications-do-my-members-get)**

## Ways You Receive Notifications

You can receive notifications in five ways:

* **In-app notifications** (on by default)

* **Email notifications** (on by default when joining from desktop or mobile app)

* **Mobile push notifications** (off by default)

* **Desktop notifications** (off by default)

* **Pop-up notifications** (on by default on web)

## In-app notifications

You’ll see these via the bell icon:

* Upper-right corner on desktop and mobile web

* Bottom-right corner on the iOS or Android app

## Email notifications

Sent based on your email notification settings. New members receive the **[Daily Digest](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/whats-the-daily-digest)**[](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/whats-the-daily-digest)by default.

## Mobile push notifications

Appear on your device when activity happens. You can enable these after downloading the Mighty Networks app.

## Desktop notifications

Off by default. See our **[desktop notifications article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-enable-desktop-notifications)** to learn how to enable them.

## Pop-up notifications

Temporary notifications shown on web and mobile web for:

* Private chat messages

* Space Chat messages

To mute Space Chat messages for a Space, open the **three-dot menu** next to the Space and select **Mute Chat**.

Private, group, and Space chat messages also appear in the **chat icon** in the upper-right corner.

## Mark Notifications as Read or Unread

On web, select the **three-dot menu** next to a notification to mark it as **Read** or **Unread**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-host/Screenshot-2025-11-23-at-7_37_49-PM.png)

## Email Notifications

## Turning email notifications on or off

Go to **Personal Settings > Notifications**, then toggle **Email Updates** on or off.

Email notifications are sent as a **Daily Digest** unless you switch to **As Activity Happens**.

## Why you may see “Unsubscribed”

You may be marked as unsubscribed if:

* Your email provider flags **@mn.co**

* Filters automatically bounce Mighty Networks emails

* You marked a Mighty email as spam

* Your email provider has **@mn.co** on a blocklist

We recommend [safelisting@mn.co](https://thegoodlifepath.org/safelist/) with your email provider.

If you need to resubscribe, you’ll see a **Contact Support** button in your settings.

## Email Frequency Options

## Daily Digest(default)

Sent at **5pm local time** and includes unread notifications from the day.

If you click an in-app notification before the Daily Digest sends, it will not appear in the digest.

The Daily Digest may include:

* **New Posts & Activity**

* **New Course Content**

* **Welcome messages**

* **Notify All Members** messages

* **Ambassador Program Updates**

## Notifications that bypass the Daily Digest

These always send immediately:

* Message All Members (from Hosts)

* Your Host just went Live

* Event reminders

* User or post reported (Network Host only)

* Member delete or deactivate

* Plan purchases

## Mobile Push Notifications

Mobile push notifications are off by default. To turn them on:

1. Download the **[Mighty Networks app.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/does-mighty-networks-have-an-app)**

2. Open **Personal Settings > Notifications** and toggle push notifications on.

If you previously denied notifications at the device level, update your device settings to allow notifications from the Mighty Networks app.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-host/9031134654349)

## Chat Notifications

Private chat and group chat notifications send as mobile push, an in-app toast, and an unread counter. There’s no email option for chat, including 1:1 chats.

* If mobile push is off for chat, the email toggle is disabled too, so you can’t end up with chat updates by email only
* **Private Chat Messages** and **Space Chat Messages** sit next to each other in your notification settings

If you turn push off on mobile, you’ll see a prompt to turn it back on.

## Choosing Which Notifications You Receive

By default, all notification types are on except **All Posts**.

You can adjust which notifications send via:

* Email

* Mobile push

In-app notifications will always appear for anything you have toggled on.

* \*\*Reactions On Your Stuff:\*\*When others emoji react on Posts, Articles, Questions, Polls, and Comments you created.

* **Comments On Your Stuff:** When others comment on Posts, Articles, Events, Questions, and Polls you created.

* **Comments After You:** If others comment after your comment or reply in a thread, you will be notified. However, you will not be notified about replies to other comments in the thread.

* \*\*@Mentions:\*\*When others tag you directly in a Post, Comment or Chat.

* \*\*Updates From Your Hosts:\*\*When a Host posts or sends a Message to All Members.

* **Event Updates and Reminders:** When an Event Host sends an update or when reminders are sent before an Event starts. If this is toggled off, the creator of an Event will also not get notifications about members RSVPing to the Event.

* **Poll Answers and Results:** When others vote on your Poll.

* \*\*Activities Relevant to You:\*\*When people near you join, or when there is relevant trending activity.

* **Activities From Members You Follow:** When a member you follow publishes a post

* **Private Chat Messages:** Push and in-app notification when other members and Hosts send you private chat messages, including chat replies. No email option.

* **Space Chat Messages:** Push and in-app notification for messages from other members in a Space, including chat replies. No email option.

* \*\*Ambassador Notifications:\*\*When a member you referred joins the Network, and when you level up your Ambassador status.

* **Livestream:** When a Host goes live anywhere in the Network.

* **All Posts:** When any new Post is published

* \*\*Hosts and Moderators: Invite Requests:\*\*Be notified of new requests to join. Only Hosts and Moderators of the Mighty Network, and of any Private Space can see this.

* **Hosts and Moderators: New Members Joined:** Be notified when new members join the Mighty Network or Space. Only Hosts and Moderators see this.

* **Hosts and Moderators: Member Purchases Plan:** Be notified when members purchase a plan.

* \*\*Hosts and Moderators: Checklist Completed:\*\*Receive a notification each time a member in the Network completes their Welcome Checklist.

* **Hosts and Moderators: Waitlist Signups:** Be notified whenever someone joins a [Waitlist](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-waitlist). This notification is turned on by default.

* **Host: Member Delete and Deactivate Notification:** Receive an email notification after a member has deleted or deactivated their account. (This email will send even if you are unsubscribed from emails.)

## Space Notifications

At the bottom of your Notifications list, you can turn notifications on or off for specific Spaces.

If a Space includes a Course, you can choose to notify all members when making **Lessons** or **Sections** visible.

**Note:** If email or push notifications are turned off at the Network level, Space-level notifications will not send.

## Other Notifications You May Receive

You will also receive the following types of notifications that won’t appear in the Daily Digest:

## Account-specific:

* Welcomes, invites, reminders, and approvals to join a Mighty Network or Space.

* List of Mighty Networks you’re a member of (when requested via mightynetworks.com)

* Password or sign-in-related notifications

## Network Host:

* Reported users, posts, and hidden posts (when a post is reported by at least two members, it will be hidden from the Activity Feed)

* Event duplication notification

* Downloaded Member list, Plan list

* Custom domain status updates (ready to activate, activated, and failed)

* Plan approved/rejected by Apple

* Income reports are available

* Member(s) that have subscription(s) ending (members who have canceled active subscriptions and their subscription will be ending that week)

* Currency is ready to be made Visible/has failed

* Quaderno account disconnected

* Your Mighty Network’s Plan payment confirmed or lapsed

* You will not receive an email before your Mighty Network's plan is set to renew.

* Upgrades to your Mighty Network’s Plan

* Changes to your Mighty Network’s Plan Interval (e.g., from Monthly to Annual)

* Members have been **[directly added](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/12573318-how-do-i-directly-add-members-to-my-network-or-spaces)** to the Network or Space(s)

## Space Host:

* Download Space Member List

* Event RSVP download

## Network/Space Moderator:

* Event duplication

* Event RSVP download

## Space (Host or Moderator):

* You have been assigned a Section or Lesson

* Duplication of a Course, Section, Lesson that you are assigned.

* Comments on a Lesson you are the Instructor for. (If other Course Instructors want to receive these notifications, they need to toggle on “All Posts” in their notification settings).


# What's An Icebreaker Question and How Do I Set One Up in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/whats-an-icebreaker-question-and-how-do-i-set-one-up-in-my-mighty-network



An Icebreaker Question is an inviting prompt that helps new members share something about themselves as soon as they join your Mighty Network. It’s the first thing they see when they enter a Space, and it’s designed to spark meaningful interaction and set the tone for an engaged community from day one.

## Set Up an Icebreaker Question

## Enable the Feed Feature

1. Go to the Space where you want to add an Icebreaker Question.
2. Click the **gear icon** to open Space settings.
3. Select **Space Features**.
4. Toggle on [**Feed**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work).

## Add an Icebreaker Question

Once the Feed is enabled, scroll down to the bottom under **Engagement Tools**

Toggle on the **Icebreaker Question** and select **Manage**.

Choose a simple, direct prompt that encourages sharing, such as:

* “What’s one thing you want to get from a community of peers?”
* “What is your #1 goal for this year?”
* “Where do you want to be in five years?”
* “What’s one new thing you tried today? How did it go?”

## Using AI to Generate Icebreaker Questions

Available on the [**Launch plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and above, you will see "Suggest Ideas".

This AI feature will suggest Icebreaker Questions that fit the tone of your community.

## Manage Your Icebreaker Question

After adding a question:

* Select **Manage** > **View Answers** to preview how it appears to members.
* Click **Ask a Different Question** to replace it.
* Turn off the Icebreaker Question feature to remove it.

## What Members See

When new members join the Space, the Icebreaker Question is pinned at the **top of the Space Feed**.

Members can browse other content immediately, but they must answer the Icebreaker Question before posting in the Feed. This ensures their first contribution is intentional and helps establish a meaningful connection from the start.

Once they submit their response, they can post freely throughout the Space.

## Keep the Conversation Going

After your Icebreaker Question sparks that first connection, deepen engagement with [**regular polls and questions**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-polls-questions-in-my-mighty-network). These tools help you surface insights, spark conversation, and keep your community active.


# What's the Daily Digest?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/whats-the-daily-digest



The **Daily Digest** is an email sent to members each day at **5pm in their local time zone**. It includes a summary of their **unread notifications**, making it easier for them to catch up on everything happening in your Mighty Network.

After extensive testing, we’ve found this digest to be one of the most effective ways to bring members back into your Mighty Network—so it’s **enabled by default** for all new members.

Members can manage this setting at any time by going to:

​[Personal Settings](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-manage-my-personal-settings) > Notifications

## What the Daily Digest Can Include

Depending on the Spaces a member is part of and the activity they follow, the Daily Digest may include:

* **New Posts & Activity:** New content, comments, @Mentions, and one-on-one Private Chat messages, plus Event and Poll updates
* **New Course Content**
* **Welcome Invites** to your Mighty Network or Spaces
* **Notify All Members** messages
* **New Members:** Members who joined with similar Custom Field answers or Members Near You
* **Ambassador Program Updates:** Referred members and new Ambassador levels reached

## Notifications Sent in Real Time

Some notifications are always delivered immediately and do **not** wait for the Daily Digest:

* **Message All Members** (sent by Hosts)
* **Your Host just went Live**
* **Event reminders**
* **Welcome Checklist Reminder**

## When the Daily Digest Is Sent

If there are **no unread notifications**, the Daily Digest will not be sent for that day.


# How Do I Make a Habit Tracker for My Members?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-make-a-habit-tracker-for-my-members



## Step 1: Create Your Space

1. Create a new **[Space](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces)**[.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces)

2. Choose a **[Content only Course template](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-kinds-of-space-templates-are-available)**

3. Or enable **[only the Course feature](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space)**[](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space)inside that Space.

4. Give your Space a clear name, such as **Daily Wellness Tasks** or **Habit Tracker**.

5. Use the[Instant Course Outline](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have) to help you brainstorm your daily, weekly, or recurring tasks.

Each task becomes a **Lesson** that members check off as they complete it.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-make-a-habit-tracker-for-my-members/Screenshot-2025-11-19-at-3_43_23-PM.png)

## Step 2: Allow Members to Reset Their Progress

To let members repeat your checklist on a schedule (daily, weekly, monthly—whatever fits):

1. Go to **Space Settings**.

2. Scroll to **Space Features** and select **Course**.

3. Scroll to the bottom and toggle on **Reset Progress**.

Members will now be able to restart the checklist anytime.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-make-a-habit-tracker-for-my-members/Screenshot-2025-11-19-at-3_44_17-PM.png)

## Step 3: Adjust Privacy and Access

Return to your Space’s **Privacy & Access** settings.

For habit-tracker Spaces, we suggest enabling **[Auto Join](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/6666839-how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-a-space)**, which automatically adds all members of your Mighty Network to the Space. This makes participation effortless and boosts engagement.

## Step 4: Add Optional Engagement Features

Want to make the experience more interactive?

You can enable additional features like **[Chat](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space)** [or Feed](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space) so members can:

* Share updates

* Celebrate wins

* Offer tips or accountability

* Build habits together

To enable more features, go to **Space Settings > Space Features**.

## Habit Tracker Ideas

Here are some ideas to help you build your checklist:

* **Daily Exercise** — Walk, jog, yoga, strength training, or stretching.

* **Meditation** — Track time spent in silent or guided meditation.

* **Healthy Eating** — Fruits, vegetables, water intake, or sticking to a plan.

* **Reading** — Daily reading minutes or chapters.

* **Gratitude Journaling** — List things you’re grateful for each day.

* **Sleep Tracking** — Set bedtime routines or monitor sleep duration.

* **Language Learning** — Practice vocabulary or complete daily lessons.

* **Productivity** — Mark off priority tasks or focused work blocks.

* **Hygiene** — Flossing, skincare, tidying a space.

* **Financial Tracking** — Log spending or savings contributions.

* **Creative Expression** — Writing, drawing, music, or crafting time.

* **Social Connection** — Reach out to a friend or family member.

* **Mindfulness** — Pause for breathing or reflection.

* **Limiting Screen Time** — Track intentional breaks from devices.

* **Self-Reflection** — Daily journaling or goal check-ins.

# Can I Charge for Events on a Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-charge-for-events-on-a-mighty-network



To charge for a single event using Plans, you’ll create a dedicated **Space** and use the **Single Event** feature inside that Space available on the Launch Plan and above.

Members will purchase a plan that grants access to the Space, and then they can attend the Event.

## Step 1: Create a Space and Enable the Single Event Feature

* Create a new [**Space**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-create-and-manage-my-spaces).
* Enable the **Single Event** feature inside that Space by going to the gear icon > Features > Single Event.
* [**Create a plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-plan) that only offers access to that Space. Members must purchase a plan to enter and attend the Event.

Note: You’ll still need to edit and customize the **plan’s landing page** separately from the Event listing.

## Step 2: Create the Event

Fill out the event details with the title, time, imagery and more.

For more information on how to set up Events, [**check out this article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network).

## Manage the Space After the Event

Once the Event is over, you can either:

### Option 1: Archive the Space

This removes the Space entirely for everyone.

### Option 2: Keep the Space and Adjust Its Settings

You can restrict visibility and access by updating:

* **Invite-Only** → *Only Hosts and moderators*
* **Who Can See This Space** → *Only logged-in members*
* **Who Can Find This Space** → *Only logged-in members*

Then you can post a **recap or replay** in the Space for members to rewatch.

Members will also need to [**RSVP**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-manage-rsvps-and-event-attendees) to the Event to receive notifications.


# Can I Create Recurring Events in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-create-recurring-events-in-my-mighty-network



Once your Mighty Network is on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and up, you can [**create Events**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network) that bring your members together in real time.

For any Event Type, you can make the Event a **Repeat Event**. This allows you to set up one Event that repeats on a schedule.

Repeat Events use a single **master Event**. The Event title, description, and meeting link stay the same across the series. To change these details, you will need to edit the master Event instead of individual instances.

If you want the flexibility to adjust titles or descriptions for each Event, consider **duplicating an Event** instead of creating a series.

## How to Create a Repeat Event

1. When creating or editing an Event, scroll to the **Event Time** section.
2. Toggle **Repeat Event** on.
3. Choose how often the Event repeats: daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, every 3 months, every 6 months, yearly, or a custom interval.

If you select **Custom**, you can set a custom frequency and choose when the series should end.

### Example: Repeat on the Third Tuesday of Every Month

1. Choose the **start date**, selecting the first third Tuesday you want to use.
2. Toggle **Repeat Event** on.
3. Select **Custom**.
4. Under **Occurs every**, choose **1 month**.
5. Under **Repeats**, select **Monthly on the third Tuesday**.

## Editing a Repeat Event

When editing a Repeat Event, you’ll see two options:

* **All Events in This Series**Edit the Event name, description, imagery, and other core settings for the entire series.​\_Note: You cannot change the Event date when editing the full series.\_
* **Only This Event**Edit only the **time and date** of the specific instance you selected.

## Deleting a Repeat Event

Open the three-dot menu on an instance of the Repeat Event and select **Delete**. You’ll see two options:

* **All Events in This Series**Deletes all Events—past, current, and future—including comments and RSVPs.​\_This action cannot be undone.\_
* **Only This Event**Deletes a single Event in the series. You’ll also have the option to message members who RSVP’d for that Event before deleting it.

## How Members RSVP to a Repeat Event

Members can RSVP directly from the top of the Event. They’ll see that it’s a Repeat Event and can view the full list of upcoming Events in the series at the bottom of the page. They can click through to open all Events in the [**calendar view.**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/is-there-a-calendar-view-for-events)

When responding with **Going**, **Maybe**, or **Not Going**, members can RSVP to:

* All Events in the series, or
* Specific upcoming Events.

As a Host or creator of the Event, you can use **Message Event Members** to contact attendees. You can message people who RSVP’d to:

* All Events in the series, or
* A single Event instance.


# Can I Have Multiple Speakers During a Livestream?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-have-multiple-speakers-during-a-livestream



Livestreams can include up to **9 Speakers total** (the Creator + 8 additional Speakers).

At this time, only **Network Hosts** can start a livestream in a Mighty Network or a Space.

This feature is available on **web** and **mobile**, but we strongly recommend using **Google Chrome** to host or join a livestream (not Safari or Firefox).

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-have-multiple-speakers-during-a-livestream/25017796310541)

## Inviting and Managing Speakers

## Invite a Speaker

The **Creator of the livestream** can invite Speakers from the **Participants** tab:

* Open the **Participants** tab.

* Scroll or search for the viewer you want to invite.

* Select the **three-dot menu** next to their name.

* Choose **Invite as Speaker**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-have-multiple-speakers-during-a-livestream/resend-invite.png)

Any viewer in your Mighty Network—Host, moderator, or member—can be invited.

## What Invited Speakers See

When invited:

* They receive a **popup invitation**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-have-multiple-speakers-during-a-livestream/25017796317453)

* They must grant **camera and microphone permissions**.

* They see a **preview** of their video and audio, and can change inputs before joining.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-have-multiple-speakers-during-a-livestream/25017796329101)

If an invited Speaker doesn’t accept permissions right away, the invitation remains valid unless the Creator removes it.

## Managing Speaker Invitations

In the **three-dot menu** next to the viewer’s name, the Creator can:

* **Remove Invite**

* **Resend Invite**

If a Speaker disconnects, they keep their Speaker status as long as the Creator hasn’t removed it.

## Recording Notice

If the livestream is being recorded:

* Invited Speakers see a notice stating that they agree to be recorded.

* A **Recording** indicator appears for all participants.

## Demoting a Speaker

To return a Speaker to viewer status:

1. Open the **Participants** tab.

2. Select the **three-dot menu** next to their name.

3. Choose **Remove as Speaker**.

## Browser and Device Compatibility

## Best Experience

* Desktop: **Chrome** is strongly recommended.

* Mobile: iOS and Android apps fully support multispeaker livestreaming.

## Pre-Stream Checklist (Recommended)

For the best performance:

* Join from a compatible browser/device.

* Update to the latest browser or OS version.

* Use headphones to prevent audio feedback.

* Close unnecessary apps/tabs.

* If issues occur, refresh the tab (desktop) or leave/rejoin the livestream.

## Permission Requirements by Platform

### Chrome (Desktop)

* Viewers: No permissions needed.

* Speakers: Must accept camera and microphone permissions.

* If permissions were denied previously, enable them in **Chrome Settings**.

### Safari (Desktop)

* Recommended for viewing only.

* **Speakers should use Chrome** instead.

### iOS (Mobile)

Viewers: Must accept device microphone/camera prompts (required by iOS).Speakers: Must also accept browser permissions when invited.If declined, iOS will open system settings to re-enable both.

### Android (Mobile)

Viewers: Must accept device microphone/camera prompts.Speakers: Must accept browser permissions when invited.If declined, Android will open system settings to re-enable both.


# How Do I Add Special Effects to My Livestream?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-add-special-effects-to-my-livestream



A great way to take your Mighty Livestreams to the next level is through the use of third-party software.

Two great options are [OBS](https://obsproject.com/), which is free, and [mmhmm](https://www.mmhmm.app/product), which starts at \$10/month.

<iframe />

## Connecting OBS to your Livestream

[OBS](https://obsproject.com/) is a popular (and free!) application, and it works well with Mighty's native Livestreaming feature. For an optimal Livestreaming experience with OBS, we suggest using Google Chrome.

First, you will need to [download the OBS software to your computer](https://obsproject.com/).

Open the application and allow permissions to your camera and microphone.

You will see a screen like this when you first open the application.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 22 01 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 22 01 PM" />

In the "Sources" section click the + icon and choose "Video Capture Device".

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 22 35 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 22 35 PM" />

Select "Create New" and choose the camera you would like to use.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 23 01 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 23 01 PM" />

From there, you can add different scenes which will allow you to create things like text overlays, split screens and more! Visit the [OBS help center](https://obsproject.com/kb/obs-studio-overview#filters) to learn about all your options.

When you’re ready to start livestreaming select "Start Virtual Camera" in the Controls setting

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 23 21 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 23 21 PM" />

When you start a Livestream after those steps, you will see your OBS camera as an option in the dropdown menu.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 23 41 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 23 41 PM" />

## Connecting mmhmm to your Livestream

Another popular option is [mmhmm](https://www.mmhmm.app/home), which is great for those that don’t need the extensive options offered by OBS. It has a fairly simple interface, the ability to easily add virtual backgrounds, and great features like the ability to add Gifs directly from Giphy.

First, you’ll create an account and download the software to your computer.

Open the application and allow permissions to your camera, microphone and install the mmhmm camera. Below is what it looks like on Mac.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 24 05 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 24 05 PM" />

Once installed, you can toggle on virtual backgrounds easily or upload your own.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 24 27 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 24 27 PM" />

They also have options to add text, images and GIFs.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 25 01 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 25 01 PM" />

Starting a Livestream in your Mighty Network will show the mmhmm Camera as an option.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 25 23 PM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 29 At 3 25 23 PM" />

For a walkthrough of both services, be sure to watch the video at the top of this article.

## Using Virtual Backgrounds With macOS Sequoia

If you're using macOS Sequoia and livestreaming through a browser (we recommend using Chrome), you can easily add virtual backgrounds to enhance your presentation. Here’s how:

1. Start your livestream and click the green video icon in your Mac’s top toolbar.
2. Select "Background" from the dropdown menu.
3. Choose from a variety of built-in backgrounds, such as color gradients and system wallpapers, or upload your own custom photo.

If you're using macOS Sequoia, you'll be prompted every month to re-allow screen sharing permissions. Be sure to grant permission when prompted to ensure smooth livestreaming.

For more information on livestreaming, check out [Can I Livestream from My Mighty Network?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-livestream-in-my-network)


# How Do I Create a Text Chat Event?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-a-text-chat-event



Once your Mighty Network is on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and up, you can create Events that bring members together in real time. Alongside options like Zoom meetings or webinars, you can also host a **Text Chat Event** directly inside your Mighty Network.

A Text Chat Event is a real-time chat session—no video or audio required. It’s a fun way for members to connect, ask questions, and share ideas. During the Event, members can send messages, images, rich links, video links, and emojis. When the Event begins, it automatically opens the chat feature within the Space on web, iOS, and Android.

## Creating a Text Chat Event

Before creating your Event, make sure the **Events** feature is [enabled in your Space](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space).

To create a Text Chat Event:

* Select the **Create** button and choose **Event**.
* Add your Event details (title, date, time, repeating options, and more).
* Under **Event Type**, select **Online**.
* Choose **Text Chat** from the dropdown menu.
* Publish your Event.

For full details on how to create Events, [**check out this article**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network).

After your Event is created, the Event post will include a link that takes members directly to the Space’s chat. Members can click or tap that link to join as soon as the Event begins.

**Members who RSVP “Yes” or “Maybe”** will receive an Event reminder notification 10 minutes before the start time.

## Turn On the Chat Feature

A Text Chat Event uses the Space’s Chat feature. Before the Event starts, make sure Chat is enabled in that Space.

To turn on Chat:

1. Go to the **Space gear icon**.
2. Select **Space Features > Chat**.
3. Enable Chat for the Space.

Once enabled, your Text Chat Event will open the Space’s chat automatically when it begins.


# How Do I Create Events in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network



The **Events feature** (available on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and up) lets you create standalone or ongoing events. The [**Single Event feature**](#h_78415a6af7) (available on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and above) is for one-time events.

Both can be used for **virtual or in-person** events and can be enabled in any Space.

## How to Enable Events

1. Go to the **gear icon** in your Space.
2. Select **Space Features > Events**.
3. You can:
   * Rename the “Events” tab to something custom (this name will appear in the Space at the top)
   * Choose whether **only Hosts and Moderators** or **all Members** can create events.

## How to Create an Event

Once Events are enabled, click the **Create** to make one.

**You can customize:**

* **Title** of the Event
* **Start and end time** (with time zone)
  * Online Events show in each member’s local time.
  * For Local Events, you can note if the event’s time zone differs.
* Whether it’s a [**Repeat Event**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-create-recurring-events-in-my-mighty-network)
* **Images or thumbnails**
* **Description** (can include text, media, files, and embeds—just like an [Article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network))
  * If you have the [**AI “Make it Better”**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have) feature, just highlight your text to use it.
* **Event Type:**
  * \[Network Name] [Livestream](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-livestream-in-my-network)
  * [Zoom](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-zoom-events-on-mighty-networks)
  * External Livestream: use this for any other meeting type
  * [Text Chat](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-a-text-chat-event)
* [**Manage RSVP options**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-manage-rsvps-and-event-attendees)
* **Live indicator** (on or off — applies to all events in a series)
* If you want the Event to immediately show in the [Feed](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-does-the-feed-work) when it's posted

When publishing, you can:

* **Notify members immediately**, or
* [**Schedule it for later**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network) (Single Events can’t be scheduled, but you can hide the tab until ready).

**Note:** Once an Event is created, the Event Host cannot be changed.

## Single Events

To enable the **Single Event** feature:

1. Go to **Space Admin (gear icon) > Features** and toggle it on.
2. You can:
   * Edit the Event
   * Change the **Display Name** of the tab
   * Toggle visibility on or off

When editing, you can customize

* **Title** of the Event
* **Start and end time** (with time zone)
  * Online Events show in each member’s local time.
  * For Local Events, you can note if the event’s time zone differs.
* **Images or thumbnails**
* **Description** (can include text, media, files, and embeds—just like an [Article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network))
  * If you have the [**AI “Make it Better”**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have) feature, just highlight your text to use it.
* **Event Type:**
  * \[Network Name] [Livestream](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-livestream-in-my-network)
  * [Zoom](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-zoom-events-on-mighty-networks)
  * External Livestream: use this for any other meeting type
  * [Text Chat](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-a-text-chat-event)
* [**Manage RSVP options**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-manage-rsvps-and-event-attendees)
* **Live indicator** (on or off — applies to all events in a series)

When publishing, you can:

* **Notify members immediately**, or
* [**Schedule it for later**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-a-post-in-my-mighty-network) (Single Events can’t be scheduled, but you can hide the tab until ready).

Here’s what the event looks like when finished. It is similar to the Page Feature.

## Managing Events

In the **three-dot menu** of any type of published Event, you can:

* **Mute** – Stop receiving notifications for the Event.
* **Share** – Copy a direct link to the Event.
* **Enable Comments** – Turn comments on or off.
* **Feature In** – Highlight the Event in the **Welcome/Featured Section** or **Welcome Checklist**.
* **Recommend** – Pin the Event to the top of the Feed.
* [**Send a Message**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-message-members-in-my-network) – Message Event attendees.
* **Download RSVPs** – Export the attendee list (you will get an email with the list)
* **Event Settings** – Adjust details like RSVPs, live indicator, or Feed visibility.
* **Edit** – Update the Event’s content or visuals.
* [**Duplicate Event**](#h_e9ea49a52f)
* **Move to Another Space** – Transfer the Event to a different Space with Events enabled.

### Duplicating Events

You can duplicate an Event to reuse its:

* Title
* Description
* [Imagery](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network)
* Settings

Then edit details and publish it in the **same Space or another one** that also has Events enabled.

## Where Events Appear

* Published Events show up in the **Events tab** of the Space (except Single Events).
* You can expand a [**calendar view**](https://intercom.help/mighty-networks/en/articles/1611079-leave-a-network-or-group) to see all Events in that Space.
* If the [**Global Events feature**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-are-global-features) is enabled, members see all Events across Spaces in one list, in date order.
* Tabs let you filter:
  * **Nearby Events** (based on your profile location)
  * **Past Events**
  * **Your Events** (you’ve RSVP’d to)
* In the calendar view, Events are **color-coded by Space**.

## Event Reminders

Members who RSVP will automatically get reminders:

* **Online Events:** 10 minutes before start time
* **Local Events:** 24 hours and 2 hours before
* Virtual event reminders link to the event in Mighty Networks (not directly to Zoom or other platforms)

## Event Ticketing

On the [Launch Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) or higher, you can create a Single Event and [charge for that Space by creating a plan!](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-charge-for-events-on-a-mighty-network#:~:text=First%20you%20need%20to%20create%20a%20Space%20and%20then%20enable%20the%20single%20event%20feature%20inside%20of%20the%20Space.%20You%20would%20then%20make%20the%20Space%20plan%20access%20and%20members%20would%20pay%20to%20access%20the%20Space%20and%20attend%20the%20Event.)


# How Do I Create Zoom Events on Mighty Networks?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-zoom-events-on-mighty-networks



The [Zoom](https://zoom.us/) integration that's available within your Mighty Network enables you to connect your Zoom account directly and schedule Zoom Events right within your Mighty Network. The integration is available on web and mobile.

In order to use this option, you will need to have [a Zoom account](https://zoom.us/signin). Zoom offers a variety of [plans and features](https://zoom.us/pricing), including the ability to have a free account.

## Connecting Your Zoom Account

When you are [creating or editing an Event](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network) in your Mighty Network, you'll see an option in the Event Type dropdown to select Zoom.

Once you've selected Zoom as the Event Type, you'll see a prompt to connect your Zoom account.

In order to use the Zoom integration and ensure we can properly sync your Mighty Networks Zoom meetings to your Zoom account, you will need to accept the following agreements and confirm access. It is also possible to bypass the Zoom captcha that appears when you are connecting your account during this flow.

Note: At this time, only one Mighty Network can be connected to the same Zoom account.

Choose **“Sign In”** to connect your current Zoom account, or **“Create an Account”** if you don’t already have one. You can \[learn more here] about the different types of Zoom accounts.

To use the Zoom integration and make sure your Mighty Networks meetings sync correctly with Zoom, you’ll need to:

* Accept the agreements, and
* Confirm access.

During setup, you can also skip the Zoom captcha that may appear.

## Scheduling a Zoom Event

After you connect your Zoom account to your Mighty Networks account, you’ll unlock all the options for scheduling a **Zoom Event**.

Depending on what your Zoom plan includes, you can choose to schedule either a **Zoom Meeting** or a **Zoom Webinar**. The Event types available to you will depend on the features your Zoom account supports.

## Zoom Meeting

A [Zoom Meeting](https://zoom.us/meetings) lets you host video calls and chat with others using:

* HD video and audio
* Recording options
* A chat window
* Collaboration tools

Once you've successfully connected a Zoom account to your Mighty Networks account, you'll see full options for scheduling a Zoom Event.

Then, depending on what your Zoom account supports, you can select if you want to schedule a Zoom Meeting or a Zoom Webinar. Your ability to create either of these Event Types will depend on the features enabled on your Zoom account.

## Zoom Webinar

A [**Zoom Webinar**](https://zoom.us/webinar) is best for virtual events where you want a more formal presentation and need tools for larger audiences. This option requires a **Zoom upgrade** if it’s not already part of your plan. If your account supports webinars, you’ll see this option available.

**Note:** For Events that use the Zoom integration, only the **Event Creator** can edit the Event Settings. This is because the Zoom account is tied to the person who created the Event.

* If you want any Host to edit the Event, choose a different Event type and paste in a Zoom link instead.
* Updates made in either Mighty Networks or Zoom should sync with each other in almost real time.

## Members Experience

Members will see a link on the Event page that takes them to your Zoom Event. If the Event is happening live, they’ll also see a large **“Join Now”** button to join right away.

When a member clicks the Zoom link, it will open the Zoom app on their device (or prompt them to install it if they don’t already have it).

* **On web:** If members don’t have the Zoom app installed, they can still join through their [web browser](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362193-Joining-a-Zoom-meeting) without installing the app or creating a Zoom account.
* **On mobile:** If members don’t have the Zoom app, they can still [join by phone](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362663-Joining-a-Zoom-meeting-by-phone) without installing the app or making a Zoom account.

## Connecting Zoom Accounts

Each person (Host or member) can connect their own Zoom account to their Mighty Networks account when creating Events.

If you want to limit who can create Events in your Mighty Network or in a specific Space, go to **Content Settings** and restrict Event creation to **Hosts and Moderators only**.

You can also use a **shared Zoom account** that multiple people connect to. There’s no limit on how many people can use the same Zoom credentials, but there are a few things to keep in mind.

## Important Things to Know About Shared Zoom Accounts

Connecting: Everyone creating Zoom Events must connect the shared Zoom account to their personal Mighty Networks account before they can use it.

Overlapping Events: Zoom doesn’t allow multiple meetings or webinars at the same time on the same account. Make sure shared accounts don’t schedule overlapping Events.

Disconnecting: If one person disconnects the shared Zoom account, it disconnects for everyone. Only share credentials with trusted Hosts or Moderators.

Permissions: If you try to open a Zoom Event another Host scheduled, you may run into permission issues. Depending on your Zoom plan, you may be able to add an **alternate Host** in Zoom so they can open the Event too.

## Editing Event Settings

* Only the **Event Creator** can edit Zoom Event settings in Mighty Networks, since the Zoom account is tied to their login.
* If you want any Host to edit, create a **Meeting-type Event** instead and paste in a Zoom link.

## How to Disconnect Your Zoom Account

1. Go to **Personal Settings > Account > Zoom**.
2. Click **Unlink** to disconnect your Zoom account.

When you disconnect:

* Any Zoom Events you created will switch to “Meeting” type events with a Zoom link.

When you reconnect the same Zoom account:

* Your past Zoom Events will switch back to Zoom Event type automatically.
* You can also connect a different Zoom account, but first sign out at **Zoom.us** so it doesn’t re-link to the same one.

## How Zoom and Mighty Networks Stay in Sync

* Zoom Events created in Mighty Networks sync automatically to your account on **Zoom.us**, and updates work both ways.
* If you schedule the same Zoom Event across two Mighty Networks, changes in one will sync to the other and to Zoom.us.
* If you use your **Personal Meeting ID**, any changes to Event settings in Mighty Networks (like password or recording options) will also change those defaults on Zoom.us.
  * Example: If you change the password for a Zoom Event in Mighty Networks, that password will also update on Zoom.us for all meetings tied to your Personal Meeting ID.


# How Do I Livestream in My Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-livestream-in-my-network



<iframe />

As a **Network Host on any Paid Plan**, you can go live in any Space where you're also a **Space Host**.

On [**Mighty Pro**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/what-is-mighty-pro) and [**Growth**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-growth-plan), Network Hosts can contact our team to enable livestreaming permissions for Space Hosts and Network moderators.

Any member with access to the Space can join your livestream.

You can have up to **nine people** on screen at once (including the Host).

Livestreaming is available on **web**, **iOS**, and **Android**.

On **Android**, viewers can minimize a livestream into picture-in-picture mode to stay engaged while doing other tasks. (Coming to iOS in the future.)

For details on multiple speakers, see: [How Do I Add Speakers to a Livestream?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-have-multiple-speakers-during-a-livestream)

## Start a Livestream

## Going Live on Web

**To go live to the entire Network:**

1. Click your **profile icon** (upper right).
2. Select **Go Live in the Network**.

<img />

**To go live in a specific Space:**

1. Click **Create** (upper right).
2. Select **Go Live**.

<img />

## Going Live on Mobile (iOS and Android)

**To go live to the entire Network:**

* Tap the **camera icon** in any Global Feature.

**To go live within a Space:**

* Open the **three-dot menu** in the upper right corner and select **Go Live**.

## Livestream Setup Options

When you go live, you’ll be prompted to allow access to your **camera** and **microphone**.

You’ll then see setup options:

**Name Your Livestream**

**Settings**

* **Record this livestream**: Automatically start recording when you go live (the recording will be available afterward).
* **Notify your members**: Sends both email and push notifications when you go live.
* **Hide camera-off speakers:** When enabled, attendees with their camera off will not be shown as tiles in the livestream.
* **Add livestream [link to an Event](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-schedule-a-livestream-event)**[:](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-schedule-a-livestream-event) Link your livestream to an Event happening within 30 minutes of your start time.

**Camera**

* **Camera Source**
* **Mirror my video**
* **Blur Background**

**Microphone**

* **Microphone source**
* **Voice Isolation** (reduces background noise)
* **Speaker source + test audio** (Chrome only)

  <img alt="Screenshot2026 03 25at10 28 55AM" title="Screenshot2026 03 25at10 28 55AM" />
</Frame>

At the bottom center, you can mute your microphone or turn your camera off before starting.

When you click **Go Live Now**, the livestream prepares and displays a countdown.

**Important:** Audio and video captured during the countdown will be included in the recording.

Your previous settings are saved for next time.

## Livestream Settings While Live

At the bottom of your livestream window (web and mobile):

<img />

* **Camera icon**: Change camera source or blur your background.
* **Microphone icon**: Change microphone or speaker source (web only) and enable Voice Isolation.
* **Share Screen:** You can share your screen during the livestream.
* **Gear icon**: Adjust camera, microphone, and mirroring, hide camera-off settings

## Screen Sharing

You can share your screen during the livestream.

* Click **Share Screen** at the bottom of the livestream window.
* Choose the window or screen you want to share.
  * Share a Tab if you only want one tab to show (not the whole desktop)
  * Share a Window for one browser window to show (with all tabs)
  * Share Entire Screen if you want your whole desktop to show.
* Your video will appear in the corner while screen sharing.

Screen sharing is **not** available on:

* iPad
* Safari

Mobile users can flip to the rear camera to show their screen instead.

### Browser notes

* **Chrome**: Can share a tab with audio.
* Other browsers: Share video only; audio must be captured by your microphone.
* **Safari**: Screen sharing doesn’t work—use Chrome instead.

## Multiple Speakers

Livestreams can have up to 9 total Speakers (including the Creator of the livestream). To learn more, [**check out this article.**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/can-i-have-multiple-speakers-during-a-livestream)

## Livestream Chat

During a livestream, members can chat in real time to react, ask questions, and share insights. Here’s how chat works for both Hosts and members.

### Chat Controls for Hosts and Moderators

[Space Hosts and Space moderators](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-space-hosts-and-space-moderators-have) have the ability to **delete chat messages** during a livestream.

To delete a message (web):

1. Hover over the message.
2. Click the **trash icon**.

### Viewer Chat Experience (Web)

* Chat appears in the panel next to the livestream.
* Viewers can toggle chat **on or off** for themselves.
* The **participant list** is displayed in a separate tab and updates in real time.

### Viewer Chat Experience (Mobile)

* The livestream fills the screen.
* Chat messages appear halfway up the screen and fade after a moment.
* Members can scroll through previous messages at any time.
* A viewer count icon at the bottom shows how many people are watching; tapping it opens the viewer list.

## Livestream Viewer Experience

When you go live, a livestream banner appears at the top of your Mighty Network. It shows:

* Livestream title
* Video preview
* Participant count

Select the banner to open the livestream in a flyout.

If multiple livestreams are happening in different Spaces, members can browse and join any of them.

## Join a Livestream

Members, Hosts, and moderators can join by:

* Selecting a notification (if enabled)
* Selecting **Join Livestream** on the banner
* Joining from the Event page or waiting room

## Joining from an Event

If a livestream is connected to an event, members can join directly from the event page.

Before the livestream starts:

* They can select **Join Waiting Room** up to 30 minutes before the start of the event to chat with other members.

When the livestream begins:

* Members in the waiting room join automatically and the chat will carry over
* Or, they can go to the Event page and select **Join Livestream**

# How Do I Manage RSVPs and Event Attendees?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-manage-rsvps-and-event-attendees



**RSVPs** make it easy for members to let you know whether they plan to attend your [Event](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network).

As the Event Host, you can track responses, message attendees, restrict access to the Event Link, close RSVPs, and automate Event actions on eligible plans.

## Enabling Event RSVPs

To allow members to RSVP:

1. [**Create or edit an Event**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network).
2. Toggle **Enable RSVPs** on.

Members can choose **Going**, **Maybe**, or **Not Going**. They can also export the Event to their calendar and leave comments.

## Changing RSVPs

Members can update their RSVP until the Event begins.

* If the Event has started: Only members who selected **Maybe** can update their status to **Going** or **Not Going**, add the Event to their calendar, and comment.
* After the Event ends: they won’t be able to update their RSVP unless they selected "Maybe," in which case they can change to "Yes" or "No."

## If RSVPs Are Turned Off

Members will not see RSVP options, and no RSVP list will appear.

## Restricting Access to the Event Link

You can choose who can see your Event Link (the meeting URL):

* Toggle **Restrict Event Link** on to allow only members who RSVP **Going** to view the link.
* Members who RSVP **Maybe** will not see the link.
* If Restrict Event Link is off, anyone who can see the Event can access the link.

## Steps for Limiting Link Access

To ensure only confirmed attendees have access:

1. Turn on **Restrict Event Link**.
2. Keep the Event Link field empty until shortly before the Event.
3. Close RSVPs when you’re ready.
4. Add the Event Link.
5. Once the Event starts, members cannot RSVP **Going** to access the link.

## How to Close RSVPs

If you want to keep the current RSVP list as-is:

1. Edit the Event.
2. Toggle **Close RSVPs** on.

You can reopen RSVPs anytime by toggling it off.

## How to Message Event Attendees

**Note:** Members who RSVP **Going** or **Maybe** receive automatic reminders—10 minutes before online Events and 24 hours before local Events.

To message attendees:

1. Open the Event.
2. Click the **three-dot menu** in the top right corner.
3. Select **Send Message**.
4. Choose your audience:
   * Going
   * Maybe
   * Not Going
   * No RSVPs
5. Write your message and click **Send Message**.

## What Members See

Members receive a notification:​“\[Host Name] sent you a message about \[Event Name].”

They can reply via private chat or click **See Event** to open the Event page.​

## Automating RSVP Actions

On the [**Scale Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-business-plan) and above [**Event Automations**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network) can help you manage RSVP-based actions without manual updates.

## RSVP Triggers

* [**RSVP to Event:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network#:~:text=RSVPed%20to%20Event,for%20this%20Trigger) Trigger an action when a member selects a specific RSVP status.
* [**Event Reached Number of RSVPs:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network#:~:text=for%20this%20Trigger-,Event%20Reached%20Number%20of%20RSVPs,-Occurs%20when%20RSVPs) Trigger an action when RSVPs reach a certain count (greater than, equal to, or less than your chosen number). This trigger fires only once per Event.

## Automatable Actions

* [**Close Event RSVPs:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network#:~:text=their%20billing%20cycle.-,Close%20Event%20RSVPs,-Disables%20the%20ability) Stops new RSVPs automatically.
  * *Suggested setup:* Use “Event Reached Number of RSVPs” → **Close Event RSVPs** to cap attendance.
* [**Open RSVPs for Event:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network#:~:text=Open%20RSVPs%20for%20Event) Reopens RSVPs.

## Notes for Recurring Events

* Automations apply to one-time Events or the **Series** for recurring Events.
* If a member RSVPs to a Series, the automation applies to the whole Series—not individual Event instances.

## Downloading Event RSVPs

To download the RSVP list:

1. Open the Event or the RSVP page.
2. Click the **three-dot menu**.
3. Select **Download RSVPs**.

You’ll receive an email with a link to download a CSV file.

## Who Can Download RSVPs

* Hosts
* Moderators in that Space
* The Event creator (even if not a Host or moderator)

## CSV Details Included

* Member ID
* First Name
* Last Name
* Email Address
  * Visible only to Network Hosts and Space Hosts on the [\*\*Launch Plan \*\*](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan)and up
* RSVP Status (Going, Maybe, Not Going)


# How Do I Post a Livestream Replay?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-post-a-livestream-replay



<iframe />

If you choose to record your livestream, you’ll receive an **email** and an **in-app notification** when the replay is ready.

Clicking the notification takes you directly to the recording.You can also access all recordings by going to your **profile icon > Livestream Recordings**.

## Filters

* **Yours**: Shows only your recordings, with the most recent at the top.

* **All**: Shows every recording created by Network Hosts across your Mighty Network.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-post-a-livestream-replay/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-3_21_54-PM.png)

## Previewing, Downloading, and Managing Recordings

You can play the video to preview it before posting. Each recording has an automatic thumbnail, which you can change after the replay is added to a post.

* To **download** the recording, click **↓ Download**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-post-a-livestream-replay/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-3_22_42-PM.png)

* You can delete recordings on **web** and **mobile web** only.

* Use the **three-dot menu** to download a timestamped transcript of all chat messages.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-post-a-livestream-replay/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-3_23_58-PM.png)

## Creating an Article with the Replay

If you don’t need to edit the recording first, select **[Create Article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network)** to generate an Article with the replay already embedded.

You can only post Articles on **web** and **mobile web**.

Choose the **Space** where the Article should appear.Articles must be **[enabled in that Space](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-add-features-to-a-space)**, and you’ll need permission to post there.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-post-a-livestream-replay/Screenshot-2025-11-21-at-3_24_48-PM.png)

## Adding the Recording to a Course

If you download your recording, you can upload it into a Space with the **Course** feature enabled to build a replay library.

To upload:

1. Click the **+** button to **[Create a Lesson](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons)**

2. Select **Add Photo, Video, or File**.

3. Choose your **.mp4** file.

While your video uploads, we recommend adding an overview of the livestream and sharing links, resources, or next steps.

You can also upload the **chat transcript** or **slide deck** as file attachments.

After processing, you can upload a **custom thumbnail**, or keep the default (a black frame with a play button).
