# How Do I Troubleshoot Video Upload Issues in a Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-troubleshoot-video-upload-issues-in-a-mighty-network



Experiencing trouble with video uploads? If you get the message: "*Something went wrong. Please check your internet connection and try again*," it signifies your request didn't make it past your device.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-troubleshoot-video-upload-issues-in-a-mighty-network/25106011084429)

This obstacle often traces back to specifics within your internet setup, ranging from personal device settings, home network configurations, to stipulations enforced by your Internet Service Provider (ISP) or workplace internet policies. The silver lining? There are actionable steps you can take to diagnose and rectify this issue.

## Troubleshooting Steps

## 1. Check for Firewall or Network Constraints

* **Disable Potentially Blocking Browser Extensions:** Begin by turning off any browser extensions, particularly those designed for ad blocking or enhancing privacy, and try uploading again.

* **Experiment with Different Browsers:** Switching browsers can sometimes provide a quick fix. Trying your upload with an alternative browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.) could reveal browser-specific limitations.

* **Utilize a VPN (Virtual Private Network):** Issues might stem from your current location's internet regulations or those imposed by your ISP. A VPN can help determine if changing your internet route circumvents the problem, indicating a local connection issue.​

* **Local Firewall Settings:** If feasible and safe, temporarily disable your firewall to see if the upload proceeds. A successful upload under these conditions suggests needed firewall adjustments to allow specific internet traffic.​

* **Adjust Antivirus Software Settings:** Antivirus tools are essential but can sometimes overly restrict internet uploads/downloads. When possible, add a bypass for [https://upload.kaltura.com/api\_v3/service/uploadtoken/action/upload](https://upload.kaltura.com/api_v3/service/uploadtoken/action/upload) in your antivirus settings to prevent blocking.

  * **Temporary Antivirus Disabling (If Safe):** If adding an exception isn't an option and you suspect your antivirus is the culprit, try a temporary disablement for the upload attempt. Ensure your device's security isn't compromised during this test.

  * **If Disabling Works:** Should the upload succeed post-disabling, your antivirus settings need tweaking to permit traffic to and from the specified URL.

* **Review Router Settings:** Home network? Scrutinize your router's configurations for potential upload barriers.

* **Navigating Corporate Networks:** In workplace settings, network restrictions might be in play. Check with your IT department for solutions.

## 2. Navigate ISP Restrictions

* **Alternate Network Trials:** Testing the upload from another network (like a friend's or public Wi-Fi) can help identify if your primary connection is the issue.

* **ISP Communication:** Reach out to your Internet Service Provider for insights into potential upload limitations and solutions.

* **Optimize Router for ISP Traffic Shaping:** If router access is within your control, tweaking settings to optimize upload speeds might alleviate issues stemming from ISP traffic prioritization.

## 3. Additional Troubleshooting Tips

* **Switch to a Network Cable Connection:** Wi-Fi inconsistencies? A direct Ethernet cable connection to your router could stabilize your internet performance.

* **Router Restart:** A simple but often effective fix, restarting your router can resolve numerous connectivity problems. Turn it off, wait briefly, then power it back on to refresh your connection.

Interested in expanding your knowledge on content uploading and embedding? Check out [this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-upload-native-videos-to-my-mighty-network).


# How Do I Upload Native Videos to My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-upload-native-videos-to-my-mighty-network



Network Hosts on all paid plans can upload **native videos** (videos not hosted on YouTube, Vimeo, or other external platforms) directly to **Articles** and **Posts**.

If you’re looking for instructions on embedding external videos, see our article on [**how to embed video**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-external-embeds) from another source.

## Who Can Upload Native Video

* **Network Hosts**: Can upload videos up to **4GB**.
* **Space Hosts, Space moderators, and members**: Can upload videos only as **file attachments** (up to **250MB**).
  * As a Host, you can decide if you want your members to upload 250mb or keep them at a smaller file upload limit: 25mb. You can make this decision in Admin > Member Settings

On [**Mighty Pro**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/what-is-mighty-pro), Network Hosts can request that native video uploading be enabled for Posts created by Network moderators and members. Reach out to the Mighty Team if you’d like this enabled.

If your Mighty Network is on the [**Launch Plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and up, you can also upload videos directly to your Course’s [**Overview**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons), [Sections, and Lessons.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/courses/how-do-i-organize-my-course-with-overviews-sections-and-lessons)

## Where Native Videos Can Be Uploaded

Native video uploading is available on:

* Web
* iOS
* Android

Once uploaded, members can watch videos seamlessly across web and mobile apps.

## Downloading Videos

**Network Hosts** on web can download any native video posted to their Network (via a download icon in the upper-right corner of any video).

**Space Hosts** are able to download any videos in their Space.

**Moderators and members** able to re-download any of their own videos.<br /><br />We've also taken a privacy-centric approach, and have ensured that any sensitive metadata (like location) is stripped from the downloaded videos

**Maximum resolution:** 1080p

## Uploading Native Video on Android

When uploading to a **Post** from Android, you can only upload video files stored in **Google Drive**.

For all other content types, select videos stored directly on your device.

## Uploading a Video to a Post

1. In a Space, click the **Create > Post** at the top of the Feed or select the box that says "Share a Post"
2. Select **Add Video**
3. Choose your video file and upload it.

Playback speeds are available on both native uploads and YouTube-embedded videos on web and mobile web.

## Uploading a Video to an Article

1. Go to Create > Article
2. Use the "+" icon and select **Video**
3. Upload your video.

## Video Captions

Native video uploads support auto-generated English captions across:

* Courses (Overview, Sections, Lessons)
* Posts
* Articles
* Events
* Pages

After uploading a video, Hosts will see a **cc** icon in the upper-right corner.

Hovering over the icon displays: **“Click to enable or disable the caption options for viewers.”**

* If captions are **enabled**, viewers can turn them on or off.
* If captions are **disabled**, viewers will not see caption options.

## Important Notes

* Captions are **auto-generated**.
* There is no option yet to upload or download caption files.
* Only English captions are supported today.
* Captions are not available on livestream recordings.
  * If you want captions for a livestream, download the recording to your computer and upload it natively as a video.


# Is There a Calendar View for Events?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/is-there-a-calendar-view-for-events



The **Calendar View** in Mighty Networks helps you and your members see all upcoming Events in one place. You can also **sync Events directly to your personal calendar**—like Google Calendar, Outlook, or Apple Calendar—so you never miss a session.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/is-there-a-calendar-view-for-events/Screenshot-2025-11-11-at-4_25_50-PM.png)

## Viewing Events in Calendar View

When you view Events on the web, you’ll see an **Expand Calendar** icon on the right side of your Events list—either in a Space or in your **Global Events** feature.

1. Click the **Expand** icon to open the full-page Calendar View.

2. You’ll see one month at a time.

3. Use the arrows to move between past or upcoming months.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/is-there-a-calendar-view-for-events/Screenshot-2025-11-11-at-4_26_02-PM.png)

## How Events Display in the Calendar

* If you have the **Global Events feature** enabled, you’ll see all Events you have access to across your Mighty Network—listed in chronological order.

* Inside a Space, you’ll only see Events happening in that specific Space.

* Members see only Events in Spaces they belong to.

## Choose Which Events to Display

Click the **gear icon** to choose:

* **Show All Events**, or

* **Show My Events Only** (Events you’ve RSVP’d to)

You can find the gear icon in two places:

* On the **small calendar sidebar** of the Events page, next to the **Expand** icon.

* In the upper-right corner of the **full-page calendar** after you expand it.

To view details, just click an Event from the calendar—it will open in full-page view.

## Syncing Events with Your Personal Calendar

From the **Calendar View**, you can automatically sync Mighty Networks Events to your personal calendar.

## How to Sync Your Events

1. On the web, open the Events page in a Space or in your **Global Events** feature.

2. Click the **gear icon** on the calendar sidebar, next to the **Expand** icon (not the Space settings gear). You can also expand the calendar first and click the gear icon in its top-right corner.

3. Select **Sync to My Calendar**.

4. Choose your sync options:

   * **Only Events I’ve RSVP’d to**, or

   * **All Events**

5. Select your calendar service:

   * **Google Calendar**

   * **Outlook Calendar**

   * **Apple Calendar**

On iOS, the sync option connects to Apple Calendar. On Android, you’ll be redirected to Google Calendar via your browser.

## Syncing Individual Events

You can also add a **single Event** to your personal calendar directly from its Event page.

* Click **Add to Calendar** on the Event.

* Choose your preferred calendar app.

* Follow the prompts to export that Event only.

## Keeping Your Calendar Up to Date

Once synced, your personal calendar will automatically update with any Event changes made in your Mighty Network—including deleted Events.

However, the update timing depends on your calendar provider:

* **Google Calendar:** Syncs every few hours to a few days.

* **Apple Calendar:** Defaults to syncing weekly (we recommend setting it to **every 1 hour**).

* **Outlook Calendar:** Syncs every few hours to a few days.

The shorter your sync interval, the faster new updates appear.

## Manually Refreshing Your Calendar

If your Events aren’t updating:

1. Remove the subscribed Mighty Networks calendar from your personal calendar.

2. Return to your Mighty Network and **sync again** using the steps above.

If you’re using Apple’s iCal, you can also select the Events in your calendar and delete them manually before re-adding.

## Helping Your Members Stay Synced

If you edit an Event scheduled within two weeks, you’ll see an option to **message your members**. You can use this to remind them how to refresh their calendars and make sure their updates are reflected.

Here’s a simple message you can send:

“If you don’t see the latest updates in your calendar, remove your Mighty Networks calendar and re-add it using the sync steps in your Events calendar view.”

## Event Reminder Notifications

Members who RSVP **Going** or **Maybe** automatically receive reminders:

* **Online Events:** 10 minutes before the Event starts

* **Local Events:** 24 hours before

For virtual Events, the reminder includes a link to the Event inside Mighty Networks (not directly to the external meeting link).


# How Do I Add Custom Badges and Tags for My Members?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-badges-and-tags-for-my-members



**Tags and Badges** are powerful ways to recognize, organize and celebrate your members. They can help you segment your community or highlight milestones—all within your Mighty Network.

## Who Can Use Tags and Badges

**Network Hosts** and **Network moderators** on the [Launch Plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and above have access to unlimited Tags and Badges on web and mobile.

## Badges

<iframe />

**Badges** are visible to everyone in your Mighty Network.

Use them to celebrate achievements, milestones, or actions—like completing a Course, referring members, or hitting engagement goals. There’s no limit to how many creative ways you can use them.

## Create a New Badge

1. Go to **Admin > Engagement > Badges.**
2. Toggle the **Badges** feature on (if it isn’t already). If the feature is toggled off, Badges won’t be visible anywhere in your Mighty Network—even to Hosts and moderators.
3. Click **Create Badge** and enter:
   * **Badge Name:** 40-character limit
   * **Badge Description:** 75-character limit
   * **Badge Image:** 256x256 pixels (will resize to 24x24 pixels in your Network). Note: Every Badge must have an image.

You can also:

* Click **Suggestions** for an AI-generated Badge image.
* Use our [Canva Badge Template](https://www.canva.com/design/DAF60eIfg68/wLvt78HwA4gjQTj0XCC8tw/view) to design your own.

## Add Badges to Members

You can assign a Badge to any role—Host, moderator, or member—and to an unlimited number of people.

Members receive email, in-app, and push notifications (if enabled) when they earn a Badge.

You can add a Badge in several ways:

* **From the Manage Badges page:** Click the three-dot menu next to a Badge, then select **Add Badge to Members.**

[**From the Network or Space Member List:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members) Select members (or all) > choose **Bulk Actions > Add Badge.**

You must be both a [Network Host/moderator](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-network-hosts-and-network-moderators-have) *and* a [Space Host/moderator](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-space-hosts-and-space-moderators-have) to use bulk actions in a Space.

**From a specific member’s profile:**

Open the three-dot menu and choose **Add Badge.**

[**From the member detail page:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-is-the-member-detail-page)

Click the **+** icon under Badges

## Remove Badges

* From the Network Member List: select members > **Bulk Actions > Remove Badge.**
* From a [Member Detail Page](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-is-the-member-detail-page): hover over a Badge and click the **x.**

## Manage Badges

Each Badge includes a three-dot menu where you can:

* **Edit Badge**
* **See Members**
* **View Automations**
* **Add Badge to Members**
* **Delete Badge**

You can also automate [awarding and removing Badges](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network) when members complete specific actions in your Mighty Network.

## View Member Badges

Badges appear on every member’s profile.

* Up to **15 Badges** display on a profile.
* Click **More** to view the full list if a member has more than 15.
* Click any Badge to open a modal showing the Badge name, description, and how many members have earned it.
* Select **See members** to view the full list—filterable by *Top*, *Near You*, *Newest*, and *Online*.

You can also search for Badge names using the global search bar.

## Tags

Tags are internal-only tools for segmenting and organizing your members. They’re visible to Hosts and moderators but not to members themselves.

Use Tags to group members—for example:

* Members at risk of churning
* Potential mentors
* Active participants in a program or challenge

<iframe />

## Create a New Tag

1. Go to **Admin > Members > Tags.**
2. Toggle the **Tags** feature on (if it isn’t already). If the feature is toggled off, Tags won’t appear anywhere in your Mighty Network.
3. Type the Tag name in the top bar (40-character limit) and click **Create.**

## Add Tags to Members

You can assign Tags to any role—Host, moderator, or member—and to unlimited members. Each member can only have one instance of a Tag at a time.

You can add a Tag in several ways:

**From the Manage Tags page:** Click the three-dot menu next to a Tag, then select **Add Tag to Members.**

[**From the Network or Space Member List:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members) Select members (or all) > choose **Bulk Actions > Add Tags.**

You must be both a [Network Host/moderator](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-network-hosts-and-network-moderators-have) *and* a [Space Host/moderator](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-permissions-do-space-hosts-and-space-moderators-have) to use bulk actions in a Space.

**From a specific member’s profile:**

Open the three-dot menu and choose **Add Tag.**

[**From the member detail page:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-is-the-member-detail-page)

Click the **+** icon under Tags

## Remove Tags

* From the Network Member List: select members > **Bulk Actions > Remove Tag.**
* From a Member Detail Page: hover over a Tag and click the **x.**

## Manage Tags

Each Tag includes a three-dot menu where you can:

* **Edit Tag** (update name or description)
* **See Members** (view all members with the Tag)
* **View Automations**
* **Add Tag to Members**
* **Delete Tag**

## Where Tags Appear

Tags are visible only on the [**Member Detail Page**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-is-the-member-detail-page) for Network Hosts and moderators.Members cannot see their assigned Tags.


# How Do I Add Custom Fields?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-do-i-add-custom-fields



<iframe />

Custom Fields are available on the [**Launch plan**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan) and up. They help you gather key details about your members so you can create better experiences and foster stronger connections in your Mighty Network.

Custom Fields currently support **dropdown**, **short text**, and **long text** response types.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 57 54 AM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 57 54 AM" />

## How to Create a Custom Field

To create a new Custom Field, go to **Admin > Members > Custom Fields** — the direct path is `/admin/custom-fields` — and select **Create Field**.

Then follow these steps:

1. **Choose a response type** Decide how members will respond: You can’t edit the response type after creating the field.
   * **Dropdown** — single or multi-select
   * **Short text** — up to 255 characters
   * **Long text** — up to 2,000 characters
2. **Name and describe the field**
   * Enter a **Field name**, which will appear on the member profile if you set the field to be visible.
   * Add a **description** that appears next to the input field.
   * Add **placeholder text** that appears when the field is empty.
3. Click **Next: Configure** to move to setup.

## Configuring Dropdown Fields

If you select **single** or **multi-select**, you’ll see configuration options for dropdowns.

* **Response limits:** For multi-select fields, set a response limit between 2 and 40 options.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 58 14 AM" />

* **Custom responses:** Choose whether to allow members to add their own responses (up to 40 characters). Once added, custom responses appear as dropdown options for all members.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 58 23 AM" />

* **Dropdown options:** Add up to **20 options** when you first create the field. You can add more later—there’s no limit.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 58 33 AM" />

## Configuring Text Fields

Short and long text fields don’t require additional configuration.Use short text for brief responses (1–255 characters) and long text for open-ended answers (1–2,000 characters).

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 58 42 AM" />

## Setting Privacy Options

For every Custom Field, you’ll configure **privacy settings** that determine who can view responses.These settings **cannot be changed later.**

* **Public:** Everyone in the Network can see responses.
* **Private:** Only Hosts, moderators, and the responding member can see responses.

Be mindful not to request sensitive information. All data collection must comply with [Mighty Networks' Terms and Conditions](https://www.mightynetworks.com/terms-of-use#_gl=1*19b37fh*_ga*MTk2NTgxNzEyMy4xNzI1MjkzMTg5*_ga_T49FMYQ9FZ*MTcyNTkxMjMzMi4yMy4xLjE3MjU5MTYwMDUuMC4wLjA.*_ga_NEGJ2SXNP7*MTcyNTkxMjMzMi4yOTAuMS4xNzI1OTE2MDA0LjcuMC4w).

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 58 57 AM" title="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 58 57 AM" />

## Making a Field Visible

After you create a field, it’s hidden by default.To make it visible, toggle **Visible** in the upper right corner of the field.

You’ll also have the option to **notify all members**. If enabled, members will receive an email and in-app notification letting them know a new field is available.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 10 59 16 AM" />

## Managing Custom Fields

All of your fields appear in the **Custom Fields list**. From here, you can:

* Edit a field
* Change the Display Field
* Hide or make a field visible
* Delete a field

You can filter and sort the list by type, visibility, privacy, field name, or number of respondents.

And you can sort by the following:

* Field Name (A to Z)
* Field Name (Z to A)
* Newest
* Oldest
* Display Order

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 11 00 05 AM" />

## Display Fields

The **Display Field** is the primary field that appears on member profiles and under the **Explore** filter in Global and Space Members.A star icon appears next to the current Display Field.

Only **public single-select** fields can be set as the Display Field.

To change it:

1. Open the **three-dot menu** next to the current Display Field and select **Remove as Display Field**.
2. Choose another eligible field and set it as the Display Field.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 11 00 19 AM" />

## Merging and Reordering Fields

* **Merge options:** If you allow custom responses for dropdowns, you can merge duplicate or similar responses. Go to **Edit Custom Field > Merge Option Into…** to combine them.
* **Reorder fields:** Change the order in which fields appear on member profiles by going to **Members > Reorder Custom Fields**.

## Viewing Member Responses

To review responses:

* From the **Custom Fields list**, open the **three-dot menu** next to a field and select **Edit Custom Field**. Then click the **Responses** tab.
* You can also view and filter responses in the **Member List** under [**Admin > Members > Member List**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-view-and-manage-my-members).

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 11 00 39 AM" />

## Member Experience

Members will see Custom Fields when editing their profile or by going to Personal Settings > Account > Private Responses.

You can also choose to notify them of new fields when they are created. The notifications will take them directly to their profile where they can fill out their answers.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 11 00 50 AM" />

After they select their response and click “Save”, they will see the response on their profile.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 11 01 03 AM" />

If they click on their response > **See Members**, they will see a list of the members who selected the same response.

## Using Custom Fields in Automations

Custom Fields can be used in **Automations**, which combine a **Trigger** and an **Action**.

You can trigger actions when a member:

* **Responds to a Custom Field**, or
* **Removes a response to a Custom Field.**

To learn more, check out this article [How Can I Set Up Automations?](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network)

## Search and Insights

# How Does Gamification Work in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/gamification/how-does-gamification-work-in-my-mighty-network



<iframe title="YouTube video player" />

Gamification features ([Launch plan ](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-courses-plan#whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-launch-plan)and up) help keep members motivated, engaged, and connected by recognizing consistent participation and meaningful contributions.

Mighty's gamification tools include **streaks**, **points**, **recognitions**, and **leaderboards**.

You can use these features together or independently, depending on the experience you want to create in your Mighty Network.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 04 16 At 9 45 51 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 04 16 At 9 45 51 AM" />
</Frame>

Mighty offers four core gamification features:

* **Streaks and streak milestones** to encourage daily visits
* **Points** to reward engagement and participation
* **Recognitions** to celebrate members who embody your Community Values
* **Leaderboard** to highlight the most recognized members across your Network

**Note:** [Limited members](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/what-is-a-full-vs-limited-membership) have access to Streaks only.

## Streaks and Streak Milestones

**Streaks** encourage members to return to your Mighty Network every day by tracking their daily visits.

## How to Enable or Disable Streaks

Go to **Admin > Engagement > Streaks** to turn this feature on or off.

On web, streaks appear within the **Gamification icon** (next to the invite icon in the upper right).

On mobile, they appear within the profile area in the bottom navigation tab.

## What Members See

Each member can view:

* **Current Streak:** Number of consecutive days they've signed in
* **Max Streak:** Their longest streak to date

When members reach specific streak milestones, an emoji appears next to their name on posts, comments, chats, and their profile.

The two types of streak data shown are:

* Current Streak: the current number of days in a row they've signed in at least once
* Max Streak: their longest streak to date

When members reach specific streak milestones, an emoji appears next to their name on posts, comments, chats, and their profile.

**The streak milestones are:**

* 3 days ⭐
* 7 days 🔥
* 14 days 🚀
* 30 days ⚡
* 45 days 🎉
* 60 days 💎
* 90 days 🏅
* 180 days 🏆
* 365 days 👑

Milestones and emojis aren't customizable at this time.

These emojis appear publicly and help inspire other members to build their own streaks.

## Calendar View

Members also see a **weekly calendar view** showing recent activity. Selecting **See More** opens their full streak calendar on their profile. This calendar is visible to everyone in your Mighty Network unless a member chooses to hide it.

To hide the streak calendar, go to **Personal Settings > Streaks** and toggle off **Public Streak Calendar**.

## Streak Notifications

Members will see:

* A small indicator on web showing their current streak progress
* A push notification (if enabled) reminding them to sign in when their streak is active

If a member has at least a 2-day streak and hasn't signed in by **2pm local time**, they'll receive a reminder to continue their streak.

Streak popups also appear inside Mighty Networks (top right on web, bottom of screen on mobile). These notifications can't currently be disabled.​

## Points, Recognitions, and Community Values

These features celebrate members for embodying your community's values and for engaging regularly.

## Setting Up Community Values

Go to **Admin > Engagement > Community Values > Get Started**.

You'll see three default values—you can edit, delete, or add your own.

## Adding Your Own Values

Select **Create from Recommendations** to view suggested values, or **Create New** to build your own. You can customize each value's name and image.

All values are currently worth **20 points** and are not customizable.

If you edit or remove a value, it will update or be removed for all members.

## How Members Earn Points

Members earn points in two ways:

* **Daily Visits:** Automatically earn 10 points each day they visit your Mighty Network.
* [**Automations:**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/automations/how-can-i-set-up-automations-in-my-mighty-network) Receive points for completing milestones or actions you define.

Members can view:

* Their total points
* Recognitions received
* Available points to recognize others

You can see how many points a member has received and how many points they have overall inside your [Mighty Insights™](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/what-is-mighty-insights#host-&-member-engagement-table)

## How Members Recognize

They'll then:

1. Choose a Community Value they want to recognize.
2. Add an optional note.
3. Click **Recognize** to send it.

# Data Security at Mighty Networks
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/data-security-at-mighty-networks



## Mighty Networks Security Overview

Mighty Networks is committed to protecting the privacy, security, and integrity of our customers’ data.

This overview answers common questions about how we safeguard your Network, your members, and your data.

For additional technical and legal details, please review:

* **[EU Data Processing Addendum (DPA)](https://www.mightynetworks.com/dpa)** — Section 6

* **SOC 2 Report** — available under a signed NDA

* **[Privacy Policies](https://www.mightynetworks.com/policies)** — full list of Mighty’s privacy commitments

* **[Uptime and Performance Status](https://status.mightynetworks.com/)** — real-time updates on Mighty’s availability

## Our Approach to Security

Mighty Networks’ software engineers follow strict security and code review processes to identify and address issues early.

* **Continuous Integration (CI) testing** verifies that all existing security measures remain effective.

* **Regular API and code reviews** ensure new features meet security, privacy, and performance standards.

* Our engineering team includes experts with formal training from **Microsoft**, **Symantec**, and other organizations—experienced in **threat modeling** and **security review**.

## Reporting Security Issues

If you suspect a security issue, please report it immediately to: 📧 **[security@mightynetworks.com]()**

All security concerns are logged as tickets, promptly escalated to engineering, and investigated for resolution.

## Penetration Testing and Vulnerability Management

* **Penetration Testing:** Our most recent independent test was completed in **April 2025**.

* **Vulnerability Testing:** We continuously test for proper security enforcement through our automated suite.

* **Third-Party Dependencies:** All software packages are regularly updated to reduce the risk of vulnerabilities in third-party code.

## API Security

## API Access

Customer API access is available through **Zapier** and open APIs which supports commonly requested actions and triggers. Learn more about available integrations [here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/analytics-and-integrations/does-mighty-networks-have-an-api).

## Authentication and Encryption

* All **Zapier API calls** are authenticated using revocable API keys and operate only over **HTTPS**.

* All **mobile and web traffic** (API and HTML) requires HTTPS and uses **TLS 1.2 or higher**.

* Authentication levels vary by feature:

  * Public Networks and registration/search APIs are accessible without authentication.

  * Private, Secret, and Plan Access Networks—as well as all write operations—use **OAuth/Session authentication** on web and **access tokens** on mobile.

## SAML Support

Mighty Networks **does not support SAML 2.0** for user authentication at this time.

## Code Review and Engineering Processes

* **Mobile code** requires review by at least one other engineer.

* **Server code** must be reviewed by two engineers before being merged into the master branch.

* Reviews evaluate security, privacy, performance, maintainability, and test coverage.

## Regulatory Compliance

Mighty Networks complies with major privacy and data protection laws:

* **GDPR** (General Data Protection Regulation)

* **CCPA** (California Consumer Privacy Act)

Mighty Networks **does not store**:

* Financial instruments (e.g., credit cards or full billing addresses), so **PCI DSS 3.0** and **Sarbanes-Oxley** do not apply.

* Medical data, except when users voluntarily share it in health-related Networks. **HIPAA compliance** is not offered.

All payment transactions are processed securely by **Stripe** or **Apple**.

## Data Security and Encryption

## Data Storage

All data is hosted on **Amazon Web Services (AWS)**. Learn more about AWS security [here](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/data-center/controls/).

## Data Deletion

Data is first **soft-deleted** (allowing recovery from errors) before being **permanently purged** on a regular schedule.

## Encryption

* All communications use **HTTPS** with **TLS 1.2+**.

* Member and Host content is **encrypted at rest** on AWS.

* All user passwords are stored with **one-way hashing**—they cannot be reversed.

* Mighty Networks does **not use or store physical media**.

## Backups and Disaster Recovery

## Backups

Mighty Networks relies on Amazon’s world-class backup systems:

* **Amazon RDS Aurora:** Daily snapshots and point-in-time recovery based on transaction logs.

* **AWS Elastic Cache:** Backups configured automatically.

* **Amazon Redshift:** Continuous backups to Amazon S3.

* **Elasticsearch:** Regular snapshots to Amazon S3.

* **Amazon S3:** Binary assets are geo-distributed and redundantly stored.

## Disaster Recovery

Every layer of Mighty Networks’ infrastructure is **redundant and fault-tolerant**.

In the event of a major outage—such as the loss of an entire AWS data center—Mighty Networks can **recover within 24 hours**, though most incidents are resolved much faster.

Rebuild scripts for new environments are tested several times a year as part of our **staging and performance testing process**.

## Summary

Mighty Networks takes a **multi-layered approach** to security that includes:

* Rigorous code review and testing

* Industry-standard encryption

* Redundant AWS infrastructure and backups

* Ongoing compliance with GDPR and CCPA

* Regular third-party audits and penetration tests

We are committed to transparency and continuous improvement in protecting your data and your members’ trust.


# How Do I Enable Multi-Factor Authentication and Email Verification?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/how-do-i-enable-multi-factor-authentication-and-email-verification



You can add extra security to your Mighty Network by turning on **Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)** and/or **Email Verification** for members. Both are optional but recommended.

## What Is Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)?

MFA adds a second step to the sign-in process. After entering a password, members are asked to enter a code from an authenticator app. It’s one of the simplest and most effective ways to protect accounts.

<iframe />

## How to Turn On MFA

1. Go to **Admin > Members > Member Settings > Multi-Factor Authentication.**
2. Toggle **Enable Multi-Factor Authentication** on.
3. Choose who MFA is required for:
   * **Not required for anyone** (default)
   * **Required for Hosts only**
   * **Required for Hosts and moderators**
   * **Required for everyone**
4. Click Save.

Once saved, anyone included in your selection will be logged out and prompted to set up MFA during their next sign-in.

## How MFA Works

MFA applies only to members who log in using an email and password.

A few important details:

* Members using **Single Sign-On (SSO)** will not be prompted to set up MFA. Networks using SSO won’t see MFA settings at all.
* MFA is compatible with **social sign-on** options like Google, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
* Members on an **outdated mobile app** will need to update before setting up MFA.
* When MFA is turned on, affected members will be logged out immediately, even if they’re in the middle of an action such as posting or joining a livestream.

## What Members Will See

When prompted to set up MFA, members will:

1. Open an authenticator app (we recommend **1Password**, but **Google Authenticator**, **Authy**, and others work too).
2. Scan the QR code or copy and paste the key into the app.
3. Enter the 6-digit code from the app back into Mighty Networks.

That’s it—MFA setup will be complete.​

## How to Turn Off MFA

To disable MFA for your Network:

1. Go to **Admin > Members > Member Settings > Multi-Factor Authentication.**
2. Select **Not required for anyone.**
3. Click Save.

## How to Reset MFA for an Account

If someone needs to reset their MFA:

1. Go to **Personal Settings > Account > Multi-Factor Authentication.**
2. Select **Reset Authentication and Log Out.**
3. They’ll be guided through setup again during their next login.

## Troubleshooting MFA

**If the code isn’t working:**

* Confirm the code matches what’s shown in the authenticator app.
* Remember, codes refresh every few seconds—try a new one.
* Make sure you’re using the correct code for your Mighty Networks account.

**If you got a new phone or device:**

* Reinstall your authenticator app.
* Log back into the app with your credentials.
* If you can’t restore access, follow the app’s recovery instructions.

## What Is Email Verification?

## How to Turn On Email Verification

1. Go to **Admin > Members > Member Settings > Email Verification.**
2. Toggle the feature on.

When enabled:

* Every new member must verify their email before their account is created.
* Existing members can verify their email anytime by going to **Personal Settings > Account > Email and Password.**

After signing up, new members will see a screen prompting them to check their email and enter a verification code.

If you toggle this feature off, the verification prompt still appears but includes an option to skip.

## Need Help?

If you have questions or run into issues, our **Customer Advocacy team** is here to help. Click the **Need Help** button in the lower right corner of your Mighty Network.


# How Does Mighty Networks Approach Accessibility?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/how-does-mighty-networks-approach-accessibility



Our vision at Mighty Networks is to unlock a world with millions of unique, vibrant communities mastering something interesting together, led by creators, brands, organizations, and coaches.

To reach that vision, we are committed to developing and upgrading Mighty Networks functionality to work for everyone. Whenever possible, we strive to provide accessibility support natively and by using integrations available in web browsers, iOS app built-in features, and common built-in features on Android devices.

We have already taken significant steps on our path to becoming compliant with the [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines](https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/wcag/) (WCAG), and we are close to Level AA WCAG 2.1 compliance. We’ve completed an audit of the platform to identify accessibility improvements and are working to be AA compliant with our current features, as well as incorporating compliance into new features as we develop them.

A key visual accessibility component involves how color and contrast are used. To achieve the WCAG AA rating, the contrast ratio between the text and icons in a Mighty Network and the background color they appear on should be at least 4.5. Our platform prompts and guides our customers to make compliance color choices, and if the contrast ratio is not adequate, the system will automatically correct the contrast to preserve visual accessibility. [More details on these features are here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-up-my-network-branding).

When adding content, Hosts can enable video captions on [natively uploaded videos.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-upload-native-videos-to-my-mighty-network) For embedded videos, we encourage our customers to use closed captioning, subtitles, and/or transcripts to accompany videos. We offer embedding for many video providers with these kinds of features, such as Searchie.io, YouTube, and Vimeo, [as described here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-external-embeds). We also recommend adding caption text with photos for any content that includes imagery, and we soon plan to introduce “alt” tag support on images.

Our native video player offers playback speed support, and we plan to continue expanding its accessibility features going forward.

For photosensitive Hosts and members, we allow the ability to [toggle off GIFs](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-gifs-in-my-mighty-network) on the Network level and the ability to toggle off auto-playing content in [personal settings](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-manage-my-personal-settings). We plan to extend this support to additional animations in the future, and until then, we also invite those on Apple devices to check out their suite of Accessibility options [here](https://www.apple.com/accessibility/cognitive/), along with additional options for those on [Android](https://support.google.com/accessibility/android/answer/6006564?hl=en) or [Windows](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/accessibility-features).

We invite you to follow along with our [weekly product updates](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/latest-product-updates) here, as well as monitor our [upcoming product roadmap](https://portal.productboard.com/wvvyyuvre1lgd6rcaw5mpdfz). For further questions or suggestions, contact us at [help@mightynetworks.com](mailto:help@mightynetworks.com).


# Is Mighty Networks GDPR and CCPA Compliant?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/is-mighty-networks-gdpr-and-ccpa-compliant



Yes! We’ve done extensive work to ensure your Mighty Network **is GDPR and CCPA compliant** and your data (and your members' data) is stored securely.

Please note that **<i>we do not sell your personal data – such as your name or your members’ names and contact information – to third parties to use for their own marketing purposes</i>**.

Please see our full list of policies **[here](https://www.mightynetworks.com/policies)**.

## Summary of GDPR Compliance

In GDPR terminology, Hosts are the Data Controllers, and Mighty Networks is the Data Processor.

The only information that Mighty Networks collects from members for our own purposes is the IP Address and mobile device ID. We need this information so that we and the companies that support our website and apps know where to send responses to your page requests. We also use it to determine your general geographic location and make the name of your town visible to your fellow Network Members.

You have the right to request that we delete any of your personal information that we collected from you and retained. You can also delete your Mighty Network account (on a network-by-network basis); for instructions, see **[here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/data-security-at-mighty-networks)**. Once we receive and confirm your verifiable consumer request, we will delete (and direct our service providers to delete) your personal information from our records, unless an exception applies.

We have a full **[GDPR summary](https://www.mightynetworks.com/gdpr)** for review, and you can find our most up-to-date policies at **[mightynetworks.com/policies](https://mightynetworks.com/policies)**. **[Here is a list of countries](https://www.gdpradvisor.co.uk/gdpr-countries)** where GDPR has been implemented.

For more information, including details about how we comply with data subject rights under GDPR, and more information on invoking your right to delete, please see our **[Privacy Policy](https://www.mightynetworks.com/privacy-policy)** and **[Cookie Policy](https://www.mightynetworks.com/cookie-policy)**, or contact our Data Protection Officer at [dpo@mightynetworks.com](mailto:dpo@mightynetworks.com).

## Summary of CCPA Compliance

The CCPA requires us to disclose information regarding the categories of personal information that we have collected about California consumers, the categories of sources from which the information was collected, the business or commercial purposes for which the information was collected, and the categories of parties with whom we share it.

You have the right to request that we delete any of your personal information that we collected from you and retained, subject to certain exceptions. You can also delete your Mighty Network account (on a network-by-network basis); for instructions, see **[here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/how-do-i-downgrade-or-cancel-my-plan)**. Once we receive and confirm your verifiable consumer request, we will delete (and direct our service providers to delete) your personal information from our records, unless an exception applies.

We have a full **[CCPA summary](https://www.mightynetworks.com/california-privacy-notice)** for review, and you can find our most up-to-date policies at mightynetworks.com/policies.

For more information, including details about how we comply with data subject rights under CCPA, and more information on invoking your right to delete, please see our **[Privacy Policy](https://www.mightynetworks.com/privacy-policy)** and **[Cookie Policy](https://www.mightynetworks.com/cookie-policy)**, or contact our Data Protection Officer at [dpo@mightynetworks.com](mailto:dpo@mightynetworks.com).


# The EU Consumer Rights Directive — Cancellation Rights
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/the-eu-consumer-rights-directive-cancellation-rights

How Mighty Networks complies with the EU Consumer Rights Directive, including the cancellation path available to members and how to set up automated cancellation confirmation emails.

The EU Consumer Rights Directive grants consumers in the European Union the right to cancel a subscription within 14 days of purchase and receive a refund for any unused portion of service.

To comply with this requirement, Mighty Networks provides a clear and accessible cancellation path for all members.

## How Cancellation Works

Members can cancel a paid plan at any time by navigating to **Plans & Access > Cancel Subscription** within their Network. This flow serves as the cancellation mechanism under the Directive and is available on the web.

For purchases made through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store, cancellation is handled directly by Apple and Google in accordance with their own compliance obligations.

## Automated Email

The Directive requires that consumers receive an email confirmation of their cancellation.

There are 2 ways to set this up:

### With the Mighty + Zapier Integration

If you've connected your Mighty Network via our Zapier integration, follow these steps:

1. Create a new Zap and select **Mighty Networks** as the trigger app.
2. Select the trigger **Canceled Subscription to Plan**. This fires immediately when a member cancels — so the confirmation sends without waiting for the billing period to end.
3. Connect your Mighty Network account. If you're connecting for the first time, you'll need your API key.
4. Select the specific plan (or plans) this should apply to, or leave it blank to cover any plan.
5. Add an action step using your email tool of choice (Gmail, Outlook, or Kit) and select the **Send Email** action.
6. Map the member's email address from the trigger data into the **To** field, then write your cancellation confirmation message in the body.
7. Test the Zap, then turn it on.

### Without the Mighty + Zapier Integration

1. Create a new Zap in Zapier and select **Stripe** as the trigger app.
2. Select the trigger **Updated Subscription**.
3. Connect your Stripe account.
4. Add a **Filter by Zapier** action step.
5. Set **Only continue if...** and map the Stripe field **Cancel At Exists** AND **Previous Attributes Canceled At** does not exist. This ensures only cancellation events trigger the Zap.
6. Add an action step using your email tool of choice (Gmail, Outlook, or Kit) and select the **Send Email** action.
7. Map the member's email address from the Stripe data into the **To** field, then write your cancellation confirmation message in the body.
8. Test the Zap, then turn it on.

**Important:** This Zap covers cancellations made through Mighty Networks (web and mobile web). Subscriptions purchased through the iOS App Store are managed and canceled in Apple's settings, so this trigger may not capture those cancellations.

## Refunds Within the Withdrawal Window

If a member cancels within 14 days of purchasing a paid plan, they're entitled to a pro-rated refund for the unused portion of their subscription.

If you have any questions, reach out to our team at [help@mightynetworks.com](mailto:help@mightynetworks.com).


# The UK Online Safety Act
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/the-uk-online-safety-act



The [UK Online Safety Act 2023 (OSA)](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/online-safety-act-explainer/online-safety-act-explainer) requires platforms, like Mighty Networks, to restrict access to content defined as “primary priority content that is harmful to children.”

To comply with the law, we’ve taken two steps:

* Free Plan Networks: UK access is blocked, since the Free Plan does not include the moderation tools needed for compliance. Restoring access requires upgrading to a premium plan, which includes those tools.​

* Paid Plan Networks (including Community): Our compliance systems flag content that requires age verification. In these cases, UK access can only be restored if:

  * All existing UK members are verified through a compliant, approved provider, and

  * All new UK members complete age verification during signup.​

Your Network and content remain fully available to members outside the UK.

We hope to continue to improve our native safeguard so that access can be allowed in the UK while meeting UK requirements, however, these improvements are not expected until later in 2026 since this requires time and extreme diligence on our end.

In the meantime, if you’d like to implement your own native safeguard that allows access to your Network in the UK while meeting OSA requirements, you can explore integrating with a third-party service called Yoti. [Here’s our guide on how that set up](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/can-i-set-up-age-verification-in-my-mighty-network).

Please note, by choosing an alternative to our native safeguard, like Yoti, it would require you to verify all existing members and have an age verification process in place for new members. Only after both requirements are reviewed and approved by us, can we legally remove our native safeguard.

We know this adds complexity, and our team is here to support you as you decide the best path forward for your community.

If you have any questions, you can reach out to our team at [help@mightynetworks.com](mailto:help@mightynetworks.com).


# What's Mighty Networks' Privacy Policy?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/whats-mighty-networks-privacy-policy



At Mighty Networks, we take privacy and data security very seriously, and we have done extensive work to ensure that your Mighty Network is GDPR and CCPA-compliant and that your data (and your members' data) is stored securely.

## Our Privacy Promise

Hosts have complete control over the content they add and the information they share within their own Mighty Network. We do not censor content or remove content, provided you and your members are participating within our [**Terms of Use**](https://www.mightynetworks.com/terms-of-use?utm_source=intercom\&utm_medium=getting_started\&utm_campaign=our_policies\&utm_content=).

You may also [add your own Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, or Community Guidelines](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/can-i-add-my-own-custom-terms-of-use-to-my-mighty-network) as the third policy for your members to agree with when they create accounts. Send us a note via Host Help with the URL link to your additional guidelines, your Mighty Network URL, and the title you want to appear in 30 characters or less. We'll get it added in a day.

As the Host of a Mighty Network, you have the ability to choose the [**privacy settings**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network) you want to enable for your community. Communities that have visibility toggled to the most restrictive options are completely locked down, and non-members (including search engines) cannot see the content, memberships, and conversations inside your Mighty Network.

If you choose to make your Mighty Network **invite only**, only members with an invite will be able to join. You, as the Host of your community, also have the power to [**remove a member or ban them**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/what-content-and-moderation-tools-do-i-have-in-my-mighty-network) at any point.

## Mighty Networks and Your Members

Mighty Networks will never email your members with any marketing communications outside of the [**notifications**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-member) they opt into that come from your community when they join. If there are notable changes to the Mighty Networks Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, members will receive an email notification from Mighty Networks.

Occasionally, you, as a Host, may receive communications from our team about feature updates and announcements, but those emails will only go out to folks who are Hosts and creators of their own Mighty Networks. Only you, as the Host (or anyone else on your team who is listed as a Host), should be getting those emails.

## Mighty Networks Policies

Please visit [this page](https://www.mightynetworks.com/policies) to view our policies and terms of use documents.

## Questions About Data Security?

Check out our [Data Security at Mighty Networks FAQs](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/privacy-security-accessibility/data-security-at-mighty-networks). This overview offers answers to common questions about Mighty Networks' security.

# How Do I Set or Reset My Password?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-set-or-reset-my-password



If you need to set up, reset, or update your password, here’s how to do it:

## Setting Up a Password for the First Time

If you originally signed in using Facebook, LinkedIn, or without creating a password, you may not have set one up when you first joined [your Mighty Network](https://mightynetworks.com/sign_in). To set up a new password or unlink your account from Facebook or LinkedIn:

1. **Sign in on a Web Browser**: You can only set up or update your password through a web browser, not through the mobile app.​

2. **Go to Your Profile**: After signing in, click on your Profile Photo > Personal Settings > Account > Update Email & Password.​

3. **Add a Password**: Select the option to "Add a Password."[](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/703957155/de50274e3397b8d973e8ccf8/update+password.png?expires=1765234800\&signature=c36f5f1c30243ac84fbe9987c7840dc5313674d0ff6e5379af3b1b88f079b173\&req=cyAkH8x5nIRaFb4f3HP0gP9MKef3gXCZVnoFHf1t7PKWlWW0ANw%2Bpcar%2FUOq%0AFro%3D%0A)

4. **Check Your Email**: We’ll send you an email with a link to set up your new password. If you don't see the email in your inbox, check your spam or junk folder.

Once you’ve set up your password, you can use it to log in going forward.​

## Resetting Your Password

If you already have a password but need to reset it:

1. **Use a Web Browser**: You'll need to use a web browser to reset your password, not the mobile app.​

2. **Click “Forgot Password?”**: On the sign-in page for your Mighty Network, click the "Forgot password?" link below the "Password" text box. On the next page, enter your email address and click "Send Email."​

3. **Check Your Email**: You’ll receive a password reset email. If you don't see it in your inbox, check your spam or junk folder. This email is valid for only one hour, but you can send yourself as many password reset emails as needed.

**Important Note:** If you click "Forgot Password?" in the mobile app, you’ll receive a magic link email that automatically logs you back into the app, but it will not allow you to reset your password. To reset your password, you must do so through a web browser.

If you're not receiving the password reset email, [click here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/why-cant-i-log-in-to-my-mighty-network).​

## Changing Your Email Address

To change your email address:

1. **On a Web Browser**: Click on your profile picture > Personal Settings > Account > Update Email and Password. From there, you’ll see the option to change your email address.​

2. **On Mobile**: You can also change your email address using the mobile app by following the same steps.​[](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/585720460/67a40e409ac8ddeede78623a/change+email+mobile.png?expires=1765234800\&signature=a0f8df11cea784cb63844f105f55595e6db855fee34d6afc39c981b54b1edd17\&req=cSgiEct%2BmYdfFb4f3HP0gAU77ShWX4s2DqGZ%2FfR4a%2FGo2kwdx8vudwPzzUoa%0AI0c%3D%0A)
