# Can I Connect My AI Assistant to My Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/can-i-connect-my-ai-assistant-to-my-network



If your Host has enabled MCP (Model Context Protocol) access, you can connect supported AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT to your Mighty Network.

Once connected, you can use natural language prompts to find information, summarize activity, and interact with content you already have access to in the Network.

## **What is MCP?**

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard that allows AI assistants to securely connect to external platforms.

In Mighty Networks, MCP lets your AI assistant access content and perform actions based on your account permissions.

For example, you might ask:

* "Summarize the activity in the community over the past week.”
* "Summarize my unread notifications."
* “Make a new draft multiple choice poll for me to approve.”

The AI assistant only has access to content and actions that you can already access.

## **Before You Start**

To use MCP:

* Your Host must enable MCP access for members.
* You must have a supported AI assistant that supports MCP connections.
* You must authenticate using your Mighty Networks account.

If you don't see MCP connection options, your Host may not have enabled access for your role.

## **Find Your MCP Connection Details**

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 08 At 8 37 09 AM 1" />
</Frame>

To connect an AI assistant:

1. Open **Connectors** in your Mighty Network.
2. Copy your personal MCP connection url.
3. Follow the setup instructions provided by your AI assistant.

For example:

**Claude:** Go to Settings > Connectors > Add Custom Connector and then paste your url there.

Each member receives access based on their own account permissions.

<iframe title="Loom video player" />

## **What Can I Do with MCP?**

Available capabilities depend on:

* Your role in the Network
* The permissions granted by your Host
* The MCP capabilities currently supported by Mighty Networks

Depending on your access, you may be able to:

* Search Network content
* Review discussions and comments
* Summarize posts and activity
* Review notifications
* Access content from Spaces you can view

## **How Permissions Work**

MCP follows the same permissions used throughout Mighty Networks.

This means:

* You can only access content you can already view.
* You cannot access Spaces you don't belong to.
* You cannot perform Host-only actions unless you are a Host.
* The MCP does not provide elevated access.

Your AI assistant can only retrieve information and perform actions that are available to your account.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### **Can MCP see content that I can't access in Mighty Networks?**

No.

MCP follows your existing permissions and only provides access to content and actions available to your account.

### **Can I use ChatGPT or Claude?**

Yes, if:

* Your Host has enabled MCP access.
* The AI assistant supports MCP connections.
* You successfully authenticate using your Mighty Networks account.

### **Why don't I see MCP connection options?**

Your Host may not have enabled MCP access for members or for your role.

Contact your Host if you believe you should have access.

### **Does MCP allow me to perform Host actions?**

No.

Hosts, moderators, and members each receive access according to their role and permissions.

### **Is my MCP connection shared with other members?**

No.

Each member authenticates separately and accesses MCP using their own Mighty Networks account.

### **Can I disconnect my AI assistant?**

On the Mighty side, simply visit the Connectors area within the Network to disconnect from your AI assistant. To disconnect on your AI assistant’s side, please refer to that service’s documentation.


# How Do I Create Events as a Member?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-create-events-as-a-member



If your Host has enabled the option for members to add events to your Mighty Network, there are four different event types to choose from **local events**, **live chats**, **live video events**, and **online meetings**.

Generally, live video events and online meetings function in the same way—for both of these event types, you'll need to add an external link to where your live video stream or online meeting will take place.

## How to Create an Event

You can use the Create button to create an Event.

From there, you'll see options to customize the Event:

You'll see options to select and customize:

* The title of your Event
* If you want the Event to immediately show in the [Feed](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-does-the-feed-work) when it's posted (if you have the feature enabled)
* The start time and end time for the Event, including time zone (for online Events, members will see the Event's time in their local time zone, and for Local Events, you can indicate if the Event's time zone differs from the member's local time)
* If you want this to be a [Repeat Event](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network)
* The Event Type
  * \[Network Name] [Livestream](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-livestream-in-my-network)
  * [Zoom](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-zoom-events-on-mighty-networks)
  * External Livestream: use this for any other meeting type
  * [Text Chat](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-a-text-chat-event)
* How you want to [manage RSVPs](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network)
* If you want the live indicator to show (does not apply to Repeat Events)
* The [imagery and thumbnails you want to use for your Event](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network)
* The description for your Event (this area can include unlimited images, [media embeds](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-external-embeds?q=upload), [file attachments](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network#:~:text=Adding%20Rich%20Media%20to%20an%20Article), formatted text, and more—just like any [Article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-an-article-in-my-mighty-network) you create in your Mighty Network)

When you publish your event you may choose to notify all members or you can [schedule it to publish later](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-a-post-in-my-mighty-network). Note that Single Events cannot be scheduled, but the Single Event feature tab itself can be set to Hidden until ready to display.

Note: Once an Event has been created, the Event Host cannot be changed.

When you add an event, it's public to all members of your Network or to members of the Space you are in.

Nor is there a way yet to limit RSVPs or attendees to a certain number of people. However, events that exist within a Space are only available to members of that Space.

[Learn more about how to create Events in your own Mighty Network here.](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/how-do-i-create-events-in-my-mighty-network)


# How Do I Post in a Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-post-in-a-mighty-network



<iframe />

As a member, you can share updates in a Mighty Network in a number of ways **Posts**, **Articles, and Questions or Polls**.

Here’s how each one works and when to use them.

## How to Create a Post

**On web:** go to a Space and click "Share a Post"

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 04 16 At 9 57 50 AM" />
</Frame>

On mobile: open the Mighty Networks iOS or Android app and tap the **pencil icon** at the bottom right.

<iframe />

## You can add or create:

* A single photo or up to 6 photos
* A video file
* A video link (YouTube, Vimeo etc..)
* A file
* A question or poll
* Add a background image
* GIF
* Emojis

## Adding Text to Images

If you post a single image, you can add text either:

* **Below the image** (like a caption), or
* **On top of the image** (making it the background).

Tap or click the corner prompt to switch between these options.

## Image Sizes

## Post images show in either:

* **21:9** (horizontal), or
* **3:4** (vertical)

The **3:4 ratio** works best if you want the image as a background. If not, any size will display as uploaded.

Note: very wide or tall images may get cropped, but the full image shows if someone clicks on it.

## Formatting

You can bold, italicize, underline and more by highlighting the text.

<img alt="Screenshot 2025 12 19 At 12 40 39 PM" />

## Create an Article

If your Host allows members to create Articles, you’ll see this option in your **Create** menu.

Articles offer full formatting and support:

* Unlimited photos
* Video embeds (YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook)
* File attachments up to 25 MB each
* Rich media (SoundCloud, Spotify, Typeform, and more)

## Formatting Text

Highlight any text in the editor to:

* Add **headers** (five levels available)
* Apply **bold**, *italic*, strikethrough, or underline
* Add **quotes** or change text **color** and **highlight color**
* Insert **hyperlinks**

## Adding Rich Media

To upload media within your Article:

1. Press **Enter** to create a new line.
2. Select the **+** button on the left side of the editor.
3. Choose to add a **photo**, **video**, [**media embed**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/can-i-use-external-embeds), **file attachment**, or **section divider**.

To add a line of text below a media item, hover under it and click the arrow that appears.

## Create a Question or Poll

You can ask a question or start a poll from any Space.

## On web

1. Go to a Space
2. Select the **Create** button
3. Choose **Poll** or **Question**

Poll options include:

* Multiple Choice
* Percentage Poll
* Hot Cold Poll

[**To learn more about each type, check out this article.**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-create-polls-questions-in-my-mighty-network#:~:text=Question%20or%20Poll.-,Single%20Questions,-Create%20a%20single)

## On mobile

Select **the pencil icon and the dropdown menu at the top**.

Either choose "Ask Question" or "Create Poll"

## Hashtags, GIFs, and Emojis

You can use **hashtags, emojis, and GIFs** in Posts, Chat, Articles, or comments.

## Hashtags

* Anyone can make hashtags.
* Type “#” plus your text (letters, numbers, or underscores).
* No spaces or special characters (&, \$, etc.).
* You can use more than one hashtag per post.
* Hashtags show up in a dropdown as you type.

Clicking a hashtag shows all posts across the Network that use it.

To learn more about how hashtags work in your Mighty Network, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-use-hashtags-in-my-mighty-network).

## GIFs and Emojis

You can add GIFs and emojis to posts, comments, chat, or Articles.

## Comments

You can turn comments **on or off** for any post you make.

**How it works:**

* Open the three-dot menu on a post
* Toggle comments on or off
* Turning them off hides existing comments, but they come back if you turn comments back on

## Posting in Your Mighty Network

## Schedule a Post

You can also schedule a Post to publish at a later date and time. This feature is available on desktop and can be used for all content types, including **Posts**, **Articles**, **Events**, **Polls**, and **Questions**.

To schedule a Post, you must also be the Space Host or Space moderator.

1. On web, open your Post draft.
2. Select the down arrow next to **Post**.
3. Choose **Schedule Post** and set the date and time.

## Managing Scheduled Posts

You can view and manage all scheduled Posts in your Mighty Network:

1. Select your profile picture.
2. Choose **Scheduled Posts**.

From here, you can:

* View all upcoming scheduled Posts from any Host or moderator.
* Select a Post to edit its content or scheduled time.
* Use the three-dot menu to **Move** or **Delete** a Post.

## Make it Better (AI Tool)

If you're on the [Community plan](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/meet-mighty/whats-included-in-the-mighty-networks-community-plan) (or higher) and have [AI enabled,](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/marketing-features/what-ai-features-does-mighty-networks-have) you can highlight any text in your post and click the **"Make it Better" sparkle icon.**

Options include:

* Fix spelling and grammar
* Shorten or expand text
* Change the tone (Casual, Fun, Professional, Sincere, Witty)


# How Do I RSVP and Attend Events as a Member?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-rsvp-and-attend-events-as-a-member



RSVPing for and attending Events in your Mighty Network is simple! This guide will walk you through everything you need to know, step by step.

## How to RSVP to an Event

**Find the Event**

* Go to the Event you want to attend.

**Choose Your RSVP**

* Select one:

  * **Going**

  * **Maybe**

  * **Not Going**

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-rsvp-and-attend-events-as-a-member/Screenshot-2025-12-04-at-8_54_48-AM.png)

* For recurring Events, you can RSVP to specific ones in the series.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-rsvp-and-attend-events-as-a-member/Screenshot-2025-12-05-at-9_59_04-AM.png)

**After You RSVP “Going”**

* Change your RSVP if needed.

* See who else is attending.

* **Add the Event to your calendar** by clicking **Add to Calendar**.

* Get reminders: you’ll receive a notification about 10 minutes before the Event (by email, push, or both—depending on your settings).

**Once you RSVP as Going, you’ll see options to:**

* Change your RSVP

* See who else has RSVP’d

**Add the Event to Your Calendar:**

* After RSVPing, select Add to Calendar to save it to your personal calendar.

**Get Reminders:** You'll receive a reminder 10 minutes before the Event starts via email, push notification, or both—depending on [your notification preferences](/for-members/account-and-purchases/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-member).

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-rsvp-and-attend-events-as-a-member/Screenshot-2025-10-01-at-3_50_32-PM.png)

## What Happens When the Event Starts?

* **If you RSVP’d Yes or No:** You can’t change your RSVP after the Event begins.

* **If you didn’t RSVP:** The option to RSVP disappears once the Event starts.

* **If you RSVP’d Maybe:** You can still change to Yes or No after the Event starts, but once you decide, the option goes away.

* **After the Event ends:** The RSVP prompt is no longer visible.

## How to Attend an Event

* **Find Your Event**

  * Livestream Events:

  * On the event page, there will be a countdown on the event.

  * If the countdown ends but the livestream hasn't started, you will see **"The livestream will begin shortly!"**

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-rsvp-and-attend-events-as-a-member/Screenshot-2025-12-04-at-8_56_44-AM.png)

* After the livestream begins, you will see **"Join the Livestream"** which will take you directly to the live video.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-rsvp-and-attend-events-as-a-member/Screenshot-2025-12-04-at-12_12_41-PM.png)

* **Zoom Events**: The Event page shows "Zoom Meeting" which is a hyperlink to the Zoom meeting.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-rsvp-and-attend-events-as-a-member/Screenshot-2025-12-04-at-8_54_48-AM.png)

* **Explore Calendar View (Web only)**

  * **[Expand the calendar in the top-right corner.](/for-hosts/events-and-livestream/is-there-a-calendar-view-for-events)**

  * Use the arrows to browse past or future months.

  * Sync Events to your Google, Outlook, or Apple calendar. You can sync **all Events** or only the ones you RSVP’d to.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-rsvp-and-attend-events-as-a-member/Screenshot-2025-10-01-at-3_54_58-PM.png)

## Global Event Feature

If your Host has enabled it, you’ll see a Global Event Feature in the upper-left corner of your Mighty Network. This feature gathers all Events from across your Network into one place, making it easy to see everything you can join.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-rsvp-and-attend-events-as-a-member/Screenshot-2025-10-01-at-3_55_26-PM.png)


# How Do I Use Hashtags in My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-use-hashtags-in-my-mighty-network



You can add hashtags to **Posts, Chat messages, Articles, comments, Lessons and Sections, Events, and Questions & Polls** on web or mobile.

To add one, type a **#** followed by text—just like on other platforms. You can include multiple hashtags in the same piece of content.

## Hashtag Basics

Hashtags can include letters, numbers, or underscores. They can’t include other special characters (like **&** or **\$**) or extra spaces.

As you type, you’ll see a dropdown showing existing hashtags. Continue typing to create a new one.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-use-hashtags-in-my-mighty-network/Screenshot-2025-11-12-at-9_04_08-AM.png)

You may also see a list of Highlighted Hashtags featured in a Space:

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-use-hashtags-in-my-mighty-network/featured-sections-space.png)

## Searching for Hashtags

When you click a hashtag, you'll see search results for all content across the **Mighty Network** that includes it, sorted by relevance.

To view all results for a hashtag across every Space you have access to:

1. Click **Search** in a Space.

2. Click the highlighted hashtag.

3. At the top of the results, de-select the Space filter to **Search All Spaces**.

**Note:** Search results include **Posts** and **Articles** with hashtags. They don’t include messages in **Chat Spaces** or **Private Chats**.

You can also sort hashtag results by **Top**, **Newest**, or **Oldest**.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-use-hashtags-in-my-mighty-network/Screenshot-2025-11-12-at-9_31_46-E2-80-AFAM.png)

## Hashtag Prompt

When creating **Posts**, **Articles**, or comments on web (and on iOS or Android for Posts), you’ll see a prompt to add a hashtag.

Click the prompt to insert a **#** where your cursor is. As you type, a dropdown will appear showing hashtags— including any **highlighted hashtags** in that Space.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-use-hashtags-in-my-mighty-network/Screenshot-2025-11-12-at-9_04_08-E2-80-AFAM.png)


# How Does the Feed Work?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-does-the-feed-work



You’ll find the **Feed** feature in two main places across your Mighty Network

**Global Feed:** Found in the upper-left navigation and shows posts from all Spaces you can access.

If your Host opted to turn this on, then you may see it listed as "Feed" or another custom name!

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 29 At 1 20 24 PM" title="Screenshot 2026 05 29 At 1 20 24 PM" />
</Frame>

**Space Feed:** Found inside an individual Space — shows posts created within that Space only.

<frame />

<Frame>
  <img alt="Community" title="Community" />
</Frame>

## The Global Feed

The **Global Feed** is a centralized stream of activity where everyone can explore and interact with content from the Spaces they belong to.

You can like, react, or comment on posts directly in the Global Feed.

### [**​**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work#create-posts-directly-from-the-global-feed)Create Posts Directly from the Global Feed

You can also create content from the Global Feed without navigating into a Space first.

* On web, click the **Create** button at the top of the Feed.
* On mobile, tap the **+** icon.

Then:

1. Choose a **Space** where you want to post.
2. Select a **post type** (such as Post, Article, or Event) based on what’s available in that Space.
3. You’ll be taken directly to that Space to publish your content.

It’s a quick shortcut for posting anywhere in your [Network!](http://Network.Space)

## Space Feed

Each individual Space can also have its own **Feed**.

The Space Feed works just like the Global Feed—but everything you post here lives within that specific Space.

From a Space Feed, you may be able to post (depending on your Host's settings):

* [**Posts**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-post-in-a-mighty-network)
* [**Articles**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-post-in-a-mighty-network)
* [**Events**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-create-events-as-a-member)
* [**Polls and Questions**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-post-in-a-mighty-network)

## Searching and Filtering in the Feed

In both Global and Space Feeds, you can search and filter to find the content you need.

Click the **Showing** button to search across:

* Articles
* Events
* Comments
* Custom Fields
* Hashtags
* Spaces

### [**​**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work#filter-options)

#### **Filter Options**

You can refine what you see using filters such as:

* Everything
* Personal Feed
* Your Activity
* From Your Hosts
* Near You
* Unanswered
* Posts
* Questions and Polls
* Articles
* Events

You can apply multiple filters at once to customize your view.

### [**​**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work#sort-options)

#### Sort Options

Click **Showing By** to sort results by:

* **Top** (most relevant)
* **Newest** (most recently published)
* **Latest Activity** (most recently engaged)
* **Oldest** (earliest published)

## [**​**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/what-is-the-feed-and-how-does-it-work#hashtags)

### Hashtags

Help organize posts and activity across your Mighty Network. Each post can include multiple hashtags to make related content easier to find.

To learn more, check out " [How Do I Use Hashtags in My Mighty Network?"](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-use-hashtags-in-my-mighty-network)

# My Host is Going Live—Where Do I Watch Them?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/my-host-is-going-livewhere-do-i-watch-them



Your Hosts can go live right in their Mighty Network! Whenever they do, a realtime preview of the stream will be visible at the top of your Mighty Network.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/my-host-is-going-livewhere-do-i-watch-them/14515377930253)

To join the livestream, click anywhere on the preview and it’ll open up full screen with sound. On the right-hand side, you can chat with fellow members and see a full list of who’s currently watching.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/engage-and-interact/my-host-is-going-livewhere-do-i-watch-them/14515477316365)

If your Host goes live, you’ll receive a notification if your Host chooses to notify all members, or based on your notification settings. This is on by default.

If your Host is going live for the members of a specific Space and you’re one of them, you’ll still always find the livestream at the top of your Mighty Network. No need to click into any other Space to find it!

Your Host can decide to record the livestream, so if you miss it they may post a replay for you to enjoy later.


# How Do I Chat With Other Members? 
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/untitled-page



**Chat** is a simple, powerful way for you to connect with other members and keep conversations flowing—whether it’s one-on-one or in a group of any size.

## Types of Chat

* **Private chats** between 2 members
* **Group chats** with no limit on how many members you can add
* **Space chats** connecting inside of a Space

## Private Chat

To start a chat with a member:

* Click the **chat** icon in the upper right corner.
* Select **+** to start a new chat.
* Search for and select the member you want to include.
* Click **Start Chat**

You can also start a private chat by visiting a member’s profile and selecting **Chat**.

<Frame>
  <img alt="New Chat" />
</Frame>

## **Group Chat**

* Click the **chat** icon in the upper right corner.
* Select **+** to start a new chat.
* Search for and select the member you want to include.
  * You will be able to add up to 50 members at a time, however there is no limit to how many people can be in a group chat.

## Managing a Conversation

* Click on the three dot menu > Settings to see options to:
  * **Customize** the name of the chat
  * **Add/remove** people
  * **Mute** the conversation
  * **Bookmark** the conversation
  * **Archive** the conversation
  * **Leave** the conversation
  * Any participant can do this, including in a 1:1 chat.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 27 At 2 03 55 PM 1" title="Screenshot 2026 07 27 At 2 03 55 PM 1" />
</Frame>

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 01 47 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 01 47 AM" />
</Frame>

## Adding and Removing Members

### Adding Members

Go to conversation settings in the three dot menu and select the **+** icon to add up to 50 people at a time. There’s no limit on how large a group chat can grow.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 32 30 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 32 30 AM" />
</Frame>

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 03 07 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 03 07 AM" />
</Frame>

The list won’t show people who are already in the chat, have private chat disabled, are blocked, or are limited members.

If a conversation with the same people already exists, we’ll ask whether you want to add them there or start a new conversation.

**Added members:**

* See the full conversation history from the beginning of the chat when they join
* Won’t get notified that they were added, but they’ll see an unread count on their chat icon for any messages they haven’t viewed yet

### Removing Members

Any member can select and remove another member from the conversation by clicking the three dot menu next to their name:

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 05 03 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 07 28 At 9 05 03 AM" />
</Frame>

**Removed Members**

* Won't get notified that they were removed
* If they happen to be inside the conversation when it happens, they’ll see a message that they’re no longer part of the chat. The conversation disappears from their list the next time they navigate away or refresh.

## System Messages

When someone is added, removed, leaves, or renames a conversation, everyone in the chat sees a message describing what changed.

## **Space Chat**

Inside of each Space, there is the ability to chat with other members.

Depending on the type of community you're a part of, your Host may or may not have this feature flipped on.

You’ll see Space chat notifications:

* As a number indicator in the left navigation next to the Space
* In your **conversation list**

To learn how to manage the chat messages in the conversation list, check out the article "[<u>How Do I Manage My Chat Messages?</u>](https://faq.mightynetworks.com/en/articles/9354575-how-do-i-manage-my-chat-messages)"

You can delete messages by hovering over them and selecting **Delete**.

## **Ways to Interact in Chat**

## **Voice Notes**

You can record and send voice notes (up to 10 minutes) in any type of chat on web or mobile.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 04 At 8 27 27 AM" />
</Frame>

**Voice notes** also come with:

* Transcripts (with non-English language detection)
* Playback speed control

<iframe title="YouTube video player" />

## **@ Mentions**

In all types of chats, you can @ mention people by typing “@” followed by their name.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 04 At 8 26 40 AM" />
</Frame>

When you mention someone in a chat, they’ll get an in-app and mobile push notification.

If you mention someone who doesn’t have access to the chat, you’ll see an error message:

“This member will not be notified because they are not a member of this Chat.”

## **Chat Replies**

**Replies** help keep conversations organized, easier to follow, and more fun.

You can reply in Space, private, or group chats by selecting the **reply** icon.

When enabled, replies trigger in-app and push notifications.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 04 At 8 25 59 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 05 04 At 8 25 59 AM" />
</Frame>

Chat threads also appear in your **conversation list** and begin with “Replies to.”

To learn more, see [**<u>How Do I Manage My Chat Messages?</u>**](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-manage-my-chat-messages#how-do-i-manage-my-chat-messages)

## **GIFs and Emoji Reactions**

React with [<u>GIFs or emojis</u>](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/how-do-i-post-in-a-mighty-network#hashtags-gifs-and-emojis) by simply selecting the icons!

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 04 At 8 24 04 AM" />
</Frame>

## **Add Files**

You can also add files locally from your computer to a chat!

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 04 At 7 50 17 AM 1" />
</Frame>

## **Start a Conversation**

If your Host has this AI feature enabled, then you will see the option to “Suggest a Conversation Starter”.

When opening a direct message or group chat with someone you haven’t chatted with before, select **Suggest a Conversation Starter**.

You’ll see a draft message based on your profiles and shared interests—you can send it as-is, edit it, or select **Try Again** for a new suggestion.

## **Turning Chat On or Off**

Your Host may have also allow you to turn off your individual private chat.

If that's an option, you will be able to see it in your [**<u>Personal Settings</u>**](https://faq.mightynetworks.com/en/articles/9953997-how-do-i-manage-my-personal-settings)\*\* > Chat.\*\*

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 05 04 At 8 20 59 AM" />
</Frame>

Because any participant can add someone to a conversation, a 1:1 chat isn’t guaranteed to stay just between 2 people unless everyone in it chooses to keep it that way.


# How Do I Join a Waitlist? 
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/untitled-page-1



If your Host is preparing to launch a Mighty Network, course, or other offering, they may invite you to join a waitlist.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Waitlist Marketing Image 1" title="Waitlist Marketing Image 1" />
</Frame>

Joining a waitlist lets them know you're interested, so they can notify you when it's available.

## **Join a Waitlist**

To join a waitlist, enter your email address in the waitlist form, and submit it.

After you sign up, you'll see a confirmation message on the page and receive a confirmation email letting you know you've been added to the waitlist.

You don't need a Mighty Networks account to join a waitlist.

## **What Happens Next?**

After joining a waitlist:

* You'll receive a confirmation email.
* Your Host will be notified that you've joined.
* When the waitlist closes, you'll receive an email with instructions for joining their Mighty Network or purchasing a Plan.

Some Hosts may also send additional updates through their email marketing platform if you've opted in.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Do I need a Mighty Networks account to join a waitlist?**

No. You can join a waitlist with your email address.

**Will I automatically become a member?**

No. Joining a waitlist lets the Host know you're interested. You'll need to accept an invitation or join when the Host opens access.

**Can I see where I am on the waitlist?**

No. Waitlists do not display your position or place in line.

**Will I receive updates while I'm on the waitlist?**

You'll receive a confirmation email after joining. Additional updates depend on how the Host chooses to communicate with people on their waitlist.

**Can I unsubscribe?**

Yes. The confirmation email includes an unsubscribe link if you no longer want to receive waitlist emails.

<br />


# How Do Streaks, Recognitions and the Leaderboard Work?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/what-are-streaks-and-recognitions



<img alt="" />

As a member, you may have noticed some fun gamification features in your Mighty Network!

If you don’t see these, check with your Host about enabling them.

### Streaks and Streak Milestones

Streaks allow you to track your daily visits to your Mighty Network!

On the web, streaks appear within the Gamification icon (next to the upper-right invite icon). On mobile, streaks appear within the profile area in the bottom tab.

The two types of streak data shown are:

* Current Streak: the current number of days in a row you’ve signed in at least once
* Max Streak: your longest streak to date

When you hit a streak milestone, an emoji will appear next to your name on posts, comments, chat, and your profile.

The streak milestones are:

* 3 day ⭐
* 7 day 🔥
* 14 day 🚀
* 30 day ⚡
* 45 day 🎉
* 60 day 💎
* 90 day 🏅
* 180 day 🏆
* 365 day 👑

We also display a weekly calendar view showing members the days they recently visited your Mighty Network.

Selecting "See More" will take you to your profile where you will see a full calendar of your streak milestones. This is public to you and everyone else in your Network.

<img alt="" />

You can toggle the calendar off per profile by going to Personal Settings > Streaks and toggle off the "Public Streak Calendar"

<img alt="" />

**Streak Notifications**

If you have at least a 2-day streak and have not signed in by 2pm in your local timezone, you will receive a push notification on your mobile device reminding you to sign in and continue your streak.

### Points, Recognitions and Community Values

In addition to streaks you can earn 10 points every day you visit your Mighty Network. You can use points to recognize other people for embodying the 5 Community values that your Host has set up.

You will see points available to you in the game icon in the upper right corner as well as any recognitions you have received.

<img alt="" />

You can click "See All" to view all the Recognitions you have received and given.

<img alt="" />

You can recognize a particular post, comment, chat, or person by hovering over their profile photo and selecting “Recognize”.

<img alt="" />

After “Recognize” is selected there is a confirmation of “Sent Recognition” and the person that has been recognized is notified.

Selecting that notification will take them to a page where they can say thanks or view the content where they were recognized. If there was an additional note added, it will appear here as well.

“Say Thanks” will open a new direct message with the member.

## Leaderboard

The **Leaderboard** highlights members who receive the most recognition for each Community Value in your Mighty Network.

It’s a simple way to see who’s showing up, contributing, and shaping the culture of the community.

There’s also a **Top Recognizers** leaderboard, which highlights members who give the most recognition to others.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 04 16 At 9 41 11 AM" />
</Frame>

### How the Leaderboard works

The Leaderboard ranks members based on the recognitions they receive from others in the Network.

Here’s what to expect:

* You’ll see the **top 10 members** for each Community Value
* Rankings are **cumulative**, based on total recognitions received
* In the case of a tie, the member who reached that total first ranks higher
* Rankings include members, moderators, and Hosts

### When the Leaderboard updates

The Leaderboard refreshes **every Monday at 7am PT**.

At that time:

* Members on the Leaderboard receive a notification (based on their notification settings)
* Other members may receive a notification to check out the latest rankings

You can manage these notifications in **Personal Settings > Notifications**.

<Frame>
  <img alt="Screenshot 2026 04 16 At 9 40 06 AM" title="Screenshot 2026 04 16 At 9 40 06 AM" />
</Frame>


# Can I Access My Mighty Network from an App?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/explore-mighty/can-i-access-my-mighty-network-from-an-app



Your Mighty Network is always within reach. You can access it from the **desktop web**, **mobile web** (through your Network's [subdomain](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/can-i-change-the-default-mnco-domain-for-my-mighty-network) or [custom domain](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/admin-and-moderation/can-i-use-my-own-web-domain-with-mighty-networks)), or our **[native iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1081683081?utm_source=intercom\&utm_medium=getting_started\&utm_campaign=download_mobile_apps\&utm_content=) and [Android apps](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mightybell.mb\&hl=en_US\&gl=US)**.

More than 65% of engagement across Mighty Networks happens on mobile—so we highly recommend downloading the app for the best experience.

## Download the Mighty Networks App

You can download the free Mighty Networks app from the **App Store** or **Google Play Store** by searching for **“Mighty Networks.”**

* **iOS:** Compatible with iPhone and iPad. Requires iOS version 15 or higher.

* **Android:** Works on all current Android devices.

You can also download the app directly from your **Personal Settings** page:

1. On the web, go to **Personal Settings > Download the App.**

2. Open your phone’s camera and scan the QR code that appears.

3. Follow the link to download the app for your Mighty Network.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/explore-mighty/can-i-access-my-mighty-network-from-an-app/Screenshot-2025-11-06-at-2_34_37-E2-80-AFPM.png)

To see which devices support our app, [check out this guide here](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/browser-and-device-support).

## Finding Your Mighty Network on the Mobile Apps

After you’ve installed the app, you’ll see two options when you open it: **Sign In** or **Discover Networks.**

* **Sign In**: Enter your email to receive a link to all Mighty Networks you’re part of.

* **Discover Networks**: Search for your Mighty Network by name and sign in when prompted.

Once you’ve signed in, the app will remember your Mighty Network until you log out.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/explore-mighty/can-i-access-my-mighty-network-from-an-app/new-app-sign-in.png)

To join another Mighty Network:

1. Open the left navigation panel.

2. Tap **Switch Networks.**

3. Select the **+** button to search for and add another Mighty Network.

## Accessing Hidden Mighty Networks

If your Mighty Network's [privacy](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/how-do-i-set-the-privacy-settings-for-my-network) setting is **Only invited members can see and find it**, it won't appear in the app's search results.

To access your hidden Network:

1. Log in to your Mighty Network using your **mobile web browser.**

2. Tap the prompt at the bottom that says **View in App.**

3. Follow the link to open your Mighty Network in the app.

You’ll only need to do this the first time you visit.

## Enabling Mobile Push Notifications

Mobile Push notifications are **off by default.**

To turn them on:

1. Download the **Mighty Networks App.**

2. On the web, click **Download App** to generate a QR code, then scan it with your phone.

3. After downloading, you’ll be prompted to **enable notifications.**

To manage them later, go to **Profile Picture > Personal Settings > Notifications** and toggle **Mobile Push** on or off.

If you previously denied notifications, go to your **device settings** to manually enable them.

## Internet Connection Requirements

Course and video content require an active internet connection. Members must be connected to **Wi-Fi** or within a **cellular data range** to access content. Offline access is not currently supported.

* **Google Chrome**
* **Mozilla Firefox**
* **Microsoft Edge**
* **Apple Safari**

* **iOS 14+**: Choose between Safari or Chrome for a smooth experience.

* **iOS or iPad OS 17+**: Immerse yourself in our vibrant community with devices running these versions.

# How Do I Leave a Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-leave-a-mighty-network



You can choose to leave a Mighty Network you belong to by logging into your account on web and going to your **Profile Image > Personal Settings > Account > Deactivate My Account.**

On the Android app, you can go to **Personal Settings > Account > Deactivate My Account > Confirmation.**

*(At the moment, it is not possible to deactivate your account from the iOS app. To do so, you'll need to login to your account via web browser with the instructions as outlined above.)*

From here, if you choose to **Leave this Network** you will instantly leave the Network and you'll stop receiving notifications. However, keep in mind that when you leave a Network, your activity (such as any comments or posts that you added) will still be visible to other members.

You can also permanently delete your account on the same menu by using the link found under the text: "To permanently delete your account, click here."

Here's what it looks like on the web:

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-leave-a-mighty-network/deactivate-account.png)

Here's what it looks like on mobile:

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-leave-a-mighty-network/change-email-mobile.png)

If you're a member of a Mighty Network where you pay a monthly or annual subscription to get access, your account will automatically be cancelled at the end of the current billing period when you choose to leave a Network.

*Please note: if you are a member of a Mighty Network that takes payments externally, you will lose access to your membership as soon as you choose to deactivate it and not at the end of your billing cycle. If you are unsure, please send us a note.*

Similarly, once you leave a Mighty Network, you won't be able to access any content inside, regardless if you previously paid for it. This applies to Mighty Networks that take payments externally.​

If you decide to re-join that Mighty Network in the future, you can always log in again with the same email address or login credentials that you used before.

If you would instead prefer to permanently delete your account and remove *all* of your activity and posts from that Network, click the option to **permanently delete your account** link at the bottom of the page when you're signed in **on your web browser (Chrome, Safari, etc.)**.


# How Do I Manage My Membership or Space Purchases?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-manage-my-membership-or-space-purchases



Managing your purchases and subscriptions in Mighty Networks is simple. Whether you need to update your billing, cancel a subscription, or download invoices, here’s everything you need to know.

## Viewing and Managing Your Purchases

To view and manage your subscriptions:

1. Click your profile picture in the upper-right corner when logged in on a web browser.
2. Go to "Plans and Access" in your profile menu.

## How to Cancel a Subscription

Canceling a subscription is easy. Here’s how:

## For Subscriptions Purchased on the Web or Mobile Web:

1. Go to "Plans and Access".
2. Find your active subscription.
3. Click "Cancel Subscription".

You’ll still have access to the Plan until the end of your billing cycle.

## For Subscriptions Purchased via the iOS App Store:

**To fully cancel, go to your Device Settings:**

1. Open your device’s Settings.
2. Tap your name at the top, then go to "Media & Purchases" > "View Account".
3. Scroll down and select "Subscriptions".
4. Find your Network's subscription and tap "Cancel Subscription".

**Important Note**: If you have questions about billing or need a refund, it's best to contact your Host first. They manage payments through Stripe. If you still need help, feel free to [reach out to the Mighty Networks team](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/explore-mighty/where-can-i-get-help).

## How to Move Between Subscription Plans

If your Host offers multiple Plans, you can **move yourself** between eligible subscription Plans on web or iOS without needing to cancel and rejoin.

To move between Plans on web:

* Go to **Personal Settings > Plans and Access**.
* Select your current Plan.
* Click **Change Plan** and choose an available Plan.

1. Open the Network's iOS app and log in.
2. Tap your profile picture in the bottom-right corner.
3. Select "Plans and Access" and choose the subscription you'd like to cancel.
4. Scroll to the bottom and tap "Change Plan".

**Things to know:**

* For upgrades, you will be charged and moved at the end of your billing cycle. You will also be able to choose a billing interval: monthly or annual if there is an option.
* Downgrades take effect at the next billing cycle.
* If you move to a plan that is the same price, the change will happen immediately.
* You cannot move yourself while on a **free trial**.
* If you move to a plan with a free trial, you will bypass it and begin paying immediately.
* You can only move between visible Plans that you are eligible to access.​

## Changing Your Billing Interval (Monthly or Annual)

If your Host offers both monthly and annual Plans, you can switch between them. Here’s how:

1. On the web, go to "Personal Settings" > "Plans and Access".
2. Select the Plan you want to switch.
3. Choose Switch to Annual/Monthly.

**Things to Remember**:

* You can’t change your billing interval during a free trial. You’ll need to wait until your trial ends or cancel the subscription.
* The switch will take effect on your next billing date, and you’ll be billed for the new Plan then.
* If you were invited to a free Plan by the Host, this option won’t apply.

## Downloading Invoices

Need to download invoices for your records? Here’s how:

1. Click your profile picture in the upper-right corner.
2. Go to Plans and Access.
3. Select your Paid Plan.
4. Under "Invoices", find your last 10 invoices.
5. Click "View Invoice" to download.

## What happens if your Host moves you to a new Plan?

Sometimes, your Host may move you to a new Plan. Here’s what to expect:

* You’ll receive an email, in-app notification, and push notification (if enabled) about the move.
* You may need to add billing details or verify the purchase.

If your Host moves you to a Paid Plan and you don’t verify or update your billing information within 7 days, the move will be canceled, and you’ll stay on your current Plan.

## Understanding Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)

For some credit card purchases, banks require [Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)](https://stripe.com/guides/strong-customer-authentication) to protect against fraud.

* SCA is needed for new purchases online, such as when your Host moves you to a new Plan. (Renewals don’t require SCA.)

1. You’ll receive a message prompting you to verify your billing information.
2. A red banner will appear when you log in, reminding you to complete verification.
3. You’ll have 7 days to verify your card details before the move is canceled.

If the move is canceled, you’ll remain on your current Plan, and your Host will be notified.

## Adding a Tax ID for Tax-Exempt Purchases

In some countries (EU, UK, New Zealand, and Australia), Hosts may allow you to add a Tax ID to your account for tax-exempt purchases.

To add or update your Tax ID:

1. Click your profile picture in the top right corner > "Personal Settings" > "Account" > "Billing".
2. Enter your Tax ID number.

By following these steps, you can easily manage your memberships, subscriptions, and purchases in Mighty Networks. Have questions? Click your profile picture > "Help Center" to reach our team.

## If You Paid Outside of Mighty Networks

If you didn't purchase your Plan directly through Mighty Networks, your Host is processing payments outside our platform.

To manage your subscriptions or access invoices, you'll need to do so through the platform where you originally made your purchase. Your Host may also share details in the community on how to manage your subscription.

If you need help with managing your payment outside of Mighty Networks, we recommend [reaching out to your Host directly](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-can-i-get-technical-support-as-a-member).

Not sure whether your Plan was purchased outside of Mighty Networks? Contact our team at [**chat@mightynetworks.com**](), and we’ll be happy to confirm!


# How Do I Purchase a Token-Gated Plan?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-purchase-a-token-gated-plan



It's easy! When viewing a Token-Gated Plan, click the Token’s name to view the details needed to join.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-purchase-a-token-gated-plan/Screen_Shot_2022-09-02_at_2_56_16_PM.png)

As a first step, you will want to purchase the required tokens or NFTs for the Plan and set up your Crypto Wallet.

## What is a Crypto Wallet?

It's a software wallet that can be used to interact with a blockchain and decentralized applications, usually in the form of a browser extension or mobile app. [MetaMask](https://metamask.io/) and [Coinbase Wallet](https://www.coinbase.com/wallet) are two popular Crypto Wallet examples. Check out this [helpful video on how to set up a wallet.](https://youtu.be/byNNauAJrKI)

## How would I start exploring the world of NFTs?

A common place to start is visiting an NFT marketplace ([OpenSea](https://opensea.io/) is a popular destination) and exploring your options from there.

You can also visit OpenSea's [learning center](https://opensea.io/learn/how-to-buy-nft) to get a step-by-step guide to purchasing an NFT. From there, you’ll be able to easily browse and purchase NFTs (most of them existing on the [Ethereum](https://ethereum.org/en/) blockchain) using your Crypto Wallet.

When you're ready to proceed, click “Access” on the Plan.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-purchase-a-token-gated-plan/Screen_Shot_2022-09-02_at_2_56_16_PM.png)

If the Plan includes access to a Mighty Network, you will be prompted to create a profile.​

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-purchase-a-token-gated-plan/Screen_Shot_2022-09-02_at_2_57_56_PM.png)

If you’ve already purchased the proper token amount or required NFT, you’ll be prompted to then add your Crypto Wallet.

If the Plan is for only a Space, then you will be prompted to add a Wallet:

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-purchase-a-token-gated-plan/Screen_Shot_2022-09-16_at_10_30_09_AM.png)

## Adding a Wallet

On web, we support MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet and WalletConnect. On Android, we support MetaMask and WalletConnect. On iOS, we support MetaMask.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-purchase-a-token-gated-plan/Screen_Shot_2022-09-28_at_11_21_13_AM.png)

After connecting your Wallet and successfully validating that you’ve met the token requirement, you’ll be granted access to the Plan.

We will continually check that you still have access to the required token, so if the gate requirements are no longer met (through selling, transferring or losing access), you’ll no longer have access to the Plan. Both you and your Network Hosts will receive a notification if this happens.

For gating based on token amounts, we don’t currently support combining token amounts across multiple wallets.

## Disconnecting A Wallet

If you need to disconnect your Wallet at anytime, just visit Your Profile > Account > Web3 Wallets:

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-purchase-a-token-gated-plan/Screen_Shot_2022-09-02_at_3_08_46_PM.png)

Select the Wallet you would like to disconnect:

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-purchase-a-token-gated-plan/Screen_Shot_2022-09-02_at_3_08_55_PM.png)

If you are a member of any Plans that require you to have a Token to access them and you remove the Wallet qualifying your membership, you will be removed from the Plan. Our system checks your wallet hourly to ensure that you still have the required tokens for membership.

# What Notifications Will I Get as a Member?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-member



**Notifications** serve as a way for you to see the updates about activity in your Mighty Network.

Change what you're notified about as well as how you're notified by clicking your profile picture and going to Personal Settings -> Notifications.

## Five Ways You Receive Notifications

You can receive notifications through five different channels: in-app, email, desktop, mobile push and pop-up notifications.

**In-app notifications**: By default, you will receive notifications based on your notification settings via the bell icon.

**Email notifications (on by default):** If you have Email Updates turned on in notification settings, you will receive email notifications at the email address you used to join your Mighty Network. Here’s an example:

**Mobile push notifications (off by default)**: These notifications will appear on your mobile device when activity happens in your Mighty Network. Here’s what a mobile push notification looks like:

If you would like to enable desktop notifications, [check out this article](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/content-and-messaging/how-do-i-enable-desktop-notifications).

**Pop-up notifications (on by default):** These notifications will appear temporarily in the lower right corner of the screen. These notifications will appear for direct chat messages and Space Chat Messages.

If you would like to turn on or off the Space Chat Message notifications for all your Spaces, you can do so in **Personal Settings > Notifications > Space Chat Messages**. If you would like to mute Space Chat Messages for a Space, you can do so by selecting the three-dot menu next to the Space and clicking "Mute Chat"

## Default Notifications and Settings When You First Create Your Account

When you first create your Mighty Networks account, here’s how your notifications and settings are set by default:

* **All sounds** are turned on.

* **Appearance** is set to match your Device Settings (so it will follow your light or dark mode preferences).

* **Email updates** are toggled on, with the frequency set to **Daily Digest** (instead of "As Activity Happens").

* **All notifications** are turned on, except for "All Posts."

You can easily customize them to match your preferences.

## How to Manage Sounds for Notifications

In addition to managing your notifications, you can also choose whether or not to have sound alerts for them. Here’s how:

1. Click on your profile picture.

2. Select "Personal Settings."

3. Click on "Appearance and Sounds."

4. From here, you can toggle the sound on or off for "Notifications," "Chat," and "System."

This way, you have full control over how you’re alerted to activity in your Mighty Network.

## How to Enable or Disable Email and Mobile Push Notifications

**Email Notifications**​

Email notifications are on by default. To toggle email notifications on or off, click your profile picture -> Personal Settings -> Notifications. From there, you can easily toggle email notifications on or off.

*Why does it say that I'm unsubscribed?*

A member can be marked as unsubscribed for a few reasons:

* The email provider is flagging "@mn.co" email notifications.

* The email provider’s settings have been updated, so they flag our email notifications.

* The email provider’s filters pick up the "@mn.co" email address and bounce the email.

* The email provider has "@mn.co" on a spam list, which flags our email delivery system.

* The member accidentally marked our emails as spam.

To help prevent this, we encourage you to safelist @mn.co emails within your email provider. For more information on those steps, visit [https://thegoodlifepath.org/safelist/](https://thegoodlifepath.org/safelist/).

If you need to resubscribe yourself to our emails, you will see a "Contact Support" button in your notification settings. Tap that button, or email [help@mightynetworks.com](mailto:help@mightynetworks.com) and we'll get you back on track.

**Choose Email Frequency**​

If you prefer to only get one email per day with a roundup of all your notifications, you can select to receive a Daily Digest. The Daily Digest is enabled by default.

The Daily Digest email will be sent to you at the end of each day with a summary of your unread notifications. Note that time-sensitive notifications (like event reminders) may still send as activity happens. If you click on an in-app notification, it will be considered read and not appear in the Daily Digest

Your Daily Digest can include a combination of the following notification types:

* New Posts & Activity: New content, comments, @Mentions, plus Event and Poll-related updates

* New Course Content: Published and unlocked Course content

* Welcome Invites to Mighty Network and Spaces

* Notify All Members

* New Members joined: Members with a similar Custom Field or who are near you

* Ambassador Program Updates: Referred Members joined, new Ambassador level reached

Otherwise, you can select to have notifications sent as activity happens.

The following notifications bypass the Daily Digest setting and are sent in real-time:

* Message all members from Hosts

* Your Host just went Live

* Event Reminders

* User Reported

* Welcome Checklist Reminder

**Mobile Push Notifications**​

Mobile Push notifications are off by default.

To enable Mobile Push notifications, first [download the Mighty Networks App](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/setting-up-your-network/does-mighty-networks-have-an-app). When you're logged in on the web, click on the Download App button which prompts you to enter your mobile number. You will then receive an SMS Text with a link to download the app.

Once you’ve downloaded the app, you’ll be prompted to enable Mobile Push notifications.

[<img alt="" />](/images/for-members/account-and-purchases/what-notifications-will-i-get-as-a-member/Push-Notifications-Welcome.png)

If you’d like to manage your mobile push notifications moving forward, you can do so by tapping your profile picture -> Personal Settings -> Notifications. From there, you can toggle Mobile Push notifications on or off.

If you previously turned off Mobile Push notifications through your mobile device settings or didn’t allow notifications when prompted, then you may need to visit your device settings to manually allow the Mighty Networks app to send Mobile Push notifications.

## Select Notifications as Read or Unread

You can select individual notifications to be marked as read or unread by selecting the three-dot menu next to each notification:

## Select the Types of Notifications You Receive

Once you've selected how you want to be notified, you can toggle which types of notifications you want to receive via email and/or mobile push. You will always receive in-app notifications for any notifications you have toggled on.

* **Reactions On Your Stuff:** When others emoji react on Posts, Articles, Questions, Polls, and Comments you created.

* **Comments On Your Stuff**: When others comment on Posts, Articles, Events, Questions, and Polls you created.

* **Comments After You**: If others comment after your comment or reply in a thread, you will be notified. However, you will not be notified about replies to other comments in the thread.

* **@Mentions:** When others tag you directly in a Post, Comment or Chat.

* **Updates From Your Hosts:** When a Host posts or sends a message.

* **Event Updates and Reminders:** When the Event Host sends an update or when reminders are sent before an event starts.

* **Poll Answers and Results:** When others vote on your Polls.

* **Activities Relevant to You:** When people near you join, or when there is relevant trending activity.

* **Activities From Members You Follow**: When members you follow post new content

* **Private Chat Messages**: Push and in-app notification when other members and Hosts send you private chat messages, including chat replies. No email option.

* **Space Chat Messages:** Push and in-app notification for messages from other members in a Space, including chat replies. No email option.

* **Ambassador Notifications**: When members you referred join the Network, and when you level up your Ambassador status.

* **New Course Material:** When new Course material is published or unlocked.

* **Livestream:** When a Host goes live anywhere in the Network you have access to.

* **All Posts:** When there’s any type of new post

## Space Notifications

At the bottom of your notifications list, you can also turn on notifications for specific Space that you are a member of.

Please note: If you turn off email and mobile push notifications at the Network notification level, you will not receive notifications for a Space.

## Other Notifications You May Receive

You may also receive the following types of notifications:

**Account-specific:**

1. Welcomes, invites, reminders, and approvals to join a Mighty Network or Space

2. List of Mighty Networks you’re a member of (when signing in via [mightynetworks.com](https://mightynetworks.com/sign_in?_ga=2.121489420.544297043.1655134287-1427381717.1651266887&_gac=1.51964507.1656096873.CjwKCAjwwdWVBhA4EiwAjcYJELg4DzP3IY_HIvTUhNC2cI8CehHtieMCiXKGBQc-GlKhGASd8fmE8hoCTsMQAvD_BwE))

3. Password or sign-in-related notifications

4. You were added to the Network or Spaces

\*\*Badges awarded:\*\*If your Host [awards you a Badge](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/engage-and-interact/what-are-streaks-and-recognitions), you will receive an email, in-app and mobile push notification (if enabled).

**Host or Moderator actions:** Host or Moderator chooses to “Notify All” or message all Members, or has gone live

**Payment/Plan notifications:** Status updates or changes for free trials, payments, and one-time or subscription Plans.

**Waitlist confirmations:** If you join a [Waitlist](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-hosts/payments-and-access/how-do-i-create-a-waitlist), you'll receive a confirmation email. If you're already a full member of the Network, you'll also get an in-app or push notification.


# Why Can't I Log In to My Mighty Network?
Source: https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/why-cant-i-log-in-to-my-mighty-network



If you're having trouble logging into your Mighty Network, here are a few things to ensure:

1. **Correct URL**: Make sure you're using the correct URL for the Mighty Network you're trying to log into.​

2. **Correct Email Address**: Use the email address associated with your account when you first signed up. If you initially signed up using Social Sign In (Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, or Apple), try those options to log in. If you'd like to switch to signing in with your email, you'll need to [reset your password](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-set-or-reset-my-password).​

3. **Separate Logins for Each Network**: Remember, every Mighty Network is standalone, meaning you'll need a separate profile and login for each one you're part of. You can use the same login information for each Network if you prefer.​

4. **Switching Between Networks**:​

   * **On Mobile**: Once you log in to a Mighty Network app, you can easily switch between Networks without needing to log in again. Just click the three line menu in the top left corner > click "Switch Networks".​

   * **On Web**: Once logged in, you can easily hop between Networks by going directly to the URL in your web browser. For easy navigation, consider bookmarking the landing pages of all the Mighty Networks you're a member of.

## Resetting Your Password

If you need to [reset your password](https://docs.mightynetworks.com/for-members/account-and-purchases/how-do-i-set-or-reset-my-password), please note the following:

1. **Use a Web Browser**: You can only reset your password through a web browser, not through the mobile app.​

2. **Forgot Password?**: Login through a web browser, go to the Sign In page of your Mighty Network, and click the "Forgot password?" link. Enter your email address and click "Send Email." The password reset email is valid for one hour, but you can send yourself as many reset emails as needed.

If you haven't received the email, be sure to search your inbox for "password" and check your spam and junk folders. If you're still having trouble, email us at [chat@mightynetworks.com]().

## Why was I logged out of my Mighty Network?

For security, login sessions on both web and mobile apps auto-renew regularly, as long as you've accessed your Network in recent months. If it's been a while since your last visit, you may be asked to log in again.​

## Account Disabled?

If your account has been disabled, here are a couple of reasons why that might have happened:

1. **Banned by Host or Moderator**: A Network Host or Moderator may have banned your account.​

2. **Flagged for Spam**: Your account might have been flagged for spam due to sending repeated messages.

If you believe your account was disabled by mistake, you can email us at [chat@mightynetworks.com](), and we’ll take a look. However, if your account was banned by a Host or Moderator, please note that we cannot overturn their decision.
